\section{Traffic Safety Laws, Regulations \& Rules \;/\; 道路交通安全法律法规}

\needspace{14\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1.}\ 
[Image] The way the vehicle marked in the red circle is using its lights, as shown, is correct.\par
\smallskip\begin{center}\includegraphics[width=6cm,height=4cm,keepaspectratio]{work/img/201904101025192asdcqevyphgpzrvkk8wrd.jpg}\end{center}\smallskip
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：如图所示，红圈中标记车辆使用灯光的方法是正确的。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Do not use high beams when meeting oncoming traffic at night; switch to low beams beyond 150 meters, since high beams blind the other driver.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{14\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2.}\ 
The maximum speed on this stretch of road is 50 km/h.\par
\smallskip\begin{center}\includegraphics[width=6cm,height=4cm,keepaspectratio]{work/img/201904101025198abgdewmbcnnnshjacrsme.jpg}\end{center}\smallskip
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：在这段路的最高时速为每小时50公里。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  A blue sign with white text shows a minimum speed limit, while a red-circled white sign shows a maximum speed limit.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{14\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{3.}\ 
[Image] When encountering this situation while driving, you may tap the horn lightly to alert the non-motor vehicles and pedestrians ahead that a vehicle is approaching from behind.\par
\smallskip\begin{center}\includegraphics[width=6cm,height=4cm,keepaspectratio]{work/img/20190410102519axaknvfjwaxddh4qs3dht3.jpg}\end{center}\smallskip
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：如图所示，驾驶机动车遇到这种情况，可以轻按喇叭提醒前方非机动车和行人后方有来车。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  A non-motor vehicle ahead is in the middle of the road, so a warning horn tap is appropriate.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{14\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{4.}\ 
In this situation, you must stop and yield to pedestrians.\par
\smallskip\begin{center}\includegraphics[width=6cm,height=4cm,keepaspectratio]{work/img/20190410102519cmq3ycnqrcacutqhrbmksy.jpg}\end{center}\smallskip
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：遇到这种情形时要停车避让行人。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Pedestrians have priority, so motor vehicles must take care to yield to them.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{14\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{5.}\ 
[Image] When driving straight and encountering congestion ahead, a vehicle may stop temporarily to wait within the yellow grid-marked area, but must not stop on the crosswalk.\par
\smallskip\begin{center}\includegraphics[width=6cm,height=4cm,keepaspectratio]{work/img/20190410102519l2jtbhekpkupwf5fuztxmq.jpg}\end{center}\smallskip
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：如图所示，驾驶机动车直行遇前方道路堵塞时，车辆可以在黄色网格线区域临时停车等待，但不得在人行横道停车。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Both crosswalks and yellow grid no-stopping zones prohibit stopping, so vehicles must wait outside the intersection.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{6.}\ 
When the road ahead has fewer lanes and traffic is moving slowly, vehicles should merge alternately, one from each lane, to keep traffic orderly and safe.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：遇前方路段车道减少行驶缓慢，为了有序、安全，应依次交替通行。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Random lane changes or cutting in when lanes merge cause worse congestion and can lead to accidents.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{14\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{7.}\ 
In this situation, you may speed up to cross the crosswalk.\par
\smallskip\begin{center}\includegraphics[width=6cm,height=4cm,keepaspectratio]{work/img/2019041010252012i7vrwk88s7cg32pahqec.jpg}\end{center}\smallskip
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：在这种情况下可以加速通过人行横道。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  When pedestrians are crossing at a crosswalk, you must stop and yield, then proceed only after they have passed.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{14\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{8.}\ 
This passenger car's way of entering the expressway travel lane is correct.\par
\smallskip\begin{center}\includegraphics[width=6cm,height=4cm,keepaspectratio]{work/img/2019041010252012svcks4mrxydliuyjgwft.jpg}\end{center}\smallskip
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：这辆小型载客汽车进入高速公路行车道的行为是正确的。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  When entering an expressway, a vehicle must follow the ground guide lines.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{14\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{9.}\ 
[Image] What the dark-colored vehicle marked by the red circle is doing, as shown, is illegal.\par
\smallskip\begin{center}\includegraphics[width=6cm,height=4cm,keepaspectratio]{work/img/201904101025202husd4t998uxfqcxdhwtkc.jpg}\end{center}\smallskip
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：如图所示，红圈标注的深色车辆的做法是违法的。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  You must signal well before changing lanes, and a solid line must not be crossed.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{10.}\ 
When driving uphill and nearing the top of the slope, you should accelerate and sound the horn.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车上坡时，在将要到达坡道顶端时要加速并鸣喇叭。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Near the top of a slope the driver's view is blocked, so accelerating there can easily cause an accident.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{11.}\ 
When driving through an intersection, you must obey the traffic signals.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车通过交叉路口要遵守交通信号。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Traffic signals include traffic lights, traffic signs, road markings, and police directions.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{12.}\ 
When opening a vehicle door, you must not obstruct other vehicles or pedestrians.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：打开机动车车门时，不得妨碍其他车辆和行人通行。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Watch for oncoming traffic and pedestrians before opening a door so you do not block their path.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{14\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{13.}\ 
In this situation, you may use the bus lane on the right to overtake.\par
\smallskip\begin{center}\includegraphics[width=6cm,height=4cm,keepaspectratio]{work/img/20190410102520dknfcdawiuj9lgnjo9unfa.jpg}\end{center}\smallskip
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：在这种情况下可以借右侧公交车道超车。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Bus-only lanes may not be used by other vehicles.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{14.}\ 
On an urban road without a center line, a motor vehicle's maximum speed must not exceed 50 km/h.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车在没有中心线的城市道路上，最高速度不能超过每小时50公里。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Without a center line the limit is 30 km/h in cities and 40 km/h on highways; with a center line it is 50 and 70 km/h.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{14\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{15.}\ 
[Image] The vehicle marked in the picture is allowed to park at this location.\par
\smallskip\begin{center}\includegraphics[width=6cm,height=4cm,keepaspectratio]{work/img/20190410102520jjxyteqquyaj64ukh5yu2g.jpg}\end{center}\smallskip
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：图中标注车辆在该地点停车是可以的。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  No parking is allowed within 30 meters of a stop or 50 meters of an intersection.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{16.}\ 
When driving in sandstorm or dusty conditions, you do not need to turn on the headlights, clearance lights, and rear position lights.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车在沙尘天气条件下行车不用开启前照灯、示廓灯和后位灯。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  In sandstorm or dusty weather, you should turn on headlights, clearance lights, and rear position lights.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{14\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{17.}\ 
On this stretch of road, you may stop temporarily in the non-motor-vehicle lane.\par
\smallskip\begin{center}\includegraphics[width=6cm,height=4cm,keepaspectratio]{work/img/20190410102520mnw8toaw96y7ay8nyrhubu.jpg}\end{center}\smallskip
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：这个路段可以在非机动车道上临时停车。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  The non-motor-vehicle lane is for non-motor vehicles; motor vehicles are prohibited from stopping there.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{14\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{18.}\ 
[Image] At an intersection with this sign, you should slow down and yield.\par
\smallskip\begin{center}\includegraphics[width=6cm,height=4cm,keepaspectratio]{work/img/20190410102520q7sr8psx7sz6unaedg2xxv.jpg}\end{center}\smallskip
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：如图所示，通过这个标志的路口时应该减速让行。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  An octagonal sign with the character for 'Stop' means stop and yield, while a triangular 'Yield' sign means slow down and yield.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{14\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{19.}\ 
[Image] What the motor vehicle is doing as it reaches the intersection, as shown, is correct.\par
\smallskip\begin{center}\includegraphics[width=6cm,height=4cm,keepaspectratio]{work/img/20190410102520qxjvhb6lgv9zrp6vrjenhs.jpg}\end{center}\smallskip
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：如图所示，当机动车行驶至交叉口时的做法是正确的。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  The signal shown is a round green light, which allows vehicles to go straight or turn right.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{14\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{20.}\ 
[Image] You may make a U-turn at the intersection ahead.\par
\smallskip\begin{center}\includegraphics[width=6cm,height=4cm,keepaspectratio]{work/img/20190410102520rlwungf1q7w6fu7uzxqmiy.jpg}\end{center}\smallskip
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：如图所示，在前方路口可以掉头。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Railway crossings have complex conditions, so making a U-turn there can easily cause an accident.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{21.}\ 
Reversing is prohibited at intersections and inside tunnels.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：在交叉路口、隧道内均不能倒车。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Conditions at intersections and inside tunnels are complex, so reversing there easily causes accidents.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{22.}\ 
At an intersection without traffic signals, when the vehicle ahead is moving slowly, vehicles should proceed in turn, alternating.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车在没有交通信号的路口遇到前方车辆缓慢行驶时要依次交替通行。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Traffic conditions at intersections without signals are complex, so vehicles should slow down and proceed cautiously in turn.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{23.}\ 
When a motor vehicle breaks down on an expressway, a warning triangle should be placed 50 to 100 meters behind it, on the side traffic is coming from.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车在高速公路上发生故障时，在来车方向50至100米处设置警告标志。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  The warning triangle should be placed more than 150 meters back on an expressway; 50-150 meters applies to ordinary roads.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{24.}\ 
When the intersection ahead is congested, if there is no yellow grid marking inside it, you may stop and wait inside the intersection.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车遇前方交叉路口交通阻塞时，路口内无网状线的，可停在路口内等候。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  When an intersection is congested, vehicles should queue and wait outside the stop line, not inside the intersection.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{25.}\ 
When a vehicle breaks down and cannot move, a warning triangle should first be placed 50-150 meters behind it to prevent rear-end collisions.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：车辆发生故障而无法移动时，首先应在车辆后方50-150米处放置危险警告标志，防止后车追尾。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  The correct placement is 50-100 meters on an ordinary road and more than 150 meters on an expressway.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{14\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{26.}\ 
[Image] Vehicle A is allowed to park here.\par
\smallskip\begin{center}\includegraphics[width=6cm,height=4cm,keepaspectratio]{work/img/201904101025216ma22pdct412koehm6rbxt.jpg}\end{center}\smallskip
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：如图所示，A车在此处停车是可以的。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  No parking is allowed within 30 meters of a stop or 50 meters of an intersection.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{14\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{27.}\ 
Is the following action correct?\par
\smallskip\begin{center}\includegraphics[width=6cm,height=4cm,keepaspectratio]{work/img/201904101025216pwpafzkffwgwspzl7kpu9.jpg}\end{center}\smallskip
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：下列做法是否正确？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  When towing, speed must not exceed 30 km/h, the following distance must be more than 150 meters, and the vehicle must travel in the rightmost lane.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{14\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{28.}\ 
You may make a U-turn at this intersection.\par
\smallskip\begin{center}\includegraphics[width=6cm,height=4cm,keepaspectratio]{work/img/201904101025217kdpupjzs7ngeeqmzlrpnh.jpg}\end{center}\smallskip
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：在这个路口可以掉头。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Follow traffic signals; safety comes first.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{29.}\ 
A motor vehicle should turn on the turn signal at the same time as it changes lanes.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车应在变更车道的同时开启转向灯。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  You should signal well before changing lanes, ensuring a safe distance before actually changing.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{30.}\ 
Do not hang or place items that obstruct the driver's view within the front or rear windshield area of the cab.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：不要在驾驶室的前后窗范围内悬挂和放置妨碍驾驶人视线的物品。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  A clear view for the driver is essential to ensure safe driving.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{31.}\ 
When driving over a flooded road or flooded bridge, you should stop and check the water conditions first.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车行经漫水路或者漫水桥时，应当停车察明水情。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  You must confirm it is safe before crossing a flooded section of road.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{32.}\ 
When making a U-turn, turning, or driving down a steep slope, a motor vehicle's maximum speed must not exceed 40 km/h.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车掉头、转弯、下陡坡时的最高速度不能超过每小时40公里。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  The speed limit for U-turns, turns, and steep downhill driving is 30 km/h.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{33.}\ 
Traffic signs and road markings are not part of traffic signals.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：交通标志和交通标线不属于交通信号。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Signs and markings are both used to convey traffic signals.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{14\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{34.}\ 
At this position in the intersection, you may speed up to get through it.\par
\smallskip\begin{center}\includegraphics[width=6cm,height=4cm,keepaspectratio]{work/img/20190410102521kx9efzjbxnj239vapqncxc.jpg}\end{center}\smallskip
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：在路口这个位置时可以加速通过路口。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Stop on red, go on green, and slow to a stop when yellow appears.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{14\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{35.}\ 
When approaching a railway crossing in this situation, you must stop and observe.\par
\smallskip\begin{center}\includegraphics[width=6cm,height=4cm,keepaspectratio]{work/img/20190410102521lir5yuqqhgmjr1ywvlqggg.jpg}\end{center}\smallskip
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：行至这种情况的铁路道口要停车观察。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  The rule is: stop, look, then proceed.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{36.}\ 
In sandstorm, hail, rain, fog, icy, or similar weather conditions, a motor vehicle should reduce its speed.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车遇到沙尘、冰雹、雨、雾、结冰等气象条件时应降低行驶速度。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  In driving, safety always comes first.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{37.}\ 
Other vehicles are not permitted to drive in a dedicated lane, so as not to affect the normal passage of the vehicles it is reserved for.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：其他车辆不准进入专用车道行驶，其目的是为了不影响专用车的正常通行。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  A dedicated lane is for its designated vehicles only; other vehicles may not use it.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{14\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{38.}\ 
[Image] Vehicle B has the right of way.\par

{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：如图所示，B车具有优先通行权。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Right turns yield to left turns, left turns yield to going straight, and turning yields to going straight.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{39.}\ 
Overtaking is prohibited in tunnels, on steep slopes, and other special sections of road.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车在隧道、陡坡等特殊路段不得超车。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Conditions in tunnels and on steep slopes are complex, so overtaking there easily causes accidents.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{40.}\ 
When making a U-turn on the road, a motor vehicle should turn on the left turn signal in advance.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车在道路上掉头时提前开启左转向灯。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  A U-turn is made by turning left, so you should use the left turn signal.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{41.}\ 
Parking is prohibited within 50 meters of a narrow road less than 4 meters wide.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：距离宽度不足4米的窄路50米以内的路段不能停车。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  The same no-parking buffer, 30 meters from a stop and 50 meters from an intersection, applies to narrow roads too.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{14\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{42.}\ 
On this sharp curve, you should alternate between high and low beams while driving.\par
\smallskip\begin{center}\includegraphics[width=6cm,height=4cm,keepaspectratio]{work/img/201904101025229opskhnjdbyqlc3kagz9er.jpg}\end{center}\smallskip
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：在这种急弯道路上行车应交替使用远近光灯。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  At night, when driving through a sharp curve, alternate high and low beams to signal your presence.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{43.}\ 
At night, the correct practice when meeting oncoming traffic on a narrow road or narrow bridge is to use high beams.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：夜间驾驶机动车在窄路、窄桥会车时正确的做法是使用远光灯。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  At night when meeting oncoming traffic, switch to low beams beyond 150 meters.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{14\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{44.}\ 
[Image] When traffic ahead is moving slowly, it is correct to use the bus-only lane to overtake.\par

{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：如图所示，驾驶机动车遇前方车流行驶缓慢时，借用公交专用道超车是正确的。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Other vehicles may not use or overtake in a bus-only lane.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{45.}\ 
A motor vehicle must not make a U-turn at railway crossings, on bridges, steep slopes, in tunnels, or on other sections prone to danger.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车在铁路道口、桥梁、陡坡、隧道或者容易发生危险的路段不能掉头。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  These are complex road conditions that easily cause accidents, so U-turns are prohibited there.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{46.}\ 
When a motor vehicle breaks down on the road and cannot move, a warning triangle should be placed within 50 meters behind it.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车在道路上发生故障难以移动时要在车后50米以内设置警告标志。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  First move occupants out of the vehicle to safety, turn on hazard lights, place the warning triangle 50-100 meters behind, then call for help.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{47.}\ 
While driving, you may throw or scatter items onto the road.\par

{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车时可以向道路上抛撒物品。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Throwing or scattering items onto the road while driving is prohibited, as it may obstruct other vehicles or pedestrians.}\par\smallskip

You may enter the expressway travel lane directly from this position.\par

{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：可以从这个位置直接驶入高速公路行车道。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Entering an expressway must follow the ground guide markings.}\par\smallskip

In this situation, you may enter the yellow grid-marked area and stop to wait.\par

{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：遇到这种情况的路段，可以进入网状线区域内停车等候。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Although the light shown is green, traffic ahead is congested, so you should stop and wait outside the intersection.}\par\smallskip

\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{50.}\ 
[Image] Vehicle A has the right of way.\par

{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：如图所示，A车具有优先通行权。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  At an intersection with no signal, sign, or markings, the vehicle coming from the right goes first.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{51.}\ 
After taking a state-controlled psychotropic drug, you may still drive a motor vehicle for a short distance.\par

{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：服用国家管制的精神药品可以短途驾驶机动车。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  After taking state-controlled psychotropic drugs, you must not drive a motor vehicle on the road at all.}\par\smallskip

When turning right at an intersection and the vehicle ahead in the same lane is waiting for the go signal, you should queue and wait your turn.\par

{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：在路口右转弯遇同车道前车等候放行信号时，要依次停车等候。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  When the vehicle ahead is waiting for the signal, you should queue and wait rather than force your way through to turn right.}\par\smallskip

\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{53.}\ 
If you cannot find a parking space, you may park on the sidewalk.\par

When turning right at an intersection, a motor vehicle should turn on the right signal in advance, and, unrestricted by traffic lights or speed limits, pass through quickly to prevent blocking the intersection.\par

After overtaking, a motor vehicle should immediately turn on the right signal and pull back into the original lane.\par

[Image] This sign is placed at an attended railway crossing, telling the driver there are 100 meters remaining to the attended crossing.\par

When driving through a flooded road, you should speed up.\par

{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Conditions on a flooded road are unknown, so you must not speed up.}\par\smallskip

When a traffic light and a traffic police officer's directions conflict at an intersection, follow the traffic light.\par

At an intersection without traffic signals, you should pass through as quickly as possible.\par

Driving on an expressway for a long stretch straddling the lane dividing line occupies two lanes at once, making it hard for vehicles behind to pass, and easily causes accidents.\par

When a vehicle breaks down and cannot move, is the following action correct?\par

{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  No parking is allowed within 30 meters of a stop or 50 meters of an intersection.}\par\smallskip

On a highway without a center line, a motor vehicle's maximum speed must not exceed 70 km/h.\par

On this stretch of road, you must reduce how often you sound the horn.\par

{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：在这段道路上一定要减少鸣喇叭的频率。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Sounding the horn is prohibited on this stretch of road.}\par\smallskip

If a motor vehicle misses its exit on an expressway, and there is confirmed to be no traffic behind, it may reverse back to the exit and leave the expressway.\par

In this situation at the intersection, you have the right of way.\par

{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：在交叉路口遇到这种情况享有优先通行权。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Right turns yield to left turns, left turns yield to going straight, and turning yields to going straight.}\par\smallskip

When the road ahead has fewer lanes and traffic is slow, to keep the road flowing you should use the oncoming lane to pass quickly.\par

[Image] With this traffic signal at the intersection, a vehicle turning right may proceed as long as it does not obstruct the vehicles or pedestrians that have been given the right of way.\par

{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：如图所示，驾驶机动车在路口遇到这种交通信号时，右转弯的车辆在不妨碍被放行的车辆、行人的情况下，可以通行。}\par

In foggy weather, to improve visibility, you should turn on the high beams.\par

\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{72.}\ 
In this situation, you may overtake from the right side.\par

{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：遇到这种情况下可以从右侧超车。}\par

On an urban road without a marked center line, a motor vehicle must not exceed 50 km/h.\par

{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车在没有划分道路中心线的城市道路上行驶速度不得超过50公里/小时。}\par

\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{112.}\ 
[Image] When a pedestrian is crossing at a crosswalk, a motor vehicle must stop and yield because pedestrians have priority to cross.\par

{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：如图所示，机动车遇行人正在通过人行横道时，要停车让行，是因为行人享有优先通过权。}\par

[Image] In this situation before the intersection, vehicle A has the right of way.\par

You cannot make a U-turn at this intersection.\par

{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Pay attention to traffic signs and obey traffic rules while driving.}\par\smallskip

\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{115.}\ 
When driving on the road, a motor vehicle must not exceed the maximum speed shown on the speed limit sign.\par

You may leave the expressway by entering the ramp directly from this position.\par

{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驶离高速公路可以从这个位置直接驶入匝道。}\par

\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{117.}\ 
When driving over a flooded road or flooded bridge, you should stop to check the water conditions, then cross quickly.\par

{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车行经漫水路或者漫水桥时，应当停车察明水情，快速通过。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Crossing a flooded section too fast may stall the engine.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{14\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{118.}\ 
[Image] In this situation, you may make a U-turn as long as there is no traffic behind or coming from the opposite direction.\par

{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：如图所示，这种情况下只要后方、对向无来车，可以掉头。}\par

Traffic signals include traffic lights, traffic signs, road markings, and police directions.\par

{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  A traffic police officer's hand signals take precedence over all other traffic signals.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{14\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{120.}\ 
[Image] Vehicle A has the right of way.\par

{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：如图所示，A车具有优先通行权。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Right turns yield to left turns, left turns yield to going straight, and turning yields to going straight.}\par\smallskip

While driving through a tunnel, a motor vehicle may stop temporarily.\par

[Image] When a vehicle on the right forces its way into your lane, you should slow down and let the vehicle ahead on the right change lanes smoothly.\par

Parking is prohibited within 50 meters of an intersection.\par

[Image] This sign at a railway crossing tells the driver that the crossing ahead has a single railway track.\par

When a vehicle breaks down on an expressway and cannot move, is the driver's attempt to fix the problem, as shown, correct?\par

{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：车辆在高速公路发生故障不能移动时，驾驶人这种尝试排除故障的做法是否正确？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  The correct procedure is: turn on hazard lights, move the vehicle aside, get people out, place a warning sign, then call for help.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}

Before a motor vehicle has come to a complete stop, doors must not be opened and no one may get in or out.\par

On this stretch of road, you may make a U-turn as long as it does not affect other vehicles.\par

When a motor vehicle breaks down on an expressway and needs to stop to fix the problem, if it can be moved into the emergency lane, the hazard lights do not need to be turned on.\par

At this railway crossing you should accelerate through.\par

When encountering this situation at an intersection, you must slow down and yield.\par

When driving in fog, turn on the fog lights and the hazard warning flashers.\par

When a motor vehicle involved in a traffic accident on an expressway cannot be driven normally, it should be towed away using a rescue vehicle or wrecker.\par

On an expressway, a driver must travel at the speed indicated by the speed-limit sign.\par

On a road in this condition, the maximum speed must not exceed 50 km/h.\par

Making a temporary stop on a pedestrian crosswalk is a traffic violation.\par

{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：关于机动车灯光的使用，以下说法正确的是什么？}\par

When crossing a railway crossing, use a low gear to pass safely and do not shift gears midway, to avoid stalling the engine.\par

If an oncoming vehicle suddenly forces an overtake and occupies your lane, you may refuse to yield and force it to give way instead.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：行车中突遇对向车辆强行超车，占据自己车道时，可不予避让，迫使对方让路。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Even if the other driver acts uncivilly, you should not respond in kind.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{679.}\ 
When driving at night, a driver's sight distance shortens, affecting observation, and having to concentrate intensely also makes fatigue more likely.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：夜间行车，驾驶人视距变短，影响观察，同时注意力高度集中，易产生疲劳。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Extra caution is needed when driving at night.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{14\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{680.}\ 
[Image] It is wrong to hang or place items on the front windshield that obstruct the driver's view while driving.\par
\smallskip\begin{center}\includegraphics[width=6cm,height=4cm,keepaspectratio]{work/img/20190410102547uzcnymo3xysmwcgfwa9yh9.jpg}\end{center}\smallskip
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：如图所示，驾驶机动车时，前风窗玻璃处悬挂放置干扰视线的物品是错误的。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Blocking the view impairs safe driving.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{681.}\ 
When approaching a sharp bend, slow down and keep to the right to avoid colliding with an oncoming vehicle that crosses the centerline.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：车辆行至急转弯处时，应减速并靠右侧行驶，防止与越过弯道中心线的对方车辆相撞。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  When meeting oncoming traffic at a sharp bend, slow down and stay to the right.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{14\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{682.}\ 
[Image] What does this sign mean?\par
\smallskip\begin{center}\includegraphics[width=6cm,height=4cm,keepaspectratio]{work/img/20190410102547wmumuoqllpyjz2dkpf3gzn.jpg}\end{center}\smallskip
{\small \textbf{A.} Two-way traffic \quad \textbf{B.} Divided road \quad \textbf{C.} Tidal (reversible) lane \quad \textbf{D.} Slow down and yield}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：这个标志是何含义？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Two-way traffic  A yellow warning sign with up-and-down arrows is the two-way traffic warning sign.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{683.}\ 
Braking on muddy roads can easily cause the wheels to skid or the rear to swing out, leading to traffic accidents.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：在泥泞路上制动时，车轮易发生侧滑或甩尾，导致交通事故。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Muddy road surfaces have low traction, so drive through them cautiously.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{684.}\ 
When overtaking on the road, keep as much lateral distance as possible, and if necessary you may cross a solid line to overtake.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：在道路上超车时，应尽量加大横向距离，必要时可越实线超车。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Dashed lines may be crossed, but solid lines may not.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{14\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{685.}\ 
[Image] As shown, if a vehicle on the right changes lanes in this situation, slow down, keep a safe gap, and be ready to yield.\par
\smallskip\begin{center}\includegraphics[width=6cm,height=4cm,keepaspectratio]{work/img/201904101025484fm2rkmiqubjtl37ak6m73.jpg}\end{center}\smallskip
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：如图所示，在这种情况下遇右侧车辆变更车道，应减速保持安全间距，注意避让。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Civilized driving means giving way courteously.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{14\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{686.}\ 
[Image] As shown, in a traffic accident at this roundabout intersection, vehicle A should bear full responsibility.\par
\smallskip\begin{center}\includegraphics[width=6cm,height=4cm,keepaspectratio]{work/img/201904101025485hqk33dxhyvthsqhoojyda.jpg}\end{center}\smallskip
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：如图所示，在环岛交叉路口发生的交通事故中，应由A车负全部责任。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  A vehicle entering a roundabout must not interfere with vehicles already circulating inside it.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{14\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{687.}\ 
[Image] As shown, in this situation you may make a U-turn as long as there is no traffic behind or oncoming.\par
\smallskip\begin{center}\includegraphics[width=6cm,height=4cm,keepaspectratio]{work/img/2019041010254878c8strahmmxcbmbodelzh.jpg}\end{center}\smallskip
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：如图所示，这种情况下只要后方、对向无来车，可以掉头。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Dashed lines may be crossed, but solid lines may not.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{688.}\ 
If a driver notices a tire is losing air and moves the vehicle off the main lane, they should avoid emergency braking to prevent a rollover or a rear-end collision from a following vehicle braking too late.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶人发现轮胎漏气，将车辆驶离主车道时，不要采用紧急制动，以免造成翻车或后车采取制动不及时导致追尾事故。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  To avoid emergency braking, press the brake pedal gently to slow down gradually while leaving the main lane.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{14\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{689.}\ 
[Image] As shown, vehicle A wants to make a U-turn ahead, so it may change lanes here into the left lane to prepare for the turn.\par
\smallskip\begin{center}\includegraphics[width=6cm,height=4cm,keepaspectratio]{work/img/20190410102548anufqbhmufcyz3lgnee3xu.jpg}\end{center}\smallskip
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：如图所示，A车要在前方掉头行驶，可以在此处变换车道，进入左侧车道准备掉头。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Dashed lines may be crossed, but solid lines may not.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{690.}\ 
After the green light comes on at an intersection, if a non-motor vehicle cuts in and drives ahead, the vehicle need not yield.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：车辆在交叉路口绿灯亮后，遇非机动车抢道行驶时，可以不让行。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Motor vehicles must always give way to pedestrians and non-motor vehicles.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{691.}\ 
After a tire blowout, before regaining control of the vehicle's speed, the driver should not risk using the foot brake to stop, to avoid the vehicle swinging sideways and creating a greater hazard.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：车辆发生爆胎后，驾驶人在尚未控制住车速前，不要冒险使用行车制动器停车，以避免车辆横甩发生更大的险情。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  During a blowout, grip the wheel firmly, keep going straight, use engine braking to slow gradually, then brake gently to a stop.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{14\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{692.}\ 
[Image] As shown, vehicle B has the right of way.\par
\smallskip\begin{center}\includegraphics[width=6cm,height=4cm,keepaspectratio]{work/img/20190410102548cpdoccld5qccrknawyevsr.jpg}\end{center}\smallskip
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：如图所示，B车具有优先通过权。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Right turns yield to left turns, left turns yield to straight-through traffic, and turns yield to straight-through traffic.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{693.}\ 
When a motor vehicle is inside a roundabout and another vehicle forces its way in, it may refuse to yield as long as it has the right of way.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车在环形路口内行驶，遇有其他车辆强行驶入时，只要有优先权就可以不避让。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Even if the other driver acts uncivilly, you should not respond in kind.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{694.}\ 
When driving on an expressway with visibility below 200 meters, keep a distance of over 100 meters from the vehicle ahead in the same lane.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车在高速公路上行驶，能见度小于200米时，与同车道前车应保持100米以上的距离。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Mnemonic for expressway low-visibility rules: 261, 145, 520 (exit).}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{695.}\ 
At night, when passing through an area with no street lights or poor lighting, switch from low beams to high beams, but a following vehicle traveling the same direction must not use high beams.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：夜间通过没有路灯或路灯照明不良时，应将近光灯转换为远光灯，但同向行驶的后车不得使用远光灯。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  At night, following distances are short, so a following vehicle's high beams would blind the driver ahead.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{696.}\ 
The Road Traffic Safety Law Implementing Regulations state that the maximum expressway speed must not exceed 120 km/h. Therefore, driving on an expressway is lawful as long as the speed does not exceed 120 km/h.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：《道路交通安全法实施条例》规定，高速公路上最高时速不得超过120公里。因此在高速公路上行驶只要时速不超过120公里就不违法。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  The maximum expressway speed is 120 km/h, but the minimum speed must not be below 60 km/h.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{697.}\ 
Outside the designated hours for a dedicated lane, other vehicles may drive in that lane.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：专用车道规定的专用使用时间之外，其他车辆可以进入专用车道行驶。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  During the designated hours, only the specified vehicles may use the dedicated lane.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{698.}\ 
At night, a driver's ability to observe things is clearly worse than during the day, and sight distance is shorter.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：夜间驾驶人对事物的观察能力明显比白天差，视距变短。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Drive slowly at night.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{699.}\ 
When driving on an expressway and encountering dense fog that blocks visibility, you should immediately brake hard to stop.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：行驶在高速公路上遇大雾视线受阻时，应当立即紧急制动停车。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Sudden emergency braking is not allowed on expressways.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{700.}\ 
Vehicles may stop on an expressway ramp.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：车辆在高速公路匝道上可以停车。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Stopping is prohibited on expressways.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{701.}\ 
When police cars, fire engines, ambulances, and engineering rescue vehicles are on emergency duty, delaying or obstructing them can lead to serious consequences, so other vehicles and pedestrians should proactively yield.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：警车、消防车、救护车、工程救险车执行紧急任务时，耽误或影响其通行可能会导致严重后果，所以其他车辆和行人应当主动让行。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Vehicles must proactively give way to special-purpose vehicles on emergency duty.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{702.}\ 
Before pulling away, a driver should observe the traffic conditions around the vehicle and start moving only after confirming it is safe.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：车辆起步前，驾驶人应对车辆周围交通情况进行观察，确认安全时再开始起步。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Civilized driving puts safety first.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{14\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{703.}\ 
[Image] As shown, in this situation the motor vehicle must stop and yield.\par
\smallskip\begin{center}\includegraphics[width=6cm,height=4cm,keepaspectratio]{work/img/20190410102548ktpwizdc8vaqxbj8zry6um.jpg}\end{center}\smallskip
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：如图所示，在这种情况下，驾驶机动车要停车让行。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Motor vehicles must yield to pedestrians in every situation.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{704.}\ 
When a vehicle drives on an expressway at 100 km/h, keeping over 100 meters from the vehicle ahead in the same lane is a safe distance.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：车辆在高速公路以每小时100公里的速度行驶时，距同车道前车100米以上为安全距离。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Expressway rule: above 100 km/h keep over 100 m; below 100 km/h keep over 50 m.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{705.}\ 
When turning, a vehicle should stay on the right side of the road and not encroach on the opposing lane, following the rule: wide arc for a left turn, tight arc for a right turn.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：车辆转弯时应沿道路右侧行驶，不要侵占对方的车道，做到“左转转大弯，右转转小弯”。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  The rule is: wide arc for left turns, tight arc for right turns.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{706.}\ 
When driving uphill, observe the road conditions and slope length in advance, and downshift promptly to keep the vehicle powered enough.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：车辆上坡行驶，要提前观察路况、坡道长度，及时减挡使车辆保持充足的动力。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Climbing in too high a gear can easily cause the engine to stall and the vehicle to roll back.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{707.}\ 
When changing lanes, you only need to turn on the turn signal before quickly steering into the target lane.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：变更车道时只需开启转向灯，便可迅速转向驶入相应的行车道。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  The proper steps are: signal early, check behind for traffic, ensure a safe gap, then change lanes.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{708.}\ 
If a driver observes no traffic approaching from behind, it is reasonable to change lanes without using the turn signal.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶人在观察后方无来车的情况下，未开转向灯就变更车道也是合理的。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Any change in driving state must be signaled to alert other vehicles.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{709.}\ 
After yielding to let a special-purpose vehicle pass smoothly, a vehicle should return in an orderly way to its original lane and continue driving, and should not tailgate the special-purpose vehicle to avoid an accident.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：避让特种车辆使其顺利通过后，车辆应有序回到原车道继续行驶，不要尾随特种车辆，以免发生交通事故。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Vehicles must yield to special-purpose vehicles on duty.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{710.}\ 
Overtaking is not allowed when crossing a railway crossing.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：通过铁路道口时，不得超车。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Overtaking is prohibited at railway crossings.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{711.}\ 
In complex weather such as wind, rain, snow, or fog, if the vehicle ahead is going slowly, turn on the headlights and sound the horn continuously to quickly overtake it.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：风、雨、雪、雾等复杂气象条件，遇前车速度较低时，应开启前照灯，连续鸣喇叭迅速超越。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Overtaking must only be done when it is safe.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{712.}\ 
A vehicle may make full use of coasting in neutral when driving downhill.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：车辆在下坡行驶时，可充分利用空挡滑行。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Coasting in neutral downhill is not allowed.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{713.}\ 
Before changing lanes, a driver should observe carefully in order to judge whether the conditions for a lane change are met.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车变更车道前应仔细观察，目的是判断有无变更车道的条件。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  The proper steps are: signal early, check behind for traffic, ensure a safe gap, then change lanes.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{714.}\ 
When passing through an intersection at night with no traffic signal, you must not switch between high and low beams.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：夜间通过无交通信号灯控制的交叉路口时，不得变换远、近光灯。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Drivers should flash between high and low beams to warn other traffic at unsignalized intersections at night.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{715.}\ 
When driving on icy or snowy roads, you must reduce speed and increase the safety distance.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：在冰雪路面上行车，必须降低车速、加大安全距离。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Slow down and keep a safe distance when driving on icy or snowy roads.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{716.}\ 
When driving down a long slope, using inertia to coast can reduce fuel consumption and should be encouraged.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车下长坡时，利用惯性滑行可以减少燃油消耗，值得提倡。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Coasting in neutral using inertia is a bad driving habit.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{717.}\ 
Before starting off at night, you should first turn on the low beams.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
