{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Signal the vehicle ahead before overtaking.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{758.}\ 
At night, a driver's field of view is limited and it is hard to observe traffic beyond the area lit by the headlights, so speed should be reduced.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：夜间行车，驾驶人的视野受限，很难观察到灯光照射区域以外的交通情况，因此要减速行驶。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Slow down when driving at night.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{759.}\ 
Overpasses are generally one-way, so vehicles do not need to slow down.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：立交桥上一般都是单向行驶，车辆不必减速行驶。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  You should slow down whenever it is required, regardless of whether the road is one-way.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{760.}\ 
When a vehicle reaches an intersection, a left-turning vehicle may enter the left-turn waiting area at any time.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：车辆行至交叉路口时，左转弯车辆在任何时段都可以进入左弯待转区。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  When both the straight-ahead and left-turn signals are red, left-turning vehicles may not enter the waiting area.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{761.}\ 
Overtaking is not allowed when passing through a tunnel.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：通过隧道时，不得超车。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Overtaking is prohibited in tunnels.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{762.}\ 
If a rear tire blows out, the tail of the vehicle will swing unstably; the driver should grip the steering wheel firmly with both hands, keep the vehicle going straight, and slow down to a stop.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：车辆后轮胎爆裂，车尾会摇摆不定，驾驶人应双手紧握转向盘，控制车辆保持直线行驶，减速停车。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  With a rear blowout, the first priority is to keep the steering under control.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{763.}\ 
If a motor vehicle breaks down or is in an accident and cannot drive normally, the hazard warning flashers should be turned on immediately.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车发生故障或事故不能正常行驶时，应立即打开危险报警闪光灯。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  In case of a breakdown, warn following traffic promptly.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{764.}\ 
After pulling away from the roadside, a vehicle should speed up quickly and turn sharply left into the normal traffic lane.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：车辆在路边起步后应尽快提速，并向左迅速转向驶入正常行驶道路。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Before pulling away, observe the surroundings first and confirm it is safe.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{765.}\ 
On rainy days the road is slippery and braking distance increases, so try to use emergency braking to slow down while driving.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：雨天路面湿滑，车辆制动距离增大，行车中尽量使用紧急制动减速。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  In rain, avoid emergency braking; instead use engine braking by downshifting to slow down.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{766.}\ 
When driving in snow, follow existing tire tracks on sections where they are present.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：雪天行车中，在有车辙的路段应循车辙行驶。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Tire tracks show that other vehicles have already passed, making them a relatively safer path.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{767.}\ 
After entering a mountain road, pay special attention to 'continuous bends' signs, proactively yield to vehicles and pedestrians, and slow down and sound the horn in advance as needed.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：车辆进入山区道路后，要特别注意“连续转弯”标志，并主动避让车辆及行人，适时减速和提前鸣喇叭。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Slow down when driving on mountain roads.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{768.}\ 
When merging into traffic, turn on the turn signal in advance, keep driving straight, check left and right through the mirrors, and merge only after confirming it is safe.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶车辆汇入车流时，应提前开启转向灯，保持直线行驶，通过后视镜观察左右情况，确认安全后汇入合流。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Merging into traffic must not disrupt vehicles that are already driving normally.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{769.}\ 
When a motor vehicle encounters blocked traffic ahead on an expressway, it should queue in order behind the vehicle ahead and immediately turn on the hazard warning flashers to prevent a rear-end collision.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车在高速公路上遇前方交通受阻时，应当跟随前车顺序排队，并立即开启危险报警闪光灯，防止追尾。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  During expressway congestion, do not cut in randomly or use the emergency lane.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{770.}\ 
If a motor vehicle breaks down on an expressway and can be moved into the emergency lane, only the hazard warning flashers need to be turned on, and whether to place the warning triangle can be decided based on traffic flow.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车在高速公路上车辆发生故障时，若车辆可以移动至应急车道内，只需开启危险报警闪光灯，警告标志可根据交通流情况选择是否放置。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Expressway breakdown procedure: turn on hazard flashers, move the vehicle, place the warning triangle and evacuate occupants, call for help, then wait for rescue.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{771.}\ 
If a driver has an urgent matter, they may make or take handheld phone calls while driving.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车遇紧急事务，可以边开车边接打手持电话。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Using a phone while driving is unsafe, illegal, and carries a 3-point penalty.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{772.}\ 
When overtaking, if a safe gap with the vehicle being overtaken cannot be guaranteed, the overtake should be abandoned voluntarily.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：超车时，如果无法保证与被超车辆的安全间距，应主动放弃超车。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  If safe overtaking conditions are not met, the overtake should be abandoned.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{14\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{773.}\ 
[Image] As shown, vehicle A has the right of way.\par
\smallskip\begin{center}\includegraphics[width=6cm,height=4cm,keepaspectratio]{work/img/20190410102550pjxurf9wwghvvt9x6nxc5u.jpg}\end{center}\smallskip
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：如图所示，A车具有优先通过权。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Right turns yield to left turns, left turns yield to straight-through traffic, and turns yield to straight-through traffic.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{774.}\ 
Vehicles may change lanes frequently while driving on an expressway.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：车辆在高速公路上行车，可以频繁地变更车道。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Frequent lane changes are not allowed on any road.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{775.}\ 
Vehicles must not make a U-turn on an expressway ramp.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：车辆不得在高速公路匝道上掉头。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  U-turns are prohibited on expressways.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{776.}\ 
If a front tire blows out while driving and the vehicle starts to swerve, the driver should grip the steering wheel firmly with both hands and try hard to keep the vehicle going straight.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：行车中当车辆前轮爆胎已发生转向时，驾驶人应双手紧握转向盘，尽力控制车辆直线行驶。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  With a front blowout, grip the wheel firmly the moment it happens.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{14\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{777.}\ 
[Image] As shown, in this foggy condition, when passing through an intersection you must turn on lights, sound the horn, and speed up to avoid causing traffic congestion.\par
\smallskip\begin{center}\includegraphics[width=6cm,height=4cm,keepaspectratio]{work/img/20190410102550tyy4rxpbqctmuzrahfnyya.jpg}\end{center}\smallskip
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：如图所示，在这种雾天情况下，通过交叉路口时必须开灯、鸣喇叭，加速通过，以免造成交通拥堵。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  In fog, turn on fog lights and slow down, rather than speeding up.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{778.}\ 
If you feel tired while driving on an expressway, you should stop immediately to rest.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：在高速公路上行驶感觉疲劳时，应立即停车休息。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Stopping arbitrarily on an expressway is not allowed.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{779.}\ 
When driving through a flooded road, shift into a high gear and pass through quickly.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：漫水道路行车时，应挂高速挡，快速通过。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  When passing a flooded road, stop to check the water conditions and only proceed once it is confirmed safe.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{780.}\ 
While making a U-turn, strictly control speed, carefully observe the road ahead and behind, and only move forward or reverse after confirming it is safe.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：掉头过程中，应严格控制车速，仔细观察道路前后方情况，确认安全后方可前进或倒车。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  A U-turn must not affect vehicles driving normally.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{781.}\ 
A flashing warning signal light is a continuously flashing yellow light, whose purpose is to alert vehicles and pedestrians to pass through quickly.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：闪光警告信号灯为持续闪烁的黄灯，其作用是提示车辆、行人需要快速通过。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  A flashing yellow light warns drivers to be cautious; it does not mean they should pass through quickly.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{782.}\ 
When driving in heavy rain, you should control your speed to avoid the danger caused by hydroplaning.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：在大雨天行车，为避免发生“水滑”而造成危险，要控制速度行驶。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Hydroplaning happens when driving fast on water-covered roads in rain, which is dangerous for driving.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{783.}\ 
Vehicles should drive on the right shoulder of the expressway.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：车辆应靠高速公路右侧的路肩上行驶。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Except in emergencies, driving on the right shoulder of an expressway is prohibited.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{784.}\ 
It is illegal for a driver to use a handheld phone while driving.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶人一边驾车，一边打手持电话是违法行为。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  This violates the Road Traffic Safety Law, which makes it illegal.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{785.}\ 
What should a driver do when approaching a crosswalk?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Speed up and pass through \quad \textbf{B.} Stop immediately \quad \textbf{C.} Slow down first, watch for pedestrians and non-motor vehicles, and proceed only after confirming it is safe \quad \textbf{D.} Honk the horn to signal pedestrians to yield}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：车辆驶近人行横道时，应怎样做？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. Slow down first, watch for pedestrians and non-motor vehicles, and proceed only after confirming it is safe  Pedestrians move unpredictably, so drivers must slow down and watch carefully before proceeding.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{14\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{786.}\ 
[Image] As shown in the figure, when driving through this road section, you should slow down to avoid a traffic accident caused by glare.\par
\smallskip\begin{center}\includegraphics[width=6cm,height=4cm,keepaspectratio]{work/img/201904101025515eg8z79uxzgkgkqxhnqhvp.jpg}\end{center}\smallskip
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：如图所示，驾驶机动车行经该路段时，应减速慢行，避免因眩目导致的交通事故。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  The light difference between the inside and outside of a tunnel requires adjustment, so drivers should slow down.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{787.}\ 
When driving in fog, honking the horn often can draw the attention of other drivers; if you hear another vehicle honk, you should also honk in response.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：雾天行车多使用喇叭可引起对方注意；听到对方车辆鸣喇叭，也应鸣喇叭回应。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  In foggy weather, honking the horn helps drivers alert each other.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{788.}\ 
When passing through school zones and residential areas, drivers should watch for signs and markings, drive at low speed, and not honk the horn.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：车辆通过学校和小区应注意观察标志标线，低速行驶，不要鸣喇叭。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Driving through school and residential areas must not disturb students' studies or residents' daily life.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{789.}\ 
What should a driver do when following another vehicle on a mountain road?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Appropriately increase the safety distance \quad \textbf{B.} Follow closely behind the vehicle ahead \quad \textbf{C.} Appropriately reduce the safety distance \quad \textbf{D.} Look for opportunities to overtake whenever possible}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：车辆在山区道路跟车行驶时，应怎样做？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Appropriately increase the safety distance  Keeping a sufficient safety distance helps ensure safe driving.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{790.}\ 
When a bicycle ahead is obstructing traffic, you may honk to alert it and speed up to go around it.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：行车中前方遇自行车影响通行时，可鸣喇叭提示，加速绕行。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Drivers may honk moderately but should slow down, not speed up, when passing a bicycle.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{791.}\ 
What lights should be used when driving at night through a road section with good lighting conditions?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Fog lights \quad \textbf{B.} Low beam headlights \quad \textbf{C.} High beam headlights \quad \textbf{D.} Hazard warning lights}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：夜间车辆通过照明条件良好的路段时，应使用什么灯？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Low beam headlights  High beams must not be used on well-lit roads at night; low beams should be used instead.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{792.}\ 
When meeting oncoming traffic on a narrow road section, drivers should follow the three courtesies: slow down first, yield first, and stop first.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：在狭窄的路段会车时，应做到礼让三先：先慢、先让、先停。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Courteous driving requires yielding politely to other vehicles.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{793.}\ 
Drivers should drive courteously and yield politely, avoiding reckless driving, risky driving, angry driving, and driving while unfit.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：行车中要文明驾驶，礼让行车，做到不开英雄车、冒险车、赌气车和带病车。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Courteous driving means never racing or arguing with other drivers on the road.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{794.}\ 
What is the main effect of the nighttime road environment on safe driving?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Low visibility, making it hard to observe traffic conditions \quad \textbf{B.} The road surface is complex and changeable \quad \textbf{C.} The driver's physical stamina declines \quad \textbf{D.} The driver is prone to impulsiveness and hallucinations}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：夜间道路环境对安全行车的主要影响是什么？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Low visibility, making it hard to observe traffic conditions  At night low visibility makes it hard to observe the road, so lights must be used correctly to signal other vehicles.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{795.}\ 
When driving through a crosswalk, drivers should take care to yield to pedestrians.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶车辆通过人行横道线时，应注意礼让行人。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Courteous driving requires yielding to pedestrians.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{796.}\ 
When overtaking and the vehicle ahead does not slow down to let you pass, you should abandon the overtake, slow down appropriately, and keep a safe distance from the vehicle ahead.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车超车时，前方车辆不减速让路，应停止超车并适当减速，与前方车辆保持安全距离。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Forcing an overtake easily causes traffic accidents.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{797.}\ 
When overtaking and the vehicle being overtaken does not slow down to let you pass, you should quickly speed up to complete the overtake.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车超车时，被超越车辆未减速让路，应迅速提速超越前方车辆完成超车。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Forcing an overtake like this easily causes traffic accidents, so the attempt should be abandoned instead.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{798.}\ 
A front tire blowout is quite dangerous: the vehicle will immediately veer toward the side of the burst tire, directly affecting the driver's control of the steering wheel.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：车辆前轮胎爆裂，危险较大，方向会立刻向爆胎车轮一侧跑偏，直接影响驾驶人对转向盘的控制。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  With a front tire blowout, the driver must grip the steering wheel firmly right away to control direction.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{14\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{799.}\ 
[Image] As shown in the figure, when driving through a crosswalk with no pedestrians crossing, there is no need to slow down.\par
\smallskip\begin{center}\includegraphics[width=6cm,height=4cm,keepaspectratio]{work/img/20190410102551g3bbkuf8vtowkovjxirikb.jpg}\end{center}\smallskip
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：如图所示，驾驶机动车遇到没有行人通过的人行横道时不用减速慢行。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Courteous driving requires slowing down at crosswalks regardless, in case pedestrians appear.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{800.}\ 
What should you do when meeting an oncoming vehicle that has difficulty passing and needs to borrow part of your lane?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Do not encroach on the other lane and drive normally \quad \textbf{B.} Signal the other vehicle to stop and yield \quad \textbf{C.} Keep to the right and speed up \quad \textbf{D.} Yield as much as possible to let the other vehicle go first}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：会车中遇到对方来车行进有困难需借道时，应怎样做？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. Yield as much as possible to let the other vehicle go first  Courteous driving means yielding politely to vehicles in difficulty.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{801.}\ 
Why is making a U-turn on a crosswalk prohibited?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Vehicles are prohibited from crosswalks \quad \textbf{B.} The section has surveillance equipment \quad \textbf{C.} To avoid obstructing pedestrians' normal passage \quad \textbf{D.} Parking is prohibited on crosswalks}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：人行横道上禁止掉头的原因是什么？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. To avoid obstructing pedestrians' normal passage  Courteous driving must not obstruct pedestrians' normal passage.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{802.}\ 
Vehicles must not overtake while descending a steep slope on a mountain road.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：车辆在山区道路行车下陡坡时，不得超车。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Overtaking while descending a steep slope easily causes traffic accidents.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{803.}\ 
If you accidentally drive past your exit on an expressway, what should you do?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Stop immediately \quad \textbf{B.} Make a U-turn on the spot \quad \textbf{C.} Reverse back on the spot \quad \textbf{D.} Continue driving forward and look for the next exit}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：高速公路上行车，如果因疏忽驶过出口，应怎样做？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. Continue driving forward and look for the next exit  Reversing and making U-turns are prohibited on expressways.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{804.}\ 
When driving on icy or snowy roads, vehicle stability decreases, and accelerating too abruptly can easily cause the wheels to spin or slip.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：在冰雪道路上行车时，车辆的稳定性降低，加速过急时车轮极易空转或溜滑。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Icy and snowy roads easily cause skidding or loss of steering control, so drivers must be cautious.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{805.}\ 
When an expressway is blocked due to an accident, vehicles may drive on the right emergency lane or shoulder.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：高速公路因发生事故造成堵塞时，可在右侧紧急停车带或路肩行驶。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Except in emergencies, the emergency lane and right shoulder of an expressway must not be used for driving.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{806.}\ 
When changing to the right lane, drivers should turn on the right turn signal in advance, observe carefully, and merge into the target lane only when it is safe.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶车辆向右变更车道时，应提前开启右转向灯，注意观察，在确保安全的情况下，驶入要变更的车道。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Lane changes require signaling in advance, checking behind, and ensuring a safe distance before merging.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{807.}\ 
When following another vehicle at night, the following vehicle may use high beams.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：夜间尾随前车行驶时，后车可以使用远光灯。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Using high beams while following closely at night blinds the driver ahead, so low beams should be used instead.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{808.}\ 
When passing through mountain sections prone to landslides or mudslides, avoid stopping.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：通过经常发生塌方、泥石流的山区地段，避免停车。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Drive cautiously and put safety first in landslide-prone areas.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{809.}\ 
When pedestrians commit a traffic safety violation, vehicles may refuse to yield to them.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：当行人出现交通安全违法行为时，车辆可以不给行人让行。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Courteous driving requires yielding to pedestrians regardless of their violations.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{810.}\ 
When changing lanes, you only need to turn on the signal and quickly steer into the target lane, so as not to obstruct vehicles already in that lane.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：变更车道时只需开启转向灯，并迅速转向驶入相应的车道，以不妨碍同车道机动车正常行驶。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Lane changes require signaling early, checking behind, and confirming a safe distance, not just steering in quickly.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{811.}\ 
When driving slowly on a congested road and another vehicle forces its way into your lane, what should you do?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Honk a warning and refuse to let it in \quad \textbf{B.} Speed up and follow closely behind the vehicle ahead to block it \quad \textbf{C.} Yield proactively to ensure safe driving \quad \textbf{D.} Squeeze against the cutting vehicle to force it to leave}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：车辆在拥挤路段低速行驶时，遇其他车辆强行插队，应怎样做？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. Yield proactively to ensure safe driving  Courteous driving means yielding politely rather than blocking or forcing other vehicles.}\par\smallskip

\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{812.}\ 
When driving on a main road and approaching a junction with a side road, what should you do to prevent colliding with a vehicle suddenly entering from the side road?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Maintain normal speed \quad \textbf{B.} Slow down in advance, observe, and drive cautiously \quad \textbf{C.} Honk and pass quickly \quad \textbf{D.} Speed up in advance to pass through}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：车辆在主干道上行驶，驶近主支干道交汇处时，为防止与从支路突然驶入的车辆相撞，应怎样做？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Slow down in advance, observe, and drive cautiously  Drivers must constantly watch surrounding conditions to avoid accidents at junctions.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{813.}\ 
While driving, motor vehicle drivers should keep a safe distance from the vehicle ahead.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：在行驶过程中，机动车驾驶人要注意与前车保持安全距离。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Courteous driving puts safety first, which requires a safe following distance.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{814.}\ 
After entering the ramp, quickly increase your speed to above 60 km/h.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par

{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Entering an expressway follows the sequence entrance, ramp, acceleration lane, then normal lane; speed should build up gradually, not on the ramp.}\par\smallskip

[Image] As shown in the figure, when passing vehicle A which is stopped before the crosswalk, vehicle B should slow down and be ready to stop and yield.\par

[Image] As shown in the figure, when a motor vehicle drives on this type of road, why does it travel in the middle of the road?\par

{\small \textbf{A.} To leave enough space for non-motor vehicles and pedestrians on both sides \quad \textbf{B.} Visibility is better in the middle of the road \quad \textbf{C.} Driving in the middle is faster \quad \textbf{D.} To prevent the vehicle from running off the road}\par

\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{817.}\ 
When reversing on a normal road and you notice a passing vehicle, what should you do?\par

{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：在一般道路倒车时，若发现有过往车辆通过，应怎样做？}\par

When a front tire blowout has already caused the vehicle to veer, the driver should not overcorrect; once direction is under control, how should the vehicle be slowed gradually?\par

What should be noted when driving on icy or snowy roads?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Braking distance increases \quad \textbf{B.} Anti-skid capability increases \quad \textbf{C.} Road surface traction increases \quad \textbf{D.} Braking performance is unchanged}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：冰雪路行车时应注意什么？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Braking distance increases  Icy and snowy roads increase braking distance and the risk of skidding, so drivers should slow down and increase following distance.}\par\smallskip

What should you do when you encounter children while driving?\par

What should you do when a non-motor vehicle cuts in front while driving?\par

{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：行车中，遇非机动车抢行时，应怎样做？}\par

What should you do when overtaking a bicycle traveling in the same direction?\par

{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：行车中超越同向行驶的自行车时，应怎样做？}\par

What lights should be turned on before entering a two-way tunnel?\par

When a motor vehicle is being overtaken by another vehicle, what is the purpose of it slowing down and moving to the right?\par

\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{826.}\ 
When going down a long slope, besides brake braking, what other effective method helps control speed?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Shift into neutral and coast \quad \textbf{B.} Use engine braking \quad \textbf{C.} Press the clutch and coast \quad \textbf{D.} Turn off the engine and coast}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：下长坡时，控制车速除了刹车制动以外还有什么有效的辅助方法？}\par

What should a driver do when passing over a water-covered road surface?\par

{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶人在行车中经过积水路面时，应怎样做？}\par

\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{828.}\ 
When vehicles ahead are stopped in a queue or moving slowly, is it correct to force your way through?\par

{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：遇到前方车辆停车排队或者缓慢行驶时，强行穿插，以下说法正确的是什么？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. Prohibited, because it disrupts traffic flow and worsens congestion  Forcing through disrupts traffic flow and worsens congestion, so it is prohibited.}\par\smallskip

When entering an expressway toll gate, which entrance should you choose?\par

{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驶入高速公路的收费口时，应选择怎样的入口？}\par

\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{830.}\ 
What should you do when an oncoming vehicle is driving in your lane?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Drive close to the center of the road \quad \textbf{B.} Yield proactively to the other vehicle \quad \textbf{C.} Flash the headlights to warn it \quad \textbf{D.} Force it to move to the right}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：行车中遇到对向来车占道行驶，应怎样做？}\par

\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{831.}\ 
What lights should be turned on when a vehicle stops temporarily in the rain?\par

{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：车辆在雨天临时停车时，应开启什么灯？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Hazard warning lights  A temporary stop must alert vehicles behind to avoid accidents, so hazard lights should be used.}\par\smallskip

When a vehicle breaks down on an expressway, which of the following handling methods is incorrect?\par

When a motor vehicle breaks down on an expressway and needs to stop for repairs, what is the correct order of the following steps: (1) place warning signs, move passengers to a safe place, and call for help promptly; (2) turn on the hazard warning lights; (3) move the vehicle to a position that does not obstruct traffic; (4) wait for rescue?\par

{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：会车前选择的交会位置不理想时，应怎样做？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Slow down, pass at low speed, or stop to yield  Courteous meeting of oncoming traffic puts safety first: slow down, pass slowly, or stop to yield.}\par\smallskip

\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{870.}\ 
On a 4-lane (same direction) expressway, which lane should vehicles traveling faster than 110 km/h use?\par

{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：在同向4车道高速公路上行车，车速高于每小时110公里的车辆应在哪条车道上行驶？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. The leftmost lane  On a 4-lane expressway, the minimum speed limits from left to right are 110, 90, 90, and 60 km/h, so faster vehicles use the leftmost lane.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{871.}\ 
When a vehicle must stop on an expressway due to a breakdown, how many meters behind the vehicle should the warning sign be placed?\par

{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：车辆因故障必须在高速公路停车时，应在车后方多少米以外设置故障警告标志？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. 150  Warning signs should be placed 50 to 100 meters away on ordinary roads, and more than 150 meters away on expressways.}\par\smallskip

When a vehicle with the right of way at an intersection encounters another vehicle cutting in, what should you do?\par

{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. Slow down to avoid it, and stop to yield if necessary  Even if the other driver is discourteous, you should still slow down and yield if needed.}\par\smallskip

When approaching a bus stopped at a station, what should you do to guard against the bus suddenly pulling out or a pedestrian darting out in front of it?\par

{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Slow down, keep a sufficient distance, and be ready to stop at any time  Courteous driving puts safety first near buses, requiring reduced speed and sufficient distance.}\par\smallskip

What lights should be turned on when a vehicle stops temporarily on a snowy day?\par

{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. Hazard warning lights  A temporary stop requires signaling vehicles behind with hazard warning lights.}\par\smallskip

\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{875.}\ 
Before entering a curve on a mountain road with no oncoming traffic, what should you do?\par

{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. Should slow down, honk, and keep to the right  Safe driving requires slowing down, honking, and keeping to the right when entering a curve.}\par\smallskip

What should you do when driving at night and an oncoming bicycle approaches?\par

{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：夜间驾驶车辆遇自行车对向驶来时，应怎样做？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. Use low beams and slow down or stop to yield  Using high beams or switching between beams blinds the oncoming cyclist, so low beams and slowing down are required instead.}\par\smallskip

When changing lanes before an intersection, how should you merge into the target lane?\par

{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. Within the dashed-line zone, following the guide arrows  Lane changes are allowed only in the dashed-line zone following the guide arrows; a solid line must not be crossed.}\par\smallskip

{\small \textbf{A.} Follow other vehicles into the intersection \quad \textbf{B.} Continue driving only after the road ahead clears and the light is green \quad \textbf{C.} May drive directly into the intersection and wait there \quad \textbf{D.} May proceed whenever the light is green}\par

Continuing the overtake could easily cause a scrape or collision with the oncoming vehicle  Overtaking requires being on the dashed-line side with no oncoming traffic; if a vehicle appears, continuing risks a collision and the overtake must be abandoned.}\par\smallskip

When the light for your lane is green but pedestrians are still crossing the crosswalk ahead, what should you do?\par

Why does the rule require using low beams within 150 meters when meeting an oncoming vehicle at night?\par

\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{903.}\ 
On an expressway with complete signs and markings, drivers should follow the lane and speed rules set by what?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Signs or markings \quad \textbf{B.} The Road Traffic Safety Law \quad \textbf{C.} The vehicle owner's manual \quad \textbf{D.} Local regulations}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：在标志、标线齐全的高速公路上行车，应当按照什么规定的车道和车速行驶？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Signs or markings  When signs and markings are complete, drivers should follow them.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{904.}\ 
What should you do when an ambulance rescuing injured people approaches from the wrong direction in your lane?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Move aside, slow down, or stop to yield \quad \textbf{B.} Use another lane \quad \textbf{C.} Speed up and change lanes to avoid it \quad \textbf{D.} Continue driving in the same lane}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：行车中遇抢救伤员的救护车从本车道逆向驶来时，应怎样做？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Move aside, slow down, or stop to yield  Drivers must proactively yield to special vehicles performing emergency duties, such as an ambulance.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{905.}\ 
Why should the turn signal remain on throughout a turn at an intersection?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} To let other drivers know you are overtaking \quad \textbf{B.} Turning off the signal before completing the turn would damage the vehicle \quad \textbf{C.} To let other drivers know you are turning \quad \textbf{D.} Turning off the signal before completing the turn is just a habitual action}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：路口转弯过程中，持续开启转向灯，主要原因是因为什么？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. To let other drivers know you are turning  The turn signal must stay on throughout the turn so other drivers know you are turning, and be switched off only after completing it.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{906.}\ 
When driving on a narrow mountain road and the vehicle on the mountainside does not yield, what should you do?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Honk to urge it to yield \quad \textbf{B.} Maintain normal speed \quad \textbf{C.} Slow down or stop in advance to yield \quad \textbf{D.} Move left into the other lane and pass cautiously}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：车辆在较窄的山路上行驶时，如果靠山体的一方不让行，应怎样做？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. Slow down or stop in advance to yield  On a narrow mountain road, the vehicle in the relatively safer position should yield first, so this vehicle should slow down or stop.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{907.}\ 
When driving on an expressway in fog, rain, snow, sandstorms, hail, or other low-visibility weather with visibility below 100 meters, what is the maximum allowed speed, and what minimum distance must be kept from the vehicle ahead in the same lane?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 40, 50 \quad \textbf{B.} 40, 40 \quad \textbf{C.} 50, 40 \quad \textbf{D.} 50, 30}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车在高速公路上行驶，遇有雾、雨、雪、沙尘、冰雹等低能见度气象条件下，能见度在100米以下时，车速不得超过每小时多少公里，与同车道前车至少保持多少米的距离？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. 40, 50  Below 100 meters of visibility, speed must not exceed 40 km/h and following distance must be at least 50 meters.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{908.}\ 
Why is a flooded road surface dangerous and hard to pass safely?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Hidden potholes and raised surfaces cannot be seen \quad \textbf{B.} Road surface traction increases \quad \textbf{C.} Visibility is low and blurry \quad \textbf{D.} Sunlight reflection blocks the view}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：水淹路面影响行车安全，不易通行的原因是什么？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Hidden potholes and raised surfaces cannot be seen  On a flooded road, hidden potholes and bumps cannot be seen, so drivers should stop to check the water conditions before proceeding.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{909.}\ 
When the lanes ahead merge and traffic is moving slowly, what should you do to ensure safety and order?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Take turns merging one by one \quad \textbf{B.} Use the opposite lane to pass quickly \quad \textbf{C.} Speed up and overtake the vehicle ahead on either side \quad \textbf{D.} Cut into the queue of vehicles ahead}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：遇前方路段车道减少，车辆行驶缓慢，为了保证安全有序应该怎么做？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Take turns merging one by one  Taking turns merging one by one prevents further road congestion.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{910.}\ 
Which of the following is an incorrect way to avoid a tire blowout?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Lowering tire pressure \quad \textbf{B.} Regularly checking the tires \quad \textbf{C.} Promptly removing foreign objects from the tire grooves \quad \textbf{D.} Replacing tires that are cracked or severely damaged}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：避免爆胎的错误的做法是什么？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Lowering tire pressure  Regular checks, prompt cleaning, and replacing damaged tires effectively prevent blowouts; lowering tire pressure does not.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{911.}\ 
When overtaking via the left lane and unable to maintain a safe lateral distance from the vehicle ahead traveling normally, what should you do?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Overtake cautiously \quad \textbf{B.} Give up overtaking \quad \textbf{C.} Drive alongside for a distance before overtaking \quad \textbf{D.} Accelerate to overtake}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：进入左侧道路超车，无法保证与正常行驶前车的横向安全间距时，应怎样做？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Give up overtaking  Without safe overtaking conditions, you should give up overtaking.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{912.}\ 
When a driver sees a "watch for children" sign while driving, what should they do?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Speed up \quad \textbf{B.} Take a detour \quad \textbf{C.} Maintain normal speed \quad \textbf{D.} Carefully choose driving speed}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶人行车中看到注意儿童标志的时候，应怎样做？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. Carefully choose driving speed  Drive courteously, safety first.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{913.}\ 
When the light is green at a congested intersection, what should a vehicle do?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} May enter the intersection directly \quad \textbf{B.} Must not enter the intersection \quad \textbf{C.} May use the oncoming lane to pass through \quad \textbf{D.} Enter the intersection if safety is ensured}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：在堵车的交叉路口绿灯亮时，车辆应怎样做？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Must not enter the intersection  If it is already congested, do not add to the jam.}\par\smallskip

[Image] For the white car on the left in the picture, to ensure safety in this situation, speed should be appropriately reduced.\par

{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：图中左侧白色轿车，在这种情况下为了保证安全，应适当降低车速。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Drive courteously and do not speed.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{915.}\ 
Which statement is correct about driving a motor vehicle down a steep slope?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} May turn off the engine \quad \textbf{B.} May use neutral but must not turn off the engine \quad \textbf{C.} May use neutral \quad \textbf{D.} Neutral or turning off the engine is not allowed}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车下陡坡时，以下说法正确的是？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. Neutral or turning off the engine is not allowed  Coasting in neutral downhill can cause loss of control and brake failure.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{916.}\ 
While braking on a slippery road, if the vehicle veers off course, which of the following is correct?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Repeatedly tap and release the brake pedal lightly \quad \textbf{B.} Press the brake pedal hard \quad \textbf{C.} Do not press the brake pedal \quad \textbf{D.} Press the brake pedal arbitrarily}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：湿滑路面制动过程中，发现车辆偏离方向，以下做法正确的是？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. Do not press the brake pedal  On slippery roads, braking hard cannot brake normally and may cause skidding and loss of control.}\par\smallskip

When driving on this type of uphill section, which of the following is correct?\par

{\small \textbf{A.} Shift to a lower gear and press the accelerator \quad \textbf{B.} Shift to a lower gear and release the accelerator \quad \textbf{C.} Shift to a higher gear and press the accelerator \quad \textbf{D.} Shift to a higher gear and release the accelerator}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：行驶至这种上坡路段时，以下做法正确的是什么？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Shift to a lower gear and press the accelerator  A lower gear gives the engine more pulling power, and pressing the accelerator maintains uphill speed and prevents rolling back.}\par\smallskip

\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{918.}\ 
Which of the following can help you avoid being rear-ended by another vehicle?\par

{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：下面哪种做法能帮助您避免被其他车辆从后方追撞？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Turn on the corresponding turn signal in advance before turning  Drive courteously, safety first.}\par\smallskip

{\small \textbf{A.} Keep using high beams \quad \textbf{B.} Keep switching back and forth between high and low beams \quad \textbf{C.} Switch to low beams \quad \textbf{D.} Turn off the lights}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：夜间行驶，与对向车道车辆交会时，以下做法正确的是？}\par

Neutral gear is prohibited on long downhill slopes. Which of the following reasons is incorrect?\par

{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：长下坡禁止挂空挡，下列原因错误的是？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. Using neutral downhill tends to increase fuel consumption  Coasting downhill in neutral can cause loss of control and brake failure; engine braking should be used to control speed.}\par\smallskip

When a vehicle needs to be towed due to breakdown or other reasons, which statement is correct?\par

{\small \textbf{A.} Both the towing and towed vehicles should turn on hazard lights \quad \textbf{B.} All vehicles should yield \quad \textbf{C.} Both vehicles should drive as fast as possible \quad \textbf{D.} Not subject to traffic signal restrictions}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：车辆因故障等原因需被牵引时，以下说法正确的是什么？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Both the towing and towed vehicles should turn on hazard lights  When towing, both the front and rear vehicles should have their hazard lights on.}\par\smallskip

If you are driving on a bumpy road section, which of the following is correct?\par

When driving on an expressway under weather conditions with visibility below 200 meters, the maximum speed must not exceed 60 km/h, and the distance from the vehicle ahead must be kept above 100 meters.\par

{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Signal permitting vehicles on the right going straight to pass  Memory aid: both hands extended out, right hand waving for straight-ahead traffic.}\par\smallskip

{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par

{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Red means stop, green means go, and a yellow light means wait.}\par\smallskip

{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：遇到图中这种有车道信号灯的路段，应该选择右侧或者左侧车道行驶。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  The middle lane shows a red cross, indicating it is closed to traffic.}\par\smallskip

{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：如果遇到图中这种情况需要超车时，可以在不影响公交车正常行驶的前提下借公交车道超越。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Overtaking must only be done from the left side.}\par\smallskip

{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par

{\small \textbf{A.} Water depth cannot be judged accurately \quad \textbf{B.} Standing water on the road affects distance judgment \quad \textbf{C.} The driver ahead's reactions become slower \quad \textbf{D.} Splashed water will impair visibility}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：在图中所示的道路跟车行驶时，为什么要保持较大的跟车距离？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. Splashed water will impair visibility  Drive courteously, safety first.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{14\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1003.}\ 
[Image] Before meeting an oncoming vehicle in an environment like this, you should first alternate high and low beams with the oncoming vehicle to observe the road ahead, and both vehicles should turn off their headlights when meeting.\par

{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：在图中这种环境下会车前，要先与对面来车交替变换远、近光灯观察前方道路情况，会车时两车都要关闭前大灯。}\par

{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：在图中所示的铁路道口，如果没有看到列车驶来就要加速通过道口。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  "Accelerate through" is incorrect.}\par\smallskip

{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Follow the vehicle ahead while maintaining a safe distance  Drive courteously, safety first.}\par\smallskip

{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par

{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par

{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车，必须遵循什么原则？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Drive on the right  Drive on the right, overtake from the left.}\par\smallskip

{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车在山区冰雪覆盖的道路上行驶，应当采取在\_\_\_上安装防滑链等安全措施？}\par

{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Drive courteously, safety first.}\par\smallskip

\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1022.}\ 
When driving in snow, you should turn on low beams and fog lights to indicate your vehicle's position to others.\par

{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  In snow with reduced visibility, low beams should be turned on to alert other vehicles.}\par\smallskip

\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1023.}\

\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1031.}\ 
Before entering a railway crossing, a vehicle should slow down and downshift; gear changes are allowed after entering the crossing.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶车辆驶入铁路道口前应减速降挡，进入道口后可以变换挡位。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Slowing down and downshifting must be completed before entering the railway crossing.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1032.}\ 
When traffic lights, traffic signs, or road markings conflict with a traffic police officer's directions, how should you proceed?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Follow the traffic light \quad \textbf{B.} Follow the traffic police officer's directions \quad \textbf{C.} Follow the traffic sign \quad \textbf{D.} Follow the road marking}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：遇到交通信号灯、交通标志或交通标线与交通警察的指挥不一致时，应如何行驶?}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Follow the traffic police officer's directions  A traffic police officer's hand signal takes priority over all other traffic signals.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{14\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1033.}\ 
[Image] As shown, a motor vehicle may not turn left in this situation.\par
\smallskip\begin{center}\includegraphics[width=6cm,height=4cm,keepaspectratio]{work/img/20200528174906sbsuqf1nqp3mxszi6ybbeq.jpg}\end{center}\smallskip
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：如图所示，驾驶机动车在这种情况下不可以左转弯。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Red means stop, green means go, and a yellow light means wait.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1034.}\ 
When driving at night through sharp curves, slopes, humpback bridges, or pedestrian crossings, you should alternate high and low beams to signal.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：夜间驾驶机动车通过急弯、坡路、拱桥、人行横道时，应当交替使用远近光灯示意。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Drive slowly and cautiously at night.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1035.}\ 
When encountering slow-moving traffic ahead on an expressway, which of the following is correct?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Follow the flow of traffic while keeping a safe distance \quad \textbf{B.} Drive into the emergency lane \quad \textbf{C.} You may reverse \quad \textbf{D.} Stop immediately}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车在高速公路上遇前方车流缓行时，以下做法正确的是什么？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Follow the flow of traffic while keeping a safe distance  Traffic congestion is even more reason not to force your way through.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{14\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1036.}\ 
[Image] As shown, car A's action is correct.\par
\smallskip\begin{center}\includegraphics[width=6cm,height=4cm,keepaspectratio]{work/img/20200528174906uhxjszozmtqxy1q8smbmrm.jpg}\end{center}\smallskip
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：如图所示，A车的行为是正确的。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  A dashed line permits lane changes; a solid line must not be crossed.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{14\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1037.}\ 
[Image] As shown, after exiting the ramp lane, a motor vehicle may drive directly into the through lane.\par
\smallskip\begin{center}\includegraphics[width=6cm,height=4cm,keepaspectratio]{work/img/20200528174906vtarywqv9cxxzol5c9affi.jpg}\end{center}\smallskip
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：如图所示，驾驶机动车驶出车道后可以直接驶入行车道。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  The process for entering an expressway is: entrance, ramp, acceleration lane, then the normal travel lane.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1038.}\ 
At night, when passing through an intersection with no or poor streetlighting, a following vehicle driving close behind a vehicle ahead in the same direction may use high beams to alert the vehicle ahead.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：夜间通过没有路灯或路灯照明不良的路口，同方向行驶的后车与前车近距离行驶时，可以使用远光灯提醒前车注意。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Low beams should be used when following closely at night.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{14\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1039.}\ 
[Image] As shown, when a motor vehicle encounters this situation, it should slow down while continuously honking to remind pedestrians to check the road conditions.\par
\smallskip\begin{center}\includegraphics[width=6cm,height=4cm,keepaspectratio]{work/img/20200608191055rkkaciw8pb9zfb7nq4wsrb.jpg}\end{center}\smallskip
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：如图所示，驾驶机动车遇到这种情况，要减速慢行，同时持续鸣喇叭提醒行人查看路况。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Continuous honking can startle pedestrians into crossing erratically, leading to accidents.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1040.}\ 
When a vehicle drives on an expressway at a speed below 100 km/h, the minimum safe following distance from the vehicle ahead in the same lane is 100 meters or more.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：车辆在高速公路以低于每小时100公里的速度行驶时，距同车道前车最低保持100米以上为安全距离。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Expressway rule: above 100 km/h requires a following distance over 100 meters; below 100 km/h requires over 50 meters.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1041.}\ 
When driving a motor vehicle in the slow lane on a road with two or more lanes in the same direction, if you need to pass the vehicle ahead in the same lane, you may pass via the fast lane.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车在同方向划有2条以上机动车道的慢速车道内行驶，需要超越同车道行驶的前车时，可以通过快速车道进行超越。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Overtaking must be done from the left side, so passing via the fast lane on the left is correct.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1042.}\ 
Parking a motor vehicle within 50 meters of a construction section is prohibited.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车距离施工路段50米内禁止停放车辆。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  The rule bars parking within 30m of a bus stop and within 50m of intersections or construction zones.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1043.}\ 
Warning markings function to make road users aware of special conditions on the road, raising alertness and preparing them for responsive precautions.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：警告标线的作用是促使道路使用者了解道路上的特殊情况，提高警觉准备应变防范措施。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Warning markings exist precisely to alert road users to hazards.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1044.}\ 
A blue parking space marking indicates a paid parking space.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：停车位标线为蓝色表示收费停车位。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  White markings indicate paid parking, blue indicates free parking, and yellow indicates reserved parking.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1045.}\ 
When using a flexible tow-link device, what distance should be kept between the towing vehicle and the towed vehicle?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Less than 0.5 meters \quad \textbf{B.} Less than 4 meters \quad \textbf{C.} More than 4 meters but less than 10 meters \quad \textbf{D.} More than 10 meters}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：使用软连接牵引装置时，牵引车与被牵引车之间应当保持多远距离？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. More than 4 meters but less than 10 meters  Chinese traffic rules require the gap between vehicles joined by a flexible tow connector to be 4 to 10 meters.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1046.}\ 
When pulling over to park a motor vehicle on the road, how should lights be used?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Alternate between high and low beams \quad \textbf{B.} No need to turn on any lights \quad \textbf{C.} Turn on the hazard warning lights \quad \textbf{D.} Turn on the right turn signal in advance}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车在路上靠边停车，应如何使用灯光？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. Turn on the right turn signal in advance  Pulling over requires the right turn signal; U-turns and overtaking require the left turn signal.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1047.}\ 
For failing to use lights as required while driving a motor vehicle, how many demerit points are given per violation?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 1 point \quad \textbf{B.} 9 points \quad \textbf{C.} 3 points \quad \textbf{D.} 6 points}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车不按规定使用灯光的，将被一次记多少分？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. 1 point  Improper light use, marking/line violations, missed inspection, and no seatbelt each carry a 1-point penalty.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1048.}\ 
When starting to drive at night on a road section with street lighting, high beams should be used.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：夜间驾驶机动车在有路灯照明的路段起步，应开启远光灯。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  High beams may only be used where lighting is poor and no vehicles are ahead or approaching.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1049.}\ 
Regarding the use of turn signals while driving, which statement is correct?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} The turn signal may be skipped when returning to the original lane after overtaking \quad \textbf{B.} The turn signal is not needed when pulling away from a parked position \quad \textbf{C.} The right turn signal should be turned on in advance when pulling over to park \quad \textbf{D.} The turn signal may be skipped when changing lanes}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：关于驾驶机动车时转向灯的使用，以下说法正确的是什么？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. The right turn signal should be turned on in advance when pulling over to park  Turn signals must be used in advance for pulling over, changing lanes, finishing an overtake, and pulling away from a stop.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1050.}\ 
In which of the following driving situations is a turn signal required? (1) preparing to overtake (2) turning at an intersection (3) pulling over to park (4) changing lanes\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Only (1) \quad \textbf{B.} Only (1)(2) \quad \textbf{C.} Only (1)(2)(3) \quad \textbf{D.} (1)(2)(3)(4)}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：下列驾驶情形中，需要使用转向灯的是？①准备超车②路口转弯③靠边停车④变更车道}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. (1)(2)(3)(4)  Any change in driving state must be signaled to other vehicles in time.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1051.}\ 
How should lights be used when driving through a crosswalk at night?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Alternate between high and low beams \quad \textbf{B.} Turn on the fog lights \quad \textbf{C.} Turn on the high beams \quad \textbf{D.} Turn off the headlights}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车在夜间通过人行横道时怎样使用灯光？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Alternate between high and low beams  Alternating high and low beams signals pedestrians at a crosswalk at night.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1052.}\ 
At a signal-controlled intersection, when the through signal is green and the left-turn signal is red, a vehicle may enter the left-turn waiting area to wait.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：在有信号灯的交叉路口，直行是绿灯，左转是红灯时，车辆可以进入左转待转区等待。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Entering the left-turn waiting area is allowed only while the through signal is green.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1053.}\ 
On narrow mountain slopes, when vehicles meet, the downhill vehicle has the right of way because downhill speed is harder to control and more dangerous.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：山区狭窄坡路会车时，下坡的车辆先行，因为下坡速度不好控制更加危险。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  On a narrow slope, the uphill vehicle has the right of way, not the downhill one.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1054.}\ 
What light should be turned on when a motor vehicle enters an expressway from a ramp?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Left turn signal \quad \textbf{B.} Right turn signal \quad \textbf{C.} Hazard warning lights \quad \textbf{D.} Headlights}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车从匝道驶入高速公路，应当开启什么灯？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Left turn signal  Merging is a leftward lane change, so the left turn signal must be used in advance.}\par\smallskip

\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1055.}\ 
A tidal lane is a variable lane whose direction of travel is adjusted according to morning and evening traffic flow.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：潮汐车道是可变车道，会根据早晚车流量，调整车道行驶方向。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Tidal lanes are designed specifically to handle morning and evening traffic peaks.}\par\smallskip

Traffic police hand signals carry the strongest legal authority among all traffic signals (signal lights, signs, markings, etc.).\par

{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：交通警察手势信号是所有交通信号(信号灯、标志、标线等)当中法律效力最强的一种信号。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Police hand signals take precedence over all other traffic signals.}\par\smallskip

When driving at night and the light turns green at an intersection, if pedestrians are still crossing the crosswalk, high beams should be used to hurry them along.\par

{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：夜间驾驶机动车在路口遇前方绿灯亮起时，如果人行横道上仍有行人通过，应开启远光灯催促其尽快通过。}\par

Which of the following signs indicates an uneven road surface ahead?\par

{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：下面哪个标志表示注意路面不平？}\par

Which of the following signs indicates a hump (camelback) bridge ahead?\par
\smallskip\begin{center}\includegraphics[width=6cm,height=4cm,keepaspectratio]{work/img/20200727150249kxmbockmfbejoh56gtcpqx.jpg}\end{center}\smallskip
{\small \textbf{A.} Figure ① \quad \textbf{B.} Figure ② \quad \textbf{C.} Figure ③ \quad \textbf{D.} Figure ④}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：下面哪个标志表示注意驼峰桥？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Figure ①  Memory aid: the hump-shaped sign with a bridge outline indicates a camelback bridge.}\par\smallskip

\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1061.}\ 
Before entering a two-way tunnel, high beams should be turned on.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：车辆驶入双向行驶隧道前，要开启远光灯。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  High beams blind oncoming drivers in a tunnel and can easily cause an accident.}\par\smallskip

When waiting at an intersection with no traffic lights, it is acceptable to temporarily use the opposing lane to avoid causing worse congestion.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：在没有交通信号灯的路口遇停车等待时，可以临时占用对面车道，以免造成更大的拥堵。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Occupying the opposing lane at a congested intersection can make the congestion even worse.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1063.}\ 
Prohibition markings function to inform road users of special rules such as mandatory compliance, prohibitions, and restrictions.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：禁止标线的作用是告知道路使用者道路交通的遵行、禁止、限制等特殊规定。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  This is the defined function of prohibition markings under traffic regulations.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1064.}\ 
Work-zone signs function to announce road closures, detours, and similar conditions.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：作业区标志的作用是通告道路交通阻断、绕行等情况。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Work-zone signs direct drivers to detour as indicated by the sign.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1065.}\ 
If a vehicle breaks down or is in an accident on an expressway, the driver should pull the car to the side, evacuate people, and call for help immediately, to avoid a secondary accident.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车在高速公路上发生车辆故障或事故时，应做到“车靠边、人撤离、即报警”，避免发生二次事故。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Expressway breakdown procedure: hazard lights, move the vehicle aside, place a warning triangle, evacuate people, then call for help.}\par\smallskip

What color is the parking line marking for a free parking space?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} White \quad \textbf{B.} Blue \quad \textbf{C.} Yellow \quad \textbf{D.} Red}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：免费停车位的停车标线是什么颜色?}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Blue  White markings indicate paid parking, blue indicates free parking, and yellow indicates reserved parking.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1067.}\ 
When changing lanes, once the turn signal is switched on in advance, the lane change can be made immediately.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：变更车道时，提前打开转向灯后，就可以立即变更车道。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Lane changes require signaling, checking behind, and confirming a safe gap before actually moving over.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1068.}\ 
How should lights be used when a motor vehicle finishes overtaking and returns to its original lane?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Turn on the left turn signal \quad \textbf{B.} Turn on the right turn signal \quad \textbf{C.} Turn on the low beams \quad \textbf{D.} Turn on the hazard warning lights}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车完成超车、驶回原车道时，应该怎样使用灯光?}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Turn on the right turn signal  Overtaking is done from the left, so returning to the original lane on the right requires the right turn signal.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1069.}\ 
Which of the following distances is NOT included in stopping sight distance?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Starting distance \quad \textbf{B.} Reaction distance \quad \textbf{C.} Braking distance \quad \textbf{D.} Safety distance}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：停车视距不包括以下哪个距离？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Starting distance  Stopping sight distance runs from spotting an obstacle to fully stopping, which excludes the starting distance.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1070.}\ 
Warning signs alert drivers that there is danger ahead and that they must proceed with caution.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：警告标志是警告机动车驾驶人前方有危险，需谨慎通过。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Yellow-plate signs are, by definition, warning signs.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1071.}\ 
When intending to change lanes while driving, the turn signal should be switched on in advance and the lane change made smoothly only once safety is confirmed.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车在道路上行驶，欲变更车道时，应提前开启转向灯，在确认安全的前提下，平稳变更车道。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Lane changes must only be carried out once safety has been confirmed.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1072.}\ 
If symptoms such as fainting, nausea, weakness, or hallucinations that affect safe driving occur, the driver must not continue driving, to avoid a traffic accident.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：出现晕厥、恶心、乏力、幻象等影响安全驾驶的现象时，驾驶人不能继续驾驶机动车，避免发生交通事故。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Safety always comes first when driving.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1073.}\ 
How should lights be used when preparing to exit a roundabout?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Turn on the left turn signal in advance \quad \textbf{B.} No signal is needed \quad \textbf{C.} Turn on the hazard warning lights \quad \textbf{D.} Turn on the right turn signal in advance}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车准备驶离环岛时，应如何使用灯光？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. Turn on the right turn signal in advance  No signal is needed entering a roundabout, but the right turn signal is required when exiting.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1074.}\ 
When passing a crosswalk at a school gate, it is fine to accelerate through as long as no pedestrians are crossing.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车通过学校门口的人行横道，只要没有行人经过，就可以加速通过。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Accelerating through a crosswalk is never correct, even without pedestrians present.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1075.}\ 
When reversing a motor vehicle, the driver must clearly check the situation behind the car and confirm it is safe before reversing.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车倒车时，应当察明车后情况，确认安全后倒车。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Reversing has blind spots, so drivers must observe surroundings carefully and yield to passing vehicles.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1076.}\ 
When meeting oncoming traffic on a congested road, the lateral distance between the two vehicles does not need attention.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：在拥堵的道路上驾驶机动车与对向来车会车时，可以不注意两车横向间距。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Insufficient lateral safety distance between vehicles can cause a traffic accident.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1077.}\ 
When driving on a road with a maximum speed limit sign, which statement is correct?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} The posted maximum speed must not be exceeded \quad \textbf{B.} Exceeding the posted maximum speed by 10\% is allowed \quad \textbf{C.} The vehicle's maximum design speed may be exceeded \quad \textbf{D.} The vehicle must always travel at exactly the posted maximum speed}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车在设有最高限速标志的道路上行驶，以下说法正确的是什么？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. The posted maximum speed must not be exceeded  Drivers must comply with the speed indicated by the posted speed limit sign.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1078.}\ 
When approaching the crest of an uphill section at night, high beams should be used.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：夜间驾驶机动车驶近上坡坡顶路段时，要使用远光灯。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  High beams can blind oncoming drivers over a hill crest, which is unsafe.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1079.}\ 
On a road with a designated dedicated lane, only the specified vehicles are permitted to use that lane.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：道路划设专用车道的，在专用车道内，只准许规定的车辆通行。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  A dedicated lane is, by definition, reserved for the specified vehicle type.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1080.}\ 
What should be done when driving on an expressway and encountering slow-moving traffic ahead?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Reverse the vehicle \quad \textbf{B.} Drive in the emergency lane \quad \textbf{C.} Follow the traffic flow while keeping a safe following distance \quad \textbf{D.} Stop immediately}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车在高速公路上行驶遇前方车流行驶缓慢时，应该怎么做？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. Follow the traffic flow while keeping a safe following distance  Using the emergency lane on an expressway carries a 6-point penalty, so drivers should follow traffic at a safe distance.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1081.}\ 
When towing a broken-down vehicle, both the towing and towed vehicles must turn on hazard warning lights, and the maximum speed must not exceed 60 km/h.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：牵引故障车时，牵引与被牵引的机动车都要开启危险报警闪光灯，最高行驶速度不得超过60公里/小时。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Both vehicles must use hazard lights when towing, but the stated 60 km/h speed limit is incorrect.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1082.}\ 
What should be done when a motor vehicle encounters a stop signal ahead?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Stop before (outside) the stop line \quad \textbf{B.} Stop within (past) the stop line \quad \textbf{C.} Stop at the right side of the intersection \quad \textbf{D.} Stop in the middle of the intersection}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车遇前方停止信号时，应该怎么做?}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Stop before (outside) the stop line  Stopping before the stop line is required; crossing it violates the traffic signal.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1083.}\ 
When starting to drive in low-visibility snowy weather, low beams should be turned on.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车在能见度低的雪天起步时，要开启近光灯。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Low beams are required when starting to drive in snowy, low-visibility conditions.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1084.}\ 
Prohibition signs are used to forbid or restrict the traffic behavior of vehicles and pedestrians.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：禁令标志是用以禁止和限制车辆、行人交通行为的标志。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Red-plate signs are, by definition, prohibition signs.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
