\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1085.}\ 
If a vehicle breaks down on an expressway and cannot move normally, it should be towed by a rescue or recovery vehicle; the towing vehicle must use hazard lights, but the towed broken-down vehicle does not need to use any lights.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车在高速公路上发生故障，无法正常行驶，应由救援车或清障车拖曳、牵引，牵引车应开启危险报警闪光灯，被牵引的故障车无需开启灯光。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Only a professional recovery vehicle may tow it, and the towed vehicle must also use hazard lights.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1086.}\ 
How should lights be used when approaching an uphill section at night?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Turn off the high beams \quad \textbf{B.} Use the hazard warning lights \quad \textbf{C.} Use the high beams \quad \textbf{D.} Alternate between high and low beams}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：夜间驾驶机动车驶近上坡路段时，应如何使用灯光？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. Alternate between high and low beams  Uphill sections have complex visibility, so alternating beams warns other road users.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1087.}\ 
When exiting a roundabout, the driver should first move into the rightmost lane and may exit without using a turn signal.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车驶出环岛时，应先驶入最右侧车道不用开启转向灯驶离即可。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  No signal is needed entering a roundabout, but the right turn signal must be used in advance when exiting.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1088.}\ 
In foggy weather, a motor vehicle should have its fog lights, low beams, position lights, and rear lights on; when visibility is especially low, hazard warning lights should also be turned on.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车在雾天行车应开启雾灯、近光灯、示廓灯和后位灯，能见度较低时，还应开启危险报警闪光灯。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Vehicles must use fog lights and hazard warning lights when driving in fog.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1089.}\ 
How should speed be controlled when crossing a narrow bridge with good road conditions?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} No more than 60 km/h \quad \textbf{B.} No more than 50 km/h \quad \textbf{C.} No more than 40 km/h \quad \textbf{D.} No more than 30 km/h}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车通过路面条件较好的窄桥怎样控制车速？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. No more than 30 km/h  Speed must not exceed 30 km/h when crossing a narrow bridge or narrow road.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1090.}\ 
When entering sections with limited sight distance, such as sharp bends or the crest of a slope, a motor vehicle should slow down and sound the horn to signal.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驶进急弯、坡道顶端等影响安全视距的路段时，应当减速慢行，并鸣喇叭示意。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Limited sight distance requires slowing down; safety comes first.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1091.}\ 
When driving in strong wind and the steering wheel suddenly feels hard to control, the driver should turn the steering wheel against the wind direction.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：在大风天气条件下驾驶机动车，突然感觉到方向盘难以控制时，要逆风方向转动方向盘。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Turning against the wind is the wrong response; the wheel should be corrected the other way.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1092.}\ 
When entering a roundabout, a motor vehicle should travel clockwise, slowing down or stopping to yield when necessary.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车在进入环岛路口时应按顺时针方向行驶，必要时减速或停车让行。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Roundabouts in China are driven counterclockwise, not clockwise.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1093.}\ 
When making a U-turn on an expressway ramp, the driver should ensure no vehicles are approaching from behind.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：车辆在高速公路匝道上掉头时，应确保后方无来车。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  U-turns and reversing are never allowed anywhere on an expressway, including ramps.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1094.}\ 
When temporarily stopping on the road, a motor vehicle should park facing the direction of traffic, with the vehicle body no more than 50 cm from the road edge.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车在道路上临时停车时，应按顺行方向停车，车身距道路边缘不超过50厘米。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Temporary stopping must not obstruct other vehicles or pedestrians; the stated distance requirement is incorrect.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1095.}\ 
Drivers should straddle lane-dividing lines as much as possible while driving, to make it easier to pick a lane based on conditions ahead.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车应尽量骑轧可跨越车道分界线行驶，便于根据前方道路情况选择车道。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Straddling lane lines is not allowed; drivers should keep to the right within their lane.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1096.}\ 
When driving through a sharp bend at night, the driver should alternate between high and low beams.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：夜间驾驶机动车通过急弯路时，应交替使用远近光灯。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Signaling with alternating beams around a blind bend is safe, courteous driving.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1097.}\ 
A continuously flashing yellow warning signal means motor vehicles should watch carefully and may proceed once safety is confirmed.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：黄色闪光警告信号灯持续闪烁，表示机动车要注意瞭望，在确认安全后可以通过。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  A steady yellow light means wait, while a continuously flashing yellow light means proceed once safety is confirmed.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1098.}\ 
If a driver feels fatigued while driving on an expressway, they should stop and rest at the next service area.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：在高速公路上行驶感觉疲劳时，应在下一个服务区停车休息。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Stopping on an expressway is not allowed except in emergencies, so drivers must wait for the next service area.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1099.}\ 
Where should a warning triangle be placed if a motor vehicle breaks down on an expressway?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} In the direction traffic is coming from \quad \textbf{B.} In front of the vehicle \quad \textbf{C.} No need to set one up \quad \textbf{D.} Anywhere}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车在高速上发生故障时，应当如何设置警告标志？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. In the direction traffic is coming from  Warning triangles go on the side traffic approaches from: 50-100m on ordinary roads, over 150m on expressways.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1100.}\ 
When a vehicle skids sideways on a muddy road, which of the following actions is correct?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Turn the steering wheel slightly toward the direction of the skid to correct it \quad \textbf{B.} Turn the steering wheel slightly away from the direction of the skid to correct it \quad \textbf{C.} Brake hard to slow down \quad \textbf{D.} Brake hard to stop}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：车辆在泥泞路上发生侧滑时，以下做法正确的是？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Turn the steering wheel slightly toward the direction of the skid to correct it  Since most cars steer with the front wheels, correcting toward the skid direction helps regain control.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1101.}\ 
Before crossing a railway crossing, shift into a low gear and do not change gears midway, to avoid stalling the engine.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：车辆通过铁路道口前，换入低速挡，不得中途换挡，避免导致发动机熄火。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Slowing down and shifting gears must be completed before entering the railway crossing.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1102.}\ 
On a road section with heavy traffic flow, the following distance is not important; it is enough to just keep a low speed.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：如遇交通流量较大的路段，跟车距离不重要，只需要保持低速行驶即可。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Even at low speed, an insufficient following distance can still cause a rear-end collision.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1103.}\ 
When driving on an expressway in foggy weather, which statement is correct?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} When visibility is under 100 meters, speed must not exceed 60 km/h \quad \textbf{B.} When visibility is under 50 meters, speed must not exceed 20 km/h, and the driver should exit the expressway at the nearest exit \quad \textbf{C.} When visibility is under 200 meters, speed must not exceed 80 km/h \quad \textbf{D.} When visibility is under 30 meters, the vehicle should simply stop and wait in the travel lane}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车在高速公路上遇雾天时，以下说法正确的是什么？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. When visibility is under 50 meters, speed must not exceed 20 km/h, and the driver should exit the expressway at the nearest exit  Memory aid for expressway fog rules: under 200m drive at 60, under 100m at 40, under 50m at 20 and exit at the nearest ramp.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1104.}\ 
A street-sweeping vehicle working on the road, as long as it does not obstruct other traffic, may be exempt from what restriction?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Speed limit restrictions \quad \textbf{B.} Lane-discipline restrictions \quad \textbf{C.} Traffic signal restrictions \quad \textbf{D.} Traffic sign restrictions}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：在道路上作业的清扫车在不影响其他车辆通行的情况下，可以不受什么限制？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Lane-discipline restrictions  Working sweeper vehicles are exempt from normal lane-discipline rules; other vehicles must give way.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1105.}\ 
When reversing on an expressway ramp, the driver should turn on hazard warning lights.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：车辆在高速公路匝道上倒车时，应开启危险报警闪光灯。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Reversing is never allowed anywhere on an expressway, including ramps, regardless of lights used.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1106.}\ 
A school bus must not carry more than its certified number of passengers, for any reason whatsoever.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：校车载人不得超过核定的人数，不得以任何理由超员。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Overloading a school bus is irresponsible toward students' personal safety.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1107.}\ 
When meeting oncoming traffic at night, high beams may be turned on so both vehicles can see the road more clearly.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：夜间驾驶机动车会车时，可开启远光灯，以便本车和对向车辆能够更好的看清路面情况。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Drivers must switch to low beams more than 150 meters before meeting oncoming traffic at night.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1108.}\ 
Traffic police directing traffic use two types of signals: hand signals and instrument-assisted signals.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：交通警察的指挥分为：手势信号和使用器具的交通指挥信号。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Both hand gestures and equipment-based signals are recognized methods of police traffic direction.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1109.}\ 
Overinflated tires are prone to blowouts, so in hot weather, air should be regularly let out to lower tire pressure.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：轮胎胎压过高时容易爆胎，因此在天气炎热时，要经常放气降低胎压。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Both overinflation and underinflation can cause a blowout; releasing air is not the correct fix.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1110.}\ 
When driving through a sharp bend, the maximum speed must not exceed 30 km/h.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车通过急弯路时，最高行驶速度不得超过30公里/小时。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Speed must not exceed 30 km/h at railway crossings, sharp bends, narrow roads, and narrow bridges.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1111.}\ 
After entering the acceleration lane, the vehicle should quickly raise its speed to above 60 km/h.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：车辆驶入加速车道后，尽快将车速提高到每小时60公里以上。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  The minimum expressway speed is 60 km/h, so drivers must reach it before merging.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1112.}\ 
On an expressway, a motor vehicle may use the emergency lane at any time to drive, overtake, or park.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车在高速公路上行驶，可以随时借用应急车道行驶、超车或停车。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Driving improperly on an expressway, including misusing the emergency lane, carries a 6-point penalty.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1113.}\ 
When following another vehicle on a slope, a motor vehicle should keep a larger safety distance than on flat road.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车在坡道路段跟车行驶时，应保留比平路跟车时更大的安全距离。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Slopes reduce braking control, so a larger following distance is safer.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1114.}\ 
After a motor vehicle exits the expressway onto the ramp, its speed should be reduced below the posted limit.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车驶离高速公路进入匝道后，应将车速降到限定速度以下。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Drivers must comply with the posted speed limit, which is lower on ramps.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1115.}\ 
Operating a school bus or passenger transport service while severely exceeding the rated passenger capacity can constitute the crime of dangerous driving.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：从事校车业务或者旅客运输，严重超过额定乘客载客的，可构成危险驾驶罪。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Severe overloading or overspeeding by school buses or passenger vehicles can constitute the crime of dangerous driving.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1116.}\ 
Temporary parking is allowed on a sidewalk that has no marked parking spaces.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：在没有施划停车位的人行道上可以临时停车。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Parking on sidewalks is prohibited.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1117.}\ 
On a road with two or more lanes marked in the same direction, the left side is the fast lane and the right side is the slow lane.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：在道路同方向划有2条以上机动车道的，左侧为快速车道，右侧为慢速车道。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Memory aid: left is fast, right is slow.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1118.}\ 
Pedestrians must not climb over or sit on road dividers, cling to vehicles, forcibly stop vehicles, or carry out other acts that endanger road traffic safety.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：行人不得跨越、倚坐道路隔离设施，不得扒车、强行拦车或者实施妨碍道路交通安全的其他行为。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Road safety is everyone's responsibility, and these rules apply to pedestrians too.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1119.}\ 
Guide signs function to provide route information, conveying road direction, location, and distance to drivers.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：指路标志的作用是指引道路信息，为驾驶人传递道路方向、地点、距离等信息。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Guide signs typically include information such as direction, location, and distance.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1120.}\ 
When following another vehicle in foggy weather, which of the following practices is wrong?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Increase the distance between the two vehicles \quad \textbf{B.} Constantly watch for changes in the lead vehicle's brake lights \quad \textbf{C.} Reduce driving speed \quad \textbf{D.} Honk to tell the lead vehicle to speed up, to avoid being rear-ended}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：雾天驾驶机动车跟车行驶，以下做法错误的是什么？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. Honk to tell the lead vehicle to speed up, to avoid being rear-ended  In fog, drivers should use fog lights and slow down; honking to make the lead car speed up is wrong.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1121.}\ 
Where is it prohibited to park a motor vehicle within 50 meters?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} First-aid station \quad \textbf{B.} Fire hydrant \quad \textbf{C.} Intersection \quad \textbf{D.} Bus stop}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车在距离50米以内不得停车的路段是什么？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. Intersection  Memory rule: no parking within 30m of a bus stop or 50m of an intersection.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1122.}\ 
On an expressway, the maximum speed must not exceed 120 km/h.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：高速公路上最高时速不得超过120公里。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  The expressway maximum speed is 120 km/h and the minimum is 60 km/h.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1123.}\ 
At an intersection directed by traffic police, when vehicles are queued or moving slowly, motor vehicles should proceed alternately in turn.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：交通警察指挥的交叉路口遇到停车排队等候或者缓慢行驶时，机动车应当依次交替通行。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  When a traffic police officer is directing on scene, their instructions take priority.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1124.}\ 
If a motor vehicle is involved in a traffic accident at night and cannot be moved, what lights should be turned on?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} High beams and hazard warning lights \quad \textbf{B.} Low beams and hazard warning lights \quad \textbf{C.} Hazard warning lights, outline lights, and rear position lights \quad \textbf{D.} The interior cabin light}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：夜间驾驶机动车发生交通事故，难以移动的，应当开启什么灯？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. Hazard warning lights, outline lights, and rear position lights  An immobile vehicle at night must use hazard lights, outline lights, and rear position lights to warn other vehicles.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1125.}\ 
A driver with an illness that impairs safe driving may still drive as long as there is no obvious discomfort at the time.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶人患有妨碍安全驾驶机动车的疾病，在无明显不适的情况下，可以驾驶机动车。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Any condition posing a safety risk means the person should not drive.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1126.}\ 
On a long downhill section, turning off the engine or coasting in neutral can reduce fuel consumption.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车在长下坡路段行驶时，熄火或者空挡滑行可以减少油耗。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Turning off the engine or coasting in neutral downhill is dangerous and not allowed.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1127.}\ 
When a motor vehicle needs to stop temporarily by the roadside, which of the following statements is wrong?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} It may stop temporarily on a crosswalk \quad \textbf{B.} It may stop in a roadside parking bay \quad \textbf{C.} It may stop temporarily where a no-prolonged-parking sign is posted \quad \textbf{D.} It must not stop where a no-parking sign is posted}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车需要在路边临时停车时，下列哪种说法是错误的？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. It may stop temporarily on a crosswalk  Stopping on a crosswalk is never allowed.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1128.}\ 
When needing to stop temporarily roadside, a driver may choose to stop on a crosswalk as long as it does not block pedestrians.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车需要在路边临时停车时，可选择在不影响行人通行的人行横道上停放。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Crosswalks are reserved for pedestrians; parking a motor vehicle there is prohibited.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1129.}\ 
Which of the following behaviors is prohibited while driving a motor vehicle?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Watching the vehicle ahead \quad \textbf{B.} Watching an in-car TV screen \quad \textbf{C.} Watching the vehicle behind \quad \textbf{D.} Watching traffic signals}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车不得有下列哪种行为？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Watching an in-car TV screen  Watching an in-car television screen distracts from safe driving and is prohibited.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1130.}\ 
After how long of continuous driving must a driver stop and rest for at least 20 minutes?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 2 hours \quad \textbf{B.} 4 hours \quad \textbf{C.} 6 hours \quad \textbf{D.} 8 hours}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶人连续驾驶机动车超过多长时间时，应停车休息至少20分钟？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. 4 hours  Drivers must rest at least 20 minutes after 4 hours of continuous driving to prevent fatigue.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1131.}\ 
Decorative plush toys may be hung from the front windshield of a motor vehicle.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车前风窗玻璃处可以悬挂装饰类毛绒玩具。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Hanging objects on the windshield creates blind spots, so it is prohibited.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1132.}\ 
A driver who has driven continuously for more than 4 hours should stop and rest for at least 20 minutes.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶人连续驾驶机动车超过4小时，应停车休息至少20分钟。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Resting after 4 hours of continuous driving prevents fatigue-related accidents.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1133.}\ 
While driving on an expressway, a motor vehicle must not throw or scatter objects out the window.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车在高速公路上行驶时，不得向窗外抛撒物品。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Throwing objects from a moving vehicle endangers other road users, so it is prohibited.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1134.}\ 
When driving and encountering an engineering rescue vehicle at work, the driver should proactively yield.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车在路上行驶，遇到正在进行作业的工程救险车时，要主动避让。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Police cars, fire engines, ambulances, and engineering rescue vehicles on emergency duty must always be given the right of way.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1135.}\ 
When driving at 110 km/h on an expressway, a motor vehicle must keep a minimum following distance of at least 50 meters from the vehicle ahead in the same lane.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车以每小时110公里的速度在高速公路上行驶时，与同车道前车最低保持50米以上的安全距离。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Above 100 km/h the required following distance is over 100 meters, not 50.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1136.}\ 
When driving in the left lane of a two-lane-per-direction expressway, what minimum following distance should be kept from the vehicle ahead in the same lane?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 20 meters \quad \textbf{B.} 30 meters \quad \textbf{C.} 50 meters \quad \textbf{D.} 100 meters}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：在高速同向两车道左侧车道行驶时，应当与同车道前车保持多少米以上的安全距离？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. 100 meters  The left lane implies higher speed (over 100 km/h), requiring a following distance of over 100 meters.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1137.}\ 
In which of the following situations may a driver still drive a motor vehicle?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} After taking a state-controlled psychotropic drug \quad \textbf{B.} After drinking alcohol \quad \textbf{C.} When severely fatigued \quad \textbf{D.} After drinking water}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶人出现下列哪种情况时，可以驾驶机动车？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. After drinking water  Controlled drugs, alcohol, and severe fatigue all impair safe driving, unlike drinking water.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1138.}\ 
The double solid white line at the very front of an intersection is a slow-down-and-yield line.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：路口最前端的双白实线是减速让行线。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  A double solid white line is actually a stop-and-yield line; the double dashed line is the slow-down-and-yield line.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1139.}\ 
When a motor vehicle needs to park by the roadside, it should park within a designated parking bay.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车需要在路边停车时，应在停车泊位内停放。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Where parking bays are marked, vehicles must park within them.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1140.}\ 
While driving in strong wind, if a gust causes the vehicle to drift sideways, the driver should sharply turn the steering wheel to correct direction.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：大风天气行车中，如果遇到狂风袭来，感觉机动车产生横向偏移时，要急转方向以恢复行驶方向。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Sharp steering corrections are not allowed in strong winds; the wheel should be adjusted gently.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1141.}\ 
The double dashed white line at the very front of an intersection is a stop-and-yield line.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：路口最前端的双白虚线是停车让行线。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  A double dashed white line is actually the slow-down-and-yield line; the double solid line is the stop-and-yield line.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1142.}\ 
When driving through a school zone, what is the maximum speed allowed?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 30 km/h \quad \textbf{B.} 60 km/h \quad \textbf{C.} 90 km/h \quad \textbf{D.} 100 km/h}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车通过学校区域时，最高车速不得超过多少？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. 30 km/h  School zones require reduced speed, capped at 30 km/h, for pedestrian safety.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1143.}\ 
When encountering livestock crossing or blocking the road, the driver should honk promptly to drive them away.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶汽车遇到牲畜横穿抢道的情况，要及时鸣喇叭进行驱赶。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Honking can startle livestock into unpredictable movement; slowing down and waiting is the safer response.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1144.}\ 
When meeting oncoming traffic at night, it is acceptable to turn off the headlights at the appropriate moment.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：在夜间会车的时候，可以适时关闭前大灯。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  At night, headlights must switch from high to low beam before meeting oncoming traffic, not be turned off entirely.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1145.}\ 
When a driver has taken medication that could affect driving ability, the driver must not drive a motor vehicle.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：当驾驶人服用的药物对驾驶行为可能有影响时，驾驶人不得驾驶机动车。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Any safety risk, including medication side effects, means the person must not drive.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{14\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1146.}\ 
[Image] When a motor vehicle passes through the intersection shown with the green light on, it may proceed directly.\par
\smallskip\begin{center}\includegraphics[width=6cm,height=4cm,keepaspectratio]{work/img/20210330145531pfnktb4ui6irdf9nvdftsd.jpg}\end{center}\smallskip
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车经过图中绿灯亮的路口时，可以直接通过。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  When a traffic police officer is directing on scene, their instructions override the signal light.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1147.}\ 
In rainy weather, a vehicle's driving resistance increases.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：雨天行车，车辆行驶阻力会增大。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Rain reduces tire traction rather than increasing driving resistance, so emergency braking should be avoided.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1148.}\ 
When crossing an unmanned railway crossing, it is fine to accelerate through as long as safety is ensured.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：通过无人看守的铁路道口，只要在确保安全的情况下，就可以加速通过。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Railway crossings require stopping, looking, then proceeding, never accelerating through.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1149.}\ 
If a motor vehicle's engine suddenly stalls at a railway crossing and cannot restart, the driver should repair it on the spot immediately.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车在铁路道口突然熄火，无法重新启动时，应立即就地检修。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Repairing the car on the tracks risks serious consequences if a train arrives; evacuate and call for help instead.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1150.}\ 
When passing through an intersection without traffic lights, a motor vehicle should slow down and yield to pedestrians and vehicles with the right of way.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车在通过没有信号灯的交叉路口，应当减速慢行，并让行人和优先通行的车辆先行。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Without signal control, slowing down and yielding is even more essential for safety.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1151.}\ 
After taking a state-controlled narcotic drug, it is acceptable to drive a motor vehicle for a short distance.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：服用国家管制的麻醉药品可以短途驾驶机动车。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Any safety risk, including controlled narcotics, means driving is prohibited, regardless of distance.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1152.}\ 
A motor vehicle must not overtake the vehicle ahead in the same lane when that vehicle has its left turn signal on.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车遇同车道行驶的前车开启左转向灯时不得超车。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  A left signal from the lead vehicle may indicate it is changing lanes or turning, making it unsafe to overtake.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{14\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1153.}\ 
[Image] The sign shown indicates that temporary parking is allowed.\par
\smallskip\begin{center}\includegraphics[width=6cm,height=4cm,keepaspectratio]{work/img/20210506182100voj7fwkas1g8oomdzdreab.jpg}\end{center}\smallskip
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：图中标志表示允许临时停车。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  A red circle with a red cross through it means no stopping, so this sign actually prohibits parking.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1154.}\ 
When encountering an ambulance or other special vehicle on duty, a motor vehicle should quickly yield, clearing a life-saving lane for it.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车遇到救护车等执行任务的特种车辆时，应迅速避让，为特种车辆空出一条“生命通道”。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Ambulances are saving lives, and life safety takes priority over everything else.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1155.}\ 
When a school bus is stopped on the right side of the road loading or unloading students, and there are two lanes in the same direction, a vehicle in the left lane behind may slow down and pass.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车遇到校车在道路右侧停车上下学生时，同向有两条机动车道，左侧车道后方机动车可以减速通过。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  With only two lanes, both the bus's lane and the adjacent lane must stop and wait; slow passage is allowed only with three or more lanes.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1156.}\ 
After entering the acceleration lane of an expressway, if there is little traffic in the through lane, how should the driver proceed?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Merge into the through lane ahead of normally moving traffic \quad \textbf{B.} Merge into the through lane behind normally moving traffic \quad \textbf{C.} Accelerate and merge directly into the through lane \quad \textbf{D.} Stop and wait for normally moving traffic to pass}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车驶入高速公路加速车道后，遇行车道车辆较少时，应如何行驶？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Merge into the through lane behind normally moving traffic  The acceleration lane exists to build up speed and merge in behind existing traffic safely.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{14\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1157.}\ 
[Image] As shown, when driving through this section, if the vehicle ahead is moving relatively slowly, it is acceptable to overtake as long as no vehicle is approaching from the opposite direction.\par
\smallskip\begin{center}\includegraphics[width=6cm,height=4cm,keepaspectratio]{work/img/20210524151049hnoczacflky8fsq3h84dwp.jpg}\end{center}\smallskip
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：如图所示，驾驶机动车行经该路段，如果前车行驶相对较慢，在对向没有来车的情况下可以超车。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Overtaking on a stretch of continuous bends is prone to causing serious accidents.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1158.}\ 
On a road without marked lanes, motor vehicles travel in the middle of the road, while non-motor vehicles and pedestrians travel along the sides.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车通过无划分车道的道路时，机动车在道路中间通行，非机动车和行人在道路两侧通行。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Memory aid: with no lane markings, drive in the middle; with markings, keep to the assigned side.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{14\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1159.}\ 
[Image] When encountering a continuously flashing yellow light like the one shown at an intersection, what does it alert vehicles to?\par
\smallskip\begin{center}\includegraphics[width=6cm,height=4cm,keepaspectratio]{work/img/20210608142951pt2s9awsvvuyvr4vdot5b.jpg}\end{center}\smallskip
{\small \textbf{A.} All vehicles are prohibited from passing through the intersection \quad \textbf{B.} A traffic accident has occurred at the intersection \quad \textbf{C.} The intersection is under traffic control and must be cleared \quad \textbf{D.} Traffic signal control at the intersection is temporarily suspended}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：在路口遇到图中这种黄灯不断闪烁时，提醒车辆应注意什么？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. Traffic signal control at the intersection is temporarily suspended  A continuously flashing yellow light means normal signal control is suspended; proceed with caution after confirming safety.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{14\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1160.}\ 
[Image] As shown, when vehicle A turns right and encounters pedestrians crossing the crosswalk, it should keep a low speed and proceed through.\par
\smallskip\begin{center}\includegraphics[width=6cm,height=4cm,keepaspectratio]{work/img/202106111534559pb4qwk2wp4b8xmazwrhuf.jpg}\end{center}\smallskip
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：如图所示，A车右转遇人行横道有行人通过时，应保持较低车速通过。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Motor vehicles must yield to pedestrians under all circumstances, not merely slow down and pass.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1161.}\ 
While driving in a tunnel, if the driver realizes the route is wrong, how should they proceed?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Continue driving and find the correct route after exiting the tunnel \quad \textbf{B.} Make a U-turn in the emergency stopping bay \quad \textbf{C.} Stop inside the tunnel and figure out the route before continuing \quad \textbf{D.} Drive out of the tunnel against traffic after confirming no vehicles are behind}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：在隧道内行驶，发现行驶路线错误，应如何行驶？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Continue driving and find the correct route after exiting the tunnel  Overtaking, stopping, U-turns, and reversing are all prohibited inside a tunnel.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1162.}\ 
When noticing the vehicle ahead is overtaking, to avoid an accident, the driver should tail it closely and pick the right moment to pass it too.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：当发现前车正在超车时，为了避免发生交通事故，驾驶人应紧跟前车，选择合适的时机超越前车。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Drivers should wait until the vehicle ahead finishes overtaking before looking for their own safe opportunity.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1163.}\ 
When meeting oncoming traffic at night, drivers should switch to low beams more than 150 meters before the other vehicle.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：夜间会车，应当在对向来车150米以外改用近光灯。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  High beams must not be used against oncoming traffic at night.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1164.}\ 
On an unlit road section at night, when following closely behind another vehicle, high beams should be used for illumination.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：夜间在没有照明的路段，与前车跟车距离较近时，应当开启远光灯照明。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Using high beams while following closely at night would blind the driver ahead through their mirrors.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1165.}\ 
On a road with a designated dedicated lane, other motor vehicles may temporarily use it to overtake.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：道路划设的专用车道，其他机动车可以临时借道超车。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  A dedicated lane is reserved exclusively for its designated vehicles.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1166.}\ 
When starting off, as long as the left turn signal is on, the vehicle can pull away directly.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：车辆起步时，只要打开了左转向灯，就可以直接起步。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Drivers must check surroundings and confirm safety before pulling away, not rely on the signal alone.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1167.}\ 
Driving at 60 km/h on an unrestricted three-lane-per-direction expressway with no posted speed limit sign, the vehicle should stay in the rightmost lane.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：以60公里/小时的速度在没有限速标志的同向三车道的高速公路上行驶，应该走最右侧车道。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  60 km/h is the minimum expressway speed, matching the rightmost, slowest lane.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{14\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1168.}\ 
When a motor vehicle encounters this situation, it must yield to vehicles approaching from the left.\par
\smallskip\begin{center}\includegraphics[width=6cm,height=4cm,keepaspectratio]{work/img/20210915175312bf3kn98qrobpt5sgnsdgwm.jpg}\end{center}\smallskip
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车遇到这种情形要让左侧来车先行。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  An octagonal stop sign requires stopping and yielding priority to crossing traffic from the left.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{14\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1169.}\ 
[Image] The signal light shown flashing continuously indicates that the intersection or road ahead is a hazardous section.\par
\smallskip\begin{center}\includegraphics[width=6cm,height=4cm,keepaspectratio]{work/img/20210915175312bxonkhw3w6fquv7wrcteyx.jpg}\end{center}\smallskip
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：图中信号灯持续闪烁表示前方路口或道路是危险路段。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  A continuously flashing warning light marks a hazardous location requiring extra caution.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1170.}\ 
Vehicles on an expressway must not change lanes frequently.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：车辆在高速公路上行车，不可以频繁地变更车道。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Frequent lane changes are unsafe and prohibited on any type of road.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1171.}\ 
When a motor vehicle passes through an intersection without traffic signal control at night, how should the lights be used?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Use low beam headlights \quad \textbf{B.} Use hazard warning flashers \quad \textbf{C.} Use high beam headlights \quad \textbf{D.} Alternate between high and low beams to signal}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车在夜间通过没有交通信号灯控制的交叉路口时，要怎样使用灯光？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. Alternate between high and low beams to signal  With no signal light controlling the intersection, the driver must actively alert other road users by flashing between high and low beams.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1172.}\ 
When driving in fog with low visibility, you should speed up to reach a safe location as quickly as possible.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：雾天驾驶机动车在道路上行驶，由于能见度低，应加速行驶，尽快到达安全地点。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  In fog, drivers should turn on fog lights and slow down, not speed up.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1173.}\ 
On a same-direction 3-lane expressway, a vehicle traveling faster than 90 km/h but slower than 110 km/h must not use the leftmost lane.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：在同向3车道高速公路上行车，车速高于每小时90公里、低于每小时110公里的机动车不得在高速公路最左侧车道行驶。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  On a 3-lane expressway, the minimum speeds from left to right are 110, 90, and 60 km/h.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1174.}\ 
Driving at night, if the light turns green at an intersection but pedestrians are still crossing the crosswalk, what should you do?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Slow down and stop in time to yield \quad \textbf{B.} Honk to signal pedestrians to move aside \quad \textbf{C.} Speed up and pass in front of the pedestrians \quad \textbf{D.} Quickly swerve around behind the pedestrians}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：夜间驾驶机动车在路口遇前方绿灯亮起时，如果人行横道上仍有行人通过，应怎样做？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Slow down and stop in time to yield  Motor vehicles must yield to pedestrians under all circumstances.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1175.}\ 
You must not make phone calls while driving, but on roads with light traffic, you may briefly answer an incoming call while driving.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：开车过程中不得主动打电话，但在车流量较少的道路上，当他人打来电话时，可以临时边开车边接电话。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Using a phone while driving is illegal and carries 2 demerit points, regardless of traffic volume.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{14\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1176.}\ 
[Image] The sign in the picture warns drivers that the maximum speed limit ahead is 80 km/h.\par
\smallskip\begin{center}\includegraphics[width=6cm,height=4cm,keepaspectratio]{work/img/20211012173352hhuslomzap1awyecdwq4dz.jpg}\end{center}\smallskip
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：图中标志提醒驾驶人前方车辆最高限速为80公里/小时。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  The number's color on the sign matters: yellow indicates a higher limit, white a lower limit, black a suggested speed, not this sign's meaning.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1177.}\ 
When a vehicle travels on an expressway above 100 km/h, keeping only 50 meters from the vehicle ahead in the same lane is a dangerous distance.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：车辆在高速公路以每小时100公里以上的速度行驶时，距同车道前车50米为危险距离。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  On expressways, keep over 100 m at speeds above 100 km/h, and over 50 m at speeds below 100 km/h.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1178.}\ 
Distracted driving slows reaction time, making accidents more likely from delayed or improper responses in emergencies.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：分心驾驶会影响人的反应速度，在遇紧急情况时，容易因反应不及时、采取措施不当引发事故。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Civilized driving always puts safety first.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1179.}\ 
When merging from the acceleration lane into the driving lane on an expressway, the steering wheel should not be turned abruptly or forcefully.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾车在高速公路行驶，在由加速车道汇入行车道时，操纵转向盘不应过急过猛。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Sudden or forceful steering can easily cause an accident.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{14\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1180.}\ 
When this traffic signal is lit at an intersection, driving straight is prohibited, but left and right turns are allowed.\par
\smallskip\begin{center}\includegraphics[width=6cm,height=4cm,keepaspectratio]{work/img/202111081602475kdqjeehoqgdw5axdqyqws.jpg}\end{center}\smallskip
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车在路口遇到这种信号灯亮时，不得直行，但是可以左转和右转。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  When a circular red signal is lit, a right turn is allowed if it does not obstruct traffic that has the right of way.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{14\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1181.}\ 
[Image] As shown, when following another vehicle under this road condition, you should turn on the high beam headlights.\par
\smallskip\begin{center}\includegraphics[width=6cm,height=4cm,keepaspectratio]{work/img/20211108160247dwn9ydisorvdgqcy7xsdul.jpg}\end{center}\smallskip
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：如图所示，在这种路况下跟车行驶时，应当开启远光灯照明。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  When following closely at night, drivers should use low beams, not high beams.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{14\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1182.}\ 
A non-bus vehicle may enter this lane at 10 a.m.\par
\smallskip\begin{center}\includegraphics[width=6cm,height=4cm,keepaspectratio]{work/img/20211108160247gup3zv84db5pfmf8uixwop.jpg}\end{center}\smallskip
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶非公交车在上午10点钟时，可以进入该车道行驶。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  During the designated hours, this dedicated lane is only open to authorized vehicles.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{14\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1183.}\ 
When this traffic signal is lit at an intersection, driving straight is prohibited, but left and right turns are allowed.\par
\smallskip\begin{center}\includegraphics[width=6cm,height=4cm,keepaspectratio]{work/img/20211109103345joc4dbib6wznoyz89pms2c.jpg}\end{center}\smallskip
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车在路口遇到这种信号灯亮时，不得直行，但是可以左转和右转。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Stop on red, go on green.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{14\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1184.}\ 
[Image] As shown, when driving at night on an unlit road and following closely behind another vehicle, you may turn on the high beam headlights.\par
\smallskip\begin{center}\includegraphics[width=6cm,height=4cm,keepaspectratio]{work/img/20211109103345vmkrneriradm4r9wfnmrxo.jpg}\end{center}\smallskip
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：如图所示，夜间驾驶机动车在没有照明的路段，当与前车跟车行驶距离较近时，可以开启远光灯照明。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Using high beams while following closely at night blinds the driver ahead.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{14\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1185.}\ 
[Image] In the situation shown, a driver should wait for pedestrians to cross before accelerating away from the crosswalk.\par
\smallskip\begin{center}\includegraphics[width=6cm,height=4cm,keepaspectratio]{work/img/20211109103345xpvpfwxsbauvihen94syuq.jpg}\end{center}\smallskip
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车遇图中情形时，应待行人通过再加速驶离人行横道。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Vehicles must not accelerate while crossing a crosswalk.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1186.}\ 
When a motor vehicle breaks down on the road and must stop to fix it, the driver should immediately turn on the hazard flashers. What else should be done?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Stop right where it is, to avoid a mechanical accident \quad \textbf{B.} Stop quickly and place a warning sign in front of the vehicle \quad \textbf{C.} Move the vehicle to a place that does not obstruct traffic \quad \textbf{D.} Stop immediately and call for help right away}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车在道路上发生故障，需要停车排除时，驾驶人应立即开启危险报警闪光灯，还应怎么做？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. Move the vehicle to a place that does not obstruct traffic  A breakdown stop must not obstruct normal traffic flow.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{14\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1187.}\ 
[Image] As shown, when passing through this intersection, the maximum speed must not exceed 30 km/h.\par
\smallskip\begin{center}\includegraphics[width=6cm,height=4cm,keepaspectratio]{work/img/20211112095131lnwv27kjz8ppyupjv6ryzo.jpg}\end{center}\smallskip
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：如图所示，驾驶机动车通过此路口，最高速度不能超过每小时30公里。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Speed must not exceed 30 km/h when passing railway crossings, sharp bends, narrow roads, or narrow bridges.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1188.}\ 
A vehicle being towed after breaking down may temporarily carry passengers.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：车辆发生故障被牵引时，可以临时搭载乘客。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  A towed vehicle may carry no one except its driver.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1189.}\ 
You must not get in or out of the vehicle from the right side while on a traffic lane.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：在机动车道上不得从机动车右侧上下车。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  When stopped along the right curb, you should get in or out from the right side, not the left.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1190.}\ 
How should lights be used when driving at night on a poorly lit road?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Only turn on the high beams \quad \textbf{B.} Only turn on the headlights \quad \textbf{C.} Turn on the headlights, outline marker lights, and rear position lights \quad \textbf{D.} Only turn on the rear position lights}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：夜间在照明不良的路段行驶，应该怎样使用灯光？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. Turn on the headlights, outline marker lights, and rear position lights  High beams should not be used when following another vehicle closely at night.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1191.}\ 
What should you do when following another vehicle on an icy or snowy road?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Keep a larger following distance \quad \textbf{B.} Turn on the hazard warning flashers \quad \textbf{C.} Continuously switch between high and low beams \quad \textbf{D.} Continuously honk to alert the vehicle ahead}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：车辆在冰雪道路跟车行驶时，应怎样做？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Keep a larger following distance  Speed must not exceed 30 km/h when driving on icy or snowy roads.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1192.}\ 
When a traffic signal, sign, or road marking conflicts with a traffic police officer's directions, follow the officer's directions.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：遇到交通信号灯、交通标志或交通标线与交通警察的指挥不一致时，按照交通警察指挥行驶。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  A traffic police officer's hand signals take precedence over all other traffic signals.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1193.}\ 
You may temporarily exceed the speed limit on a road with light traffic at night.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：夜间行经车流量较少的公路，可以临时超速驾驶。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Safe driving requires never speeding, regardless of traffic conditions.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1194.}\ 
Road maintenance and construction units must set up standard safety warning signs and protective facilities as required when performing maintenance or repairs.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：道路养护施工单位在道路上进行养护、维修时，应当按照规定设置规范的安全警示标志和安全防护设施。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Safety comes first.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1195.}\ 
When driving on an expressway, you should strictly follow the speed indicated by the vehicle's navigation system.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车在高速公路行驶时，要严格按照车载导航指示的车速行驶。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  The speed shown by a vehicle's navigation system is not necessarily accurate or correct.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{14\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1196.}\ 
When encountering this sign, a driver should realize there is an expressway service area ahead.\par
\smallskip\begin{center}\includegraphics[width=6cm,height=4cm,keepaspectratio]{work/img/20211210160038qjnnkjoqvyxm71mucrfnyh.jpg}\end{center}\smallskip
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车遇这个标志时，驾驶人应意识到前方有高速公路服务区。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  A fork-and-knife icon marks a service area, a teacup icon marks a rest area, and a plain P marks a parking area.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1197.}\ 
The main causes of braking skids include a wet or slippery road surface, locked wheels, and jerking the steering wheel while braking.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：制动侧滑的主要原因包括路面湿滑、车轮抱死、制动时猛打方向等。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Braking, inertia, and other factors can cause a vehicle's wheels to slide sideways, most often from a slippery road, locked wheels, or abrupt steering during braking.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{14\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1198.}\ 
Which light should be turned on promptly when driving in fog?\par
\smallskip\begin{center}\includegraphics[width=6cm,height=4cm,keepaspectratio]{work/img/20211217145927rwctft76isprasxct5d5mv.jpg}\end{center}\smallskip
{\small \textbf{A.} 10a \quad \textbf{B.} 10b \quad \textbf{C.} 10c \quad \textbf{D.} 10d}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：雾天行车时，应及时开启哪个灯？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. 10b  In fog, turn on the fog lights along with the hazard warning flashers.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1199.}\ 
If a fire breaks out inside a tunnel while driving, you should stay in the vehicle and wait for rescue.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车遇隧道内发生火灾时，应留在车内等待救援。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Personal safety comes first, so you should evacuate on your own instead of waiting.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1200.}\ 
Which of the following statements about driving on an expressway is correct?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} You may overtake on the ramp, acceleration lane, or deceleration lane \quad \textbf{B.} Reversing, driving against traffic, and crossing the median to turn around are prohibited \quad \textbf{C.} You may use the emergency lane when it is not an emergency \quad \textbf{D.} You may test-drive or practice driving on an expressway}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车上高速公路行驶，以下正确的说法是什么？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Reversing, driving against traffic, and crossing the median to turn around are prohibited  Overtaking is banned on ramps and acceleration/deceleration lanes; the emergency lane is for emergencies only; testing or learning to drive on an expressway is prohibited.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1201.}\ 
If a vehicle skids on an icy or snowy road, you should jerk the steering wheel sharply to correct it.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车在冰雪路面发生侧滑时，要猛打方向调整。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Jerking the steering wheel sharply during a skid can easily cause the vehicle to roll over.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{14\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1202.}\ 
Which light should be turned on when driving in fog?\par
\smallskip\begin{center}\includegraphics[width=6cm,height=4cm,keepaspectratio]{work/img/20211228170404hflgjpbvszxcjwf8nc86b6.jpg}\end{center}\smallskip
{\small \textbf{A.} Figure 1 \quad \textbf{B.} Figure 2 \quad \textbf{C.} Figure 3 \quad \textbf{D.} Figure 4}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车在雾天行驶时，要开启什么灯？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. Figure 4  Figure 1 is the washer fluid indicator, Figure 2 is the high beam indicator, and Figure 3 is the turn signal indicator.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1203.}\ 
When entering an expressway tollgate, you should slow down and proceed in an orderly manner, choosing a lane with a green light.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车驶入高速公路收费口应减速慢行，有序行驶，选择绿灯亮起的收费口进入。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  A red light at a tollgate lane means no entry, while a green light means normal passage is allowed.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1204.}\ 
When passing through a sharp bend with poor visibility, if an oncoming vehicle honks to signal you, you should honk back promptly.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车行经视线受阻的急弯路段时，如遇对方车辆鸣喇叭示意，也应当及时鸣喇叭进行回应。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  When another driver honks to signal, you should honk back in response.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1205.}\ 
When encountering heavy fog or extremely low visibility, you should pull over at a safe location and stop.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车遇到大雾或特大雾等能见度过低天气时，应选择安全地点停车。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Safety must always come first when driving.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1206.}\ 
If the vehicle ahead does not yield space when you try to overtake, what should you do?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Overtake anyway while honking continuously \quad \textbf{B.} Stop attempting to overtake \quad \textbf{C.} Overtake with the headlights on \quad \textbf{D.} Overtake quickly}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：超车时，前方车辆不让出超车空间，应该怎么做？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Stop attempting to overtake  Overtaking should only be done when it is safe to do so.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1207.}\ 
How should a motor vehicle be driven on a road section with no posted speed limit sign?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} No speed restriction applies \quad \textbf{B.} Drive at whatever speed you wish \quad \textbf{C.} Maintain a safe speed \quad \textbf{D.} Drive at the vehicle's maximum design speed}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车在没有限速标志的路段，应怎样行驶？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. Maintain a safe speed  Safety comes first, so drivers must maintain a safe speed.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1208.}\ 
How should you drive when the road ahead is congested and traffic is moving slowly?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Follow the vehicle ahead in sequence \quad \textbf{B.} Overtake from the right \quad \textbf{C.} Pull over and wait \quad \textbf{D.} Overtake from the left}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车遇前方道路拥堵通行缓慢时怎样行驶?}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Follow the vehicle ahead in sequence  Forcing an overtake or stopping on the shoulder can both worsen the congestion.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1209.}\ 
Regarding runaway truck ramps, which statement is incorrect?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} A runaway ramp may be used to park temporarily for repairs \quad \textbf{B.} A runaway ramp is for emergency stops when brakes fail \quad \textbf{C.} Runaway ramps are generally located on long downhill sections \quad \textbf{D.} A warning sign should be placed before a runaway ramp}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：关于避险车道，以下错误的说法是什么?}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. A runaway ramp may be used to park temporarily for repairs  A runaway truck ramp is meant for vehicles with failed brakes on a steep descent to make an emergency stop, not for routine parking.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1210.}\ 
Which of the following is not a type of traffic signal?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Police warning light \quad \textbf{B.} Traffic signs \quad \textbf{C.} Traffic police directions \quad \textbf{D.} Road markings}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：下列不属于交通信号的是什么？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Police warning light  Traffic signals are divided into four categories: signal lights, traffic signs, road markings, and police directions.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1211.}\ 
Parking a motor vehicle within 30 meters of a gas station or fire hydrant is prohibited.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车在距离加油站、消防栓30米以内禁止停放机动车。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Parking is banned within 30 meters of a gas station or fire hydrant, and within 50 meters of certain other restricted points.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{14\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1212.}\ 
Which category does this sign belong to?\par
\smallskip\begin{center}\includegraphics[width=6cm,height=4cm,keepaspectratio]{work/img/20220228173959qqednfnxnlhytubku5yamm.jpg}\end{center}\smallskip
{\small \textbf{A.} Warning sign \quad \textbf{B.} Prohibition sign \quad \textbf{C.} Mandatory/indication sign \quad \textbf{D.} Guide sign}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：这属于哪一种标志？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Warning sign  Traffic signs are grouped by color: yellow for warning signs, red for prohibition signs, blue for mandatory or indication signs.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1213.}\ 
When driving in the rain and encountering pedestrians or cyclists crossing the road, you should slow down early and stop to yield if they are close.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：雨天驾驶机动车遇行人和骑车人横穿道路，应提前减速，距离较近时应停车让行。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Motor vehicles must yield to pedestrians and non-motorized vehicles under all circumstances.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1214.}\ 
When meeting oncoming traffic at night, you should switch from high beams to low beams within 150 meters of the oncoming vehicle.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：夜间在道路上会车时，应在距离对向来车150米内将远光灯改用近光灯。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Still using high beams within 150 meters would blind the oncoming driver.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1215.}\ 
When driving out of a valley exit and a crosswind shifts the vehicle's direction, you should hold the wheel firmly with both hands and correct lightly toward the side opposite the wind, without jerking the wheel sharply.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车行至山谷出口处，遇到横风导致车辆行驶方向偏移时，应双手握稳转向盘，向来风相反的一侧适当修正，力度要轻，不可急转转向盘。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Jerking the steering wheel sharply in a crosswind can easily cause the vehicle to roll over.}\par\smallskip
