\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1216.}\ 
Which sign indicates a straight-ahead lane?\par
\smallskip\begin{center}\includegraphics[width=6cm,height=4cm,keepaspectratio]{work/img/20220322144211exz7dsskpeqklmgnr8thqr.jpg}\end{center}\smallskip
{\small \textbf{A.} Figure 1 \quad \textbf{B.} Figure 3 \quad \textbf{C.} Figure 2 \quad \textbf{D.} Figure 4}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：以下哪个标志，表示直行车道？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Figure 3  Figure 1 means one-way road, Figure 2 means go straight, Figure 3 means straight-ahead lane, and Figure 4 means priority on the main road.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1217.}\ 
When overtaking on a wide, gentle uphill stretch in a mountainous area, which action is incorrect?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Turn on the left turn signal \quad \textbf{B.} Honk in advance to signal \quad \textbf{C.} Turn on the right turn signal \quad \textbf{D.} Overtake once conditions allow it}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：在山区宽阔的缓上坡路段超车时，错误的做法是什么？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. Turn on the right turn signal  Overtaking is done from the left side, so the left turn signal, not the right, should be used.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1218.}\ 
How far from an intersection with poor visibility should you turn off the high beams when turning at night?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 50-100 meters \quad \textbf{B.} 30-100 meters \quad \textbf{C.} 60-100 meters \quad \textbf{D.} 50-150 meters}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：夜间在视线较差的路口转弯，应在距离路口多远时关闭远光灯？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. 30-100 meters  High beams must not be used when passing through an intersection at night.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1219.}\ 
After parking, you should check the traffic ahead and behind before opening the vehicle door to ensure it is safe.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：停车后，应先观察前后交通环境，确保安全后再打开机动车车门。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Occupants must check traffic before opening doors, so as not to obstruct other vehicles or pedestrians.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1220.}\ 
A driver who continues to drive despite a physical condition that impairs safe driving will be fined between 200 and 1,000 yuan.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶人身体条件发生变化，妨碍机动车安全驾驶，仍然驾驶机动车的，将被处以200元以上1000元以下罚款。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Under the regulations, such a driver has their license confiscated and is fined between 200 and 500 yuan, not up to 1,000.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1221.}\ 
A driver who needs vision correction must wear glasses while driving.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：有视力矫正的机动车驾驶人驾驶机动车时，应当佩戴眼镜。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Regulations require drivers needing vision correction to wear glasses while driving.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1222.}\ 
A driver with a hearing impairment must wear a hearing aid while driving.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：有听力障碍的机动车驾驶人驾驶机动车时，应当佩戴助听设备。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Drivers with hearing impairments are required to wear a hearing aid while driving.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{14\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1223.}\ 
[Image] What should a driver pay attention to on the section of road shown in the picture?\par
\smallskip\begin{center}\includegraphics[width=6cm,height=4cm,keepaspectratio]{work/img/20220408194228ffyqxnfxdtjykcnyszxaxk.jpg}\end{center}\smallskip
{\small \textbf{A.} No vehicle may cross the center line whenever oncoming traffic is present \quad \textbf{B.} The center line must not be crossed or driven on at all \quad \textbf{C.} The center line may be crossed if there is no oncoming traffic \quad \textbf{D.} The center line may only be crossed while overtaking}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：在图中所示的这段道路上行驶，驾驶人需要注意什么？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. The center line must not be crossed or driven on at all  A dashed line may be crossed, but a solid line may not.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1224.}\ 
What is the correct way to drive on a mountain-area curve?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Slow down, honk, and keep to the right \quad \textbf{B.} Slow down, honk, and drive along the center \quad \textbf{C.} Speed up, honk, and keep to the right \quad \textbf{D.} Speed up and get through the curve quickly}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车在山区弯道行驶时，以下正确的做法是什么？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Slow down, honk, and keep to the right  Mountain roads have frequent bends, so drivers should watch for sharp-curve warning signs and slow down, honk, and keep right, without entering the opposing lane.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{14\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1225.}\ 
[Image] As shown, regarding precautions when meeting oncoming traffic in heavy fog, which statement is incorrect?\par
\smallskip\begin{center}\includegraphics[width=6cm,height=4cm,keepaspectratio]{work/img/202204121131245y6le9kqnpr8w6pn7g87g3.jpg}\end{center}\smallskip
{\small \textbf{A.} Reduce driving speed appropriately \quad \textbf{B.} Keep to the right \quad \textbf{C.} Concentrate fully while driving \quad \textbf{D.} Use high beams to alert the oncoming vehicle}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：如图所示，关于驾驶机动车在大雾天气会车时的注意事项，以下说法错误的是什么？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. Use high beams to alert the oncoming vehicle  In fog, drivers should use fog lights and low beams when meeting oncoming traffic, never high beams.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1226.}\ 
When driving on an expressway at 100 km/h, what is the dangerous following distance?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 50 meters \quad \textbf{B.} 100 meters \quad \textbf{C.} 110 meters \quad \textbf{D.} 150 meters}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车在高速公路上行驶，速度为100km/h，危险车间距是多少？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. 50 meters  Regulations require over 100 m of following distance above 100 km/h, and at least 50 m below that speed.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1227.}\ 
When closing a door, you should first pull it to within about 10 centimeters of the door frame, then push it shut firmly.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：关门时应将车门拉至与车门框约10厘米左右，再用力关紧车门。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  When entering, open the door slowly about 10 cm and check behind you before opening further; when closing, pull it to about 10 cm from the frame first, then close it firmly.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1228.}\ 
If a vehicle breaks down on an expressway, where can it stop?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} In the emergency lane \quad \textbf{B.} On the exit ramp \quad \textbf{C.} In the leftmost lane \quad \textbf{D.} On the entrance ramp}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车在高速公路上发生故障，可以在以下哪个地方停车？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. In the emergency lane  For a breakdown, turn on hazard flashers, set the warning sign 150 m behind the vehicle, and move to the right shoulder or emergency lane while calling for help.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{14\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1229.}\ 
[Image] As shown, you may change to the left lane on this stretch of road to make a U-turn.\par
\smallskip\begin{center}\includegraphics[width=6cm,height=4cm,keepaspectratio]{work/img/20220412151001nyucad5ar2mfpj6hxzf6td.jpg}\end{center}\smallskip
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：如图所示，在这段道路上可以变更到左侧车道掉头。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  There is a no-U-turn sign ahead on the left in the picture, so a U-turn is not allowed.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1230.}\ 
When a non-motorized vehicle illegally occupies a lane and blocks a motor vehicle's path, which action is incorrect?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Watch the non-motorized vehicle's movements and slow down \quad \textbf{B.} Observe carefully and pass slowly \quad \textbf{C.} Continuously honk to warn the non-motorized vehicle to move aside \quad \textbf{D.} Keep a safe distance from the non-motorized vehicle}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：在机动车道上遇到非机动车违法占用车道行驶，且妨碍机动车前进时，以下错误的做法是什么?}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. Continuously honk to warn the non-motorized vehicle to move aside  Drivers should yield courteously, observe carefully, slow down, and keep a safe distance, not honk continuously and risk startling the cyclist.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1231.}\ 
After driving on an expressway for a long time, drivers tend to underestimate the vehicle's actual speed.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车在高速公路上长时间行驶，驾驶人往往会低估车辆行驶速度。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Prolonged high-speed driving skews a driver's sense of speed, so checking the speedometer regularly helps avoid unintentional speeding.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1232.}\ 
If a driver feels tired on an expressway, they should pull into the nearest service area to rest, and must not stop to rest in the emergency lane.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶人在高速公路上行驶感觉疲劳时，应驶入最近的服务区休息，不得在应急车道内停车休息。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  On expressways, drivers must rest at a rest area or service area, not stop arbitrarily.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1233.}\ 
Non-motorized vehicles, tractors, wheeled special-purpose machinery, articulated buses, full trailers, and other motor vehicles with a maximum design speed below 70 km/h must not enter an expressway.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶非机动车、拖拉机、轮式专用机械车、铰接式客车、全挂拖斗车以及其他设计最高时速低于70公里的机动车，不得进入高速公路。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  The Road Traffic Safety Law bars pedestrians and such low-speed vehicles from expressways, where the speed limit does not exceed 120 km/h.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1234.}\ 
Which of the following vehicle types is allowed to tow a trailer?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Three-wheeled vehicle \quad \textbf{B.} Semi-trailer tractor \quad \textbf{C.} Low-speed cargo truck \quad \textbf{D.} Large passenger vehicle}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：以下机动车中，哪种车型可以牵引挂车？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Semi-trailer tractor  Regulations allow trucks, semi-trailer tractors, and tractors to tow one trailer each, but bar large or medium buses, low-speed trucks, and three-wheelers from towing.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1235.}\ 
What is the maximum speed for a medium-sized bus on an expressway?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 80 km/h \quad \textbf{B.} 100 km/h \quad \textbf{C.} 110 km/h \quad \textbf{D.} 120 km/h}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶中型客车在高速公路上行驶，最高速度不能超过多少？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. 100 km/h  On expressways, motorcycles are capped at 80 km/h, cars at 120 km/h, and other vehicles at 100 km/h.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1236.}\ 
Which statement is correct about driving on a city road with no center line?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Maximum speed is 30 km/h \quad \textbf{B.} Minimum speed is 30 km/h \quad \textbf{C.} Speed may be 50 km/h \quad \textbf{D.} Minimum speed is 40 km/h}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车在没有中心线的城市道路上行驶，以下说法正确的是什么？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Maximum speed is 30 km/h  On a city road without a center line, the maximum speed is 30 km/h; with a center line, it is 40 km/h.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1237.}\ 
If a driver whose physical condition makes them unfit to drive continues driving, the police confiscate their license. What additional penalty applies?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} A fine \quad \textbf{B.} A warning \quad \textbf{C.} License revocation \quad \textbf{D.} Detention of the driver}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶人身体条件发生变化不适合驾驶机动车，依旧驾驶机动车的，由公安机关交通管理部门收回机动车驾驶证，还会受到什么处罚？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. A fine  Driving while physically unfit also carries a fine of 200 to 500 yuan.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1238.}\ 
At which of the following locations is a U-turn allowed?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Where a no-left-turn sign is posted \quad \textbf{B.} Where a no-U-turn sign is posted \quad \textbf{C.} Where a U-turn-permitted sign is posted \quad \textbf{D.} Where the road's center line is a solid yellow line}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：以下哪个位置可以掉头？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. Where a U-turn-permitted sign is posted  U-turns are banned where prohibited by signs or markings and at railway crossings, crosswalks, bridges, sharp bends and other hazardous spots; a solid yellow center line also cannot be crossed.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1239.}\ 
Which statement about turning right on the road is correct?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Turn on the right turn signal in advance \quad \textbf{B.} Not restricted by the traffic signal \quad \textbf{C.} Not restricted by speed limits \quad \textbf{D.} Turn right quickly to avoid causing congestion}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车在道路上向右转弯时，以下说法正确的是？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Turn on the right turn signal in advance  A right turn must be made safely without obstructing other traffic.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1240.}\ 
Which of the following statements is correct?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} When entering an expressway from a ramp, turn on the right turn signal in advance \quad \textbf{B.} When leaving an expressway via a ramp, turn on the right turn signal in advance \quad \textbf{C.} Overtaking is allowed on ramp sections \quad \textbf{D.} If you enter the wrong ramp, you may reverse back onto the expressway}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：下列说法正确的是什么？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. When leaving an expressway via a ramp, turn on the right turn signal in advance  Use the left turn signal when entering an expressway, and the right turn signal when exiting it.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1241.}\ 
On a narrow bridge, if an oncoming vehicle is already on the bridge, what should you do?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Slow down, keep right, and let it pass first \quad \textbf{B.} Rush ahead of the oncoming vehicle \quad \textbf{C.} Pull over to the left side of the road \quad \textbf{D.} Honk and speed through}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车遇到窄桥路段，如相对方向的来车已经在桥上，应该怎么做？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Slow down, keep right, and let it pass first  Civilized driving means yielding whenever possible.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1242.}\ 
What color should the parking line for a dedicated parking space be?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Blue \quad \textbf{B.} White \quad \textbf{C.} Yellow \quad \textbf{D.} Red}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：专属停车位的停车标线应该用什么颜色表示？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. Yellow  White spaces are paid parking, yellow spaces are dedicated/reserved spaces, and blue spaces are free public parking.}\par\smallskip

\section{Traffic Signals \;/\; 交通信号}

\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1243.}\ 
The Subject Two test for small manual-transmission cars includes reverse parking into a garage, stopping and starting on a slope, side parking, curved-lane driving, and a right-angle turn.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：小型手动挡汽车科目二考试内容包括倒车入库、坡道定点停车和起步、侧方停车、曲线行驶、直角转弯。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  For small vehicles, manual license C1 requires 5 items in Subject Two, while automatic license C2 requires 4.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1244.}\ 
A driver on probation who drives on an expressway must be accompanied by a driver with at least one year's experience holding the same or a higher class license.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶人在实习期内驾驶机动车上高速公路行驶，应由持相应或者更高准驾车型驾驶证一年以上的驾驶人陪同。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  A probationary driver on an expressway must be accompanied by a driver with at least 3 years of experience; violation incurs a fine of 20 to 200 yuan.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1245.}\ 
A vehicle under mortgage registration or pledge filing cannot undergo a transfer registration.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车在抵押登记、质押备案期间不可以办理转让登记。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  A transfer registration during a mortgage or pledge period can be jointly applied for by the original owner, new owner, and mortgagee or pledgee.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1246.}\ 
A driver may still drive for up to one year after their license has expired.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶人持超过有效期的驾驶证可以在1年内驾驶机动车。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  A driver must not drive if the license is lost, damaged, expired, confiscated, suspended, or has reached 12 demerit points.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1247.}\ 
Failing to obey traffic signal lights while driving incurs 6 demerit points per violation.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车不按交通信号灯指示通行的，一次记6分。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Driving a vehicle class not matching the license incurs 9 points, while running a red light incurs 6 points.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1248.}\ 
A license authorizing small automatic-transmission cars also allows driving a low-speed cargo truck.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：准驾车型为小型自动挡汽车的，可以驾驶低速载货汽车。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  A small automatic-transmission license (C2) only authorizes small or mini automatic passenger cars and light or mini automatic cargo trucks.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1249.}\ 
Fleeing the scene after causing an accident, when it does not constitute a crime, incurs 12 demerit points.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：造成交通事故后逃逸，尚不构成犯罪的，记12分。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Non-criminal hit-and-run incurs 12 points if it causes injury above minor or death, but only 6 points for minor injury or property damage.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1250.}\ 
If an applicant bribes or cheats during the exam process, their exam eligibility is cancelled, and any other subjects already passed become invalid.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：申请人在考试过程中有贿赂、舞弊行为的，取消考试资格，已经通过考试的其他科目成绩无效。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  The rule of escalating bans for fraud, forgery, revocation, drunk driving, and hit-and-run treats exam cheating as a form of fraud.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1251.}\ 
A driver who forges, alters, or uses a forged or altered license and constitutes a crime will be held criminally liable according to law.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：伪造、变造或者使用伪造、变造驾驶证的驾驶人构成犯罪的，将依法追究刑事责任。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Forging, altering, or using a forged or altered license leads to confiscation, detention, and a fine of 2,000 to 5,000 yuan.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1252.}\ 
A driver on probation must not tow a trailer while driving.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶人在实习期内驾驶机动车不得牵引挂车。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  During the probation period, towing trailers and carrying hazardous materials are both prohibited.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1253.}\ 
If the vehicle identification number becomes illegible or damaged due to wear, corrosion, an accident, or other reasons, an application for filing may be made to the registering vehicle administration office.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：车辆识别代号因磨损、锈蚀、事故等原因辨认不清或者损坏的，可以向登记地车辆管理所申请备案。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  If the engine number or VIN becomes illegible or damaged, it must be reported to the registering vehicle administration office.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1254.}\ 
After an accident, a party who deliberately damages or fabricates the scene or destroys evidence bears full responsibility.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：发生交通事故后，当事人故意破坏、伪造现场、毁灭证据的，承担全部责任。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Anyone who flees, deliberately damages or fabricates the scene, or destroys evidence after an accident bears full responsibility.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1255.}\ 
The demerit-point system is cumulative, and the scoring period must be counted continuously from the date the driver first obtained their license.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶人的交通违法行为实行累积记分制度，记分周期必须从驾驶人初次领取机动车驾驶证之日起连续计算。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  The scoring period is 12 months, with a maximum of 12 points, counted continuously either from the date of first obtaining the license or first obtaining a temporary driving permit.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1256.}\ 
If a person is undergoing community drug rehabilitation, mandatory isolated drug rehabilitation, or community recovery measures, the vehicle administration office will cancel their license.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：正在执行社区戒毒、强制隔离戒毒、社区康复措施，车辆管理所将注销其驾驶证。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Drug-related violations lead to license cancellation.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1257.}\ 
A driver residing outside the jurisdiction of the vehicle administration office that issued their license may apply to renew their license at the vehicle administration office where they live.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶人在驾驶证核发地车辆管理所管辖区以外居住的，可以向居住地车辆管理所申请换证。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  A license renewal may be applied for at the vehicle administration office of the driver's place of residence.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1258.}\ 
A driver who drives a vehicle suspected of meeting the scrapping standard will be detained by traffic police in accordance with the law.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶人驾驶有达到报废标准嫌疑机动车上路的，交通警察依法予以拘留。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Driving a scrapped vehicle results in a fine of 200 to 2,000 yuan, license revocation, and forced confiscation and scrapping of the vehicle, not detention.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1259.}\ 
A vehicle that has met the scrapping standard may still be driven on the road after major repairs.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：已经达到报废标准的机动车经大修后可以上路行驶。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Driving a scrapped or illegally assembled vehicle results in a fine of 200 to 2,000 yuan, license revocation, and confiscation of the vehicle for forced scrapping.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1260.}\ 
The owner of a registered vehicle that changes its body color should apply for an alteration registration with the public security traffic administration department.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：已注册登记的机动车，改变机动车车身颜色的应到公安交通管理部门申请变更登记。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  After a body color change, the vehicle information no longer matches the registration certificate, so an alteration registration is required promptly.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1261.}\ 
If a vehicle's license plate is damaged, the owner must apply for a replacement or reissue at the registering vehicle administration office.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车号牌损毁，机动车所有人要向登记地车辆管理所申请补领、换领。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  All vehicle-related replacements and reissues must be applied for at the registering vehicle administration office.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1262.}\ 
A driver who voluntarily downgrades their license class needs to apply at the vehicle administration office to replace their license.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：自愿降级的驾驶人需要到车辆管理所申请换领驾驶证。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  A driver may apply to replace their license after voluntarily requesting a downgrade.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1263.}\ 
If a traffic accident between a motor vehicle and a pedestrian causes injury, death, or property loss, and the motor vehicle side is not at fault, it bears no liability for compensation.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车与行人之间发生交通事故造成人身伤亡、财产损失的，机动车一方没有过错的，不承担赔偿责任。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Even without fault, the motor vehicle side must bear no more than 10 percent of the compensation liability.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1264.}\ 
If a driver's contact phone number, address, or other information changes, they must file it with the vehicle administration office that issued their license within 30 days of the change.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶人联系电话、联系地址等信息发生变化，应当在信息变更后三十日内，向驾驶证核发地车辆管理所备案。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Any change in information must be filed and updated within 30 days.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1265.}\ 
Illegally driving in the emergency lane on an expressway incurs 6 demerit points per violation.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车在高速公路违法占用应急车道行驶的一次记6分。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Using the emergency lane illegally, running a red light, and driving while the license is suspended all carry 6 demerit points.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1266.}\ 
A driver must not drive while their license is lawfully confiscated or suspended.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶人的机动车驾驶证被依法扣留、暂扣的情况下不得驾驶机动车。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Driving without a valid license, including one that is confiscated or suspended, is prohibited.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1267.}\ 
An applicant with a mental illness may still apply for a driver's license, but must not drive during an episode.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：申请人患有精神病的，可以申领机动车驾驶证，但是在发病期间不得驾驶机动车。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Epilepsy, mental illness, and color blindness to red and green are all disqualifying conditions for a license.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1268.}\ 
A driver on probation who accumulates 12 demerit points will have their probationary license class cancelled.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶人在实习期内有记满12分记录的，注销其实习的准驾车型驾驶资格。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  The probation period lasts 12 months, requires a standard probation sticker on the vehicle, and is cancelled if 12 points are reached.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1269.}\ 
A driver holding a license for large buses, heavy tractors, city buses, medium buses, or large trucks whose employer information changes must file it with the vehicle administration office that issued the license within 30 days.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：持有大型客车、重型牵引挂车、城市公交车、中型客车、大型货车驾驶证的驾驶人从业单位等信息发生变化的，应当在信息变更后三十日内，向驾驶证核发地车辆管理所备案。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Such information changes must actually be filed with the vehicle administration office where the employer is located, not the issuing office.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1270.}\ 
If a driver's points have not reached the maximum but they have an unpaid fine, the points carry over into the next scoring period.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶人记分没有达到满分，有罚款尚未缴纳的，记分转入下一记分周期。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Points are cleared once the fine has been paid.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1271.}\ 
A driver aged 70 or older must undergo a physical examination once a year.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：年龄在70周岁以上的机动车驾驶人，应当每年进行一次身体检查。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Drivers over 70 must have an annual health check, or their license will be cancelled if they miss a year.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1272.}\ 
If a driver's license is lost or damaged beyond recognition, the driver should apply for a reissue at the vehicle administration office.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶证遗失、损毁无法辨认时，机动车驾驶人应当向车辆管理所申请补发。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  A reissue can be applied for at any vehicle administration office, as long as no violation bars issuance.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1273.}\ 
A driver already holding a C1/C2 license who adds a C6 class must take Subject Two and Subject Three's safe civilized driving knowledge test.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：已持有C1/C2准驾车型增加C6准驾车型的，应当考试科目二和科目三安全文明驾驶常识。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Regulations require Subject Two and Three exams when adding certain new vehicle classes to an existing license.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1274.}\ 
A driver's license validity period is divided into 6 years, 10 years, and 20 years.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶证有效期分为6年、10年、20年。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  License validity periods are actually 6 years, 10 years, and permanent (long-term), not 20 years.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1275.}\ 
If a registered vehicle's owner relocates within the jurisdiction of the same vehicle administration office, or the owner's name or contact information changes, this must be filed with the registering vehicle administration office.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：已注册登记的机动车，机动车所有人住所在车辆管理所管辖区域内迁移或者机动车所有人姓名（单位名称）、联系方式变更的，应当向登记地车辆管理所备案。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Any change to a vehicle's registration information must be filed with the registering vehicle administration office.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1276.}\ 
Using another vehicle's license plate or registration certificate incurs 3 demerit points per violation.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：使用其他机动车号牌、行驶证的一次记3分。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Using a forged or altered plate, registration, license, or school bus sign, or using another vehicle's plate or registration, actually incurs 12 demerit points.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1277.}\ 
A vehicle that has reached the state-mandated compulsory scrapping standard cannot undergo registration.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车达到国家规定的强制报废标准的不能办理注册登记。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Driving a scrapped vehicle on the road is dangerous, so registration is not permitted.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1278.}\ 
Before applying for a transfer registration, the vehicle owner must resolve all road traffic violations and accidents involving the vehicle.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车所有人申请转让登记前，应当将涉及该车的道路交通安全违法行为和交通事故处理完毕。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  All violations and accidents involving the vehicle must be resolved before a transfer registration can be applied for.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1279.}\ 
A first-time driver's license has a validity period of 6 years.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：初次申领的机动车驾驶证的有效期为6年。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  License validity periods are 6 years, 10 years, and permanent.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1280.}\ 
If a driver accumulates 12 demerit points within one scoring period and refuses to attend the required study and retest, the public security traffic department will publicly announce that the license is suspended.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶人在一个记分周期内累计记分达到12分，拒不参加学习和考试的，将被公安机关交通部门公告其驾驶证停止使用。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Reaching 12 points within one scoring period requires retaking study and the exam.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1281.}\ 
A driver must not drive after their license becomes damaged.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶人的驾驶证损毁后不得驾驶机动车。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  A damaged license counts as no valid license, and driving without a valid license is prohibited.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1282.}\ 
Subject Three consists of two parts: the road driving skills test and the safe civilized driving knowledge test.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：科目三考试分为道路驾驶技能考试和安全文明驾驶常识考试两部分。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Subject Three tests two things: driving skills and driving knowledge, with a passing score of 90.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1283.}\ 
If a vehicle registration certificate is lost, it should be reissued promptly to prevent misuse by criminals.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车登记证书丢失后应及时补办，避免被不法分子利用。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Misuse of a lost registration certificate by criminals can have serious consequences, so it should be reissued quickly.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1284.}\ 
A vehicle with a safety hazard must not be driven on the road.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：不得驾驶具有安全隐患的机动车上道路行驶。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  A vehicle with a safety hazard must absolutely not be driven.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1285.}\ 
A driver must drive only the vehicle classes listed on their license.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶人要按照驾驶证载明的准驾车型驾驶车辆。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  The license specifies the authorized vehicle classes, and driving outside that class is not allowed.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1286.}\ 
A driver residing outside the jurisdiction of the vehicle administration office that issued their license may apply to renew their license at the vehicle administration office where they live.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶人在核发地车辆管理所管辖区以外居住的，可以向居住地车辆管理所申请换证。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  A driver not living where the license was issued can renew it at their place of residence.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1287.}\ 
A person applying for a license for the first time at a temporary residence cannot directly apply for a large truck license.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：在暂住地初次申领机动车驾驶证的，不能直接申领大型货车驾驶证。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  A first-time applicant can, in fact, apply directly for a large truck license.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1288.}\ 
Driving under the influence of alcohol incurs 12 demerit points per violation.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：饮酒后驾驶机动车的一次记12分。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Drunk driving results in a 6-month license suspension and a fine of 1,000 to 2,000 yuan.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1289.}\ 
If a driver holding a license for large buses, heavy tractors, city buses, medium buses, or large trucks fails to promptly report changes to their phone number or employer, the public security traffic department will fine them between 20 and 200 yuan.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：持有大型客车、重型牵引挂车、城市公交车、中型客车、大型货车驾驶证的驾驶人联系电话、从业单位等信息发生变化未及时申报变更信息的，公安机关交通管理部门处二十元以上二百元以下罚款。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Holders of these license classes must file information changes within 30 days, or face a fine of 20 to 200 yuan.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1290.}\ 
A first-time license holder on probation may drive alone on an expressway.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：初次申领驾驶证的驾驶人在实习期内可以单独驾驶机动车上高速公路行驶。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  A first-time driver going on an expressway must be accompanied by an experienced driver with 3 or more years of driving experience.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1291.}\ 
A motor vehicle on the road must display its license plate as required.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车上路行驶应当按规定悬挂号牌。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Plate violations: forged or altered plates incur 12 points; missing, obscured, or dirty plates incur 9 points; improperly mounted plates incur 3 points.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1292.}\ 
If a driver of a small vehicle causes a fatal accident and bears equal or greater responsibility without having their license revoked, they must undergo a review within 30 days after the scoring period ends.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：小型汽车驾驶人发生交通事故造成人员死亡，承担同等以上责任未被吊销驾驶证的，应当在记分周期结束后30日内接受审验。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Note the key condition, that the license was not revoked despite bearing equal or greater responsibility.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1293.}\ 
Driving a small vehicle over 50 percent above the posted speed limit on an expressway or urban expressway incurs 12 demerit points per violation.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶小型汽车在高速公路、城市快速路上行驶超过规定时速50\%以上的，一次记12分。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  For small vehicles on expressways or urban expressways: over 50 percent above the limit incurs 12 points, 20 to 50 percent incurs 6 points, and under 20 percent incurs none.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1294.}\ 
A person who flees the scene of an accident and commits a crime cannot apply for a driver's license.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：造成交通事故后逃逸构成犯罪的人不能申请机动车驾驶证。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Under the rule, a criminal hit-and-run results in a lifetime ban from obtaining a license.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1295.}\ 
A license authorizing small cars also allows driving a small automatic-transmission passenger car.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：准驾车型为小型汽车的，可以驾驶小型自动挡载客汽车。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  A small car license (C1) also authorizes small automatic cars (C2), low-speed trucks (C3), and three-wheeled vehicles (C4).}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1296.}\ 
Failing to yield to a school bus as required incurs 6 demerit points per violation.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车不按照规定避让校车的，一次记6分。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Failing to stop for a crosswalk or yield to a school bus actually incurs 3 demerit points, not 6.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1297.}\ 
A driver of a small vehicle who causes a fatal accident and bears equal or greater responsibility without having their license revoked must undergo a review at the public security traffic department within 30 days after the current scoring period ends, and must also report their physical condition.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：持有小型汽车驾驶证的驾驶人，发生交通事故造成人员死亡承担同等以上责任未被吊销机动车驾驶证的，应当在本记分周期结束后三十日内到公安机关交通管理部门接受审验，同时应当申报身体条件情况。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  In a fatal accident where the license was not revoked despite equal or greater responsibility, review is required within 30 days after the scoring period ends.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1298.}\ 
If a non-motorized vehicle rider or pedestrian deliberately collides with a motor vehicle causing an accident, the motor vehicle side bears no liability for compensation.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：非机动车驾驶人、行人故意碰撞机动车造成交通事故的，机动车一方不承担赔偿责任。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Note the key condition, that the collision was deliberate.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1299.}\ 
A driver may still drive for up to 3 months after losing their license.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶人在驾驶证丢失后3个月内还可以驾驶机动车。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  A person without a valid license must not drive, and a vehicle without valid documents must not be on the road.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1300.}\ 
Reversing, driving against traffic, or crossing the median to make a U-turn on an expressway or urban expressway incurs 6 demerit points per violation.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车在高速公路、城市快速路上倒车、逆行、穿越中央分隔带掉头的，一次记6分。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  On expressways such violations actually incur 12 points; on ordinary roads, reversing incurs 1 point and driving against traffic incurs 3.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1301.}\ 
For a motor vehicle acquired by purchase, allocation, gift, etc. that has not yet been registered, it may only be driven temporarily on the road after obtaining a temporary license plate from the vehicle administration office.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：经购买、调拨、赠予等方式获得机动车后尚未注册登记的，向车辆管理所申领临时行驶车号牌后，方可临时上道路行驶。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  A motor vehicle without a license plate is not permitted to be driven on the road.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1302.}\ 
Drivers of large buses, heavy tractor-trailers, city buses, medium buses, and large trucks must submit a physical condition certificate once every two years.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：大型客车、重型牵引挂车、城市公交车、中型客车、大型货车驾驶人应当每两年提交一次身体条件证明。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Holders of these licenses must submit a physical condition certificate annually, not every two years.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1303.}\ 
A driver who accumulates 12 demerit points and refuses to attend the required study and retake the exam will have their license publicly declared suspended.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：记分满12分的驾驶人拒不参加学习和考试的将被公告驾驶证停止使用。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Drivers who reach 12 points must retake road traffic safety law study and the exam, or face suspension.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1304.}\ 
An assembled (jury-rigged) motor vehicle may be driven on the road as long as it is considered safe.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：拼装的机动车只要认为安全就可以上路行驶。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Assembled vehicles with safety hazards must not be driven on the road, regardless of perceived safety.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1305.}\ 
A driver who pays someone else to accept a traffic violation penalty and demerit points on their behalf will be fined up to three times the amount paid, but not more than 60,000 yuan.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶人请他人代为接受交通违法行为处罚和记分，并支付经济利益的，会被处以所支付经济利益三倍以下的罚款，但最高不得超过六万元。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Paying someone else to take the points for profit results in a fine of up to three times the amount paid plus 12 demerit points, not just a fine.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1306.}\ 
For the Subject 3 road driving skills test and the civilized safe driving knowledge test, the full score is 100 for each, and passing requires 80 and 90 points respectively.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：科目三道路驾驶技能和安全文明驾驶常识考试满分分别为100分，成绩分别达到80和90分的为合格。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Subject 3 has two parts, driving skills and safe driving knowledge, and both require a passing score of 90, not 80.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1307.}\ 
A driver who smokes or injects drugs and then drives a motor vehicle will have their license revoked once caught.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶人吸食或注射毒品后驾驶机动车的，一经查获，其驾驶证将被注销。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Drug-related driving results in cancellation of the driver's license.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1308.}\ 
For a registered motor vehicle, if the body color is changed, the owner does not need to apply for a change of registration at the vehicle administration office where it was registered.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：已注册登记的机动车，改变车身颜色，机动车所有人不需要向登记地车辆管理所申请变更登记。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Changing the body color changes the vehicle's registered information, so a change-of-registration application is required.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1309.}\ 
An applicant with epilepsy may apply for a driver's license, but must be accompanied by another person while driving.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：申请人患有癫痫病的，可以申领机动车驾驶证，但是驾驶时必须有人陪同。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  A person with epilepsy may not hold a driver's license at all, since a seizure while driving could have disastrous consequences.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1310.}\ 
Drivers aged 50 and above must undergo a physical examination once a year and report their physical condition to the traffic administration department.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：年龄在50周岁以上的机动车驾驶人，应当每年进行一次身体检查，并向公安机关交通管理部门申报身体条件情况。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  It is drivers aged 70 and above, not 50, who must have the annual physical exam; failing to do so leads to license cancellation.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1311.}\ 
A registered motor vehicle that meets the state's mandatory scrapping standard must have its registration cancelled at the vehicle administration office where it was registered.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：已注册登记的机动车达到国家规定的强制报废标准的，应当向登记地车辆管理所申请注销登记。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  All matters related to a registered vehicle are handled at the vehicle administration office where it was registered.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1312.}\ 
If a vehicle registration document is destroyed or lost, the owner must apply for a replacement or reissue at the vehicle administration office where the vehicle was registered.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车行驶证灭失、丢失，机动车所有人要向登记地车辆管理所申请补领、换领。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Replacement or reissue of vehicle-related documents is handled at the office where the vehicle was registered.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1313.}\ 
A driver who smokes or injects drugs and then drives a motor vehicle will not have their license revoked.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：有吸食、注射毒品后驾驶机动车行为的驾驶人，不会被注销驾驶证。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Drug-related driving results in license cancellation, contrary to the statement.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1314.}\ 
If a driver does not reach 12 demerit points in any scoring cycle during the 6-year validity period of their license, the license will be renewed for a 10-year validity period.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶人在机动车驾驶证的6年有效期内，每个记分周期均未达到12分的，换发10年有效期的机动车驾驶证。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  A first license is valid for 6 years; with no record of reaching the point limit, it can be renewed for 10 years, then later for a lifetime license.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1315.}\ 
A first-time driver's license has a validity period of 4 years.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：初次申领的机动车驾驶证的有效期为4年。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Driver's license validity periods are 6 years, 10 years, or lifetime, not 4 years.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1316.}\ 
If an applicant's place of residence changes and they apply to change the exam location, this may not be done more than 3 times.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：申请人因居住地发生变化，提出变更考试场地申请，不得超过3次。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Applications to change the exam location are capped at 3 times.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1317.}\ 
While driving during the probationary period, a driver must affix or hang a standardized probationary driver sign on the rear of the vehicle.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶人在实习期内驾驶机动车时，应当在车身后部粘贴或者悬挂统一式样的实习标志。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  The probationary period is 12 months, and a standardized sign must be displayed on the rear of the vehicle during that time.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1318.}\ 
To apply for a small motor vehicle (car) license, the applicant must be between 18 and 70 years old.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：申请小型汽车驾驶证的，年龄应在18周岁以上70周岁以下。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Applying for a C1/C2 license only requires being 18 or older; there is no upper age limit.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1319.}\ 
Driving a small vehicle on a highway or urban expressway at more than 50\% over the speed limit incurs 3 demerit points per offense.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶小型汽车在高速公路、城市快速路上行驶超过规定时速50\%以上的，一次记3分。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  For small vehicles, exceeding the speed limit by more than 50\% on a highway or expressway incurs 12 points, not 3.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1320.}\ 
Fleeing the scene of a traffic accident that caused injury (minor injury or worse) or death, without constituting a crime, incurs 12 demerit points per offense.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：造成致人轻伤以上或者死亡的交通事故后逃逸，尚不构成犯罪的，一次记12分。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  This is one of the offenses listed under the point-management rules that carries a mandatory 12-point penalty.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{14\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1321.}\ 
Driving this motor vehicle on the road involves no violation.\par
\smallskip\begin{center}\includegraphics[width=6cm,height=4cm,keepaspectratio]{work/img/20190410102527kzepaycpdjgdt6bvgkswpb.jpg}\end{center}\smallskip
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶这种机动车上路行驶没有违法行为。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Deliberately obscuring the license plate while driving is a violation carrying 9 demerit points.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1322.}\ 
Drivers holding a large bus, heavy tractor-trailer, city bus, medium bus, or large truck license who have incurred demerit points during a scoring cycle must undergo a review at the traffic administration department within 30 days after the cycle ends, and must also report their physical condition.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：持有大型客车、重型牵引挂车、城市公交车、中型客车、大型货车驾驶证的驾驶人，记分周期内有记分的，应当在记分周期结束后三十日内到公安机关交通管理部门接受审验，同时还应当申报身体条件情况。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Holders of these licenses with points must complete review within 30 days after the cycle ends and submit a physical condition certificate; those with no points are exempt from review.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1323.}\ 
A driver aged 70 or above who fails to submit a physical condition certificate within one year after a scoring cycle ends will have their license cancelled by the vehicle administration office.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：年龄在70周岁以上，在一个记分周期结束后一年内未提交身体条件证明的，其机动车驾驶证将会被车辆管理所注销。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Drivers aged 70 and above must have an annual physical check; failing to do so for a year results in license cancellation.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1324.}\ 
Using a forged or altered driver's license incurs 12 demerit points per offense.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：使用伪造、变造的驾驶证一次记12分。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Using any forged or altered license plate, vehicle registration, driver's license, or school bus sign carries a mandatory 12-point penalty.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1325.}\ 
A driver who has deferred their license review due to military service, going abroad, etc. must not drive a motor vehicle during the deferral period.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶人因服兵役、出国（境）等原因延期审验期间不得驾驶机动车。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  A driver may not operate a vehicle during any period when their license review cannot be completed.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1326.}\ 
The maximum accumulated demerit points in one scoring cycle for road traffic safety violations is 12 points.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：道路交通安全违法行为累积记分一个周期满分为12分。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  The point limit per scoring cycle is 12; reaching it requires retaking study and the exam.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1327.}\ 
The main purpose of a motor vehicle undergoing a safety technical inspection is to check its various performance parameters, eliminate safety hazards promptly, and reduce accidents.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车参加安全技术检验的主要目的是检查车辆各项性能系数，及时消除车辆安全隐患，减少事故发生。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Safety technical inspections effectively reduce the occurrence of accidents.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1328.}\ 
Before driving a motor vehicle on the road, the driver should check the vehicle's safety technical condition.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车上路前应当检查车辆安全技术性能。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  A vehicle with safety hazards must not be driven on the road, so a pre-drive check is required.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1329.}\ 
A person who drives a motor vehicle without having obtained a driver's license will be held legally liable.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：对未取得驾驶证驾驶机动车的，追究其法律责任。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Driving without a license is a violation of the law.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1330.}\ 
If a vehicle registration certificate, license plate, or vehicle registration document is destroyed, lost, or damaged, the owner should apply for a replacement or reissue at the vehicle administration office of their place of residence.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车登记证书、号牌、行驶证灭失、丢失或者损毁的，机动车所有人应当向居住地车辆管理所申请补领、换领。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Applications to replace vehicle-related documents must be made at the office where the vehicle was originally registered, not the place of residence.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1331.}\ 
If a driver's license is not renewed within one year after its expiration, the license will be cancelled.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶证有效期超过一年以上未换证的，驾驶证将被注销。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  License renewal must be applied for within 90 days before expiration; failing to renew for over a year leads to cancellation.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1332.}\ 
If an applicant cannot attend the exam at the scheduled time for some reason, they should apply to cancel the appointment one day in advance; an applicant who fails to attend at the scheduled time will be judged to have failed that exam.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：申请人因故不能按照预约时间参加考试的，应当提前一日申请取消预约，对申请人未按照预约考试时间参加考试的，判定该次考试不合格。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Not attending the exam counts as a fail, so cancelling one day in advance is required if unable to attend.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1333.}\ 
How long before a driver's license expires should the driver apply to renew it?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Within 30 days \quad \textbf{B.} Within 60 days \quad \textbf{C.} Within 90 days \quad \textbf{D.} Within 6 months}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶人在驾驶证有效期满前多长时间申请换证？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. Within 90 days  License renewal must be applied for within 90 days before expiration; information changes require renewal within 30 days.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1334.}\ 
After a driver obtains a replacement driver's license, the original license becomes invalid and must not continue to be used.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶人补领机动车驾驶证后，原机动车驾驶证作废，不得继续使用。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  A replacement is issued for a lost or damaged license, and the old one becomes invalid to prevent misuse by others.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1335.}\ 
When renewing an expired driver's license, the driver may only submit a physical condition certificate issued by a medical institution at or above the county level.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶人驾驶证有效期满换领驾驶证时，只能提交县级以上医疗机构出具的身体条件证明。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  For a renewal after expiration, the physical condition certificate may come from any medical institution, not only one at or above the county level.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1336.}\ 
What is the age requirement for applying for a small motor vehicle (car) license?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 18 to 60 years old \quad \textbf{B.} 18 years or older, no upper limit \quad \textbf{C.} 21 to 50 years old \quad \textbf{D.} 24 to 70 years old}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：申请小型汽车准驾车型驾驶证的人年龄条件是多少？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. 18 years or older, no upper limit  Applying for a C1/C2 license only requires being 18 or older, with no upper age limit.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1337.}\ 
If a driver's license is lawfully revoked because it was obtained through fraud, bribery, or other improper means, how long must the person wait before reapplying?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Within 3 years \quad \textbf{B.} For life \quad \textbf{C.} Within 1 year \quad \textbf{D.} Within 5 years}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：以欺骗、贿赂等不正当手段取得驾驶证被依法撤销驾驶许可的，多长时间不得重新申请驾驶许可？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Within 3 years  Under the standard rule, a license revoked for being fraudulently obtained carries a 3-year reapplication ban.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1338.}\ 
How long is the probationary period after a driver first applies for and obtains a driver's license?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 6 months \quad \textbf{B.} 12 months \quad \textbf{C.} 3 months \quad \textbf{D.} 2 years}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶人初次申请机动车驾驶证的多长时间为实习期？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. 12 months  The probationary period is 12 months, during which a standardized sign must be displayed on the vehicle.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1339.}\ 
An applicant with which of the following behaviors is barred from reapplying for a driver's license for one year?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Feeling physically unwell during the exam \quad \textbf{B.} Cheating during the exam \quad \textbf{C.} Not diligently practicing driving skills per the syllabus \quad \textbf{D.} Not attending theory training}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：存在以下哪种行为的申请人在一年内不得再次申领机动车驾驶证？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Cheating during the exam  Cheating on the exam counts as fraud, which carries a 1-year reapplication ban under the standard rule.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1340.}\ 
If a driver's license is lost, at which vehicle administration office should the driver apply for a replacement?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Place of issuance \quad \textbf{B.} Place of temporary residence \quad \textbf{C.} Place of residence \quad \textbf{D.} Any of the above}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶证遗失的，机动车驾驶人应当向哪里的车辆管理所申请补发？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. Any of the above  Under current rules, a replacement driver's license can be applied for at any vehicle administration office nationwide.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1341.}\ 
If a vehicle breaks down on an ordinary road, the driver should turn on the hazard warning lights and place a warning triangle 50 to 100 meters behind the vehicle. Failing to use the lights and set up the warning sign as required results in how many demerit points per offense?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 1 point \quad \textbf{B.} 12 points \quad \textbf{C.} 3 points \quad \textbf{D.} 6 points}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：车辆在一般道路上发生故障后，应开启危险报警闪光灯，并在车后50-100米设置警告标志，如不按规定使用灯光和设置警告标志的，将被一次记多少分？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. 3 points  For a breakdown stop: turn on hazards, pull over, set out a warning sign, and evacuate the vehicle; failing to comply carries 3 points.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{14\baselineskip}

Which of the following violations is this motor vehicle on the road committing?\par
\smallskip\begin{center}\includegraphics[width=6cm,height=4cm,keepaspectratio]{work/img/20190410102529s12kqhuczhk9azui467hjx.jpg}\end{center}\smallskip
{\small \textbf{A.} Driving against traffic \quad \textbf{B.} Not displaying the license plate as required \quad \textbf{C.} Deliberately obscuring the license plate \quad \textbf{D.} Occupying a non-motor-vehicle lane}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：这辆在道路上行驶的机动车有下列哪种违法行为？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. Deliberately obscuring the license plate  Deliberately obscuring or defacing the license plate carries 9 demerit points.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1343.}\ 
A license authorizing small motor vehicles (cars) also permits driving which of the following?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Low-speed cargo trucks \quad \textbf{B.} Medium buses \quad \textbf{C.} Three-wheeled motorcycles \quad \textbf{D.} Wheeled special-purpose machinery vehicles}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：准驾车型为小型汽车的，可以驾驶下列哪种车辆？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Low-speed cargo trucks  A small-vehicle (C1) license also covers C2, C3 (low-speed cargo truck), and C4 vehicle classes.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1344.}\ 
For a registered small passenger car, in which of the following situations does the owner NOT need to apply for a change of registration?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Replacing the engine \quad \textbf{B.} Installing front and rear anti-collision devices \quad \textbf{C.} Changing the body color \quad \textbf{D.} Replacing the body or chassis}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：已注册登记的小型载客汽车有下列哪种情形，所有人不需要办理变更登记？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Installing front and rear anti-collision devices  Engine, body color, or chassis/body changes alter the vehicle's registered information and require a change of registration, but adding anti-collision devices does not.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1345.}\ 
In addition to lawful administrative penalties for a driver's traffic violations, the traffic administration department also applies which of the following systems?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Violation registration system \quad \textbf{B.} Mileage reward system \quad \textbf{C.} Cumulative demerit point system \quad \textbf{D.} Mandatory scrapping system}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：公安机关交通管理部门对驾驶人的交通违法行为除依法给予行政处罚外，实行下列哪种制度？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. Cumulative demerit point system  Traffic violations are subject to administrative penalties plus a cumulative demerit point system.}\par\smallskip

\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1346.}\ 
When a driver cannot complete their license review due to military service, going abroad, etc., what is the maximum length of the deferral period?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 1 year \quad \textbf{B.} 2 years \quad \textbf{C.} 3 years \quad \textbf{D.} 5 years}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶人因服兵役、出国（境）等原因无法办理审验时，延期审验期限最长不超过多长时间？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. 3 years  The maximum deferral period is 3 years, during which the driver may not operate a vehicle.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1347.}\ 
If a driver falsifies their study record or commits fraud during the review-education process, the study record becomes invalid, the driver must retake the review study, and is fined up to how much?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 200 yuan \quad \textbf{B.} 500 yuan \quad \textbf{C.} 1,000 yuan \quad \textbf{D.} 2,000 yuan}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶人参加审验教育时在签注学习记录、学习过程中弄虚作假的，相应学习记录无效，重新参加审验学习，并处多少元以下罚款？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. 1,000 yuan  Falsifying the study record during review education is punishable by a fine of up to 1,000 yuan.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1348.}\ 
In which of the following situations can a driver apply to the vehicle administration office for a replacement license?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} License seized \quad \textbf{B.} License detained \quad \textbf{C.} License lost \quad \textbf{D.} License suspended}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：下列哪种情况可以向车辆管理所申请补发驾驶证？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. License lost  A replacement can be applied for at any vehicle administration office when the license is lost, but not when it has been seized, detained, or suspended for a violation.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}

A driver who operates a vehicle that has already met the mandatory scrapping standard will face which of the following penalties?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Detention of up to 15 days \quad \textbf{B.} Revocation of the driver's license \quad \textbf{C.} A fine of 20 to 200 yuan \quad \textbf{D.} Criminal liability}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：对驾驶已达到报废标准的机动车上路行驶的驾驶人，会受到下列哪种处罚？}\par

How many demerit points are given per offense for drunk driving (after drinking alcohol)?\par

\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1352.}\ 
A first-time applicant for a driver's license may apply for which of the following vehicle classes?\par

\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1353.}\ 
How many demerit points are given per offense for using a forged or altered vehicle registration document?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 12 points \quad \textbf{B.} 6 points \quad \textbf{C.} 3 points \quad \textbf{D.} 1 point}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：使用伪造、变造的行驶证一次记几分？}\par

\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1354.}\ 
If a party deliberately destroys or fabricates the scene, or destroys evidence, after a traffic accident, what liability must they bear?\par

How many demerit points are given per offense for deliberately obscuring or defacing the license plate of a vehicle on the road?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 9 points \quad \textbf{B.} 6 points \quad \textbf{C.} 3 points \quad \textbf{D.} 1 point}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：上道路行驶的机动车故意遮挡、污损机动车号牌的一次记几分？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. 9 points  Deliberately obscuring or defacing the license plate carries 9 demerit points.}\par\smallskip

An applicant seeking to add a new vehicle class to their license should apply at which vehicle administration office?\par

{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：申请增加准驾车型的，申请人应向哪里的车辆管理所申领机动车驾驶证？}\par

Which of the following is NOT part of the driver's license review content?\par

If a driver's license was cancelled for not being renewed more than one year (but not more than two years) after expiration, how can the driver restore their driving eligibility?\par

{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. By passing the road traffic safety laws, regulations, and related knowledge exam  This exam is Subject 1, the road traffic safety laws and regulations exam, which must be passed to restore eligibility.}\par\smallskip

The driver's license review content does NOT include which of the following?\par

{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶证审验内容不包括以下哪一项？}\par

What is the purpose of the annual physical exam required for drivers aged 70 and above?\par

How long is the probationary period after a driver first obtains a driver's license?\par

{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶人初次申领驾驶证后的实习期是多长时间？}\par

If a driver's household registration moves out of the jurisdiction of their original vehicle administration office, where should they apply to renew their license?\par

Which of the following violations results in 6 demerit points per offense?\par

\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1365.}\ 
Which of the following physical conditions disqualifies a person from applying for a driver's license?\par

How often must drivers aged 70 and above submit a physical condition certificate?\par

What vehicle class does B1 represent?\par

Which of the following documents must a driver carry with them while driving?\par

Which of the following violations by a driver results in 6 demerit points per offense?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Driving a vehicle class not authorized by the license \quad \textbf{B.} Driving without displaying the license plate \quad \textbf{C.} Failing to obey a traffic signal light \quad \textbf{D.} Driving a school bus without school bus driving qualification}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：以下哪种违法行为的机动车驾驶人将被一次记6分？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. Failing to obey a traffic signal light  The other three violations each carry 9 points; failing to obey a traffic signal light carries 6.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1406.}\ 
An applicant who bribes or cheats during the exam is barred from reapplying for a driver's license for how many years?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 1 year \quad \textbf{B.} 2 years \quad \textbf{C.} 3 years \quad \textbf{D.} 4 years}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：申请人在考试过程中有贿赂、舞弊行为的，申请人在多少年内不得再次申领机动车驾驶证？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. 1 year  Bribery or cheating during the exam counts as fraud, which carries a 1-year reapplication ban under the standard rule.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{14\baselineskip}

{\small \textbf{A.} Vehicle A bears full liability \quad \textbf{B.} Vehicle B bears full liability \quad \textbf{C.} Each bears half the liability \quad \textbf{D.} Vehicle B bears primary liability}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：如图所示，在这起交通事故中，以下说法正确的是什么？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Vehicle A bears full liability  The party facing an obstruction must yield to the unobstructed party, so the obstructed vehicle bears full liability.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{14\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1408.}\ 
[Image] As shown in the figure, vehicle A's cargo fell off and caused vehicle B to collide with the fallen cargo. Which of the following statements is correct?\par
