{\small \textbf{A.} Vehicle B bears its own liability \quad \textbf{B.} Vehicle A bears full liability \quad \textbf{C.} Each bears half the liability \quad \textbf{D.} It was a chance event, unavoidable}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：如图所示，A车货物掉落，导致B车与掉落货物发生碰撞，以下说法正确的是什么？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Vehicle A bears full liability  Vehicle A's falling cargo caused the collision, so vehicle A bears full liability.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1409.}\ 
Which of the following actions results in 9 demerit points per offense for a driver?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Failing to yield to a school bus as required \quad \textbf{B.} Driving while the license is suspended \quad \textbf{C.} Failing to obey a traffic signal light \quad \textbf{D.} Driving a vehicle class not authorized by the license}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：以下哪种行为机动车驾驶人将被一次记9分？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. Driving a vehicle class not authorized by the license  Driving a vehicle class not matching the license carries 9 points; the other listed offenses carry fewer.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{14\baselineskip}

{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：如图所示，在这起交通事故中，以下说法正确的是什么？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Vehicle B bears full liability  A vehicle making a U-turn must not impede a normally traveling vehicle, so the U-turning vehicle bears full liability.}\par\smallskip

\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1411.}\ 
An applicant who conceals relevant facts or submits false materials when applying for a driver's license is barred from reapplying for how many years?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 1 year \quad \textbf{B.} 2 years \quad \textbf{C.} 3 years \quad \textbf{D.} 4 years}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：隐瞒有关情况或者提供虚假材料申请机动车驾驶证，申请人在多少年内不得再次申领机动车驾驶证？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. 1 year  Concealing facts or submitting false materials counts as fraud, which carries a 1-year reapplication ban under the standard rule.}\par\smallskip

A C1 (small vehicle) license also permits driving which of the following vehicle classes?\par

{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：准驾车型为C1驾照，还可以驾驶下列哪种车型？}\par

\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1415.}\ 
If a traffic accident between a motor vehicle and a pedestrian causes injury, death, or property loss, and the vehicle driver was not at fault, the pedestrian bears responsibility alone.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车与行人之间发生交通事故造成人身伤亡、财产损失的，机动车一方没有过错的，由行人自行承担责任。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  The driver is exempt from liability only if the pedestrian caused the accident intentionally; otherwise the driver still bears some liability even without fault.}\par\smallskip

If a driver resides outside the jurisdiction of the vehicle administration office that issued their license, where should they renew it?\par

{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶人在驾驶证核发地车辆管理所管辖区以外居住的，应该在哪里换证？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. The vehicle administration office of their place of residence  A driver not residing in the issuing location can renew their license at the vehicle administration office of their place of residence.}\par\smallskip

{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：已经达到报废标准的机动车在缴纳管理费后可以上路行驶。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Driving a scrapped vehicle leads to mandatory confiscation and destruction, license revocation, and a fine of 200 to 2,000 yuan; no fee can waive this.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1437.}\ 
A driver who pays someone else to accept a traffic violation penalty and demerit points on their behalf will be fined up to twice the amount paid.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶人请他人代为接受交通违法行为处罚和记分，并支付经济利益的，会被处以所支付经济利益二倍以下的罚款。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  The actual penalty is a fine of up to three times the amount paid, plus 12 demerit points, not twice.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1438.}\ 
Vehicles that meet the scrapping standard and are driven on the road will be confiscated by the traffic police department. Which of the following statements is incorrect?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Driving a scrapped vehicle endangers the driver's safety \quad \textbf{B.} A scrapped vehicle's mechanical parts are aged and prone to accidents \quad \textbf{C.} The vehicle no longer meets safety and technical standards and must be forcibly scrapped \quad \textbf{D.} It looks unattractive and affects the city's image}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶达到报废标准的机动车上道路行驶的，公安交通管理部门将会予以收缴。以下说法错误的是什么？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. It looks unattractive and affects the city's image  Scrapped vehicles are confiscated to protect road safety, not for reasons of appearance or city image.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1439.}\ 
When applying for demerit-point reduction through legal study, a driver who completes a cumulative 30 minutes of online study on road traffic safety laws, regulations, and related knowledge within three days and passes the test may have 1 point deducted per instance.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶人申请学法减分时，参加道路交通安全法律、法规和相关知识网上学习三日内累计满三十分钟且考试合格的，一次扣减1分。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Completing 30 minutes of online traffic-law study within three days and passing the test reduces demerit points by 1, as officially specified.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1440.}\ 
Failing to meet oncoming traffic properly while driving a motor vehicle will result in how many demerit points per instance?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 1 point \quad \textbf{B.} 6 points \quad \textbf{C.} 3 points \quad \textbf{D.} 9 points}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车不按规定会车的，将被一次记多少分？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. 1 point  Improper overtaking scores 3 points, while improperly meeting oncoming traffic scores only 1 point.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1441.}\ 
If a non-motor-vehicle driver or pedestrian causes a traffic accident with a stationary motor vehicle and the motor vehicle bears no fault, which statement about the motor vehicle's compensation liability is correct?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Bears no compensation liability \quad \textbf{B.} Bears 10\% liability \quad \textbf{C.} Bears 60\% liability \quad \textbf{D.} Bears full liability}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：非机动车驾驶人、行人与处于静止状态的机动车发生交通事故造成损失，机动车一方无责任的，关于机动车一方的赔偿责任，下面说法哪种是正确的？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Bears no compensation liability  Since the vehicle was not even moving, it bears no liability for the accident.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1442.}\ 
If a learner driver violates road traffic safety rules or causes a traffic accident during driving instruction, who is responsible?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} The learner \quad \textbf{B.} The instructor and learner jointly \quad \textbf{C.} The owner of the training vehicle \quad \textbf{D.} The instructor}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：学员在学习驾驶过程中有违反道路交通安全的行为或者造成交通事故的，由谁承担责任？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. The instructor  During driving instruction, the instructor bears legal responsibility for violations or accidents.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{14\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1443.}\ 
[Image] As shown in the picture, the vehicle ahead has committed no violation while driving.\par

{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：如图所示，前车在行驶过程中没有违法行为。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  As a driving-school training vehicle, it may only operate on designated routes, so it was in fact in violation.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1444.}\ 
For applicants of a C1/C2/C3 license, uncorrected or corrected vision in both eyes should reach at least what value on the logarithmic visual acuity chart?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 4.7 \quad \textbf{B.} 4.8 \quad \textbf{C.} 4.9 \quad \textbf{D.} 5.0}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：申请C1/C2/C3驾驶证的，两眼裸视力或矫正视力应达到对数视力表多少以上？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. 4.9  C1, C2, and C3 applicants need vision of at least 4.9, while A and B license applicants need at least 5.0.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1445.}\ 
A truck exceeding the specified width or height limit while driving on an expressway will score how many demerit points per instance?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 9 points \quad \textbf{B.} 6 points \quad \textbf{C.} 3 points \quad \textbf{D.} 1 point}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：货车上高速公路行驶超过规定限宽或者限高的，一次记几分？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. 1 point  Exceeding the width or height limit on an expressway is one of several minor violations that each score 1 point.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1446.}\ 
If a driver's license is damaged and illegible, within how long must a replacement be applied for?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 60 days \quad \textbf{B.} 50 days \quad \textbf{C.} 40 days \quad \textbf{D.} 30 days}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶证损毁无法辨认的，要在多长时间内申请换证？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. 30 days  A damaged, illegible driver's license must be replaced within 30 days.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1447.}\ 
Anyone who has used or injected drugs within how many years is barred from applying for a driver's license?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 1 \quad \textbf{B.} 2 \quad \textbf{C.} 3 \quad \textbf{D.} 4}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：多少年内有吸食、注射毒品行为的，不得申请机动车驾驶证？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. 3  Anyone who has used or injected drugs within the past three years is barred from applying for a driver's license.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1448.}\ 
Which of the following actions by a driver results in license revocation with a lifetime ban on reapplying?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Driving after drinking alcohol \quad \textbf{B.} Using a forged or altered license plate \quad \textbf{C.} Driving while drunk \quad \textbf{D.} Causing a major accident that constitutes a crime while driving after drinking or while drunk}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶人有下列哪种行为，会被吊销驾驶证，终生不得重新取得驾驶证？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. Causing a major accident that constitutes a crime while driving after drinking or while drunk  Causing a major accident that constitutes a crime leads to permanent revocation and a lifetime disqualification, per criminal liability rules.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1449.}\ 
Which of the following actions makes a party bear full liability for a traffic accident?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Hitting a pedestrian on an expressway \quad \textbf{B.} Colliding with a turning vehicle while going straight at an intersection \quad \textbf{C.} Colliding with a motorcycle in the fast lane \quad \textbf{D.} Deliberately damaging the scene, falsifying evidence, or destroying evidence after an accident}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：当事人有下列哪种行为，要承担交通事故全部责任？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. Deliberately damaging the scene, falsifying evidence, or destroying evidence after an accident  Deliberately damaging or falsifying the scene, like fleeing after an accident, results in full liability.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1450.}\ 
If a newly purchased motor vehicle is not yet registered but needs to be temporarily driven on the road, what should be done?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Obtain a temporary driving permit \quad \textbf{B.} Carry an ID card \quad \textbf{C.} Drive directly without any permit \quad \textbf{D.} Display the inspection certificate on the windshield}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车购买后尚未登记，需要临时上道路行驶的，应当如何做？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Obtain a temporary driving permit  An unregistered vehicle must obtain a temporary permit before it can legally be driven on the road.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1451.}\ 
What penalty does a probationary driver face for driving alone on an expressway during the probationary period?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} A fine of 20 to 200 yuan \quad \textbf{B.} 3 demerit points \quad \textbf{C.} 6 demerit points \quad \textbf{D.} License revocation}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶人在实习期内单独驾驶机动车上高速公路行驶，会受到什么处罚？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. A fine of 20 to 200 yuan  Probationary drivers must be accompanied by a driver with 3 or more years of experience on expressways; violating this incurs a 20 to 200 yuan fine.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1452.}\ 
A violation caused by inconsistent traffic signal indications should, once verified, be cleared from the record.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par

{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Demerit points are cleared once a violation is verified to result from conflicting signals, on-scene handling, emergency rescue, or vehicle theft or impersonation.}\par\smallskip

[Image] How many demerit points will be recorded for parking at the location shown in the picture?\par

{\small \textbf{A.} 12 points \quad \textbf{B.} 3 points \quad \textbf{C.} 1 point \quad \textbf{D.} No points}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：在图中位置停车会被记多少分？}\par

\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1454.}\ 
A motor vehicle driven on the road that fails to undergo the required periodic inspection will score how many demerit points per instance?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 3 points \quad \textbf{B.} 1 point \quad \textbf{C.} 6 points \quad \textbf{D.} 12 points}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：上道路行驶的机动车不按规定年检，一次记多少分？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. 1 point  Failing to complete the required vehicle inspection is a minor violation scoring 1 point, like improper markings or light use.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1455.}\ 
When a vehicle stops on the road due to breakdown or an accident, failing to set up a warning triangle as required scores 1 point per instance.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：在道路上车辆发生故障、事故停车后，不按规定设置警告标志，一次记1分。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Failing to place the warning triangle at the required distance (50 to 100 meters on ordinary roads, over 150 meters on expressways) actually scores 3 points, not 1.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1456.}\ 
Using or answering a handheld phone while driving a motor vehicle scores how many demerit points per instance?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 3 points \quad \textbf{B.} 1 point \quad \textbf{C.} 6 points \quad \textbf{D.} 12 points}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车有拨打、接听手持电话的行为，一次记多少分？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. 3 points  Using a handheld phone while driving scores 3 points, versus 1 point for not wearing a seatbelt.}\par\smallskip

\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1457.}\ 
If a motor vehicle has been lawfully seized or impounded by a supervisory authority, court, procuratorate, or administrative enforcement body, which body will refuse to process its registration?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} The traffic police department \quad \textbf{B.} The people's court \quad \textbf{C.} The people's procuratorate \quad \textbf{D.} The people's government}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车被监察机关、人民法院、人民检察院、行政执法部门依法查封、扣押的，（ ）不予办理注册登记？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. The traffic police department  Traffic police departments will not register vehicles lawfully seized or impounded by courts, procuratorates, or administrative enforcement bodies.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1458.}\ 
Running a red light while driving scores 6 points per instance.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车闯红灯一次扣6分。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Running a red light scores 6 points, while driving a vehicle class not matching the license scores 9 points.}\par\smallskip

Holders of a foreign driver's license who meet the licensing conditions set by the State Council's public security department and pass an assessment by the traffic police department may be issued a Chinese driver's license.\par

{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：持有境外机动车驾驶证的人，符合国务院公安部门规定的驾驶许可条件，经公安机关交通管理部门考核合格的，可以发给中国的机动车驾驶证。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  A qualifying foreign license holder who passes the required assessment can be issued a Chinese driver's license, per regulation.}\par\smallskip

A driver who resides outside the jurisdiction of the vehicle management office that issued their license may apply to a general government service center to replace the license.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶人在驾驶证核发地车辆管理所管辖区以外居住的，可以向政务大厅申请换证。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  License replacement must be handled at a vehicle management office, not a general government service center.}\par\smallskip

What penalty applies to a driver who continues driving after failing to complete the overdue license review?\par

{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. A fine of 200 to 500 yuan  Driving after failing to complete the overdue license review incurs a fine of 200 to 500 yuan.}\par\smallskip

\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1462.}\ 
A driver with no accumulated demerit points for how many years may have their license review period extended?\par

A driver who fails to wear a seatbelt as required while driving on the road scores how many demerit points per instance?\par

{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶人驾驶机动车在道路上行驶，未按规定系安全带的，一次记多少分？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. 1 point  Not wearing a seatbelt while driving always scores 1 point, regardless of road type.}\par\smallskip

\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1464.}\ 
Driving a small car on an expressway while exceeding the speed limit by 20\% or more but less than 50\% scores how many demerit points per instance?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 3 points \quad \textbf{B.} 6 points \quad \textbf{C.} 9 points \quad \textbf{D.} 12 points}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶小型汽车在高速公路行驶，超过规定时速20\%以上，未达50\%的，一次记多少分？}\par

\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1465.}\ 
If an applicant obtains a driver's license through fraud, bribery, or other improper means, the traffic police department will confiscate the license, revoke the driving privilege, and impose a fine of up to how much?\par

{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：申请人以欺骗、贿赂等不正当手段取得机动车驾驶证的，公安机关交通管理部门收缴机动车驾驶证，撤销机动车驾驶许可，并处多少元以下罚款？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. 2,000 yuan  Obtaining a license through fraud or bribery leads to confiscation, a 3-year reapplication ban, and a fine of up to 2,000 yuan.}\par\smallskip

A driver who reaches 12 points two or more times, or accumulates 24 or more points, within one scoring period will have their license returned as soon as they pass the traffic law knowledge exam.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶人在一个记分周期内有两次以上达到12分或者累积记分达到24分以上的，在道路交通安全法律、法规和相关知识考试合格后即可发还机动车驾驶证。}\par

\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1467.}\ 
When traffic ahead is stopped in a queue or moving slowly, cutting in to overtake, using the opposite lane, or weaving through waiting vehicles scores how many demerit points per instance?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 3 points \quad \textbf{B.} 9 points \quad \textbf{C.} 6 points \quad \textbf{D.} 12 points}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车遇前方机动车停车排队或者缓慢行驶时，借道超车或者占用对面车道、穿插等候车辆的，将被一次记多少分？}\par

Driving on a road other than an expressway or urban expressway without wearing a seatbelt as required scores how many demerit points per instance?\par

{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车在高速公路或者城市快速路以外的道路上行驶时，未按规定系安全带的，一次记多少分？}\par

\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1469.}\ 
When applying for demerit-point reduction through legal study, the maximum cumulative deduction within one scoring period is 3 points.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶人申请学法减分时，一个记分周期内，累计最高扣减3分。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  The actual maximum cumulative deduction per scoring period is 6 points, not 3.}\par\smallskip

\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1470.}\ 
Violating a prohibition sign or prohibition marking while driving scores how many demerit points per instance?\par
