{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车违反禁令标志、禁止标线指示的，一次记多少分？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. 1 point  Violating a prohibition sign or marking scores 1 point, the same as not wearing a seatbelt.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1471.}\ 
Driving a small car on an ordinary road while exceeding the speed limit by 20\% but less than 50\% scores 2 points per instance.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶小型汽车在一般道路行驶，超过规定时速20\%但不到50\%的，一次记2分。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  On ordinary roads, exceeding the speed limit by 20\% to 50\% actually scores 3 points, not 2.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1472.}\ 
When an owner mortgages their motor vehicle, they should apply for mortgage registration at the vehicle management office where the vehicle is registered.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车所有人将机动车作为抵押物抵押的，应当向登记地车辆管理所申请抵押登记。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Mortgage registration must be filed at the vehicle's registration office, as required by regulation.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1473.}\ 
Failing to yield to a school bus as required while driving scores how many demerit points per instance?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 6 points \quad \textbf{B.} 9 points \quad \textbf{C.} 3 points \quad \textbf{D.} 12 points}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车不按照规定避让校车的，一次记多少分？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. 3 points  Failing to yield to a school bus, like failing to yield at a crosswalk, scores 3 points.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1474.}\ 
To apply for a small car or three-wheeled vehicle license, the applicant must be between 18 and 70 years old.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：申请小型汽车、三轮汽车驾驶证的，年龄段在18周岁以上70周岁以下。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Applicants for C1, C2, C5, or F licenses only need to be at least 18 years old, with no upper age limit.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1475.}\ 
What is the age requirement for applying for a license for a special automatic-transmission passenger car for disabled drivers?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 18 or older, with no upper limit \quad \textbf{B.} 18 to 60 years old \quad \textbf{C.} 20 to 70 years old \quad \textbf{D.} 20 to 60 years old}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：申请残疾人专用小型自动挡载客汽车驾驶证的人年龄条件是多少？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. 18 or older, with no upper limit  Applicants for this license class need only be 18 or older, with no maximum age limit.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1476.}\ 
Driving against traffic on an ordinary city road scores how many demerit points per instance?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 12 points \quad \textbf{B.} 6 points \quad \textbf{C.} 3 points \quad \textbf{D.} 1 point}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：在普通城市道路上逆向行驶，将被一次性扣多少分？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. 3 points  Driving against traffic on an ordinary road scores 3 points, versus 12 points on an expressway.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1477.}\ 
If a driver uses their original license after already receiving a replacement license, besides having the original confiscated, what fine will also apply?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} A fine of 20 to 200 yuan \quad \textbf{B.} A fine of 200 to 500 yuan \quad \textbf{C.} A fine of 1,000 to 2,000 yuan \quad \textbf{D.} A fine of 200 to 2,000 yuan}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶人补领机动车驾驶证后，使用原机动车驾驶证驾驶的，除被收回原机动车驾驶证外，还会处多少元罚款？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. A fine of 20 to 200 yuan  Continuing to use the original license after a replacement was issued incurs a fine of 20 to 200 yuan, in addition to confiscation.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1478.}\ 
Illegally occupying the emergency lane on an urban expressway scores how many demerit points per instance?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 1 point \quad \textbf{B.} 3 points \quad \textbf{C.} 6 points \quad \textbf{D.} 12 points}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：在城市快速路上违法占用应急车道，一次记多少分?}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. 6 points  Illegally occupying the emergency lane on an urban expressway scores 6 points.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1479.}\ 
Which of the following is part of a driver's license review?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Whether the driver has a medical condition impairing safe driving \quad \textbf{B.} The vehicle's cumulative mileage \quad \textbf{C.} The vehicle's inspection status \quad \textbf{D.} The license's validity period}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：下列属于机动车驾驶证审验内容的是？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Whether the driver has a medical condition impairing safe driving  License review focuses on the driver's fitness to drive, such as disqualifying medical conditions, not the vehicle itself.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1480.}\ 
Driving in the wrong lane on an urban expressway scores how many demerit points per instance?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 1 point \quad \textbf{B.} 9 points \quad \textbf{C.} 3 points \quad \textbf{D.} 6 points}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车在城市快速路上不按规定车道行驶的，将被一次记多少分？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. 3 points  Driving in the wrong lane on an expressway or urban expressway scores 3 points.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1481.}\ 
Reversing a motor vehicle on an expressway scores how many demerit points per instance?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 1 point \quad \textbf{B.} 3 points \quad \textbf{C.} 6 points \quad \textbf{D.} 12 points}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车在高速公路上倒车，一次记几分？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. 12 points  Reversing on an expressway scores 12 points, versus only 1 point for reversing on an ordinary road.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1482.}\ 
Driving a small car on an expressway while exceeding the speed limit by 20\% but less than 50\% scores 2 points per instance.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶小型汽车在高速公路行驶，超过规定时速20\%但不到50\%的，一次记2分。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  On expressways, exceeding the speed limit by 20\% to 50\% actually scores 6 points, not 2.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1483.}\ 
If a driver's license is lost, the driver should apply for a replacement at the vehicle management office that issued it, or at another vehicle management office.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶证遗失的，机动车驾驶人应当向机动车驾驶证核发地或者核发地以外的车辆管理所申请补发。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  A lost license can be replaced at any vehicle management office, not only the one that originally issued it.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1484.}\ 
Failing to slow down, stop, or yield to pedestrians when passing a crosswalk scores how many demerit points per instance?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 1 point \quad \textbf{B.} 3 points \quad \textbf{C.} 6 points \quad \textbf{D.} 12 points}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车行经人行横道，不按规定减速、停车、避让行人的，将被一次记多少分？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. 3 points  Failing to slow, stop, or yield to pedestrians at a crosswalk scores 3 points.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1485.}\ 
A motor vehicle driven on the road without properly installed license plates scores 12 points per instance.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：上道路行驶的机动车不按规定安装机动车号牌的，一次记12分。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Improperly installed plates score only 3 points; 12 points applies to forged or altered plates instead.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1486.}\ 
When an owner mortgages their motor vehicle, they should apply for mortgage registration at the vehicle management office of their place of residence.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车所有人将机动车作为抵押物抵押的，机动车所有人应当向居住地车辆管理所申请抵押登记。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Mortgage registration must be filed at the vehicle's registration office, which is not necessarily the owner's place of residence.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1487.}\ 
A driver who has long-term addiction to dependency-forming psychotropic drugs and has not overcome it will have their license canceled by the vehicle management office.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：长期服用依赖性精神药品成瘾尚未戒除的，车辆管理所将注销其驾驶证。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Drivers still addicted to such drugs are highly likely to cause traffic accidents, so their license is canceled.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1488.}\ 
What penalty applies if a driver's license has been expired for more than a year without renewal?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} License cancellation \quad \textbf{B.} Vehicle registration cancellation \quad \textbf{C.} Vehicle impoundment \quad \textbf{D.} A fine}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：超过机动车驾驶证有效期一年以上未换证的，会受到何种处罚？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. License cancellation  Failing to renew the license more than one year past its expiration results in cancellation of the license.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1489.}\ 
Improper overtaking or failing to yield right of way while driving scores how many demerit points per instance?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 1 point \quad \textbf{B.} 3 points \quad \textbf{C.} 6 points \quad \textbf{D.} 12 points}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车不按规定超车、让行的，将被一次记多少分？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. 3 points  Improper overtaking or failing to yield scores 3 points, versus 1 point for improperly meeting oncoming traffic.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1490.}\ 
To apply for vehicle registration, only the purchase tax payment certificate or tax exemption certificate is needed, unrelated to the owner's identity.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：申请机动车登记，只需提交车辆购置税的完税证明或者免税凭证，与机动车所有人的身份无关。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Vehicle registration also requires proof of the owner's identity, not just the tax certificate.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1491.}\ 
What is the policy term of compulsory motor vehicle insurance?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Half a year \quad \textbf{B.} 1 year \quad \textbf{C.} 2 years \quad \textbf{D.} 3 years}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车强制险的保险期间为多长时间?}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. 1 year  Compulsory motor vehicle insurance has a policy term of one year.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1492.}\ 
To apply for a small car license, the applicant only needs to be 18 years or older.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：申请小型汽车驾驶证的，年龄在18周岁以上即可。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Applicants for a small car (C1) license only need to be 18 or older, with no upper age limit.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1493.}\ 
A probationary driver holding a C1 license may drive alone on the expressway if accompanied by a driver holding a C2 license for 3 or more years.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：准驾车型为C1的驾驶人，在实习期内驾驶机动车上高速公路行驶，可以由准驾车型为C2驾照3年以上的驾驶人陪同。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  The accompanying driver must hold a license of the same class or higher than C1, so a C2 license does not qualify.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1494.}\ 
Illegally installed sirens or emergency signal lights will be forcibly removed and confiscated by the traffic police department.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：非法安装警报器、标志灯具的，公安机关交通管理部门会强制拆除，予以收缴。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Installing sirens or emergency lights without authorization is prohibited and subject to forced removal and confiscation.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1495.}\ 
Driving in the wrong lane on an expressway scores how many demerit points per instance?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 1 point \quad \textbf{B.} 6 points \quad \textbf{C.} 3 points \quad \textbf{D.} 12 points}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车在高速公路上不按规定车道行驶的，一次记多少分？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. 3 points  Driving in the wrong lane on an expressway scores 3 points.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1496.}\ 
Applicants for a driver's license who are over 70 years old must undergo tests of memory, judgment, and reaction ability.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：申请机动车驾驶证年龄在70周岁以上的人，需要进行记忆力、判断力、反应力等能力测试。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Applicants over 70 must pass the 'three abilities' test covering memory, judgment, and reaction speed.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1497.}\ 
Illegally using another vehicle's license plates or registration certificate while driving scores how many demerit points per instance?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 1 point \quad \textbf{B.} 3 points \quad \textbf{C.} 6 points \quad \textbf{D.} 12 points}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车违法使用其他机动车号牌、行驶证的，一次记多少分?}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. 12 points  Illegally using another vehicle's plates or registration documents scores 12 points, the same as forging such documents.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1498.}\ 
A driver holding a small automatic-transmission car license (C2) may drive a special automatic-transmission passenger car for upper-limb disabled drivers.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：对于持有小型自动挡汽车驾驶证（C2）的驾驶人，可以驾驶上肢残疾人专用小型自动挡载客汽车。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  A C2 license covers automatic-transmission vehicles, which includes this special vehicle type.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1499.}\ 
If a vehicle runs a red light at an intersection because a large bus ahead blocked the driver's view, what penalty applies?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 3 demerit points \quad \textbf{B.} 6 demerit points \quad \textbf{C.} 12 demerit points \quad \textbf{D.} No points recorded}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：车辆行至交叉路口，因前方大型客车遮挡视线，导致闯红灯，会受到什么处罚？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. 6 demerit points  Running a red light scores 6 points regardless of the reason, so drivers must keep a safe distance behind large vehicles to see the signals.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1500.}\ 
An applicant who submits false materials to apply for a driver's license bears which of the following legal consequences?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} A fine of 20 to 200 yuan \quad \textbf{B.} Disqualification from applying for a license \quad \textbf{C.} Barred from reapplying for 1 year \quad \textbf{D.} Barred from reapplying for 2 years}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：提供虚假材料申请驾驶证的申请人会承担下列哪种法律责任？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. Barred from reapplying for 1 year  Under the standard rule of thumb, submitting false materials results in a one-year ban on reapplying for a license.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1501.}\ 
Driving a vehicle of a class not matching the license held scores 3 points per instance.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶与准驾车型不符的机动车的，一次记3分。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Driving a vehicle class that does not match the license actually scores 9 points, not 3.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1502.}\ 
Parking is prohibited where a no-parking sign is posted; violating this scores 2 points per instance.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车在设置了禁停标志的路段，不得停放车辆，否则一次记2分。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Parking where prohibited is a violation, but the 2-point penalty tier no longer exists under current scoring rules.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1503.}\ 
When making a U-turn at an intersection, a driver may not cross a double solid yellow line to do so; violating this scores 2 points per instance.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：车辆行至交叉路口，需要掉头时，不可直接轧双黄实线掉头，否则一次记2分。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Crossing a solid line to U-turn is a violation, but the 2-point penalty tier no longer exists under current scoring rules.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1504.}\ 
Once a siren is installed on a motor vehicle, the driver may activate it as soon as possible in an emergency to alert others.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车安装报警器后，遇到紧急情况，可尽快开启报警器提示他人。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Ordinary motor vehicles are not permitted to install or use sirens at all, since this is illegal.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1505.}\ 
A driver licensed for small cars may also drive light or mini special-purpose work vehicles.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：准驾车型为小型汽车的，可以驾驶轻型、微型专项作业车。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  The C1 license class includes small and mini passenger cars as well as light and mini special-purpose work vehicles.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1506.}\ 
If an insured motor vehicle has no traffic accidents within a year, the insurance premium rate will be lower the following year.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：被保险机动车1年内没有发生交通事故，下一年的保险费率会降低。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  A year with no accidents leads to a discounted premium rate the following year.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1507.}\ 
If a party flees the scene after causing a traffic accident, they must still bear full liability even if evidence proves the other party was also at fault.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：造成交通事故后当事人逃逸的，有证据证明对方当事人也有过错的，逃逸的当事人仍需承担全部责任。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  If evidence shows the other party was also at fault, that party bears its share of liability instead of the fleeing party taking full blame.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1508.}\ 
A history of drink-driving will cause the compulsory traffic accident liability insurance rate to rise.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：有酒后驾驶机动车行为的，机动车交通事故责任强制保险费率将上浮。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Compulsory insurance premiums can rise up to 60\% following a prior year's drink-driving or drunk-driving offense.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1509.}\ 
If a driver's license is lost or damaged beyond recognition, the driver should apply for a replacement at a vehicle management office.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶证遗失、损毁无法辨认时，应当向车辆管理所申请补领。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  A lost or illegible license can be replaced promptly at a vehicle management office.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1510.}\ 
The Subject 2 test for small automatic-transmission cars includes reverse parking, hill-start parking, parallel parking, curve driving, and right-angle turns.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：小型自动挡汽车科目二考试内容包括倒车入库、坡道定点停车和起步、侧方停车、曲线行驶、直角转弯。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  The C2 automatic-transmission test includes only four items, omitting the hill-start parking item required for manual cars.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1511.}\ 
The Learner's Permit is valid for three years.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：学习驾驶证明的有效期是三年。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  The Learner's Permit is valid for three years, while the medical certificate is valid for only six months.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1512.}\ 
For drivers over 70, C1 license holders must undergo a physical exam once a year, while C2 license holders may undergo one every two years.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶人年龄在70岁以上时，准驾车型为C1的驾驶人每年都要体检1次，准驾车型C2的驾驶人可以每两年检查1次身体状况。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Both C1 and C2 license holders over 70 must undergo an annual physical exam, not every two years for C2.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1513.}\ 
Vehicle registration is categorized into initial registration, change registration, transfer registration, mortgage registration, and cancellation registration.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车登记分为注册登记、变更登记、转移登记、抵押登记和注销登记。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  These five categories correctly cover all types of vehicle registration.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1514.}\ 
Driving against traffic on an ordinary road scores 6 points per instance.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车在一般道路逆向行驶，一次记6分。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Driving against traffic on an ordinary road scores 3 points, not 6; expressways score 12 points.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1515.}\ 
For first-time license applicants or those adding a license class, the vehicle management office should issue the Learner's Permit within 3 days after passing Subject 1.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：初次申请机动车驾驶证或者申请增加准驾车型的，科目一考试合格后，车辆管理所应当在3日内核发学习驾驶证明。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  The Learner's Permit is issued the same day the applicant passes Subject 1, not within 3 days.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1516.}\ 
Driving while the license is suspended or detained scores 9 points per instance.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶证被暂扣或者扣留期间驾驶机动车的，将会被一次记9分。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Driving during license suspension or detention scores 6 points, not 9.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1517.}\ 
If an applicant bribes or cheats during the test, their eligibility is canceled, but scores already passed for other subjects are retained.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：申请人在考试过程中有贿赂、舞弊行为的，取消考试资格，已经通过考试的其他科目成绩予以保留。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Cheating invalidates all previously passed subject scores, since it counts as submitting false results.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1518.}\ 
If a driver applies for license cancellation, the vehicle management office should cancel their driver's license.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶人提出注销申请的，车辆管理所应当注销其机动车驾驶证。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  The office is required to process a valid cancellation application as submitted.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1519.}\ 
While a lost license is being replaced, a driver with a replacement-in-progress certificate may temporarily drive the corresponding vehicle class.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶证遗失补办期间，有补办证明的，可以临时驾驶相应车型的机动车。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Driving without a valid license is never permitted, including during the lost-license replacement period.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1520.}\ 
A vehicle meeting the scrapping standard does not need to be deregistered as long as it is no longer driven on the road.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：达到报废条件的机动车，只要不再上路行驶，就可以不用办理注销登记。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  A scrapped vehicle must be deregistered regardless of whether it is still driven.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1521.}\ 
A probationary driver may temporarily tow a trailer while driving.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶人在实习期内驾驶机动车可以临时牵引挂车。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Probationary drivers are prohibited from towing trailers or transporting hazardous chemicals.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1522.}\ 
If a driver cannot complete the license review due to military service, travel abroad, or similar reasons, the deferral period must not exceed one year.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶人因服兵役、出国（境）等原因无法办理审验时，延期审验期限最长不得超过1年。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  The driver may not operate any motor vehicle at all during the deferral period, which is the key restriction here.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1523.}\ 
Driving a small passenger car overloaded by more than 100\% scores how many demerit points per instance?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 3 points \quad \textbf{B.} 6 points \quad \textbf{C.} 9 points \quad \textbf{D.} 12 points}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶小型载客汽车超过核定人数100\%以上的，一次记多少分？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. 12 points  For ordinary passenger cars, overloading by more than 100\% scores 12 points under the graduated overload scale.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1524.}\ 
A vehicle that has already met the scrapping standard still cannot be driven on the road even after major repairs.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：已经达到报废标准的机动车经大修后也不可以上路行驶。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Scrapped vehicles cannot legally return to the road under any circumstances, including after repairs, or face fines and confiscation.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1525.}\ 
The C1 (manual) Subject 2 test includes reverse parking, hill-start parking, parallel parking, curve driving, and right-angle turns; the C2 (automatic) test removes the hill-start item, reducing the number of items from 5 to 4.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：小型汽车C1科目二考试内容包括倒车入库、坡道定点停车和起步、侧方停车、曲线行驶、直角转弯；小型自动挡汽车C2考试内容，取消科目二考试“坡道定点停车和起步”项目，考试项目由5项减少为4项。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Manual-transmission cars are tested on 5 Subject 2 items, while automatic-transmission cars are tested on only 4.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1526.}\ 
A driver aged 70 or older who is at fault in an accident causing serious injury or death must undergo license review at the traffic police department within 30 days after the current scoring period ends.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：年满70岁的驾驶人发生责任交通事故造成人员重伤或者死亡的，应当在本记分周期结束后三十日内到公安机关交通管理部门接受审验。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Causing serious injury or death requires review within 30 days after the scoring period ends, as stated.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1527.}\ 
A driver over 70 years old may not drive which of the following motor vehicles?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} A light trailer-towing vehicle \quad \textbf{B.} A small car \quad \textbf{C.} A small automatic-transmission car \quad \textbf{D.} A special automatic-transmission passenger car for disabled drivers}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：年龄在70周岁以上的，不可以驾驶下列哪种机动车？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. A light trailer-towing vehicle  The light trailer-towing license requires the applicant to be 20 to 60 years old, so those over 70 cannot hold it.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1528.}\ 
A medical certificate is valid for how long from the date it is issued?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 1 month \quad \textbf{B.} 3 months \quad \textbf{C.} 6 months \quad \textbf{D.} 1 year}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：身体条件证明自出具之日起多长时间之内有效？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. 6 months  The medical certificate is valid for 6 months from issuance, versus 3 years for the Learner's Permit.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1529.}\ 
The electronic version of a driver's license has the same legal effect as the paper version.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶证电子版与纸质版具有同等效力。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Both the electronic and paper driver's licenses carry equal legal validity.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1530.}\ 
Active-duty military personnel (including armed police) should apply for a driver's license at the vehicle management office of which location?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Place of residence \quad \textbf{B.} Place of household registration \quad \textbf{C.} Any vehicle management office nationwide \quad \textbf{D.} Location of their military unit}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：现役军人（含武警）应向哪里的车辆管理所申领机动车驾驶证？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. Location of their military unit  Active-duty military personnel apply for their license at the vehicle management office where their unit is stationed.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1531.}\ 
To apply for adding the light trailer-towing license class, the applicant must have held a small car or small automatic-transmission car license for how many years or more?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 1 \quad \textbf{B.} 2 \quad \textbf{C.} 3 \quad \textbf{D.} 5}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：申请增加轻型牵引挂车准驾车型的，应取得驾驶小型汽车、小型自动挡汽车准驾车型资格几年以上？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. 1  Applicants adding the light trailer-towing class must have held a C1 or C2 license for at least one year.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1532.}\ 
What is the age requirement for applying to add a light trailer-towing driver's license?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 18 or older, with no upper limit \quad \textbf{B.} 18 to 60 years old \quad \textbf{C.} 20 to 60 years old \quad \textbf{D.} 20 to 70 years old}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：申请增驾轻型牵引挂车驾驶证的人年龄条件是多少？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. 20 to 60 years old  Applicants for the light trailer-towing endorsement must be between 20 and 60 years old.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1533.}\ 
Which of the following is NOT part of the light trailer-towing license's Subject 2 test?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Parallel parking \quad \textbf{B.} Curve driving \quad \textbf{C.} Stake (pole course) test \quad \textbf{D.} Right-angle turn}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：以下哪项不属于轻型牵引挂车科目二考试内容？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Parallel parking  The light trailer-towing Subject 2 test covers only three items: the stake test, curve driving, and right-angle turns, excluding parallel parking.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1534.}\ 
A foreign license holder making a brief visit may apply for a temporary driving permit valid for 3 months.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：持有境外机动车驾驶证入境短暂停留的，可以临时申请3个月的临时机动车驾驶许可。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  The temporary driving permit for foreign license holders is valid for 3 months, as specified by regulation.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1535.}\ 
To add a license class, the applicant should apply at the vehicle management office of their place of household registration.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：申请增加准驾车型的，申请人应向户籍所在地车辆管理所申领驾驶证。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Adding a license class must be applied for at the office that originally issued the license, not the household registration office.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1536.}\ 
A driver changing their license class to the special automatic-transmission vehicle for disabled drivers, due to a change in physical condition, must take the Subject 2 and Subject 3 tests.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶人因身体条件发生变化，申请变更准驾车型为残疾人专用小型自动挡载客汽车，应考试科目二和科目三。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Changing to this disability-adapted vehicle class requires passing both the Subject 2 and Subject 3 driving tests.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1537.}\ 
If the local area has no Subject 2 test site, applicants may choose another test site within the same province or autonomous region.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：因当地尚未设立科目二考场的，申请人可以选择省（自治区）内其他考场参加考试。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  When no local test site exists, applicants may take the test at another site within the same province.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1538.}\ 
The Learner's Permit is valid for three years, but its expiration date cannot exceed the applicant's maximum eligible age limit.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：学习驾驶证明的有效期为三年，但有效期截止日期不得超过申请年龄条件上限。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  The permit is valid for three years, though it cannot extend past the age limit for the applicable license class.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1539.}\ 
A driver whose overloading or speeding constitutes a crime and results in license revocation is barred from applying for a driver's license for how many years?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 1 \quad \textbf{B.} 3 \quad \textbf{C.} 5 \quad \textbf{D.} 10}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车超员、超速，构成犯罪，被吊销驾驶证的，几年内不得申请机动车驾驶证？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. 5  Overloading or speeding that constitutes a crime results in license revocation and a five-year reapplication ban.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1540.}\ 
A first-time applicant for a driver's license may not apply for which of the following license classes?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Small car \quad \textbf{B.} Small automatic-transmission car \quad \textbf{C.} Large truck \quad \textbf{D.} Light trailer-towing vehicle}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：初次申领机动车驾驶证的，不得申请下列哪种准驾车型？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. Light trailer-towing vehicle  First-time applicants cannot directly apply for large passenger or trailer-towing vehicle classes, which require an existing license.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1541.}\ 
To add a license class, the driver should apply at which vehicle management office?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} The office that issued the license \quad \textbf{B.} The office of temporary residence \quad \textbf{C.} The office of place of residence \quad \textbf{D.} Any vehicle management office nationwide}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：申请增加准驾车型的，机动车驾驶人应当向哪里的车辆管理所申请？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. The office that issued the license  Adding a license class must be applied for at the vehicle management office that originally issued the license.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1542.}\ 
If an applicant bribes or cheats during the test, their eligibility is canceled, all previously passed subject scores become invalid, and they are fined up to how much?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 200 yuan \quad \textbf{B.} 500 yuan \quad \textbf{C.} 1,000 yuan \quad \textbf{D.} 2,000 yuan}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：申请人在考试过程中有贿赂、舞弊行为的，取消考试资格，已经通过考试的其他科目成绩无效，并处多少元以下罚款？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. 2,000 yuan  Bribery or cheating during the test invalidates all passed scores and incurs a fine of up to 2,000 yuan.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1543.}\ 
A driver who already holds a C1/C2 license and adds the light trailer-towing (C6) class must take the Subject 2 and Subject 3 tests.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：已持有C1/C2准驾车型增加C6准驾车型的，应当考试科目二和科目三。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Adding the light trailer-towing class only requires passing the Subject 2 skills test, not Subject 3.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1544.}\ 
Concealing facts or submitting false materials when applying for a driver's license leads the traffic police department to refuse the application and impose a fine of up to how much?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 200 yuan \quad \textbf{B.} 500 yuan \quad \textbf{C.} 1,000 yuan \quad \textbf{D.} 2,000 yuan}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：隐瞒有关情况或者提供虚假材料申领机动车驾驶证的，公安机关交通管理部门不予受理或者不予办理，并处多少元以下罚款？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. 500 yuan  Concealing facts or submitting false materials when applying for a license incurs a fine of up to 500 yuan.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1545.}\ 
A person who, within the past 3 years, committed which of the following is barred from applying for a driver's license?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Taking the driving test on someone else's behalf \quad \textbf{B.} Driving under the influence (drunk driving) \quad \textbf{C.} Driving without a license, causing serious injury while bearing primary responsibility \quad \textbf{D.} Speeding that constitutes a crime, leading to license revocation}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：3年内有下列哪种行为的人不得申请机动车驾驶证？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Taking the driving test on someone else's behalf  Taking a driving test in place of someone else results in a 3-year ban on applying for a license.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1546.}\ 
Which of the following violations scores 9 demerit points per instance?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Carrying passengers 50\% to 100\% over capacity in a passenger car with more than 7 seats \quad \textbf{B.} Carrying passengers more than 20\% over capacity in a school bus \quad \textbf{C.} Accepting payment to take on another driver's traffic penalty and points \quad \textbf{D.} Using forged or altered license plates, or another vehicle's plates}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶人有下列哪种违法行为一次记9分？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Carrying passengers 50\% to 100\% over capacity in a passenger car with more than 7 seats  The other three options each score 12 points; only overloading a large passenger car by 50\% to 100\% scores 9 points.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1547.}\ 
Fleeing the scene after causing an accident with only minor injury or property damage, without it constituting a crime, scores 12 points per instance.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车造成致人轻微伤或者财产损失的交通事故后逃逸，尚不构成犯罪的，将会被一次记12分。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Fleeing after only minor injury or property damage scores 6 points; 12 points applies only when injury is more serious or fatal.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1548.}\ 
Fleeing the scene after causing an accident with injury beyond minor or death, without it constituting a crime, scores 12 points per instance.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶人造成致人轻伤以上或者死亡的交通事故后逃逸，尚不构成犯罪的，一次记12分。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Fleeing after causing injury beyond minor or death, without a crime being charged, correctly scores 12 points.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1549.}\ 
Which of the following violations scores 12 demerit points per instance?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Fleeing after causing injury beyond minor or death, not constituting a crime \quad \textbf{B.} Driving without displaying plates, or with plates deliberately obscured or damaged \quad \textbf{C.} Fleeing after causing only minor injury or property damage, not constituting a crime \quad \textbf{D.} Driving below the minimum speed limit on an expressway}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶人有下列哪种违法行为一次记12分？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Fleeing after causing injury beyond minor or death, not constituting a crime  The other options score 9, 6, and 3 points respectively; only fleeing after serious injury or death scores 12 points.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1550.}\ 
Accepting payment to take on another driver's traffic violation penalty and demerit points scores how many points per instance?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 3 points \quad \textbf{B.} 6 points \quad \textbf{C.} 9 points \quad \textbf{D.} 12 points}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：代替实际机动车驾驶人接受交通违法行为处罚和记分牟取经济利益的，一次记多少分？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. 12 points  Accepting payment to take on another driver's traffic penalty scores 12 points, with a fine of up to three times the payment received.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1551.}\ 
Which of the following violations scores 9 demerit points per instance?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Overloading a cargo truck by more than 50\% \quad \textbf{B.} Illegally parking on an expressway \quad \textbf{C.} Transporting oversized cargo without following the designated route \quad \textbf{D.} Driving while the license is suspended}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶人有下列哪种违法行为一次记9分？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Illegally parking on an expressway  Illegal parking on an expressway scores 9 points, per the expressway scoring scale.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1552.}\ 
For a small car driver who reaches 12 points two or more times within one scoring period, within how many days after passing Subject 1 again must the vehicle management office administer the Subject 3 test?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 10 \quad \textbf{B.} 20 \quad \textbf{C.} 30 \quad \textbf{D.} 40}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：小型汽车驾驶人在一个记分周期内两次以上达到12分的，车辆管理所应当在驾驶人科目一考试合格多少日后对其进行科目三考试？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. 30  After passing Subject 1 again, the driver must take the Subject 3 road test within 30 days.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1553.}\ 
Driving below the minimum required speed on an expressway scores 2 points per instance.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车在高速公路上行驶低于规定最低时速的，一次记2分。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Driving below the minimum expressway speed actually scores 3 points, not 2.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1554.}\ 
Based on the severity of a traffic violation, the possible demerit point values per instance are 12, 6, 3, 2, and 1.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：根据交通违法行为的严重程度，一次记分的分值为：12分、6分、3分、2分、1分。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Under current rules, a 9-point tier was added and the 2-point tier was removed, so the values are 12, 9, 6, 3, and 1.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1555.}\ 
Driving a small car more than 50\% over the speed limit on an expressway or urban expressway scores 9 points per instance.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶小型汽车在高速公路、城市快速路上行驶超过规定时速50\%以上的，一次记9分。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Exceeding the expressway speed limit by more than 50\% actually scores 12 points, not 9.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1556.}\ 
A small car driver who accumulates 12 points within one scoring period must attend a 30-day course on traffic safety laws and related knowledge.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：小型汽车驾驶人在一个记分周期内累积记分达到12分的，应当参加为期30日的道路交通安全法律、法规和相关知识学习。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Reaching 12 points requires a 7-day study course, not 30 days, with 7 more days added for each additional 12 points.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1557.}\ 
Driving a small car on an urban expressway while exceeding the speed limit by 20\% or more but less than 50\% scores how many demerit points per instance?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 3 points \quad \textbf{B.} 6 points \quad \textbf{C.} 9 points \quad \textbf{D.} 12 points}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶小型汽车在城市快速路上行驶超过规定时速20\%以上未达50\%的，一次记多少分？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. 6 points  Exceeding the speed limit by 20\% to 50\% on an urban expressway scores 6 points.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1558.}\ 
A driver may process multiple traffic violation records for the same vehicle in a single visit.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶人可以一次性处理同一辆机动车的多起交通违法行为记录。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Multiple violations can be processed together in one visit, with the points added together.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1559.}\ 
A driver who pays someone else to accept a traffic violation penalty and demerit points on their behalf will be fined up to how many times the amount paid?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} One time \quad \textbf{B.} Two times \quad \textbf{C.} Three times \quad \textbf{D.} Four times}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶人请他人代为接受交通违法行为处罚和记分，并支付经济利益的，会被处以所支付经济利益几倍以下的罚款？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. Three times  The fine for paying someone to take on your traffic penalty is up to three times the amount paid.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1560.}\ 
When applying for demerit-point reduction through legal study, completing a cumulative 30 minutes of online study on road traffic safety laws, regulations, and related knowledge within three days and passing the test reduces points by how much per instance?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 1 point \quad \textbf{B.} 2 points \quad \textbf{C.} 3 points \quad \textbf{D.} 6 points}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶人申请学法减分时，参加道路交通安全法律、法规和相关知识网上学习三日内累计满三十分钟且考试合格的，一次扣减几分？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. 1 point  Completing 30 minutes of online traffic-law study within three days and passing the test reduces demerit points by 1 per instance.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1561.}\ 
For an applicant who has not yet obtained a motor vehicle driving licence, if there is no instructor accompanying and guiding while practicing driving on the road, how much fine will the public security traffic administration department impose?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} A fine of 200 to 2,000 yuan \quad \textbf{B.} A fine of 2,000 to 5,000 yuan \quad \textbf{C.} A fine of 1,000 to 3,000 yuan \quad \textbf{D.} A fine of 20 to 200 yuan}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：未取得机动车驾驶证申请人，在道路上学习驾驶时，没有教练员随车指导，由公安机关交通管理部门处多少元罚款？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. A fine of 200 to 2,000 yuan  Practicing without an instructor, or with unqualified guidance, is treated as driving without a licence, punishable by a 200 to 2,000 yuan fine.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1562.}\ 
At the end of a demerit-point cycle, if a driver's accumulated points are under 12 but there is an overdue unpaid fine, the points for the violation with the unpaid fine carry over to the next cycle.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶人在一个记分周期期限届满，累积记分虽未满12分，但有罚款逾期未缴纳的，该记分周期内尚未缴纳罚款的交通违法行为记分分值转入下一记分周期。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Regulations state that unpaid-fine violation points carry over to the next cycle even if total points are under 12.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1563.}\ 
In which of the following situations can a driver take part in the study-law point-reduction program?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} After clearing all violations, accumulated points are under 12 \quad \textbf{B.} The driving licence is overdue for periodic review \quad \textbf{C.} While the driving licence is seized or suspended \quad \textbf{D.} During the probationary period}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶人有以下哪种情况时，可以参加学法减分？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. After clearing all violations, accumulated points are under 12  A driver may apply to reduce points through traffic-safety education only after clearing violations and having under 12 accumulated points.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1564.}\ 
While a driving licence is lawfully impounded, seized, or suspended, the driver may not apply for a replacement.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶证被依法扣押、扣留或者暂扣期间，机动车驾驶人不得申请补发。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Regulations bar applying for a replacement licence while the original is impounded, seized, or suspended.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1565.}\ 
Upon discovering which of the following, must the vehicle administration office promptly launch an investigation while processing driving-licence business?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} The applicant is undergoing periodic licence review \quad \textbf{B.} The applicant is applying to replace the licence \quad \textbf{C.} The applicant is suspected of submitting false application materials \quad \textbf{D.} The applicant is filing a record with the traffic administration department}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：发现以下哪种情形，车辆管理所在办理驾驶证业务时应及时开展调查？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. The applicant is suspected of submitting false application materials  Suspected submission of false application materials requires the vehicle administration office to investigate promptly.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1566.}\ 
A driver holding an A2 licence may directly drive a light trailer-towing vehicle.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶人持有A2驾照的，可以直接驾驶轻型牵引挂车。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  The A2 (heavy trailer-towing) class covers the C6 light trailer-towing class, so A2 holders may drive light trailer-towing vehicles.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1567.}\ 
What vehicle class does licence class B2 authorize?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Heavy trailer-towing vehicle \quad \textbf{B.} Large truck \quad \textbf{C.} Medium bus \quad \textbf{D.} Large bus}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：B2表示哪种准驾车型？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Large truck  Class B2 authorizes large trucks; A2 is heavy trailer-towing, B1 is medium bus, A1 is large bus.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1568.}\ 
A driver can reduce demerit points by taking part in traffic-safety volunteer activities, with every two full hours counting as one session that reduces 1 point.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶人可以通过交通安全公益活动扣减驾驶证记分，满两个小时为一次，一次扣减1分。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  The rule requires one full hour, not two, of volunteer activity to reduce 1 point per session.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1569.}\ 
How many demerit points for incorrectly using high-beam headlights when meeting oncoming traffic?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 6 points \quad \textbf{B.} 3 points \quad \textbf{C.} 2 points \quad \textbf{D.} 1 point}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车会车错误使用远光灯，一次记多少分？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. 1 point  Incorrect use of lights, such as high beams when meeting oncoming traffic, is a commonly tested 1-point violation.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1570.}\ 
How many demerit points for incorrectly using hazard warning flashers while driving on the road?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 6 points \quad \textbf{B.} 3 points \quad \textbf{C.} 2 points \quad \textbf{D.} 1 point}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车在道路上行驶，错误使用危险报警闪光灯的，一次记多少分？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. 1 point  Hazard flashers may only be used in special circumstances; misuse is a 1-point violation.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1571.}\ 
When learning to drive, one must first study road traffic safety laws, regulations, and related knowledge, and only after passing that exam move on to learning driving skills.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：学习机动车驾驶，应当先学习道路交通安全法律、法规和相关知识，考试合格后，再学习机动车驾驶技能。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Regulations require passing the traffic law knowledge exam before beginning driving skills training.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1572.}\ 
Drivers over 70 years old may not drive tricycles, light trailer-towing vehicles, regular two-wheel motorcycles, or regular three-wheel motorcycles.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶人年龄超过70周岁，不得驾驶三轮汽车、轻型牵引挂车、普通二轮摩托车和普通三轮摩托车。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Regulations prohibit drivers over 70 from driving these vehicle classes, among others.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1573.}\ 
For applicants adding a light trailer-towing vehicle class, within what timeframe must the vehicle administration office issue the learner's driving certificate?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Immediately upon acceptance \quad \textbf{B.} Within 1 day \quad \textbf{C.} Within 3 days \quad \textbf{D.} Within 5 days}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：属于申请增加轻型牵引挂车准驾车型的，车辆管理所应在多长时间内核发学习驾驶证明？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Immediately upon acceptance  For this category of add-on applications, the certificate is issued directly upon acceptance, not after a waiting period.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1574.}\ 
Once accumulated points reach 12, the driver may no longer process violation records for other vehicles.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：累积记分满12分的，不得再处理其他机动车的交通违法行为记录。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Regulations bar processing other vehicles' violation records once a driver's points reach 12.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1575.}\ 
A driver holding a C1 licence may drive a C6 light trailer-towing vehicle.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶人持有的驾驶证准驾车型为C1的，可以驾驶C6轻型牵引挂车。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  C1 only covers C2, C3, and C4 vehicles; it does not authorize C6 light trailer-towing vehicles.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1576.}\ 
Motor vehicle registration is divided into only two types: initial registration and change registration.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车登记分为注册登记和变更登记两种。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Motor vehicle registration includes more than just these two types.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1577.}\ 
If a medical institution issues a false physical fitness certificate, the traffic administration department may stop recognizing that institution's certificates and report it to the health administration department.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：医疗机构出具虚假身体条件证明的，公安机关交通管理部门有权停止认可该医疗机构出具的证明，并通报卫生健康行政部门。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Regulations authorize the traffic administration department to stop recognizing a medical institution's certificates and report false certification to the health authorities.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1578.}\ 
What vehicle class does licence class C6 authorize?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Light trailer-towing vehicle \quad \textbf{B.} Heavy trailer-towing vehicle \quad \textbf{C.} Automatic-transmission car for disabled drivers \quad \textbf{D.} Low-speed goods vehicle}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：C6表示哪种准驾车型？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Light trailer-towing vehicle  C6 is light trailer-towing vehicle; A2 is heavy trailer-towing, C5 is the disabled-driver vehicle, C3 is low-speed goods vehicle.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1579.}\ 
Institutions that conduct vehicle safety technical inspections must inspect according to national standards and bear legal responsibility for the inspection results.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：对机动车进行安全技术检验的机构应该按照国家标准检验，并对其检验结果承担法律责任。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Regulations require inspection bodies to follow national standards and take legal responsibility for their results.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1580.}\ 
When applying for point reduction through legal study, completing at least one hour of in-person study of traffic laws, regulations, and related knowledge and passing the exam reduces how many points per session?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 1 point \quad \textbf{B.} 2 points \quad \textbf{C.} 3 points \quad \textbf{D.} 6 points}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶人申请学法减分时，参加道路交通安全法律、法规和相关知识现场学习满一小时且考试合格的，一次扣减几分？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. 2 points  One hour of in-person study plus a passing exam reduces 2 points per session, versus 1 point for online study or volunteer activity.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1581.}\ 
For applicants taking the Subject 3 exam for the small car licence class, how many days after obtaining the learner's driving certificate may they book the exam?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 10 \quad \textbf{B.} 20 \quad \textbf{C.} 30 \quad \textbf{D.} 40}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：报考小型汽车准驾车型科目三考试的，应在取得学习驾驶证明满多少日后预约？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. 30  Small car (non-automatic) applicants must wait 30 days after receiving the learner's certificate before booking Subject 3.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1582.}\ 
When encountering vehicles ahead queued or moving slowly, overtaking by using another lane, occupying the oncoming lane, or weaving through waiting vehicles earns 9 demerit points per instance.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车遇前方机动车停车排队或者缓慢行驶时，借道超车或者占用对面车道、穿插等候车辆的，一次记9分。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  This improper overtaking/yielding infraction is actually a 3-point offense, not 9.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1583.}\ 
A driver whose accumulated points reach 12 may still process violation records for other vehicles.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶人累积记分满12分的，还可以处理其他机动车的交通违法行为记录。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Once accumulated points reach 12, the driver is barred from processing other vehicles' violation records.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1584.}\ 
If a driver continues using the original licence after obtaining a replacement, what fine applies?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 20 to 200 yuan \quad \textbf{B.} 200 to 500 yuan \quad \textbf{C.} 500 to 1,000 yuan \quad \textbf{D.} 1,000 to 2,000 yuan}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶人补领机动车驾驶证后，继续使用原机动车驾驶证的，处多少元罚款？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. 20 to 200 yuan  Continuing to use the original licence after a replacement is issued carries a 20 to 200 yuan fine.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1585.}\ 
Regardless of whether driving on a highway or an ordinary road, not wearing a seatbelt earns 1 demerit point per instance.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：无论机动车驾驶人在高速公路还是普通公路上行驶，只要不系安全带，都将被一次记1分。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Not wearing a seatbelt is a commonly tested 1-point violation, on any road type.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1586.}\ 
Driving a small car on an ordinary road at 20\% to under 50\% over the speed limit earns 6 demerit points per instance.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶小型汽车在一般道路上行驶超过规定时速20\%以上未达50\%以上的，一次记6分。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  On ordinary roads, exceeding the limit by 20\% to 50\% is a 3-point violation, not 6; 6 points applies on highways/expressways.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1587.}\ 
Failing to use lights as required after a vehicle breakdown on the road earns 3 demerit points per instance.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车在道路上车辆发生故障后，不按规定使用灯光的，一次记3分。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Failing to use proper lights or warning signals after a breakdown is a commonly tested 3-point violation.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1588.}\ 
A driver whose accumulated points have not reached 12 may still process violation records for other vehicles they drive.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶人累积记分未达到12分的，还可以处理其驾驶的其他机动车的交通违法行为记录。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Under 12 points, a driver may still process violation records for other vehicles they drive.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1589.}\ 
Improperly overtaking or yielding, or driving against traffic on a road other than a highway or urban expressway, earns 6 demerit points per instance.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车不按规定超车、让行，或者在高速公路、城市快速路以外的道路上逆行的，一次记6分。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  These violations, improper overtaking/yielding or wrong-way driving off expressways, are actually 3-point offenses.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1590.}\ 
Illegally parking on a highway earns 12 demerit points per instance.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车在高速公路上违法停车的，一次记12分。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Illegal parking on a highway or expressway is a commonly tested 9-point violation, not 12.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1591.}\ 
What penalty applies to a temporarily-entering driver whose accumulated points reach 12 within one demerit cycle?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Revocation of the driving licence \quad \textbf{B.} Seizure of the driving licence \quad \textbf{C.} Cancellation of the temporary driving permit \quad \textbf{D.} Seizure of the vehicle}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：临时入境的机动车驾驶人在一个记分周期内记分满12分的，会受到什么样的处罚？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. Cancellation of the temporary driving permit  For temporarily-entering foreign drivers reaching 12 points, the traffic authority cancels their temporary driving permit.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1592.}\ 
A driver who commits fraud in the study log or study process during periodic review education is fined 1,000 yuan, but the study record is kept valid.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶人参加审验教育时在签注学习记录、学习过程中弄虚作假的，处1000元罚款，但是会保留相应学习记录。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Such fraud invalidates the study record, requiring the driver to retake it, not keep it valid.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1593.}\ 
Regarding processing a vehicle's traffic violation records, which statement is correct?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Multiple violation records may not be processed at once \quad \textbf{B.} When processing multiple violation records, points must be calculated separately and not accumulated \quad \textbf{C.} With under 12 accumulated points, other vehicles' violations may not be processed \quad \textbf{D.} Multiple violation records for the same vehicle may be processed at once}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：关于处理机动车的交通违法行为记录，以下正确的说法是什么？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. Multiple violation records for the same vehicle may be processed at once  A driver may process multiple violation records for the same vehicle in one go, with points accumulated.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1594.}\ 
How many demerit points for driving a passenger vehicle rated for fewer than 7 seats, overloaded by 50\% to under 100\%?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 3 points \quad \textbf{B.} 6 points \quad \textbf{C.} 9 points \quad \textbf{D.} 12 points}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶7座以下载客汽车超过核定载客人数50\%以上未达100\%的，一次记多少分？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. 6 points  For such vehicles, overloading of 50\% to 100\% is a 6-point violation.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1595.}\ 
How many demerit points for a small car carrying passengers 20\% to under 50\% over its rated capacity?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 3 points \quad \textbf{B.} 6 points \quad \textbf{C.} 9 points \quad \textbf{D.} 12 points}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：小型汽车载客超过额定人员20\%以上未达到50\%以上的，一次记多少分？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. 3 points  Overloading of 20\% to 50\% for these vehicle types is a 3-point violation.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1596.}\ 
When applying for point reduction through legal study, what is the maximum total points that can be reduced in one demerit cycle?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 12 points \quad \textbf{B.} 6 points \quad \textbf{C.} 4 points \quad \textbf{D.} 3 points}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶人申请学法减分时，一个记分周期内，累计最高扣减几分？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. 6 points  The regulation caps the cumulative reduction from traffic-safety education at 6 points per demerit cycle.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1597.}\ 
A driver who pays someone to accept a traffic violation penalty and points on their behalf is fined up to three times the amount paid, capped at how much?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 20,000 yuan \quad \textbf{B.} 30,000 yuan \quad \textbf{C.} 80,000 yuan \quad \textbf{D.} 50,000 yuan}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶人请他人代为接受交通违法行为处罚和记分，并支付经济利益的，会被处以所支付经济利益三倍以下的罚款，但最高不得超过多少元？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. 50,000 yuan  The fine for paying someone to take a violation on one's behalf is capped at 50,000 yuan, three times the payment at most.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1598.}\ 
The cumulative demerit-point system runs on cycles; when does a cycle begin?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} From the date of first obtaining the driving licence, or first obtaining a temporary driving permit \quad \textbf{B.} From the date of first obtaining the driving licence, or first obtaining a temporary plate \quad \textbf{C.} From the date of first obtaining a temporary plate, or first obtaining a vehicle registration certificate \quad \textbf{D.} From the date of first obtaining a temporary plate, or first obtaining a temporary driving permit}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶人的交通违法行为实行累积记分制度，记分周期应该从什么时间开始计算？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. From the date of first obtaining the driving licence, or first obtaining a temporary driving permit  The demerit cycle is 12 months, counted continuously from the driver's first licence issuance or first temporary driving permit.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1599.}\ 
A driver with two or more full-points education sessions in the current or previous demerit cycle may not participate in the study-law point-reduction program.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：在本记分周期内或者上一个记分周期内，机动车驾驶人有二次以上参加满分教育记录的，不得参加学法减分。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Regulations bar drivers with two or more full-points education records in the current or prior cycle from the point-reduction program.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1600.}\ 
For processing a licence for the automatic-transmission car class for disabled drivers, the physical fitness certificate is valid for 6 months from issuance.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：办理残疾人专用小型自动挡载客汽车驾驶证业务时，身体条件证明自出具之日起6个月内有效。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  The physical fitness certificate is valid for 6 months from issuance, distinct from the 3-year validity of the learner's certificate.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1601.}\ 
Which of the following violations earns 6 demerit points?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Fleeing after causing an accident resulting in injury above minor or death, not yet a crime \quad \textbf{B.} Using a forged or altered vehicle plate \quad \textbf{C.} Fleeing after causing an accident resulting in minor injury or property loss, not yet a crime \quad \textbf{D.} Driving in the wrong lane on a highway or urban expressway}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶人有下列哪种违法行为一次记6分？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. Fleeing after causing an accident resulting in minor injury or property loss, not yet a crime  Fleeing after an accident causing only minor injury or property loss (not a crime) is a 6-point violation, versus 12 for more serious injury or death.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1602.}\ 
An applicant who obtains a driving licence through fraud, bribery, or other improper means will have the licence confiscated, the driving permit revoked, and a fine of up to 2,000 yuan imposed.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：申请人以欺骗、贿赂等不正当手段取得机动车驾驶证的，公安机关交通管理部门收缴机动车驾驶证，撤销机动车驾驶许可，处二千元以下罚款。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Regulations impose exactly this penalty for obtaining a licence by fraud or bribery, plus a three-year re-application ban.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1603.}\ 
Accepting a traffic violation penalty and points on behalf of the actual driver for profit earns 9 demerit points per instance.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：代替实际机动车驾驶人接受交通违法行为处罚和记分牟取经济利益的，一次记9分。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  This offense, taking a violation on another's behalf for profit, actually carries a 12-point penalty and a threefold fine.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1604.}\ 
Making or answering a handheld phone call while driving, impeding safe driving, earns 2 demerit points per instance.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车有拨打、接听手持电话等妨碍安全驾驶的行为的，一次记2分。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Using a handheld phone while driving is a commonly tested 3-point violation, not 2.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1605.}\ 
When a driver's accumulated points reach 12 within one demerit cycle, the traffic administration department must seize the driving licence, issue a compulsory-measure certificate, and deliver a full-points education notice requiring the driver to attend full-points study and exam.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶人在一个记分周期内累积记分满12分的，公安机关交通管理部门应当扣留其机动车驾驶证，开具强制措施凭证，并送达满分教育通知书，通知机动车驾驶人参加满分学习、考试。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Regulations require exactly this process once a driver's points reach 12 in a cycle.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1606.}\ 
Which of the following violations earns 3 demerit points?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Driving on the road a vehicle with plates not installed as required \quad \textbf{B.} Using a forged or altered vehicle plate \quad \textbf{C.} Driving after drinking alcohol \quad \textbf{D.} Driving a vehicle class not matching the licence}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶人有下列哪种违法行为一次记3分？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Driving on the road a vehicle with plates not installed as required  Failing to properly install the vehicle plate is a commonly tested 3-point violation.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1607.}\ 
If an administrative penalty decision is lawfully changed or revoked, the corresponding demerit points will not be changed or revoked.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：行政处罚决定被依法变更或者撤销的，相应记分不会被变更或者撤销。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  When a penalty decision is changed or revoked, the corresponding demerit points must also be changed or revoked.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1608.}\ 
Driving a small car on a highway at 20\% to under 50\% over the speed limit earns 6 demerit points per instance.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶小型汽车在高速公路上行驶，超过规定时速20\%以上未达到50\%的，一次记6分。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  On highways/expressways, exceeding the speed limit by 20\% to 50\% is a 6-point violation.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1609.}\ 
How many demerit points for driving on the road a vehicle whose plate is not installed as required?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 12 points \quad \textbf{B.} 6 points \quad \textbf{C.} 3 points \quad \textbf{D.} 1 point}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：上道路行驶的机动车不按规定安装机动车号牌的，一次记几分？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. 3 points  Improperly installed vehicle plates are a commonly tested 3-point violation.}\par\smallskip

\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1610.}\ 
Failing to wear a seatbelt as required while driving earns 2 demerit points per instance.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车未按规定系安全带的，一次记2分。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Not wearing a seatbelt is a commonly tested 1-point violation, not 2.}\par\smallskip

[Image] Driving the vehicle shown in the image on the road earns how many demerit points per instance?\par

Driving on the road a vehicle that has not passed its required annual inspection earns 3 demerit points per instance.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par

Improper reversing or U-turns on a road other than a highway or urban expressway earn 2 demerit points per instance.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par

Which of the following violations earns 1 demerit point?\par
