Driving a passenger vehicle rated for more than 7 seats, overloaded by 50\% to under 100\%, earns 6 demerit points per instance.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par

\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1616.}\ 
How many demerit points for driving a small car on an ordinary road at 50\% or more over the speed limit?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 3 points \quad \textbf{B.} 6 points \quad \textbf{C.} 9 points \quad \textbf{D.} 12 points}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶小型汽车在普通公路上行驶，超过规定时速50\%以上的，一次记多少分？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. 6 points  On ordinary roads, exceeding the speed limit by 50\% or more is a 6-point violation.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1617.}\ 
Driving on the road a vehicle whose plate is not installed as required earns 12 demerit points per instance.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶不按规定安装机动车号牌的机动车上道路行驶的，一次记12分。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Improperly installed plates are a commonly tested 3-point violation, not 12.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}

How many demerit points for driving while the driving licence is suspended or seized?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 3 points \quad \textbf{B.} 6 points \quad \textbf{C.} 9 points \quad \textbf{D.} 12 points}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶证被暂扣或者扣留期间驾驶机动车的，一次记多少分？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. 6 points  Driving while the licence is suspended or seized is a commonly tested 6-point violation.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1619.}\ 
Which of the following violations by a small car driver earns 3 demerit points?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Fleeing after causing an accident resulting in minor injury or property loss, not yet a crime \quad \textbf{B.} Illegally using the emergency lane on a highway or urban expressway \quad \textbf{C.} Exceeding the speed limit by 20\% to under 50\% on an ordinary road \quad \textbf{D.} Driving while the licence is suspended or seized}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：小型汽车驾驶人有以下哪种违法行为，一次记3分？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. Exceeding the speed limit by 20\% to under 50\% on an ordinary road  Exceeding the speed limit by 20\% to 50\% on an ordinary road is a 3-point violation.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1620.}\ 
Within the validity of the learner's driving certificate, the combined number of Subject 2 and Subject 3 exam bookings must not exceed 5.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：在学习驾驶证明的有效期内，科目二和科目三道路驾驶技能考试预约次数合计不得超过5次。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Subject 2 and Subject 3 each independently allow up to 5 exam bookings, not a combined total of 5.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1621.}\ 
A driver who has exceeded the age limit for their licence class must go to the vehicle administration office to exchange it for a permitted class; if not done in time, the original class's driving qualification becomes invalid.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶人已超过准驾年龄，应到车管所换领可驾驶的准驾车型驾驶证，逾期未办理，原准驾车型驾驶资格作废。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Drivers who age out of a licence class must exchange their licence, or the original class qualification is voided.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1622.}\ 
If a temporarily-entering driver's temporary permit reaches 12 accumulated points in one demerit cycle and the driver fails to attend the required traffic law study and exam, they may not apply for a driving licence or reapply for a temporary permit.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：临时入境机动车驾驶人的临时机动车驾驶许可在一个记分周期内累积记分达到12分，未按规定参加道路交通安全法律、法规和相关知识学习、考试的，不得申请机动车驾驶证或者再次申请临时机动车驾驶许可。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Regulations impose exactly this bar on temporarily-entering drivers who reach 12 points and skip the required study and exam.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1623.}\ 
By severity of the violation, which is the correct classification of single-instance demerit point values?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 12, 6, 3, 2, 1 points \quad \textbf{B.} 12, 9, 6, 3, 1 points \quad \textbf{C.} 12, 9, 6, 3, 2, 1 points \quad \textbf{D.} 12, 9, 6, 2, 1 points}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：根据交通违法行为的严重程度，对一次记分分值的分类正确的是什么？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. 12, 9, 6, 3, 1 points  The current classification added a 9-point tier and removed the 2-point tier, giving 12, 9, 6, 3, 1.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1624.}\ 
If the place of residence changes after passing part of the exams, the applicant may apply to change the test location and book the remaining exams at the new residence.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：已通过部分科目考试后，居住地发生变更的，可以申请变更考试地，在现居住地预约其他科目考试。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Applicants may change test location due to a residence change, up to a limited number of times.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1625.}\ 
After passing part of the exams, if residence changes, the applicant can only return to the original residence to book remaining exams.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶人已通过部分科目考试后，居住地发生变更的，只能回到居住地预约其他考试。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Applicants may instead apply to change the test location, up to a limited number of times, rather than being forced to return.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1626.}\ 
For the small automatic-transmission car class Subject 3 exam, booking is allowed 30 days after obtaining the driving skills exam permit.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：报考小型自动挡汽车准驾车型科目三考试的，在取得驾驶技能准考证明满30日后预约。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  This class requires only 20 days, not 30, after obtaining the learner's certificate before booking Subject 3.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1627.}\ 
The Subject 2 exam for light trailer-towing vehicles includes: reverse parking, pole test, curved-path driving, and right-angle turns.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：轻型牵引挂车科目二考试内容包括：倒车入库、桩考、曲线行驶、直角转弯。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  The light trailer-towing class Subject 2 exam does not include reverse parking.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1628.}\ 
For the small car class Subject 3 exam, booking is allowed 30 days after obtaining the learner's driving certificate.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：报考小型汽车准驾车型科目三考试的，在取得学习驾驶证明满30日后预约。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Small car applicants must wait 30 days after receiving the learner's certificate before booking Subject 3.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1629.}\ 
If a student commits a traffic-law violation or causes an accident during compliant practice driving, the instructor or accompanying guide bears responsibility.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：学员在符合规定的学习驾驶过程中有违反道路交通安全法的行为或者造成交通事故的，由教练员或者随车指导人员承担责任。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  When practicing under a qualified instructor's guidance, the instructor or guide bears responsibility for violations or accidents.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1630.}\ 
Drivers over 70 years old must also undergo memory, judgment, and reaction-ability tests during periodic licence review.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：年龄在70周岁以上的机动车驾驶人审验时还应当按照规定进行记忆力、判断力、反应力等能力测试。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  The 'three-ability test' of memory, judgment, and reaction is required for drivers over 70.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1631.}\ 
Driving a small passenger car overloaded by 100\% or more earns 9 demerit points per instance.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶小型载客汽车超过核定人数100\%以上的，一次记9分。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  For these vehicles, overloading of 100\% or more is actually a 12-point violation, not 9.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1632.}\ 
Holders of licences for the large bus, heavy trailer-towing vehicle, city bus, medium bus, or large truck classes must, if their employer information changes, file a record with the vehicle administration office of the employer's location within what timeframe?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 30 days \quad \textbf{B.} 60 days \quad \textbf{C.} Half a year \quad \textbf{D.} One year}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：持有大型客车、重型牵引挂车、城市公交车、中型客车、大型货车驾驶证的驾驶人从业单位等信息发生变化的，应当在信息变更后的多长时间内，向从业单位所在地车辆管理所备案？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. 30 days  Such drivers must file the change with the local vehicle administration office within 30 days.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1633.}\ 
Within the vehicle administration office's jurisdiction, when applying to replace a licence due to a change in recorded driver information, the driving licence must be submitted.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：在车辆管理所管辖区域内，机动车驾驶证记载的机动车驾驶人信息发生变化申请换证时，应提交机动车驾驶证。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Information changes must be reported and the licence exchanged within 30 days, with the original licence submitted.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1634.}\ 
How many times, at most, may an applicant request a change of test location due to a change of residence?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 1 \quad \textbf{B.} 2 \quad \textbf{C.} 3 \quad \textbf{D.} 5}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：申请人因居住地发生变化，提出变更考试场地申请，不得超过几次？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. 3  Applicants may request a change of test location no more than 3 times.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1635.}\ 
For the automatic-transmission car licence for disabled drivers, the physical fitness certificate must be issued by a medical institution at county level or above.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：办理残疾人专用小型自动挡载客汽车驾驶证的，应提交由县级以上医疗机构出具的身体证明。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  This class requires a certificate from a specially designated institution certified by the provincial health authority, not just any county-level institution.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1636.}\ 
A small car driver whose accumulated points reach 12 in one demerit cycle must attend how many days of traffic law study?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 3 days \quad \textbf{B.} 10 days \quad \textbf{C.} 7 days \quad \textbf{D.} 30 days}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：小型汽车驾驶人在一个记分周期内累积记分达到12分的，要参加为期几天的道路交通安全法律、法规和相关知识学习？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. 7 days  Reaching 12 points in a cycle requires 7 days of study, versus 30 days for heavier-vehicle-class drivers.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1637.}\ 
A driver already holding a C2 (automatic small car) licence who applies to add the C1 (small car) class must take the Subject 2 and Subject 3 exams.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：已持有C2准驾车型驾驶证申请增加C1准驾车型的，应当考试科目二和科目三。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Adding a small car class onto an automatic small car licence requires passing Subject 2 and Subject 3.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1638.}\ 
To apply for adding the light trailer-towing vehicle class, the driver must have no record of reaching 12 points in the current cycle and the 3 most recent cycles before applying.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：申请增加轻型牵引挂车准驾车型的，应当在本记分周期和申请前最近3个记分周期内没有记满12分记录。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  The actual requirement is no 12-point record in the current cycle and just the immediately preceding cycle, not the 3 most recent cycles.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1639.}\ 
The Subject 3 exam for small car and small automatic car classes must cover a distance of no less than 10 kilometers.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：小型汽车、小型自动挡汽车科目三考试里程不得少于10公里。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  The required minimum Subject 3 test distance for these classes is shorter than 10 kilometers, making this claim incorrect.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1640.}\ 
Accepting a traffic violation penalty and points on behalf of the actual driver for profit is punished by the traffic administration department with a fine of up to three times the illegal gains, capped at 50,000 yuan.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：代替实际机动车驾驶人接受交通违法行为处罚和记分牟取经济利益的，由公安机关交通管理部门处违法所得三倍以下罚款，但最高不超过五万元。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Regulations impose exactly this fine, up to three times illegal gains and capped at 50,000 yuan, for taking a violation on another's behalf for profit.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1641.}\ 
The 12 months following a driver's first acquisition of a car-class or motorcycle-class licence is the probationary period.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶人初次取得汽车类准驾车型或者初次取得摩托车类准驾车型后的12个月为实习期。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Regulations set the probationary period as 12 months from first obtaining a car-class or motorcycle-class licence.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1642.}\ 
When applying for point reduction through legal study, completing at least one hour of in-person study of traffic laws and passing the exam reduces 1 point per session.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶人申请学法减分时，参加道路交通安全法律、法规和相关知识现场学习满一小时且考试合格的，一次扣减1分。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  One hour of in-person study with a passing exam actually reduces 2 points, not 1.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1643.}\ 
Towing a trailer with a motor vehicle during the probationary period is punished by the traffic administration department with a fine of 20 to 200 yuan.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：在实习期内驾驶机动车牵引挂车，由公安机关交通管理部门处二十元以上二百元以下罚款。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Probationary drivers may not tow trailers; violating this carries a 20 to 200 yuan fine.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1644.}\ 
A person who drove without a licence and caused an accident with equal-or-greater fault resulting in serious injury or death, within the past 10 years, may not apply for a driving licence.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：未取得机动车驾驶证驾驶机动车，发生负同等以上责任交通事故造成人员重伤或者死亡未满十年的，不得申请机动车驾驶证。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Regulations bar such applicants from obtaining a driving licence for 10 years after this kind of unlicensed-driving accident.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1645.}\ 
If an applicant practices driving on the road outside the route or time designated by the traffic administration department, the applicant is fined 20 to 200 yuan by the traffic administration department.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：申请人在道路学习驾驶时，未按照公安机关交通管理部门指定的路线、时间进行的，公安机关交通管理部门对申请人处以二十元以上二百元以下罚款。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  This violation is fined against the instructor or accompanying guide, not the applicant.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1646.}\ 
How many demerit points for driving on a highway below the minimum required speed?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 12 points \quad \textbf{B.} 6 points \quad \textbf{C.} 3 points \quad \textbf{D.} 1 point}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车在高速公路上行驶低于规定最低时速的，一次记几分？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. 3 points  Driving below the minimum speed limit on a highway is a commonly tested 3-point violation.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1647.}\ 
For a first-time driving licence applicant, which of the following vehicle classes may NOT be applied for?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Large truck \quad \textbf{B.} Large bus \quad \textbf{C.} Low-speed goods vehicle \quad \textbf{D.} City bus}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：初次申领机动车驾驶证的，不得申请下列哪种准驾车型？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Large bus  First-time applicants can apply for city bus, large truck, and other classes, but not large bus.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1648.}\ 
For organizing others to commit fraud in the study log or study process during periodic review education, what is the maximum fine imposed by the traffic administration department?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 1,000 yuan \quad \textbf{B.} 2,000 yuan \quad \textbf{C.} 20,000 yuan \quad \textbf{D.} 30,000 yuan}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：组织他人在驾驶人参加审验教育时在签注学习记录、学习过程中弄虚作假，由公安机关交通管理部门处多少元以下罚款？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. 20,000 yuan  Organizing such fraud with illegal gains is fined up to three times the gains, capped at 20,000 yuan.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1649.}\ 
Which class code represents medium-size goods (truck) vehicles?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} A1 \quad \textbf{B.} B1 \quad \textbf{C.} A2 \quad \textbf{D.} B2}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：以下哪个代号表示中型载货汽车？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. B2  B2 authorizes heavy and medium trucks; A1 is large bus, A2 is heavy trailer-towing, B1 is medium bus.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1650.}\ 
For a probationary A2 (heavy trailer-towing) licence driver taking a motor vehicle onto a highway, which is correct?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Must be accompanied by a driver holding a B2-class licence for 3+ years \quad \textbf{B.} Must be accompanied by a driver holding a B1-class licence for 3+ years \quad \textbf{C.} Must be accompanied by a driver holding an A1-class licence for 3+ years \quad \textbf{D.} Must be accompanied by a driver holding an A2-class licence for 3+ years}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：A2实习期驾驶人驾驶机动车上高速公路行驶，以下做法正确的是什么？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. Must be accompanied by a driver holding an A2-class licence for 3+ years  Probationary drivers must be accompanied on highways by someone holding the same or a covering licence class for 3 or more years.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1651.}\ 
A driver in the probationary period may never drive on the highway under any circumstances.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶人在实习期内，任何情况下都不得上高速行驶。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Probationary drivers may drive on highways if accompanied by a suitably licensed driver of 3+ years' experience.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1652.}\ 
What penalty applies to an applicant who conceals relevant facts or submits false materials when applying for a driving licence?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} A fine of up to 2,000 yuan; barred from reapplying for 1 year \quad \textbf{B.} A fine of up to 500 yuan; barred from reapplying for 1 year \quad \textbf{C.} A fine of 500 to 2,000 yuan; barred from reapplying for life \quad \textbf{D.} Barred from reapplying for life}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：申请人隐瞒有关情况或者提供虚假材料申领机动车驾驶证的，会受到以下哪种处罚?}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. A fine of up to 500 yuan; barred from reapplying for 1 year  Regulations impose a fine of up to 500 yuan and a 1-year reapplication ban for concealment or false materials.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1653.}\ 
After clearing violation records with under 12 accumulated points, a driver who completes required traffic-safety education may apply to reduce points. What is the maximum cumulative reduction allowed per demerit cycle?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 3 points \quad \textbf{B.} 6 points \quad \textbf{C.} 9 points \quad \textbf{D.} 12 points}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶人处理完交通违法行为记录后累积记分未满12分，参加公安机关交通管理部门组织的交通安全教育并达到规定要求的，可以申请在机动车驾驶人现有累积记分分值中扣减记分。在一个记分周期内累计最高可以扣减几分?}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. 6 points  The cumulative reduction from traffic-safety education is capped at 6 points per demerit cycle.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1654.}\ 
Changing the vehicle body color, or replacing the engine, body, or frame, without registering the change within the required deadline, is punished with a warning or a fine of up to 200 yuan by the traffic administration department.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：改变车身颜色、更换发动机、车身或车架，未在规定时限内办理变更登记的，由公安机关交通管理部门处警告或者200元以下罚款。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Regulations impose a warning or a fine of up to 200 yuan for failing to register such vehicle changes on time.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1655.}\ 
An applicant who obtains a driving licence through fraud, bribery, or other improper means will have the licence confiscated, the driving permit revoked, be fined up to 2,000 yuan, and be barred from reapplying for 3 years.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：申请人以欺骗、贿赂等不正当手段取得机动车驾驶证的，公安机关交通管理部门收缴机动车驾驶证，撤销机动车驾驶许可，处二千元以下罚款；申请人在三年内不得再次申领机动车驾驶证。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Regulations impose exactly this combined penalty for obtaining a licence through fraud or bribery.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1656.}\ 
If an administrative penalty imposed on a driver is lawfully changed or revoked, the corresponding demerit points will not be changed or revoked.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶人受到的行政处罚被依法变更或者撤销的，其相应的记分不会变更或撤销。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  When a penalty is changed or revoked, the corresponding demerit points must also be changed or revoked.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1657.}\ 
Which of the following violations earns 12 demerit points?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Transporting explosives by truck without following the designated time and route \quad \textbf{B.} Accepting a traffic violation penalty and points on behalf of the actual driver for profit \quad \textbf{C.} Driving a small passenger car on a highway 20\% to under 50\% over the speed limit \quad \textbf{D.} Transporting an oversized, non-disassemblable load without following the designated time and route}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶人有下列哪种违法行为一次记12分？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Accepting a traffic violation penalty and points on behalf of the actual driver for profit  Taking a violation penalty and points on another driver's behalf for profit is a commonly tested 12-point violation.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1658.}\ 
Regarding a lost, missing, or damaged vehicle plate, which statement is incorrect?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Apply for a replacement at the vehicle administration office where the vehicle is registered \quad \textbf{B.} After a replacement plate is issued, the original plate may continue to be used \quad \textbf{C.} The vehicle administration office reissues the plate with the same plate number \quad \textbf{D.} During reissue, a temporary plate valid for up to 15 days may be obtained}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：关于机动车号牌灭失、丢失或者损毁的，以下错误的说法是什么？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. After a replacement plate is issued, the original plate may continue to be used  Once a replacement plate is issued, the original plate becomes invalid and may no longer be used.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1659.}\ 
How many demerit points for driving a school bus, intercity coach, or tourist coach overloaded by under 20\%?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 3 points \quad \textbf{B.} 6 points \quad \textbf{C.} 9 points \quad \textbf{D.} 12 points}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶校车、公路客运汽车、旅游客运汽车载人超过核定人数未达20\%的，一次记几分？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. 6 points  For these vehicle types, overloading under 20\% is a 6-point violation; 20\% or more is 12 points.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1660.}\ 
A driver whose accumulated points in one demerit cycle reach 24 but under 36 must, after passing the traffic law knowledge exam, book a yard driving skills (Subject 2) exam as required.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶人在一个记分周期内累积记分满24分未满36分的，在道路交通安全法律、法规和相关知识考试合格后，应当按照规定预约参加场地驾驶技能考试。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  At this point range, the driver must book the road driving skills (Subject 3) exam, not the yard skills exam.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1661.}\ 
A driver who reaches 12 accumulated points three or more times in one demerit cycle must, after passing the traffic law knowledge exam, book both the yard driving skills and road driving skills exams.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶人在一个记分周期内三次以上累积记分满12分，在道路交通安全法律、法规和相关知识考试合格后，应当按照规定预约参加场地驾驶技能和道路驾驶技能考试。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Reaching 12 points three or more times in a cycle (or 36 points total) requires retaking both Subject 2 and Subject 3.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1662.}\ 
A vehicle lawfully sealed or seized by a supervisory commission, court, procuratorate, or administrative enforcement body may not be registered.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车被监察机关、人民法院、人民检察院、行政执法部门依法查封、扣押的，不得办理注册登记。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Vehicles under lawful seal or seizure by these authorities cannot be processed for initial registration.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1663.}\ 
A driver whose accumulated points reach 36 in one demerit cycle must, after passing the traffic law knowledge exam, book both the yard driving skills and road driving skills exams.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶人在一个记分周期内累积记满36分的，在道路交通安全法律、法规和相关知识考试合格后，应当按照规定预约参加场地驾驶技能和道路驾驶技能考试。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Reaching 36 accumulated points in a cycle requires retaking both Subject 2 and Subject 3.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1664.}\ 
For small passenger car drivers, each additional full-points education session or each additional 12 accumulated points in one cycle adds 7 days to the required traffic law study time, capped at 60 days per session.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：小型载客汽车驾驶人在一个记分周期内参加满分教育的次数每增加一次或者累积记分每增加12分，道路交通安全法律、法规和相关知识的学习时间增加七天，每次满分学习的天数最多六十天。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Regulations add 7 study days per repeat full-points event, capped at 60 days per session, for small passenger car drivers.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1665.}\ 
Which of the following violations earns 9 demerit points?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Driving a passenger vehicle rated for more than 7 seats, overloaded by 50\% to under 100\% \quad \textbf{B.} Driving a school bus overloaded by 20\% or more \quad \textbf{C.} Accepting a traffic violation penalty and points on behalf of the actual driver for profit \quad \textbf{D.} Using a forged, altered, or a different vehicle's plate}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶人有下列哪种违法行为一次记9分？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Driving a passenger vehicle rated for more than 7 seats, overloaded by 50\% to under 100\%  For vehicles rated over 7 seats, overloading of 50\% to under 100\% is a 9-point violation.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1666.}\ 
In which of the following situations is a driver prohibited from driving?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} The driving licence is lost or damaged \quad \textbf{B.} The driving licence is nearing its expiry date \quad \textbf{C.} Accumulated points reach 10 \quad \textbf{D.} Accumulated points reach 6}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶人出现以下哪种情况时，不得驾驶机动车？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. The driving licence is lost or damaged  Regulations bar driving when the licence is lost, damaged, expired, or seized, or when points reach 12, not merely near-expiry or below-12 points.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1667.}\ 
Using violence against a driver of a moving public transport vehicle or seizing the steering controls, disrupting normal operation and endangering public safety, constituting a crime, is punished by up to 1 year imprisonment, detention, or public surveillance, with a fine imposed concurrently or alone.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：对行驶中的公共交通工具的驾驶人使用暴力或者抢控驾驶操作装置，干扰公共交通工具正常行驶，危及公共安全，构成犯罪的，处一年以下有期徒刑、拘役或管制，并处或单处罚金。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  The Criminal Law imposes exactly this penalty for endangering public safety by seizing controls of, or attacking, the driver of a public transport vehicle.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1668.}\ 
Which of the following violations earns 9 demerit points?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Driving on the road a vehicle with a deliberately obscured or defaced plate \quad \textbf{B.} Fleeing after causing an accident resulting in minor injury or property loss, not yet a crime \quad \textbf{C.} Failing to obey traffic signal lights while driving \quad \textbf{D.} Driving while the licence is suspended or seized}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶人有下列哪种违法行为一次记9分？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Driving on the road a vehicle with a deliberately obscured or defaced plate  Deliberately obscuring or defacing a vehicle plate is a commonly tested 9-point violation.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1669.}\ 
Organizing others to attend periodic review education in place of the actual driver, when illegal gains exist, is punished with a fine of up to three times the gains, capped at 50,000 yuan.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：组织他人代替实际机动车驾驶人参加审验教育的，有违法所得的，由公安机关交通管理部门处违法所得三倍以下罚款，但最高不得超过五万元。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  The cap for this particular offense is actually 20,000 yuan, not 50,000.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1670.}\ 
Regarding the requirements for adding the light trailer-towing vehicle class, which statement is correct?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Having held a small car or small automatic car licence for 1 year \quad \textbf{B.} No 12-point record in the current cycle and the 3 most recent consecutive cycles \quad \textbf{C.} Having a 12-point record in the current and immediately preceding cycle, but having passed full-points education and exam \quad \textbf{D.} Having held a small automatic car licence for 3+ years}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：关于申请增加轻型牵引挂车准驾车型的要求，以下正确的说法是什么？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Having held a small car or small automatic car licence for 1 year  Adding the light trailer-towing class requires 1 year holding a small car or small automatic car licence, plus no 12-point record in the current and prior cycle.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1671.}\ 
A driver in the probationary period may reduce demerit points by taking traffic-safety education.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶人在实习期内，可以通过接受交通安全教育扣减交通违法行为记分。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  The point-reduction program excludes drivers with certain disqualifying records, so eligibility is restricted rather than open to all drivers.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1672.}\ 
Driving on a highway (excluding school buses, medium-or-larger passenger/goods vehicles, and hazardous materials vehicles) at 40\% over the speed limit earns 6 demerit points per instance.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶校车、中型以上载客载货汽车、危险物品运输车辆以外的机动车在高速公路上行驶超过规定时速40\%的，一次记6分。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  On highways/expressways, exceeding the speed limit by 20\% to 50\% (which includes 40\%) is a 6-point violation.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1673.}\ 
Regarding traffic violations, which statement is incorrect?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Fleeing after causing an accident resulting in minor injury or property loss, not a crime, earns 9 points per instance \quad \textbf{B.} Illegally using the emergency lane on a highway earns 6 points per instance \quad \textbf{C.} Illegal parking on a highway or urban expressway earns 9 points per instance \quad \textbf{D.} Driving while the licence is suspended or seized earns 6 points per instance}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：关于交通违法行为，以下错误的说法是什么？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Fleeing after causing an accident resulting in minor injury or property loss, not a crime, earns 9 points per instance  Fleeing after an accident causing only minor injury or property loss (not a crime) is actually a 6-point violation, not 9.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1674.}\ 
Which of the following violations earns 9 demerit points?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Illegally using the emergency lane \quad \textbf{B.} Driving a vehicle class not matching the licence \quad \textbf{C.} Failing to yield to a school bus as required \quad \textbf{D.} Not using lights as required}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶人有下列哪种违法行为一次记9分？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Driving a vehicle class not matching the licence  Driving a vehicle class not matching the licence is a commonly tested 9-point violation.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1675.}\ 
A driver may not drive alone on the highway during the probationary period; when in a new probationary period after adding a vehicle class, this restriction does not apply when driving the original licence class's vehicle.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶人在实习期内不得单独驾驶机动车上高速，在增加准驾车型后的实习期内，驾驶原准驾车型的机动车时不受上述限制。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  The highway-accompaniment restriction applies to the new class only; it does not apply when driving the original class already held.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1676.}\ 
Which of the following violations earns 1 demerit point?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Driving a truck loaded 50\% or more over the maximum allowed total weight \quad \textbf{B.} Not wearing a seatbelt as required while driving on the road \quad \textbf{C.} Driving a vehicle class not matching the licence \quad \textbf{D.} Failing to obey traffic signal lights while driving}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶人有下列哪种违法行为一次记1分？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Not wearing a seatbelt as required while driving on the road  Not wearing a seatbelt is a commonly tested 1-point violation.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1677.}\ 
For a person who has just turned 20, which of the following vehicle classes may NOT be applied for as a first-time licence?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Large truck \quad \textbf{B.} Large bus \quad \textbf{C.} Medium bus \quad \textbf{D.} City bus}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：年满20周岁的，不可以初次申请以下哪种准驾车型？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Large bus  Large bus requires a higher minimum age than 20, so a 20-year-old cannot apply for it as a first licence, unlike the other classes listed.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1678.}\ 
What penalty applies to an applicant who obtains a driving licence through fraud, bribery, or other improper means?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} A fine of up to 2,000 yuan; barred from reapplying for 3 years \quad \textbf{B.} Barred from reapplying for 1 year \quad \textbf{C.} A fine of up to 500 yuan; barred from reapplying for 3 years \quad \textbf{D.} A fine of up to 500 yuan}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：申请人以欺骗、贿赂等不正当手段取得机动车驾驶证的，会受到哪种处罚?}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. A fine of up to 2,000 yuan; barred from reapplying for 3 years  Regulations impose a fine of up to 2,000 yuan plus a 3-year reapplication ban for obtaining a licence through fraud or bribery.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1679.}\ 
How many demerit points for driving (excluding school buses, medium-or-larger passenger/goods vehicles, and hazmat vehicles) on a road other than a highway or urban expressway at 50\% or more over the speed limit?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 1 point \quad \textbf{B.} 3 points \quad \textbf{C.} 6 points \quad \textbf{D.} 9 points}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶校车、中型以上载客载货汽车、危险物品运输车辆以外的机动车在高速公路、城市快速路以外的道路上行驶超过规定时速50\%以上的，一次记几分？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. 6 points  On ordinary roads, exceeding the speed limit by 50\% or more is a 6-point violation.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1680.}\ 
Driving a truck loaded under 30\% over the maximum allowed total weight earns 1 demerit point per instance.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶载货汽车载物超过最大允许总质量未达到30\%，一次记1分。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Truck overloading under 30\% is a 1-point violation; 30\% to 50\% is 3 points, and 50\% or more is 6 points.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1681.}\ 
A driver of a moving public transport vehicle who abandons their post and fights with or assaults another person, endangering public safety, is punished by up to 1 year imprisonment, detention, or public surveillance, with a fine imposed concurrently or alone.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶人员在行驶的公共交通工具上擅离职守，与他人互殴或者殴打他人，危及公共安全的，处一年以下有期徒刑、拘役或者管制，并处或者单处罚金。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  The Criminal Law Amendment imposes this same penalty for a driver abandoning post to fight, endangering public safety.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1682.}\ 
Organizing or participating in obtaining a driving licence through fraud or bribery for profit is punished by the traffic administration department with a fine of three to five times the illegal gains, capped at 100,000 yuan.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：组织、参与实施以欺骗、贿赂等不正当手段取得机动车驾驶证并牟取经济利益的，由公安机关交通管理部门处违法所得三倍以上五倍以下罚款，但最高不超过十万元。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Regulations impose exactly this fine range and cap for organizing licence fraud for profit.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1683.}\ 
Driving (excluding school buses, medium-or-larger passenger/goods vehicles, and hazmat vehicles) on a road other than a highway or urban expressway at 50\% or more over the speed limit earns 12 demerit points per instance.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶校车、中型以上载客载货汽车、危险物品运输车辆以外的机动车在高速公路、城市快速路以外的道路上行驶超过规定时速百分之五十以上的，一次记12分。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  On ordinary roads, exceeding the speed limit by 50\% or more is actually a 6-point violation, not 12.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1684.}\ 
What penalty applies to organizing exam cheating during the driving exam that is serious enough to constitute a crime?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Public surveillance plus a fine \quad \textbf{B.} Up to 3 years imprisonment, plus a fine \quad \textbf{C.} 3 to 7 years imprisonment, plus a fine \quad \textbf{D.} 7 or more years imprisonment, plus a fine}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：组织申请人在机动车驾驶人考试过程中作弊，情节严重构成犯罪的，会受到什么处罚?}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. 3 to 7 years imprisonment, plus a fine  The Criminal Law raises the penalty to 3 to 7 years imprisonment plus a fine for serious cases of organizing exam cheating.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1685.}\ 
An applicant who conceals relevant facts or submits false materials when applying for school bus driving qualification is denied acceptance or processing, and fined up to 500 yuan by the traffic administration department.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：申请人隐瞒有关情况或者提供虚假材料申请校车驾驶资格的，公安机关交通管理部门不予受理或者不予办理，处500元以下罚款。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Regulations impose exactly this penalty for concealment or false materials in a school bus qualification application.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1686.}\ 
A vehicle whose model or technical parameters do not match the announcement of the State Council's motor vehicle product authority may not be registered.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车的型号或者有关技术参数与国务院机动车产品主管部门公告不符的，不得办理注册登记。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Vehicle registration regulations list a model/parameter mismatch as a ground for refusing initial registration.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1687.}\ 
Driving a passenger vehicle (other than school bus, intercity coach, tourist coach, or vehicles rated over 7 seats) overloaded by 60\% earns 6 demerit points per instance.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶校车、公路客运汽车、旅游客运汽车、7座以上载客汽车以外的其他载客汽车载人超过核定人数60\%的，一次记6分。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  For these vehicle types, overloading of 50\% to 100\% (which includes 60\%) is a 6-point violation.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1688.}\ 
A driver may attend the traffic law and knowledge study organized by the traffic administration department at the licence issuance location, the violation location, or the processing location, and take the exam at the study location.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶人可以在机动车驾驶证核发地或交通违法行为发生地、处理地参加公安机关交通管理部门组织的道路交通法律、法规和相关知识学习，并在学习地参加考试。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Regulations allow drivers to study and be examined at the licence issuance, violation, or processing location.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1689.}\ 
Driving (excluding school buses, medium-or-larger passenger/goods vehicles, and hazmat vehicles) on a highway or urban expressway at 50\% or more over the speed limit earns 6 demerit points per instance.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶校车、中型以上载客载货汽车、危险物品运输车辆以外的机动车在高速公路、城市快速路上行驶超过规定时速百分之五十以上的，一次记6分。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  On highways/expressways, exceeding the speed limit by 50\% or more is actually a 12-point violation, not 6.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1690.}\ 
A driver may apply for an electronic version of the driving licence through the Internet traffic safety comprehensive service management platform.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶人可以通过互联网交通安全综合服务管理平台申请机动车驾驶证电子版。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Regulations allow drivers to apply for the electronic driving licence via this online platform.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1691.}\ 
A person who attends review re-education in place of the actual driver shall be fined up to RMB 2,000 by the traffic police department.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：代替实际机动车驾驶人参加审验教育的，由公安机关交通管理部门处二千元以下罚款。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Impersonating a driver at license review re-education draws a fine of up to RMB 2,000 under the licensing regulation.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1692.}\ 
An applicant who organizes cheating during a driving test faces up to three years of fixed-term imprisonment or criminal detention, plus a fine.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：申请人在机动车驾驶人考试过程中组织作弊的，处三年以下有期徒刑或者拘役，并处或单处罚金。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Criminal Law punishes organizing cheating in a state-mandated exam with up to three years imprisonment or detention plus a fine.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1693.}\ 
Driving a passenger car, other than a school bus, highway coach, tour bus, or vehicle seating more than 7, overloaded by 50 percent or more but less than 100 percent incurs 12 points on one occasion.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶校车、公路客运汽车、旅游客运汽车、7座以上载客汽车以外的其他载客汽车载人超过核定人数百分之五十以上未达到百分之百的，一次记12分。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  That overload range actually carries 6 points; 12 points applies only once overload reaches 100 percent or more.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1694.}\ 
If accumulated points are below 12, the driver may also clear traffic violation records for other vehicles they drive.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：累积记分未满12分，可以处理其驾驶的其他机动车的交通违法行为记录。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Regulations let a driver clear violations on other vehicles they drive as long as their point total stays under 12.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1695.}\ 
After ownership of a registered motor vehicle is transferred, if the new owner fails to register the transfer within the prescribed time limit, the traffic police department will issue a warning or a fine up to RMB 1,000.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：已注册登记的机动车所有权转让后，现机动车所有人未按照规定的时限办理转让登记的，由公安机关交通管理部门处警告或者一千元以下罚款。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  The actual fine cap for late transfer registration is RMB 200, not RMB 1,000.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1696.}\ 
A person whose license was revoked for drunk driving of a commercial vehicle may not reapply for a driving license within five years of the revocation.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：饮酒后驾驶营运机动车依法被吊销机动车驾驶证未满五年的，不得再次申请机动车驾驶证。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Regulations bar reapplying for a license within five years of revocation for drink-driving a commercial vehicle.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1697.}\ 
A motor vehicle whose painted or affixed markings or body advertising impair safe driving will be issued a warning or fined up to RMB 200.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车喷涂、粘贴标识或者车身广告，影响安全驾驶的，会被处以警告或者二百元以下罚款。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Vehicle registration rules set the penalty for body markings or ads that impair safe driving at a warning or fine up to RMB 200.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1698.}\ 
Driving a vehicle, other than a school bus, medium-or-larger passenger or cargo vehicle, or hazardous-materials vehicle, on a road other than an expressway or urban expressway at 60 percent over the speed limit incurs 6 points on one occasion.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶校车、中型以上载客载货汽车、危险物品运输车辆以外的机动车在高速公路、城市快速路以外的道路上行驶超过规定时速60\%的，一次记6分。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  On ordinary roads, speeding 50 percent or more over the limit for these vehicles carries 6 points.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1699.}\ 
Taking a driving test on someone else's behalf, or having someone take it on your behalf, is punishable by criminal detention or public surveillance, plus a fine.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：代替他人或者让他人代替自己参加机动车驾驶人考试，处拘役或者管制，并处或者单处罚金。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Criminal Law penalizes exam impersonation with detention or public surveillance and a fine.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1700.}\ 
If a driver accumulates how many points within one scoring cycle, will the traffic police notify them to attend full-point re-education and retesting?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 6 points \quad \textbf{B.} 9 points \quad \textbf{C.} 12 points \quad \textbf{D.} 24 points}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶人在一个记分周期内累积记分达到多少分的，公安机关交通管理部门将通知其参加满分学习、考试？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. 12 points  Regulations require full-point re-education and retesting once accumulated points reach 12 within one scoring cycle.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1701.}\ 
If a driver has been penalized for drink-driving within how many recent scoring cycles, are they barred from reducing violation points through traffic safety education?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 1 cycle \quad \textbf{B.} 2 cycles \quad \textbf{C.} 3 cycles \quad \textbf{D.} 4 cycles}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：在最近几个记分周期内，机动车驾驶人因饮酒后驾驶机动车受到过处罚的，不得通过交通安全教育扣减交通违法行为记分？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. 3 cycles  The rule bars point reduction via education if the driver was penalized for drink-driving within the most recent three scoring cycles.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1702.}\ 
A driver whose license has been suspended, after passing full-point re-education and paying the fine, has their points cleared and can get the license back immediately without waiting for the suspension period to end.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶人被处以暂扣机动车驾驶证的，经满分学习、考试合格且罚款已缴纳的，记分予以清除，无需等暂扣期限届满，就可以发还机动车驾驶证。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  The license is only returned once the suspension period actually expires, even though the points are cleared upon passing re-education.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1703.}\ 
If accumulated violation points are below what number can a driver also clear traffic violation records for other vehicles they drive?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 3 points \quad \textbf{B.} 12 points \quad \textbf{C.} 9 points \quad \textbf{D.} 6 points}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：交通违法行为累积记分未满多少分的情况下，可以处理其驾驶的其他机动车的交通违法处罚记录？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. 12 points  Regulations allow clearing other vehicles' violation records as long as accumulated points remain below 12.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1704.}\ 
A first-time applicant for a driving license may apply for a light trailer-towing license category.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：初次申领机动车驾驶证的，可以申请轻型牵引挂车。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  First-time applicants may only apply for the specific categories listed in regulations, which exclude light trailer-towing.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1705.}\ 
Driving a cargo truck overloaded by 30 percent or more but less than 50 percent of the maximum allowed gross weight, or carrying passengers in violation of regulations, incurs 3 points on one occasion.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶载货汽车载物超过最大允许总质量30\%以上未达到50\%的，或者违反规定载客的，一次记3分。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Cargo overload of 30 to 50 percent is specifically set at 3 points under the points regulation.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1706.}\ 
Driving a vehicle with cargo exceeding the prescribed length, width, or height incurs 1 point on one occasion.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车载货长度、宽度、高度超过规定的，一次记1分。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  This violation is listed among the offenses carrying 1 point under the points regulation.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1707.}\ 
Driving a school bus, highway coach, or tour bus overloaded with passengers by what percentage or more incurs 12 points on one occasion?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 5 percent \quad \textbf{B.} 10 percent \quad \textbf{C.} 15 percent \quad \textbf{D.} 20 percent}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶校车、公路客运汽车、旅游客运汽车载人超过核定人数百分之多少以上的，一次记12分？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. 20 percent  Overloading these vehicles by 20 percent or more carries 12 points; below that it carries 6 points.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1708.}\ 
Driving a passenger vehicle seating more than 7 that is overloaded by 20 percent or more but less than 50 percent incurs how many points on one occasion?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 9 points \quad \textbf{B.} 3 points \quad \textbf{C.} 12 points \quad \textbf{D.} 6 points}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶7座以上载客汽车载人超过核定人数百分之二十以上未达到百分之五十的，一次记多少分?}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. 6 points  For vehicles seating over 7, overload of 20 to 50 percent carries 6 points, and 50 percent or more carries 9 points.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1709.}\ 
Transporting explosives by motor vehicle without hanging warning signs and taking necessary safety measures incurs 9 points on one occasion.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车载运爆炸物品，未悬挂警示标志并采取必要的安全措施的，一次记9分。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  This offense actually falls under the 6-point category of violations, not 9 points, under the points regulation.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1710.}\ 
When a driver falsifies study records or cheats during review re-education, they face corresponding penalties. Which of the following statements is incorrect?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Fined up to RMB 1,000 \quad \textbf{B.} The corresponding study record is invalidated \quad \textbf{C.} Driving license is suspended \quad \textbf{D.} Must retake the review re-education}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶人参加审验教育时在签注学习记录、学习过程中弄虚作假，会受到相应的处罚，以下说法错误的是什么?}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. Driving license is suspended  Falsifying review re-education records leads to an invalid record, retaking the course, and a fine up to RMB 1,000, not license suspension.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1711.}\ 
Driving a school bus without holding school-bus driving qualification incurs how many points on one occasion?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 12 points \quad \textbf{B.} 9 points \quad \textbf{C.} 6 points \quad \textbf{D.} 3 points}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：未取得校车驾驶资格驾驶校车的，一次记多少分?}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. 9 points  Driving a school bus without the required qualification is one of the standard violations carrying 9 points.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1712.}\ 
Regarding swapping the plate numbers of two vehicles registered under the same owner, which of the following statements is correct?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} The same vehicle can swap plate numbers multiple times within one year \quad \textbf{B.} The swap can be applied for if both vehicles are for non-commercial use \quad \textbf{C.} Before applying, both vehicles must have no unresolved traffic violation or accident records \quad \textbf{D.} The swap can be applied for even if the two vehicles are registered at different vehicle management offices}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：同一机动车所有人名下两辆机动车的号牌号码互换，以下说法正确的是什么?}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. Before applying, both vehicles must have no unresolved traffic violation or accident records  Before applying to swap plates, both vehicles must first have all traffic violations and accident records fully resolved.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1713.}\ 
Completing at least 30 cumulative minutes of online traffic safety law study organized by the traffic police within three days, and passing the test, reduces points by 1 on one occasion.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：参加公安机关交通管理部门组织的道路交通安全法律、法规和相关知识网上学习三日内累计满三十分钟且考试合格的，一次扣减1分。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Regulations set 30 cumulative minutes of online study within three days, plus a passing test, as worth a 1-point reduction.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1714.}\ 
Driving a vehicle, other than a school bus, medium-or-larger passenger or cargo vehicle, or hazmat vehicle, on an expressway at 20 percent to under 50 percent over the speed limit incurs how many points on one occasion?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 9 points \quad \textbf{B.} 3 points \quad \textbf{C.} 1 point \quad \textbf{D.} 6 points}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶校车、中型以上载客载货汽车、危险物品运输车辆以外的机动车在高速公路上行驶超过规定时速百分之二十以上未达到百分之五十的，一次记多少分?}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. 6 points  On expressways, speeding 20 to 50 percent over the limit for these vehicles is set at 6 points.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1715.}\ 
For participating in traffic safety public-service activities organized by the traffic police, what duration counts as one session, and how many points does one session reduce?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 2 hours; 2 points \quad \textbf{B.} 1 hour; 1 point \quad \textbf{C.} 2 hours; 1 point \quad \textbf{D.} 1 hour; 2 points}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：参加公安机关交通管理部门组织的交通安全公益活动的，满多长时间为一次，一次扣减几分?}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. 1 hour; 1 point  Regulations count one hour of public-service activity as one session, reducing points by 1.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1716.}\ 
When renewing an expiring driving license, a driver may get their physical exam at a qualified level-2-or-above hospital, township clinic, community health service center, or health checkup center.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶人在办理期满换领驾驶证时，可以到具有健康体检资质的二级以上医院、乡镇卫生院、社区卫生服务中心、健康体检中心等医疗机构体检。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Regulations permit these qualifying medical institutions to issue the physical fitness certificate for license renewal.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1717.}\ 
What is the vehicle category code for a medium-sized passenger vehicle (bus)?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} A2 \quad \textbf{B.} B1 \quad \textbf{C.} B2 \quad \textbf{D.} A1}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：中型客车的车型代号是什么?}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. B1  Category codes are A2 for heavy trailer-towing, B1 for medium passenger vehicle, B2 for large truck, and A1 for large passenger vehicle.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1718.}\ 
A learner's driving permit is valid for 1 year, but the expiry date may not exceed the upper age limit for the applied license category.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：学习驾驶证明的有效期为1年，但有效期截止日期不得超过申请年龄条件上限。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  The learner's permit is actually valid for three years, not one, though the age-limit cap on the expiry date is correct.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1719.}\ 
An applicant who bribes or cheats during the test has their test eligibility cancelled, other passed subject scores voided, and is fined up to RMB 1,000.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：申请人在考试过程中有贿赂、舞弊行为的，取消考试资格，已经通过考试的其他科目成绩无效，并处1000元以下罚款。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  The actual fine is up to RMB 2,000, and the applicant is also barred from reapplying for one year.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1720.}\ 
A person who impersonated someone else in a driving test within the past three years may not apply for a driving license.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：三年内有代替他人参加机动车驾驶人考试行为的，不得申请机动车驾驶证。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Regulations bar license applications from anyone with exam-impersonation conduct within the past three years.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1721.}\ 
Applicants aged 70 or above may apply for license categories covering small cars, small automatic-transmission cars, automatic-transmission cars for disabled passengers, and mopeds.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：申请人年龄在70周岁以上的，可以申请的准驾车型为小型汽车、小型自动挡汽车、残疾人专用小型自动挡载客汽车、轻便摩托车。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Applicants over 70 who pass memory, judgment, and reaction tests may apply for exactly these license categories.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1722.}\ 
A motor vehicle that has been stolen, robbed, or fraudulently obtained will not be granted registration.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车属于被盗抢骗的，不予办理注册登记。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Vehicle registration regulations list stolen or fraudulently obtained vehicles as grounds for refusing registration.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1723.}\ 
A person applying for a driving license who resides outside their household registration area must apply at the vehicle management office of their registration area.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：申请机动车驾驶证的人在户籍地以外居住的，应向户籍地车辆管理所提出申请。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Under current rules, applicants may apply at any vehicle management office nationwide, not only their registration area.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1724.}\ 
A person who has not yet completed 3 years since being released from compulsory isolated drug rehabilitation may not apply for a motor vehicle driving licence.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：解除强制隔离戒毒措施未满3年的，不得申请机动车驾驶证。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Anyone within 3 years of release from compulsory isolated drug rehabilitation is barred from applying for a driving licence.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1725.}\ 
Driving a cargo truck continuously for more than 4 hours without stopping to rest, or resting for less than 20 minutes, incurs 6 demerit points per violation.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：连续驾驶载货汽车超过4小时未停车休息或者停车休息时间少于20分钟的，一次记6分。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Continuous driving beyond 4 hours requires a rest stop of at least 20 minutes, but the demerit count stated is incorrect.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1726.}\ 
Failing to slow down, stop, or yield to pedestrians at a crosswalk as required incurs 3 demerit points per violation.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车在人行横道不按规定减速、停车、避让行人的，一次记3分。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Not yielding to pedestrians at a crosswalk, like not yielding to a school bus, carries 3 demerit points.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1727.}\ 
How long is the probationary period after a driver first obtains a car-category or motorcycle-category driving licence?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 18 months \quad \textbf{B.} 16 months \quad \textbf{C.} 12 months \quad \textbf{D.} 6 months}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶人初次取得汽车类准驾车型或者初次取得摩托车类准驾车型后的实习期是多长时间？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. 12 months  The probationary period after first obtaining a car or motorcycle licence is 12 months, during which a probation sign must be displayed.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1728.}\ 
If a small or mini passenger car applies for an alteration registration due to a change in body colour and the vehicle is not at its place of registration, the application can be made to the vehicle management office where the vehicle is currently located.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：小型、微型载客汽车因改变车身颜色申请变更登记，车辆不在登记地的，可以向车辆所在地车辆管理所提出申请。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Vehicle registration rules allow applying at the vehicle's current location, which forwards the inspection record to the original registration office.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1729.}\ 
When applying to register a vehicle for transporting dangerous goods, the vehicle owner must be an individual.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：申请危险货物运输车登记的，机动车所有人应当为个人。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Vehicle registration rules require the owner of a dangerous-goods transport vehicle to be a unit, not an individual.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1730.}\ 
If a driver has been penalized for driving after drinking alcohol, within how many recent scoring cycles may they not reduce demerit points through traffic safety education?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 1 \quad \textbf{B.} 2 \quad \textbf{C.} 3 \quad \textbf{D.} 4}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶人饮酒后驾驶机动车受到过处罚的，在最近几个记分周期内，不得通过接受交通安全教育扣减交通违法行为记分？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. 3  Within the most recent three scoring cycles, a driver penalized for drink or drunk driving cannot apply to reduce points via safety education.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1731.}\ 
When applying for motor vehicle registration, the owner must submit proof of compulsory traffic accident liability insurance.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：申请机动车注册登记的，机动车所有人必须提交机动车交通事故责任强制保险凭证。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Vehicle registration rules list compulsory traffic accident liability insurance proof as a required document for registration.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1732.}\ 
Adding interior decoration to a vehicle, as long as it does not affect safety or licence plate recognition, does not require the owner to register a change.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：增加机动车车内装饰，在不影响安全和识别号牌的情况下，机动车所有人不需要去办理变更登记。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Interior decoration is listed as an exception that needs no alteration registration, provided safety and plate visibility are unaffected.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1733.}\ 
If a vehicle breaks down on the road and the driver fails to set up a warning sign as required after stopping, it incurs 1 demerit point per violation.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车在道路上发生故障，停车后未按规定设置警告标志的，一次记1分。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Failing to set a warning sign after a breakdown is one of several violations that carry 3 demerit points, not 1.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1734.}\ 
A licence holder who has not accumulated 12 demerit points in the current scoring cycle can immediately apply to add a driving category.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：已持有机动车驾驶证在本记分周期没有记满12分的，即可申请增加准驾车型。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Applicants must have no full 12-point record in both the current and the immediately preceding scoring cycle, not just the current one.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1735.}\ 
A vehicle otherwise exempt from safety technical inspection must still undergo the inspection if it was involved in a traffic accident before applying for registration.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：免予安全技术检验的机动车，在申请注册登记前发生了交通事故，也应进行安全技术检验。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Vehicles normally exempt from safety inspection must still be inspected if they were in an accident before registration was applied for.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1736.}\ 
Regarding applying for a motor vehicle driving licence, which of the following statements is incorrect?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Those residing at their household registration location should apply there \quad \textbf{B.} Those residing outside their household registration location may apply at their place of residence \quad \textbf{C.} Active-duty military personnel (including armed police) should apply at their unit's garrison location \quad \textbf{D.} Those applying to add a driving category should apply at their household registration location}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：关于申请机动车驾驶证，以下错误的说法是什么？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. Those applying to add a driving category should apply at their household registration location  Adding a driving category must be applied for at the licence's original issuing location, not necessarily at the household registration location.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1737.}\ 
How many demerit points are recorded for driving a school bus on a highway or urban expressway at a speed exceeding the limit by less than 20\%?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 12 points \quad \textbf{B.} 9 points \quad \textbf{C.} 6 points \quad \textbf{D.} 3 points}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶校车在高速公路、城市快速路上行驶超速未达20\%的，一次记多少分？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. 6 points  School bus speeding on highways or expressways under 20\% over the limit carries 6 points; 20\% or more carries 12 points.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1738.}\ 
Applicants practicing driving in a training area or on the road must obtain a learner's driving permit as required.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：申请人在场地和道路上学习驾驶，应当按规定取得学习驾驶证明。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  A learner's driving permit is required for practice and is valid for 3 years.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1739.}\ 
Regarding the probationary period, which of the following statements is correct?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} The 12 months after a driver first obtains a car-category licence is the probationary period \quad \textbf{B.} If demerit points during the probationary period exceed 6 but stay under 12, the probationary period is extended by 6 months \quad \textbf{C.} Adding a medium bus category to an existing small car licence carries a 12-month probationary period \quad \textbf{D.} If demerit points during the probationary period reach 12, the highest driving category is also cancelled}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：关于实习期，以下说法正确的是什么？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. The 12 months after a driver first obtains a car-category licence is the probationary period  The probationary period for a first-time car licence is 12 months from the date it is obtained.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1740.}\ 
Which of the following violations incurs 9 demerit points per occurrence?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Driving against traffic on a highway \quad \textbf{B.} Making a U-turn across the central median on a highway \quad \textbf{C.} Illegally parking on an urban expressway \quad \textbf{D.} Using another vehicle's licence plate or registration certificate}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶人有下列哪种违法行为一次记9分？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. Illegally parking on an urban expressway  Illegal parking on a highway or expressway, along with a mismatched driving category, carries 9 demerit points.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1741.}\ 
How many demerit points are recorded for driving a cargo truck loaded more than 50\% over its maximum permitted total weight?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 12 points \quad \textbf{B.} 9 points \quad \textbf{C.} 6 points \quad \textbf{D.} 3 points}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶载货汽车载物超过最大允许总质量50\%以上的，一次记多少分？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. 6 points  Truck overload penalties are 1 point under 30\%, 3 points for 30 to 50\%, and 6 points over 50\%.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1742.}\ 
A driver holding only a small car licence who drives a motorcycle on the road incurs 9 demerit points per violation.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：持有小型汽车驾驶证的驾驶人，驾驶摩托车上路行驶的，一次记9分。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Driving a vehicle category that does not match one's licence is a mismatched-category violation, carrying 9 demerit points.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1743.}\ 
A person with a record of bearing equal or greater responsibility for a fatal traffic accident may not apply for which of the following licence categories?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Small car \quad \textbf{B.} Small automatic-transmission car \quad \textbf{C.} Large truck \quad \textbf{D.} Light trailer-towing vehicle}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：有造成人员死亡的交通事故中承担同等以上责任记录的，不得申请下列哪种车型?}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. Large truck  Those responsible for a fatal accident may not apply for large bus, heavy trailer, city bus, medium bus, or large truck categories.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1744.}\ 
For someone who already holds a small automatic-transmission car licence, the 12 months after adding the small car category is a probationary period.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：已经持有小型自动挡汽车驾驶证，增加小型汽车准驾车型后的12个月为实习期。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  A probationary period only applies to a driver's first car or motorcycle licence, not to an added category.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1745.}\ 
An applicant for a large bus licence should be between 26 and 50 years old.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：申请大型客车驾驶证的申请人，应该在26周岁以上，50周岁以下。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  The age requirement for large bus and heavy trailer licences is actually 22 to 60 years old.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1746.}\ 
A learner's driving permit can only be issued in paper form.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：学习驾驶证明只能采用纸质形式。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Learner's driving permits may be either paper or electronic, and both have equal legal effect.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1747.}\
