If someone takes a driving test on another person's behalf, the vehicle management office should cancel their driving licence.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：代替他人参加机动车驾驶人考试的，车辆管理所应该注销其机动车驾驶证。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Anyone with an exam impersonation record within the past 3 years is barred from applying for or must forfeit a driving licence.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1748.}\ 
Driving a small passenger car on an ordinary city road at 30\% over the speed limit incurs 3 demerit points per violation.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶小型载客汽车在普通城市道路上行驶时，超过规定时速30\%，一次记3分。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  On ordinary roads, speeding 20 to 50\% over the limit in a small car carries 3 demerit points.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1749.}\ 
How many demerit points are recorded for driving a school bus carrying 30\% more passengers than its rated capacity?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 12 points \quad \textbf{B.} 9 points \quad \textbf{C.} 6 points \quad \textbf{D.} 3 points}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶校车载人超过核定人数30\%的，一次记多少分？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. 12 points  School bus overloading is 6 points under 20\% over capacity, and 12 points at 20\% or more.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1750.}\ 
A person with which of the following cannot apply for a motor vehicle driving licence?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Lost their driving licence \quad \textbf{B.} Their driving licence has expired \quad \textbf{C.} Had their driving permit lawfully revoked more than 3 years ago \quad \textbf{D.} Took a driving test on another person's behalf within the past 3 years}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：有下列哪种行为的人不得申请机动车驾驶证？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. Took a driving test on another person's behalf within the past 3 years  Anyone with an exam impersonation record within the past 3 years is barred from applying for a driving licence.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1751.}\ 
If, within the validity period of a learner's driving permit, the applicant fails the Subject 3 road driving skills test five times, their passing scores on other subjects are voided.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：在学习驾驶证明有效期内，申请人科目三道路驾驶技能考试五次考试不合格，已考试合格的其他科目成绩作废。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Both Subject 2 and the Subject 3 road test allow only 5 attempts each before other passed subject scores are voided.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1752.}\ 
After holding a small car driving qualification for how many years or more can a driver apply to add the medium bus category?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 1 \quad \textbf{B.} 2 \quad \textbf{C.} 3 \quad \textbf{D.} 5}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：已取得驾驶小型汽车准驾车型资格多少年以上，可以申请增加中型客车准驾车型？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. 2  Adding a medium bus category requires already holding a small car or similar qualification for at least 2 years.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1753.}\ 
The motorcycle Subject 2 test includes: pole course riding, stopping and starting on a slope, and crossing a single-plank bridge.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：摩托车科目二考试内容包括：桩考、坡道定点停车和起步、通过单边桥。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  The motorcycle Subject 2 skills test consists of exactly these three items.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1754.}\ 
Continuously driving a medium-or-larger passenger vehicle or a dangerous goods transport vehicle for more than 4 hours without stopping to rest, or resting less than 20 minutes, incurs 9 demerit points per violation.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：连续驾驶中型以上载客汽车、危险物品运输车辆超过4小时未停车休息或者停车休息时间少于20分钟的，一次记9分。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Continuous driving beyond 4 hours requires a rest of at least 20 minutes, and violating this in these vehicle types carries 9 points.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1755.}\ 
A regular three-wheeled motorcycle driver who turns 70 should go to the vehicle management office to exchange their licence for a light motorcycle (moped) driving licence.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：年满70周岁的普通三轮摩托车驾驶人，应到车管所换领轻便摩托车的机动车驾驶证。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Failing to exchange the licence in time causes the original driving category to become invalid.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1756.}\ 
For a vehicle carrying passengers with more than 7 seats that is overloaded by 40\% over its rated capacity, 3 demerit points are recorded at one time.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶7座以上载客汽车载人超过核定人数40\%的，一次记3分。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  For buses with more than 7 seats, 20 to 50 percent overload gets 6 points, and over 50 percent overload gets 9 points, not 3.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1757.}\ 
For a driver who already holds a small motor vehicle licence and then adds the ordinary two-wheeled motorcycle class, the 12 months after adding it counts as a probation period.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：已经持有小型汽车的驾驶证，增加普通二轮摩托车准驾车型后的12个月为实习期。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  The 12 months after adding a motorcycle class to an existing car licence is indeed a probation period.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1758.}\ 
When applying for a motor vehicle driving licence, the applicant must submit a physical condition certificate issued by a medical institution at county level or military regiment level or above.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：在申请机动车驾驶证时，必须提交县级或者部队团级以上医疗机构出具的身体条件证明。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  The regulation requires an identity document and a medical institution's physical condition certificate, but does not restrict it to county or regiment level or above.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1759.}\ 
If a driver's physical condition changes so that they are no longer fit to drive a motor vehicle, they must not drive a motor vehicle.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶人身体条件发生变化，不适合驾驶机动车的，不得驾驶机动车。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  If physical condition is unfit, the person simply cannot drive a motor vehicle.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1760.}\ 
How many demerit points are recorded at one time for driving a small car more than 50\% over the speed limit on an expressway or urban expressway?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 3 points \quad \textbf{B.} 6 points \quad \textbf{C.} 9 points \quad \textbf{D.} 12 points}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶小型汽车在高速公路、城市快速路上行驶超过规定时速50\%以上的，一次记多少分？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. 12 points  On expressways and urban expressways, speeding over 50\% gets 12 points, 20 to 50\% gets 6 points, and under 20\% gets no points.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1761.}\ 
How many demerit points are recorded at one time for a school bus, highway coach, or tourist coach carrying passengers 20\% to under 50\% over its rated capacity?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 3 points \quad \textbf{B.} 6 points \quad \textbf{C.} 9 points \quad \textbf{D.} 12 points}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶校车、公路客运汽车、旅游客运汽车载人超过核定人数百分之二十未达百分之五十的，一次记几分？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. 12 points  For school buses and coaches, overload under 20\% gets 6 points, and overload of 20\% or more gets 12 points.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1762.}\ 
Which of the following vehicle types can a B1 licence holder drive?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Large bus \quad \textbf{B.} Light trailer towing vehicle \quad \textbf{C.} Small car \quad \textbf{D.} Ordinary two-wheeled motorcycle}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：B1驾驶证可以驾驶以下哪种车型？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. Small car  Holders of A1, A2, A3, B1, and B2 licences are all permitted to drive C1 class vehicles.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1763.}\ 
Which of the following vehicle types can a driver over 70 years old drive?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Large truck \quad \textbf{B.} Trailer towing vehicle \quad \textbf{C.} Medium bus \quad \textbf{D.} Small automatic transmission car}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：70周岁以上的驾驶人，可以驾驶以下哪种车型？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. Small automatic transmission car  Drivers over 70 years old can no longer drive medium or large vehicles.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1764.}\ 
A driver holding a C1 licence can only drive automatic transmission cars.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：持有C1驾驶证的机动车驾驶人，只能驾驶自动挡汽车。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  A C1 licence covers small and micro passenger cars, light and micro cargo trucks, and also permits C2, C3, and C4 classes, not just automatics.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1765.}\ 
When applying for a driving licence for a small automatic transmission passenger car designated for disabled drivers, how long after issuance is the physical condition certificate valid for?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 1 month \quad \textbf{B.} 3 months \quad \textbf{C.} 6 months \quad \textbf{D.} 1 year}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：办理残疾人专用小型自动挡载客汽车驾驶证业务时，身体条件证明自出具之日起多长时间之内有效？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. 6 months  The regulation states the physical condition certificate is valid for six months from its date of issue.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1766.}\ 
In which of the following situations will a registered motor vehicle be deregistered by the vehicle management office?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Within one year of reaching the mandatory national scrapping standard \quad \textbf{B.} The vehicle's registered usage nature has changed \quad \textbf{C.} The vehicle's registration has been lawfully revoked \quad \textbf{D.} The vehicle was stolen, robbed, or obtained by fraud}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：以下哪种情形已注册登记的机动车会被车辆管理所注销？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. The vehicle's registration has been lawfully revoked  Registered vehicles are deregistered when registration is lawfully revoked or when a vehicle meeting the scrapping standard is seized and forcibly scrapped.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1767.}\ 
How many days after the vehicle owner receives the official motor vehicle plate does the temporary driving plate become invalid and unusable?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 1 day \quad \textbf{B.} 2 days \quad \textbf{C.} 3 days \quad \textbf{D.} 5 days}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车所有人收到机动车号牌之日起多少日后，临时行驶车号牌作废，不得继续使用？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. 3 days  The temporary plate becomes invalid 3 days after the official plate is received.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1768.}\ 
For a vehicle returned due to a quality problem, which vehicle management office should the owner apply to for deregistration?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Place of residence \quad \textbf{B.} Place of household registration \quad \textbf{C.} Place of registration \quad \textbf{D.} Place of temporary residence}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：因质量问题退车的，机动车所有人应当向哪个车辆管理所申请注销登记？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. Place of registration  For a vehicle returned due to a quality problem, the owner must apply at the vehicle management office where the vehicle is registered.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1769.}\ 
Which of the following documents is not required when applying for a transfer registration?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Identity document \quad \textbf{B.} Vehicle registration certificate (driving permit) \quad \textbf{C.} Motor vehicle registration certificate \quad \textbf{D.} Driving licence}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：申请转让登记的，以下哪种资料不需要提供？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. Driving licence  Transfer registration requires the owner's identity document, the vehicle's ownership transfer proof, the registration certificate, and the driving permit, but not the driving licence.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1770.}\ 
For a first-time application for a motor vehicle plate and driving permit, which vehicle management office should the applicant apply to?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Vehicle management office at the place of residence \quad \textbf{B.} Vehicle management office at the place of registration \quad \textbf{C.} Vehicle management office that issued the driving licence \quad \textbf{D.} Vehicle management office at the place of household registration}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：初次申领机动车号牌、行驶证的，应当向哪个车辆管理所申请？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Vehicle management office at the place of residence  The regulation states that first-time applications for a plate and driving permit must be filed with the vehicle management office at the owner's place of residence.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1771.}\ 
When ownership of a registered motor vehicle is transferred, within how many days of the delivery date must the new owner apply for registration?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 20 days \quad \textbf{B.} 40 days \quad \textbf{C.} 30 days \quad \textbf{D.} 10 days}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：已注册登记的机动车所有权发生转让的，现机动车所有人应当自交付之日起多少日内申请登记？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. 30 days  The regulation requires the new owner to apply for transfer registration within 30 days of the vehicle's delivery date.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1772.}\ 
When a motor vehicle has reached the mandatory national scrapping standard, how should it be handled when applying for deregistration?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Sell it to a recycling enterprise \quad \textbf{B.} Sell it to a scrap collection station \quad \textbf{C.} Hand it over to the vehicle management office \quad \textbf{D.} Hand it over to a safety technical inspection agency}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车已达到国家强制报废标准的，申请注销登记时应将机动车怎么处理？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Sell it to a recycling enterprise  A vehicle being scrapped must be sold or handed over to a licensed recycling enterprise.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1773.}\ 
If a person without a motor vehicle driving licence drives a motor vehicle and causes a traffic accident with equal or greater responsibility resulting in serious injury or death, for how many years after that are they barred from applying for a driving licence?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 1 year \quad \textbf{B.} 3 years \quad \textbf{C.} 5 years \quad \textbf{D.} 10 years}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：未取得机动车驾驶证驾驶机动车，发生负同等以上责任交通事故造成人员重伤或者死亡未满多少年的，不得申请机动车驾驶证？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. 10 years  The regulation bars such a person from applying for a driving licence for 10 years after the accident.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1774.}\ 
Which of the following materials is not required when applying for a motor vehicle registration?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Identity document \quad \textbf{B.} Vehicle purchase invoice \quad \textbf{C.} Compulsory traffic insurance certificate \quad \textbf{D.} Driving permit}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：申请机动车注册登记时，以下哪项材料不需要提交？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. Driving permit  Registration requires identity proof, purchase invoice, factory or import certificate, and compulsory insurance proof, but not a driving permit that does not yet exist for a new vehicle.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1775.}\ 
After completing a change, transfer, or deregistration of a motor vehicle, if the original owner reapplies for registration and wants to keep using the original plate number, which of the following conditions must be met?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Applying within 3 years of the relocation, co-owner change, transfer, or deregistration \quad \textbf{B.} The owner has owned the original vehicle and used the original plate number for more than 2 years \quad \textbf{C.} All traffic violations and accidents involving the original vehicle have been fully resolved \quad \textbf{D.} The owner's driving licence has not reached 12 demerit points}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：办理机动车变更登记、转让登记或者注销登记后，原机动车所有人重新申请机动车登记时，若想使用原机动车号牌号码，应满足以下哪项条件？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. All traffic violations and accidents involving the original vehicle have been fully resolved  The regulation requires that all traffic violations and accidents involving the original vehicle be fully resolved before the original plate number can be reused.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1776.}\ 
When a vehicle owner's residence moves out of or into a vehicle management office's jurisdiction, what type of registration should be applied for at the registration-location office?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Registration \quad \textbf{B.} Transfer \quad \textbf{C.} Deregistration \quad \textbf{D.} Change}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车所有人的住所迁出、迁入车辆管理所管辖区域的，应当向登记地车辆管理所申请什么登记？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. Change  A change of residential address requires applying for a change (alteration) registration at the registration-location vehicle management office.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1777.}\ 
If the current owner's residence is no longer within the jurisdiction of the vehicle management office, within how many days of accepting the application must the outgoing office inspect the vehicle?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 1 day \quad \textbf{B.} 3 days \quad \textbf{C.} 5 days \quad \textbf{D.} 10 days}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：现机动车所有人住所不在车辆管理所管辖区域内的，转出地车辆管理所应当自受理之日起多少日内，查验机动车？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. 3 days  The regulation requires the outgoing vehicle management office to inspect the vehicle within 3 days of accepting the application.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1778.}\ 
Which of the following situations requires applying for a change (alteration) registration?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Adding interior decoration \quad \textbf{B.} Adding an entry/exit step to a small car \quad \textbf{C.} Adding a water tank to a cargo vehicle \quad \textbf{D.} The vehicle owner's residence has moved out of the registration-location vehicle management office's jurisdiction}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：以下哪种情况需要办理变更登记？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. The vehicle owner's residence has moved out of the registration-location vehicle management office's jurisdiction  A change registration is required when the owner's residence moves out of or into the registration office's jurisdiction, unlike minor add-ons which do not.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1779.}\ 
Which of the following situations results in a warning or a fine of under 200 yuan from the traffic police department?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Painting or affixing signage or body advertising on a motor vehicle in a way that affects safe driving \quad \textbf{B.} Obtaining vehicle registration through fraud or bribery \quad \textbf{C.} Concealing relevant facts when applying for vehicle registration \quad \textbf{D.} Submitting false materials when applying for vehicle registration}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：以下哪种情形会被公安机关交通管理部门处警告或者二百元以下罚款？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Painting or affixing signage or body advertising on a motor vehicle in a way that affects safe driving  The regulation lists vehicle signage or advertising that affects safe driving among the minor offences punished only by warning or a fine under 200 yuan.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1780.}\ 
For a registered motor vehicle, in which of the following situations should the owner file a record change with the registration-location vehicle management office?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} The owner's phone number has changed \quad \textbf{B.} Adding interior decoration \quad \textbf{C.} A vehicle part has been damaged \quad \textbf{D.} Adding an entry/exit step to a small car}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：已注册登记的机动车，以下哪种情况应向登记地车辆管理所申请备案？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. The owner's phone number has changed  The regulation requires filing a change of record when the owner's contact information, such as a phone number, changes.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1781.}\ 
If a vehicle owner's contact information changes, within how many days of the change must they apply for a change record with the registration-location vehicle management office?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 10 days \quad \textbf{B.} 15 days \quad \textbf{C.} 20 days \quad \textbf{D.} 30 days}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车所有人联系方式变更的，应当在信息或者事项变更后多少日内，向登记地车辆管理所申请变更备案？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. 30 days  The regulation gives 30 days to file the information change, separate from the 90-day period for renewing an expired licence.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1782.}\ 
In which of the following situations should the vehicle owner apply for deregistration?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} The owner's contact information has changed \quad \textbf{B.} The vehicle has reached the mandatory national scrapping standard \quad \textbf{C.} The vehicle has suffered damage \quad \textbf{D.} The vehicle identification number has become illegible due to wear, corrosion, or an accident}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：以下哪种情形机动车所有人应申请办理注销登记？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. The vehicle has reached the mandatory national scrapping standard  A vehicle that has reached the mandatory scrapping standard can no longer legally be driven, so it must be deregistered.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1783.}\ 
If a motor vehicle has not reached the mandatory national scrapping standard but the owner voluntarily scraps it, which vehicle management office should the owner apply to for deregistration?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Place of residence \quad \textbf{B.} Place of household registration \quad \textbf{C.} Place of registration \quad \textbf{D.} Place of temporary residence}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车未达到国家强制报废标准，机动车所有人自愿报废的，机动车所有人应当向哪个车辆管理所申请注销登记？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. Place of registration  Deregistration applications must be filed at the vehicle management office where the vehicle is registered.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1784.}\ 
If the certificates and documents submitted by the applicant for a motor vehicle registration are complete and valid, the traffic police department should complete the registration procedure ( ).\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Within 1 week \quad \textbf{B.} The next day \quad \textbf{C.} Within 1 month \quad \textbf{D.} On the spot}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：申请人办理机动车登记提交的证明、凭证齐全、有效的，公安机关交通管理部门应当（）办理登记手续。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. On the spot  The regulation states that when submitted documents are complete and valid, the traffic police department must complete registration on the spot.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1785.}\ 
While a plate is being reissued or replaced, for how many days at most can the applicant apply for a valid temporary driving plate?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 3 days \quad \textbf{B.} 5 days \quad \textbf{C.} 10 days \quad \textbf{D.} 15 days}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：补发、换发号牌期间，申请人可以申领有效期不超过多少日的临时行驶车号牌？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. 15 days  The regulation allows a temporary driving plate valid for no more than 15 days while the official plate is being reissued or replaced.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1786.}\ 
Which of the following situations does not require a change (alteration) registration?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Changing the body colour \quad \textbf{B.} Replacing the engine \quad \textbf{C.} The vehicle's registered usage nature has changed \quad \textbf{D.} Adding interior decoration}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：以下哪种情况不需要办理变更登记？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. Adding interior decoration  The regulation exempts minor additions like interior decoration from change registration as long as safety and plate visibility are not affected.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1787.}\ 
After the vehicle management office accepts a motor vehicle owner's application to reissue or replace a plate, within how many days of accepting it must the plate be reissued or replaced?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 3 days \quad \textbf{B.} 5 days \quad \textbf{C.} 10 days \quad \textbf{D.} 15 days}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：车辆管理所收到机动车所有人补领、换领机动车号牌的申请后，自受理之日起多少日内补发、换发号牌？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. 15 days  The regulation requires the vehicle management office to reissue or replace the plate within 15 days of accepting the application.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1788.}\ 
If a motor vehicle driver cheats during the demerit-point makeup study or exam, the exam result becomes invalid, and how much of a fine will be imposed?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Under 1,000 yuan \quad \textbf{B.} Over 1,000 yuan \quad \textbf{C.} Over 2,000 yuan \quad \textbf{D.} Over 3,000 yuan}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶人在满分学习考试中弄虚作假的，相应考试成绩无效，并会被处以多少罚款？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Under 1,000 yuan  Regulations state cheating during makeup study or exams voids the results and draws a fine of under 1,000 yuan.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1789.}\ 
If a driver over 70 years old causes a traffic accident they are responsible for, resulting in serious injury or death, within how many days after the points cycle ends must they report for a license review?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 10 days \quad \textbf{B.} 15 days \quad \textbf{C.} 30 days \quad \textbf{D.} 60 days}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：年龄在70周岁以上的机动车驾驶人发生责任交通事故造成人员重伤或者死亡的，应当在本记分周期结束后多少日内到公安机关交通管理部门接受审验？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. 30 days  Regulations require drivers over 70 who cause a serious-injury or fatal accident to report for review within 30 days after the points cycle ends.}\par\smallskip

\section{Safe \& Civil Driving Basics \;/\; 安全行车、文明驾驶基础知识}

\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1790.}\ 
While a motor vehicle is moving, children in the car do not need to wear seatbelts.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车行驶中，车上少年儿童可不使用安全带。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Children need an age-appropriate child safety seat for proper protection, not exemption from restraints.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1791.}\ 
Before driving a motor vehicle onto the road, the driver must fasten the seatbelt as required.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车在上道路行驶前驾驶人要按规定系好安全带。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Safety comes first when driving, so fastening the seatbelt before setting off is required.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1792.}\ 
When a motor vehicle is on the road, front-seat passengers do not need to wear seatbelts.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车上路行驶时，前排乘车人可不系安全带。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Safe, civilized driving requires all front-seat occupants, not just the driver, to wear seatbelts.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{14\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1793.}\ 
What is this driver's violation of the law?\par
\smallskip\begin{center}\includegraphics[width=6cm,height=4cm,keepaspectratio]{work/img/20190410102529fpovsrnc47zcqw3zvtzbq2.jpg}\end{center}\smallskip
{\small \textbf{A.} Not gripping the steering wheel as required \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong seat angle \quad \textbf{C.} Not wearing a seatbelt \quad \textbf{D.} Incorrect driving posture}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：这位驾驶人违反法律规定的行为是什么？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. Not wearing a seatbelt  Driving without a seatbelt violates the Road Traffic Safety Law.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1794.}\ 
Vehicles equipped with seatbelts should require all occupants inside to wear them.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：设有安全带装置的车辆，应要求车内乘员系安全带。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Whether driving or riding, everyone in the vehicle must buckle up.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1795.}\ 
Before driving a motor vehicle, which of the following statements is incorrect?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Adjusting the driver's seat so the pedals can be operated comfortably \quad \textbf{B.} Adjusting the tightness and height of the seatbelt \quad \textbf{C.} Adjusting the steering wheel to a suitable driving position \quad \textbf{D.} Adjusting the headrest height so it aligns with the driver's neck}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车前，以下说法错误的是什么？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. Adjusting the headrest height so it aligns with the driver's neck  The headrest top should align with the top of the driver's head, centered on the back of the head, not the neck.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{14\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1796.}\ 
Flicking this switch up and down activates the front windshield wiper.\par
\smallskip\begin{center}\includegraphics[width=6cm,height=4cm,keepaspectratio]{work/img/201904101025553grcrrutf5zkp8bee2fsee.jpg}\end{center}\smallskip
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：上下扳动这个开关前风窗玻璃刮水器开始工作。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  The front windshield wiper switch is specifically what controls the wiper.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1797.}\ 
While driving, if the fuel warning light comes on, you should refuel promptly at a nearby gas station to avoid being stranded on the road and causing a traffic accident.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：行车中，燃油报警灯亮，应及时到附近加油站加油，以免造成车辆乘员滞留公路，发生交通事故。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Running out of fuel can damage the fuel pump and may leave the vehicle stranded on the road.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1798.}\ 
Steering while emergency braking a vehicle equipped with ABS may still cause a skid.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶有ABS系统的机动车在紧急制动的同时转向可能会发生侧滑。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  ABS prevents wheel lock-up and preserves steering, but steering during braking can still cause a skid.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1799.}\ 
If the oil pressure warning light stays on, you can keep driving while watching it and wait for the light to go off on its own.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机油压力报警灯持续亮，可边行驶，边观察，等待报警灯自行熄灭。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  When the oil pressure warning light comes on, you must stop and check the vehicle immediately.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{14\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1800.}\ 
The gauge shows the current vehicle speed is 20 km/h.\par

{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：仪表显示当前车速是20公里/小时。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  The gauge needle points to 2, indicating an engine speed of 2000 rpm, not vehicle speed.}\par\smallskip

[Image] When the high-beam headlights are turned on, the indicator shown in the image lights up.\par

{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par

{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  A blue parallel-line icon indicates high beam, while a green slanted-line icon indicates low beam, which is what the image shows.}\par\smallskip

{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：打开后雾灯开关，（如图所示）亮起。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  The front fog light icon is green and points left, while the rear fog light icon is yellow and points right; the image shows the front one.}\par\smallskip

{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Whichever arrow lights up indicates that side's turn signal, and the image shows the opposite side.}\par\smallskip

{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Parking brake engaged  Inside the circle, P means the parking brake is engaged with no fault, while the exclamation mark indicates a brake system malfunction.}\par\smallskip

[Image] What device does this switch symbol control?\par

{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：（如图所示）这个符号的开关控制什么装置？}\par

When drivers and passengers get out of a vehicle, they should open the door with the hand farther from the door and turn their head to check traffic to the side and rear, to avoid obstructing others.\par

Before driving, the headrest height should be adjusted so it aligns with the driver's cervical spine.\par

{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：在驾驶机动车前，需调整安全头枕的高度，使头枕正对驾驶人的颈椎。}\par

\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1929.}\ 
Before getting into the driver's seat, the driver should first observe the surroundings and confirm it is safe before getting in.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶人在进入驾驶室前，首先要观察机动车周围情况，确认安全后再上车。}\par

\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1930.}\ 
When driving in a straight line, the faster the speed, the more steering input should be applied, and the faster the steering wheel should be turned.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：直线行驶时，车速越快，转向盘操作量应越多，转动转向盘的速度也应越快。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  At higher speeds, oversteering can cause a rollover; steering inputs should be smaller and more gradual, then promptly straightened.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1931.}\ 
When driving a motor vehicle on the road, rear-seat passengers do not need to wear seatbelts.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车上路行驶，后排乘车人可不系安全带。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  All occupants, including rear passengers, should wear seatbelts, and children need a dedicated child safety seat.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1932.}\ 
Before setting off, the driver should remind passengers to fasten their seatbelts and close the doors properly.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车起步前，应提醒乘车人系好安全带，并关好车门。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Civilized driving puts safety first.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1933.}\ 
When starting the vehicle, if the warning light on the dashboard keeps flashing, it warns the driver the vehicle may have a fault, and the driver should stop promptly to fix it.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车启动时，如果仪表上的报警灯持续闪烁，提醒驾驶人车辆可能存在故障，应及时停车排除故障。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  If there is a fault, you should stop as soon as possible to inspect and repair it.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}

How should a driver perform a walk-around check before getting into the vehicle?\par

{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：上车前，驾驶人应该如何进行绕车检查？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Walk counter-clockwise around the vehicle  A pre-drive safety check is essential for safe driving.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1935.}\ 
Before driving on the road, check whether the vehicle's condition meets safety and technical requirements; a vehicle with safety hazards such as fuel leaks must not be driven on the road.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par

{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Vehicles with safety hazards are not permitted to be driven on the road.}\par\smallskip

A vehicle's dedicated spare tire can be used as a regular tire for long-term use.\par

[Image] When the pictured indicator on the dashboard lights up, it means the low beam headlights are on.\par

{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Brake pull can lead to serious accidents, so it requires extra caution.}\par\smallskip

Continuous use of the service brake on a long downhill will shorten the engine's service life.\par

Regarding driving electric vehicles, which of the following statements is incorrect?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Flammable or explosive items must not be placed in the vehicle while charging \quad \textbf{B.} Check the remaining battery level before setting off \quad \textbf{C.} The vehicle should carry an ordinary fire extinguisher \quad \textbf{D.} Charge promptly when the battery is low}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：关于驾驶电动汽车，以下错误的说法是什么？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. The vehicle should carry an ordinary fire extinguisher  Electric vehicles should carry a dedicated onboard fire extinguisher, not an ordinary one.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1946.}\ 
In winter, the battery should be preheated before charging an electric vehicle.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：冬季在为电动汽车充电之前，要提前预热电池。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  In winter, the battery cells are warmed to a suitable temperature before charging begins, so preheating beforehand is necessary.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1947.}\ 
Before setting off in an electric vehicle, the remaining battery level must be checked.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶电动汽车在出行前，必须要检查剩余电量。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Checking the remaining battery level beforehand ensures it is sufficient for the trip.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1948.}\ 
Which of the following is the English abbreviation for vehicle navigation?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} ACC \quad \textbf{B.} ETC \quad \textbf{C.} LDW \quad \textbf{D.} GPS}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：以下选项中，车辆导航的英文缩写是什么?}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. GPS  ACC is adaptive cruise control, ETC is electronic toll collection, LDW is lane departure warning, and GPS is the vehicle navigation system.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1949.}\ 
If an electric vehicle catches fire, it is enough to report the location; there is no need to report the vehicle's brand and model.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶电动汽车发生起火，报警时告知起火地点即可，不用告知起火车辆的品牌和型号。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Reporting the vehicle's brand and model helps rescuers know its battery type, capacity, and voltage for an effective response.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1950.}\ 
Attention should be paid to maintaining electric vehicles; if a fault requires repair, a professional repair shop or technician should be chosen.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：应注意电动汽车的保养，电动汽车出现故障需要维修时，应选择专业的维修机构或者人员。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Electric vehicles differ internally from fuel vehicles, so repairs should only be done by qualified professionals, not by the driver disassembling parts.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1951.}\ 
When driving an electric vehicle, try to avoid roads with standing water during rainy weather.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶电动汽车上路，尽量避免在雨天积水路段行驶。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Deep water can cause electrical leakage or motor water ingress in electric vehicles, risking fire.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1952.}\ 
Before driving a pure electric vehicle, make sure the battery is sufficiently charged, plan a suitable route in advance, and know the locations of charging stations or charging piles along the way.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶纯电动汽车出行前，应确保电池电量充足，提前规划合适的路线，了解途中充电站或者充电桩的位置。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Since the battery is the main power source, checking the charge level and planning charging stops in advance prevents running out of power midway.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1953.}\ 
In hot weather, avoid leaving an electric vehicle exposed to prolonged direct sunlight outdoors.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：高温炎热天气，电动汽车出行时要避免在户外长时间暴晒。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Prolonged sun exposure raises internal battery pressure, causing water loss, reduced activity, and faster plate aging.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1954.}\ 
When driving an electric vehicle, it is fine to brake frequently.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶电动汽车行驶时，可以频繁使用刹车。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Frequent braking means frequent starts, causing frequent high-current battery discharge that shortens battery life.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1955.}\ 
Electric vehicles should be charged using compliant charging equipment, with an appropriate charging duration, following standard charging practices.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：为电动汽车充电应使用符合规定的充电设备，掌握适当的充电时长，规范充电。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Overcharging, over-discharging, or undercharging all shorten battery life, so charging time and frequency should match actual conditions.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1956.}\ 
Electric vehicles are quiet at low speed, so on roads with many pedestrians and non-motor vehicles, a light horn tap can be used when necessary to alert them to an approaching vehicle.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：电动汽车在低速行驶状态下声音较小，遇到行人和非机动车较多的路段，必要时可轻鸣喇叭提示，以防非机动车和行人未注意靠近的车辆。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Electric vehicles are very quiet at low speed, so a light horn tap is appropriate where pedestrians and non-motor vehicles are common.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1957.}\ 
If an electric vehicle catches fire, cut off the power immediately; if the fire becomes too large to control, move away from the vehicle and call for help right away.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：电动汽车发生起火，应立即切断电源，火势较大无法控制时，要远离车辆，立即报警。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Battery fires are dangerous: cut power immediately if possible, and if the fire cannot be controlled, retreat and call the emergency number.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}

Which of the following is the English abbreviation for the vehicle blind spot monitoring system?\par

{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：以下选项中，车辆盲点监测系统的英文缩写是什么？}\par

\needspace{4\baselineskip}

Which of the following is the English abbreviation for the forward collision warning system?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} EBD \quad \textbf{B.} BAR \quad \textbf{C.} TSR \quad \textbf{D.} FCW}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：以下选项中，前方防碰撞预警系统的英文缩写是什么？}\par

Which of the following is the English abbreviation for the automatic lane change assist system?\par

{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. ALC  ALC (Auto Lane Change) is the standard abbreviation for the automatic lane-change assist system.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1963.}\ 
Which of the following is the English abbreviation for the traffic sign recognition system?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} TSR \quad \textbf{B.} AEB \quad \textbf{C.} TRC \quad \textbf{D.} ACC}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：以下选项中，车辆交通标志识别系统的英文缩写是什么？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. TSR  TSR (Traffic Sign Recognition) is the standard abbreviation for the traffic sign recognition system.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1964.}\ 
Which of the following is the English abbreviation for the emergency brake assist system?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} LCA \quad \textbf{B.} EBA \quad \textbf{C.} FCW \quad \textbf{D.} ALC}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：以下选项中，车辆紧急制动辅助系统的英文缩写是什么？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. EBA  EBA (Emergency Brake Assist) is the standard abbreviation for the emergency braking assist system.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1965.}\ 
Which of the following is the English abbreviation for real-time traffic information?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} TMC \quad \textbf{B.} LDW \quad \textbf{C.} EBA \quad \textbf{D.} LCA}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：以下选项中，实时交通信息的英文缩写是什么？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. TMC  TMC (Traffic Message Channel) is the standard abbreviation for real-time traffic information.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1966.}\ 
Which of the following is the English abbreviation for the electronic stability control system?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} ESP \quad \textbf{B.} ESC \quad \textbf{C.} ACC \quad \textbf{D.} LDW}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：以下选项中，车身电子稳定控制系统的英文缩写是什么?}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. ESP  ESP (Electronic Stability Program) is the standard abbreviation for the electronic stability control system.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1967.}\ 
Which of the following is the English abbreviation for the cruise control system?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} ACC \quad \textbf{B.} CCS \quad \textbf{C.} ABS \quad \textbf{D.} FCW}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：以下选项中，定速巡航系统的英文缩写是什么？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. CCS  CCS (Cruise Control System) is the standard abbreviation for fixed-speed cruise control.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1968.}\ 
Which of the following is the English abbreviation for the electronic brake-force distribution system?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} BAR \quad \textbf{B.} TSR \quad \textbf{C.} EBD \quad \textbf{D.} LCA}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：以下选项中，车辆电子制动力分配系统的英文缩写是什么？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. EBD  EBD (Electronic Brakeforce Distribution) is the standard abbreviation for the brake-force distribution system.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1969.}\ 
Which of the following is the English abbreviation for the blind spot assist system?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} BSD \quad \textbf{B.} BSA \quad \textbf{C.} AEB \quad \textbf{D.} FCW}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：以下选项中，车辆盲点辅助系统的英文缩写是什么？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. BSA  BSA (Blind Spot Assist) uses short-range radar to monitor the rear and sides of the vehicle, extending the function of the mirrors.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1970.}\ 
Which of the following is the English abbreviation for the adaptive front-lighting (cornering headlight) system?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} AFS \quad \textbf{B.} ACC \quad \textbf{C.} LCA \quad \textbf{D.} ALC}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：以下选项中，车辆随动转向前照灯系统的英文缩写是什么？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. AFS  AFS (Adaptive Front-Lighting System) dynamically adjusts headlights based on steering angle and speed to improve visibility when turning.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1971.}\ 
After the vehicle has come to a stop, which of the following devices should be used to prevent it from rolling?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Gear shift lever \quad \textbf{B.} Throttle control lever \quad \textbf{C.} Clutch lever \quad \textbf{D.} Parking brake lever}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：车辆停稳后，为了避免车辆溜动，应当使用以下哪个装置？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. Parking brake lever  Engaging the parking brake (handbrake) after stopping prevents the vehicle from rolling.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1972.}\ 
Regarding precautions for connecting or disconnecting an electric vehicle's charging plug, which of the following statements is correct?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} The plug may be disconnected by pulling the charging cable \quad \textbf{B.} The vehicle may be charged using the household electrical circuit \quad \textbf{C.} Do not connect or disconnect the plug with wet hands \quad \textbf{D.} The edge of the plug may be touched while connecting or disconnecting it}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：电动汽车连接或者断开充电插座的注意事项，以下正确的说法是什么？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. Do not connect or disconnect the plug with wet hands  Never pull the cable to unplug it and never handle the plug with wet hands, as this risks electric shock.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1973.}\ 
Regarding the energy recovery (regenerative braking) function of electric vehicles, which of the following statements is incorrect?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} It saves electricity \quad \textbf{B.} It saves brake pads \quad \textbf{C.} It improves braking effect \quad \textbf{D.} It can be used as the vehicle's brake}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：关于电动汽车的能量回收功能，以下不正确的说法是什么？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. It can be used as the vehicle's brake  Regenerative braking can slow the vehicle but cannot achieve an immediate full stop, so it cannot replace the brakes.}\par\smallskip

\section{Vehicle Operation Basics \;/\; 机动车驾驶操作基础知识}

\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1974.}\ 
If an injured person cannot get out of the vehicle on their own, try to move them out of the vehicle while avoiding further injury.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：受伤者在车内无法自行下车时，可设法将其从车内移出，尽量避免二次受伤。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Leaving the injured person inside the vehicle can easily lead to secondary injury.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1975.}\ 
After a traffic accident causes a harmful gas leak, rescuers entering the scene to help the injured must wear a respirator or cover their nose and mouth with a wet towel.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：因交通事故造成有害气体泄漏后，进入现场抢救伤员时，抢救人员须佩戴空气呼吸器或用湿毛巾捂住口鼻。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Rescuers must protect themselves first before they can help the injured.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1976.}\ 
After a motor vehicle traffic accident, check for fuel leaks or ruptured lines to prevent further accidents.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车发生交通事故后，应注意是否有燃油泄漏、管路破裂的情况，避免意外情况出现。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Safety of life comes first in all situations.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1977.}\ 
At a traffic accident scene, if there is a leak of toxic or hazardous substances, people must be evacuated immediately and the incident reported to police right away.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：在交通事故现场，一旦遇到有毒有害物质泄漏，一定要第一时间疏散人员，并立即报警。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Evacuation and reporting to police must be done without delay.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1978.}\ 
Before rescuing an unconscious injured person, check their breathing first.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：抢救昏迷失去知觉的伤员要在抢救前先检查呼吸。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Life comes first: confirm vital signs before taking further action.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1979.}\ 
When using digital pressure to stop arterial bleeding, where should the thumb press relative to the wound?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} The artery proximal to the heart (near side) \quad \textbf{B.} The artery below the blood vessel \quad \textbf{C.} The artery distal from the heart (far side) \quad \textbf{D.} The middle of the blood vessel}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：采用指压止血法为动脉出血伤员止血时，拇指压住伤口的什么位置？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. The artery proximal to the heart (near side)  Arterial blood flows from the heart, so pressure should be applied on the side closer to the heart.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1980.}\ 
In an emergency, bleeding should first be controlled using the pressure method, then switched to another method as needed based on the bleeding.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：在紧急情况下为伤员止血时，须先用压迫法止血后再根据出血情况改用其他止血法。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  For arterial bleeding, press the side near the heart; for venous bleeding, press the side away from the heart.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1981.}\ 
When treating a burn victim whose wound has already blistered, what can be used to cover and protect the blister?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Handkerchief \quad \textbf{B.} Scarf \quad \textbf{C.} Plastic bag or plastic wrap \quad \textbf{D.} Tissue paper}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：救助烧伤伤员时，当伤口已经起泡的情况下，可用什么覆盖在水泡上进行保护？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. Plastic bag or plastic wrap  Blistered wounds should be covered with something that blocks contamination and will not stick to the skin.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1982.}\ 
When helping an injured person in shock from heavy blood loss, keep them warm.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：救助失血过多出现休克的伤员要采取保暖措施。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Rescuers must constantly monitor the injured person's condition and respond accordingly.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1983.}\ 
What is the first step in helping a victim of harmful gas poisoning?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Keep them warm \quad \textbf{B.} Move the victim to a place with fresh air \quad \textbf{C.} Perform artificial respiration \quad \textbf{D.} Perform chest compressions}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：救助有害气体中毒伤员，首先采取的措施是什么？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Move the victim to a place with fresh air  As with carbon monoxide poisoning, the victim should first be moved outdoors to fresh air.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1984.}\ 
If a motor vehicle catches fire while driving, get out of the vehicle quickly to avoid respiratory injury or suffocation.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车遇车辆出现燃烧现象，应迅速离开车内，避免对呼吸道造成伤害或发生窒息。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Once the vehicle is on fire, occupants must move away from it immediately.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1985.}\ 
When rescuing a bleeding injured person, what should be done first?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Observe \quad \textbf{B.} Bandage \quad \textbf{C.} Stop the bleeding \quad \textbf{D.} Ask questions}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：抢救失血伤员时，要先采取什么措施？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. Stop the bleeding  For blood loss, bleeding must be stopped before bandaging.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1986.}\ 
If the injured person has a fracture of the thigh, lower leg, or spine, generally do not move them casually.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：伤员大腿、小腿和脊椎骨折时，一般不要随便移动伤者。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Fractures are not visible to the eye, so avoid touching or moving the injured area whenever possible.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1987.}\ 
If a fracture site is bleeding, first stop the bleeding and bandage the wound, then splint the limb.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：伤员骨折处出血时，首先要对伤口进行止血和包扎，再固定肢体。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Stop the bleeding and bandage first, then immobilize the limb.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1988.}\ 
When moving a person with a spinal fracture, never support them to walk; a soft stretcher may be used to transport them.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：移动脊柱骨折的伤员，切勿扶持伤者走动，可用软担架运送。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  A spinal fracture patient's spine must be kept immobilized; a soft stretcher does not provide adequate stabilization.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1989.}\ 
A burn victim who is thirsty should only drink plain water.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：烧伤伤员口渴时，只能喝白开水。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Burn victims may drink lightly salted water to replenish fluids, not only plain water.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1990.}\ 
When performing CPR on an adult, what is the chest compression rate?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 60-80 per minute \quad \textbf{B.} 80-100 per minute \quad \textbf{C.} 100-120 per minute \quad \textbf{D.} 120-140 per minute}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：在为成人做心肺复苏时，胸外按压频率是多少？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. 100-120 per minute  The CPR compression rate is somewhat higher than a normal heartbeat rate.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1991.}\ 
When moving an unconscious injured person, the first step is to place them on their back (supine position).\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：搬运昏迷失去知觉的伤员首先要采取仰卧位。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  The first priority is to open the airway.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1992.}\ 
A thirsty burn victim may drink a small amount of lightly salted water.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：烧伤伤员口渴时，可喝少量的淡盐水。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Burn victims should not drink only plain water; lightly salted water helps replenish fluids.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1993.}\ 
If an injured person is trapped under a wheel or cargo, immediately pull their limbs to drag them out.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：遇伤者被压于车轮或货物下时，要立即拉拽伤者的肢体将其拖出。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Forcibly pulling someone trapped under a heavy object can worsen their injuries.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1994.}\ 
If no bandage is available for first aid, towels, handkerchiefs, bedsheets, or nylon stockings can be used in place of a bandage.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：在没有绷带急救伤员的情况下，可用毛巾、手帕、床单、长筒尼龙袜子等代替绷带包扎。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Wound dressings should be made of soft, smooth material.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1995.}\ 
What should be kept in mind when rescuing an unconscious injured person?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Perform CPR immediately \quad \textbf{B.} Pinch the philtrum (under the nose) hard \quad \textbf{C.} Repeatedly slap the victim's face \quad \textbf{D.} Check breathing before starting rescue}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：抢救昏迷失去知觉的伤员需注意什么？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. Check breathing before starting rescue  Life comes first: confirm vital signs before taking further action.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1996.}\ 
When treating a scald, the first step should be to continuously rinse the affected area with room-temperature clean water.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：对于烫伤进行处理时，应首先考虑用常温清水持续冲洗烫伤部位。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Continuous rinsing with room-temperature water helps cool the scalded area.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{1997.}\ 
How should a person with a spinal fracture be rescued?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Keep them warm \quad \textbf{B.} Transport on a soft-board stretcher \quad \textbf{C.} Immobilize with a triangular bandage \quad \textbf{D.} Support them to move}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：怎样抢救脊柱骨折的伤员？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. Immobilize with a triangular bandage  A fracture should not be moved; it should be immobilized in place.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1998.}\ 
When rescuing a victim of harmful gas poisoning, move them to fresh air immediately to get them out of the dangerous environment and prevent inhaling more toxic gas.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：抢救有害气体中毒伤员时，应第一时间将伤员移送到有新鲜空气的地方，脱离危险环境，防止吸入更多有害气体。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  As with carbon monoxide poisoning, the victim should be moved outdoors to fresh air first.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{1999.}\ 
To prevent a harmful gas poisoning victim from being further poisoned, first move them to a place with fresh air.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：为防止有害气体中毒伤员继续中毒，首先将伤员转移到空气新鲜的地方。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  As with carbon monoxide poisoning, the victim should be moved outdoors to fresh air first.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2000.}\ 
What emergency measure should be taken to help a person whose whole body is on fire?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Cover the flames with sand to put out the fire \quad \textbf{B.} Spray cold water on the body to put out the fire \quad \textbf{C.} Use a fire extinguisher to put out the fire \quad \textbf{D.} Help remove the burning clothes}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：救助全身燃烧伤员采取哪种应急措施？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Spray cold water on the body to put out the fire  The other options risk causing further injury.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2001.}\ 
In first aid for a poisoning victim at a traffic accident, which of the following actions is incorrect?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Move the poisoned person out of the contaminated area as quickly as possible \quad \textbf{B.} Remove clothing exposed to the toxic air \quad \textbf{C.} Rinse exposed body parts with clean water \quad \textbf{D.} Wait in place for rescue}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：交通事故中急救中毒伤员，以下做法错误的是什么？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. Wait in place for rescue  Once poisoned, action must be taken immediately, not simply waiting.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2002.}\ 
What should be kept in mind when rescuing a person with a fracture?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Quickly lift them onto a stretcher and send to hospital \quad \textbf{B.} Adjust the position of the injury as needed \quad \textbf{C.} Bandage the fracture site \quad \textbf{D.} Do not move the fractured body part}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：抢救骨折伤员时注意什么？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. Do not move the fractured body part  Fractures are not visible to the eye, so avoid touching or moving the injured area whenever possible.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2003.}\ 
Spraying cold water on a person whose whole body is on fire is an acceptable emergency measure.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：救助全身燃烧伤员可以采取向身上喷冷水灭火的措施。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Spraying cold water is the safest way to help someone who is burning.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2004.}\ 
If no bandage is available for first aid, which of the following first-aid actions is incorrect?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Bandaging with a handkerchief \quad \textbf{B.} Bandaging with a towel \quad \textbf{C.} Bandaging with a cotton garment \quad \textbf{D.} Wrapping with thin rope}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：在没有绷带急救伤员的情况下，以下救护行为中错误的是什么？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. Wrapping with thin rope  Wound dressings should be made of soft, smooth material, not rope.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2005.}\ 
What is the basic requirement for rescuing injured people at an accident scene?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Treat the injury first, save life second \quad \textbf{B.} Save life first, treat the injury second \quad \textbf{C.} Help the lightly injured first \quad \textbf{D.} Help the seriously injured last}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：在事故现场抢救伤员的基本要求是什么？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Save life first, treat the injury second  Life comes first: save the person's life before treating the injury.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2006.}\ 
If a fracture site is bleeding, first immobilize it, then stop the bleeding and bandage the wound.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：伤员骨折处出血时，要先固定，然后止血和包扎伤口。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  The bleeding should be stopped and bandaged first, then the limb immobilized.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2007.}\ 
Which of the following items should not be used for bandaging to stop bleeding?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Bandage \quad \textbf{B.} Triangular bandage \quad \textbf{C.} Tourniquet \quad \textbf{D.} Hemp rope}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：包扎止血不能用的物品是什么？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. Hemp rope  Wound dressings should be made of soft, smooth material, not rope.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2008.}\ 
When splinting a fractured limb with no exposed bone, the splint should extend past the joints above and below the wound.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：对无骨端外露的骨折伤员肢体固定时，要超过伤口上下关节。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Extending past the joints above and below the wound keeps those joints from moving.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2009.}\ 
When moving a person with a spinal fracture, at least two people should support and move them by hand.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：移动脊柱骨折的受伤人员，要有两名以上人员扶持移动。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  A spinal fracture patient's spine must be kept immobilized, not moved by hand-support alone.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2010.}\ 
If a fracture site is bleeding, first splint the limb, then stop the bleeding and bandage it.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：受伤人员骨折处出血时，要先固定好肢体再进行止血和包扎。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Bleeding must be stopped first, before the limb is splinted.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2011.}\ 
If a motor vehicle suddenly catches fire, which of the following actions is incorrect?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Slow down and stop as soon as possible \quad \textbf{B.} Evacuate in the downwind direction \quad \textbf{C.} Move the vehicle away from gas stations \quad \textbf{D.} Set up a warning sign}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车突然着火，以下做法错误的是什么？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Evacuate in the downwind direction  Evacuating downwind exposes people to smoke and fire, so this is incorrect.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2012.}\ 
When a motor vehicle is transporting explosives, flammable or explosive chemicals, or highly toxic or radioactive dangerous goods, if the police-approved designated route does not include a tunnel, the vehicle must not enter a tunnel.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车载运爆炸物品、易燃易爆化学品以及剧毒、放射性等危险物品，经公安机关批准的指定行驶路线不包含隧道的，不得进入隧道行驶。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Safety comes first: the approved route must not be changed without authorization.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2013.}\ 
While driving through a curve, Xiao Li's improper handling caused the vehicle to overturn, leaving him unconscious. What should a passing pedestrian do?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Perform CPR immediately \quad \textbf{B.} Repeatedly slap the victim's face \quad \textbf{C.} Check breathing before starting rescue \quad \textbf{D.} Pinch the philtrum (under the nose) hard}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：小李驾车经转弯路段时，因操作不当造成车辆倾翻，导致其昏迷，此时路过的行人应该怎么做？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. Check breathing before starting rescue  For an unconscious victim, breathing should be checked first before any rescue action.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2014.}\ 
If a motor vehicle's engine suddenly stalls while driving, which of the following actions is incorrect?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Turn on the hazard warning lights \quad \textbf{B.} Place a warning sign \quad \textbf{C.} Move the vehicle to a safe location \quad \textbf{D.} Stop immediately to inspect and repair it}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车在道路上行驶突然熄火，以下错误的做法是什么？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. Stop immediately to inspect and repair it  When breaking down, hazard warning lights should be turned on immediately, not an on-the-spot repair.}\par\smallskip

\section{Incidents, Emergencies \& Complex Conditions \;/\; 事故处理与应急}

\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2015.}\ 
Under defensive driving techniques, to attract attention, high beams may be used at night when meeting non-motor vehicles on narrow roads or narrow bridges.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：按照防御性驾驶技术要求，为引人注意，夜间在窄路、窄桥与非机动车会车时可以使用远光灯。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Low beams, not high beams, should be used when meeting oncoming traffic at night.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2016.}\ 
Under defensive driving techniques, when merging into traffic, scan your surroundings and leave a margin of safety: turn on the turn signal in advance, keep driving in a straight line, check left and right through the mirrors, and merge only after confirming it is safe.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶车辆汇入车流时，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，要环回视野、留有余地，应提前开启转向灯，保持直线行驶，通过后视镜观察左右情况，确认安全后汇入合流。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  The turn signal should be on for at least 3 seconds before turning the wheel.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2017.}\ 
Under defensive driving techniques, when passing through an intersection, scan your surroundings continuously and avoid fixating on any single object for more than 2 seconds, to prevent tunnel vision or staring.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：车辆通过路口时，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，要环回视野，要求眼睛不断扫视周边情况，避免注视一个物体超过2秒，防止出现视若无睹和凝视的情况发生。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Staring at the same object for too long causes visual fatigue, so fixation should not exceed 2 seconds.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2018.}\ 
Under defensive driving techniques, when opening the car door from inside, the driver should carefully check the front and rear surroundings and open the door with the right hand, without obstructing other vehicles or pedestrians.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：按照防御性驾驶技术要求，机动车驾驶人车内开车门时，应认真观察前后情况，在不得妨碍其他车辆和行人通行情况下，用右手开车门。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Vehicles should always park and stop on the right side.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2019.}\ 
When encountering a slow-moving elderly pedestrian crossing the road, under defensive driving techniques, it is acceptable to continuously honk the horn to hurry them along.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：行车中遇老人横过道路，行动缓慢，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，要引人注意，可持续鸣喇叭催促。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Motor vehicles must always yield to pedestrians and non-motor vehicles.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2020.}\ 
Under defensive driving techniques, when changing lanes, scan your surroundings and leave a margin of safety: turn on the turn signal in advance, observe carefully, keep a safe distance, and move into the new lane.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶车辆变更车道时，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，要环回视野、留有余地，应提前开启转向灯，注意观察，保持安全距离，驶入要变更的车道。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  The turn signal should be on for at least 3 seconds before turning the wheel.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2021.}\ 
Under defensive driving techniques, as long as the driver keeps scanning and confirms no vehicle is approaching from behind, it is acceptable to change lanes without using the turn signal.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：按照防御性驾驶技术要求，只要驾驶人不断环回视野，在观察后方无来车的情况下，不开转向灯就变更车道也是可以的。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  The turn signal must always be turned on before changing lanes.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2022.}\ 
When following another vehicle, the following distance does not matter much; under defensive driving techniques, matching the speed of the vehicle ahead is enough to prevent a rear-end collision.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：在道路上跟车行驶时，跟车距离不是主要的，只要按照防御性驾驶技术要求，保持与前车相等的速度，即可防止发生追尾事故。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Maintaining a safe following distance is what effectively prevents rear-end collisions.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2023.}\ 
Braking on muddy roads can easily cause the wheels to skid sideways or the rear to fishtail, leading to accidents. Under defensive driving techniques, when entering such a section, leave a margin of safety, slow down, and avoid emergency braking.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：在泥泞路上制动时，车轮易发生侧滑或甩尾，导致交通事故，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，进入该路段，行车要留有余地，减速慢行，尽量避免紧急制动。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  On muddy sections, drivers should slow down and not exceed 30 km/h.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2024.}\ 
If an oncoming vehicle forcibly overtakes and occupies your lane, under defensive driving techniques, you may refuse to yield and force the other vehicle to give way.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：行车中突遇对向车辆强行超车，占据自己车道时，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，可不予避让，迫使对方让路。}\par
