{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Safety comes first: avoid and yield whenever possible.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2025.}\ 
When a motor vehicle passes through an intersection at night with no traffic signals, under defensive driving techniques, the driver should scan the surroundings, carefully observe the intersection, slow down in advance, and attract attention by \_\_\_.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Using high beams \quad \textbf{B.} Using low beams \quad \textbf{C.} Using hazard warning lights \quad \textbf{D.} Alternating between high and low beams to signal}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车在夜间通过没有交通信号灯控制的交叉路口时，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，应当环回视野，认真观察路口路况，提前减速，要引人注意，\_\_\_。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. Alternating between high and low beams to signal  With no traffic signal, drivers must actively signal their presence to other road users.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2026.}\ 
When driving on a flooded road with non-motor vehicles on either side, under defensive driving techniques, attract attention by honking to alert non-motor vehicle riders that a motor vehicle is passing behind and to watch out; leave a margin of safety and anticipate their possible actions by \_\_\_.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Slowing down \quad \textbf{B.} Driving normally \quad \textbf{C.} Accelerating through \quad \textbf{D.} Honking the horn continuously}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：当驾驶车辆行经两侧有非机动车行驶且有积水的路面时，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，要引人注意，鸣喇叭示意非机动车驾驶人，后方有机动车通过，注意避让，要留有余地，预测非机动车驾驶人可能做的行动，\_\_\_。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Slowing down  On flooded roads, vehicle speed should not exceed 30 km/h.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2027.}\ 
When meeting an oncoming vehicle that is having difficulty and needs to borrow your lane, under defensive driving techniques, leave a margin of safety, anticipate what it might do, and \_\_\_.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Do not encroach on the other lane and drive normally \quad \textbf{B.} Signal the other vehicle to stop and yield \quad \textbf{C.} Accelerate while staying to the right \quad \textbf{D.} Yield and let the other vehicle go first whenever possible}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：会车中遇到对方来车行进有困难需借道时，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，要留有余地，预测该车有可能做出的行动，应\_\_\_。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. Yield and let the other vehicle go first whenever possible  Safety comes first: avoid and yield whenever possible.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2028.}\ 
Before exiting a roundabout, under defensive driving techniques, look far ahead, observe the exit direction in advance, attract attention by turning on the \_\_\_, and remind following vehicles to keep a safe distance.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Left turn signal \quad \textbf{B.} Hazard warning lights \quad \textbf{C.} Right turn signal \quad \textbf{D.} High beams}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶车辆驶出环岛前，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，要放眼远方，提前观察出口方向路况，要引人注意，开启\_\_\_，提醒跟进后车留有安全车距。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. Right turn signal  No turn signal is needed when entering a roundabout, but the right turn signal must be used when exiting.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2029.}\ 
While driving, when a non-motor vehicle cuts in ahead, under defensive driving techniques, consider the overall situation and \_\_\_, while also attracting attention by tapping the brakes to warn the following vehicle to keep a safe distance.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Honk a warning \quad \textbf{B.} Accelerate through \quad \textbf{C.} Proactively slow down and yield \quad \textbf{D.} Suddenly accelerate when close}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：行车中，遇非机动车抢行时，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，要顾全大局，应\_\_\_，同时要引人注意，通过点刹方式，警示跟进后车，注意保持安全车距。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. Proactively slow down and yield  Motor vehicles must always yield to pedestrians and non-motor vehicles.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2030.}\ 
When driving in the rain and encountering pedestrians walking on the road with umbrellas or raincoats, under defensive driving techniques, attract attention and leave a margin of safety by \_\_\_, and pass cautiously.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Driving at normal speed \quad \textbf{B.} Honking continuously to signal them to give way \quad \textbf{C.} Accelerating to go around them \quad \textbf{D.} Honking in advance and slowing down appropriately}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：雨天行车，遇撑雨伞和穿雨衣的行人在公路上行走时，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，要引人注意、留有余地，应当\_\_\_，谨慎通行。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. Honking in advance and slowing down appropriately  Visibility is poor in the rain, so a horn tap to alert pedestrians is appropriate.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2031.}\ 
When entering a roundabout, under defensive driving techniques, look far ahead, observe the roundabout in advance, \_\_\_, leave a margin of safety, and slow down before entering.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Turn on the right turn signal \quad \textbf{B.} Turn on the hazard warning lights \quad \textbf{C.} Turn on the left turn signal \quad \textbf{D.} No turn signal is needed}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶车辆进入环岛时，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，要放眼远方，提前观察前方环岛路况，\_\_\_，要留有余地，进入环岛前，提前减速。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. No turn signal is needed  No turn signal is needed when entering a roundabout, but the right turn signal must be used when exiting.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2032.}\ 
Under defensive driving techniques, when a motor vehicle enters a complex road section, the driver should have heightened safety awareness, maintain 360-degree situational awareness, and must not overtake a vehicle ahead that is turning left, making a U-turn, or overtaking.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：按照防御性驾驶技术要求，驾驶机动车进入复杂路段，要有更强的安全意识，保持360°环视能力，遇到前车正在左转弯、掉头、超车时，不得超车。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Overtaking should only be done when it is safe (when the conditions for overtaking are met).}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2033.}\ 
When changing lanes while driving, under defensive driving techniques, scan your surroundings, leave a margin of safety, attract attention, carefully observe your surroundings, and turn on the turn signal \_\_\_ to alert vehicles behind.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} At least 1 second in advance \quad \textbf{B.} At least 3 to 5 seconds in advance \quad \textbf{C.} No advance notice needed \quad \textbf{D.} Decide based on the situation}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：行车中变更车道，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，要环回视野、留有余地、引人注意，认真观察四周情况，\_\_\_开启转向灯，提醒后方跟车注意。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. At least 3 to 5 seconds in advance  The turn signal should be on for at least 3 seconds before turning the wheel.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2034.}\ 
If a motor vehicle breaks down during the day, obstructing traffic and difficult to move, under defensive driving techniques, the driver should attract attention by immediately turning on the \_\_\_, and place a warning sign 50 to 100 meters from the vehicle in the direction of oncoming traffic.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Outline marker lights \quad \textbf{B.} Rear position lights \quad \textbf{C.} High beams \quad \textbf{D.} Hazard warning lights}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车白天在道路上发生故障，妨碍交通又难以移动的，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，应引人注意，立即开启\_\_\_，并在距来车方向50米至100米处设置警告标志。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. Hazard warning lights  Warning sign placement: 50-100 meters on ordinary roads, over 150 meters on highways.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2035.}\ 
When approaching a bus stopped at a station, to guard against the bus suddenly pulling away or pedestrians darting out in front of it, under defensive driving techniques, scan your surroundings and leave a margin of safety by \_\_\_.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Slowing down, keeping sufficient distance, and being ready to stop at any time \quad \textbf{B.} Maintaining normal speed \quad \textbf{C.} Being ready for emergency braking at any time \quad \textbf{D.} Honking to alert and accelerating through}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：车辆驶近停在车站的公交车辆时，为预防公交车突然起步或行人从车前穿出，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，要环回视野、留有余地，应\_\_\_。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Slowing down, keeping sufficient distance, and being ready to stop at any time  Extra caution is required when passing a bus stop where buses are stopped.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2036.}\ 
When overtaking on the road, under defensive driving techniques, as long as a margin of safety is kept, the driver should maximize lateral distance and may cross a solid line to overtake if necessary.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：在道路上超车时，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，只要留有余地，应尽量加大横向距离，必要时可越实线超车。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Dashed lines may be crossed, but solid lines may not.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2037.}\ 
The five principles of defensive driving techniques are: look far ahead, consider the overall situation, scan your surroundings, \_\_\_, and attract attention.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Be bold yet careful \quad \textbf{B.} Be quick with hands and feet \quad \textbf{C.} Leave a margin of safety \quad \textbf{D.} Drive slowly}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：防御性驾驶技术五要领是：放眼远方、顾全大局、环回视野、\_\_\_和引人注意。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. Leave a margin of safety  This is a fixed set phrase to memorize.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2038.}\ 
When driving to a sharp curve in the road, under defensive driving techniques, leave a margin of safety, keep a safe driving line, and \_\_\_.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Use the opposing lane \quad \textbf{B.} Brake sharply and pass at low speed \quad \textbf{C.} Stay to the outside of the curve \quad \textbf{D.} Slow down substantially and keep to the right}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶车辆行至道路急转弯处，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，要留有余地，保持安全行车路线，\_\_\_。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. Slow down substantially and keep to the right  On sharp curves, vehicle speed should not exceed 30 km/h.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2039.}\ 
On a road without a center line, when the vehicle behind signals an intent to overtake, under defensive driving techniques, the vehicle ahead should consider the overall situation, scan the mirrors, stay aware of its surroundings, and \_\_\_.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Continue driving as before \quad \textbf{B.} Accelerate \quad \textbf{C.} Stop quickly and yield \quad \textbf{D.} Slow down and yield to the right when conditions allow}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：在没有道路中心线的道路上，遇后车发出超车信号时，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，前车应当顾全大局，扫视后视镜，保持对周围环境了解，\_\_\_。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. Slow down and yield to the right when conditions allow  When a following vehicle signals to overtake, the vehicle ahead should proactively yield when it is safe to do so.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2040.}\ 
On the road, a person's natural vision is suited to walking speed, and the average driver's line-of-sight lead time is 3-6 seconds; under defensive driving techniques, look far ahead and extend your line-of-sight lead time to 15 seconds.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：在道路上，人的自然视力适宜步行速度，一般驾驶人的平均视线提前量为3-6秒，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，要放眼远方，要将您的视线提前量提高到15秒。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Drivers must stay focused to ensure driving safety.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2041.}\ 
When encountering a highly distracted pedestrian, such as one talking on a phone, under defensive driving techniques, leave a margin of safety and attract attention by \_\_\_.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Honking only when close \quad \textbf{B.} Accelerating past on one side \quad \textbf{C.} Maintaining normal speed \quad \textbf{D.} Slowing down and honking to alert them}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：行车中遇到接听手机等注意力高度集中的行人时，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，要留有余地、引人注意，应\_\_\_。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. Slowing down and honking to alert them  Motor vehicles must always yield to pedestrians and non-motor vehicles.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2042.}\ 
When a sudden event occurs ahead or a pedestrian suddenly crosses the road, under defensive driving techniques, attract attention and adapt quickly: tap the brakes to slow down, use the flashing brake lights to alert the vehicle behind, make eye contact with the pedestrian to correctly judge their intent, and pass slowly only once it is confirmed safe.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：行车中遇到前方突发事件或行人突然横穿路面，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，要引人注意，要随机应变，采用点刹方式减速，并通过刹车灯频繁闪烁提醒后车注意，通过与行人的眼神交流，正确判断行人通行意图，确保安全情况下缓速通过。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Motor vehicles must always yield to pedestrians and non-motor vehicles.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2043.}\ 
When a vehicle ahead is moving slowly, under defensive driving techniques, scan your surroundings and keep your vehicle in a position with good visibility; leave a margin of safety, keep an appropriate following distance from surrounding vehicles, preserve an escape route in case of emergency, and \_\_\_.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Weave between the vehicles ahead \quad \textbf{B.} Stop and wait \quad \textbf{C.} Pass the vehicles ahead on either side \quad \textbf{D.} Line up and proceed in turn}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车在遇有前方机动车缓慢行驶时，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，要环回视野，应当使您的车辆保持在便于观察的位置上；要留有余地，与四周车辆保持有适当的跟车距离，保持出现紧急情况时自己的出路，\_\_\_。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. Line up and proceed in turn  When traffic ahead is moving slowly, vehicles should queue and proceed in turn rather than adding to congestion.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2044.}\ 
When driving on a flooded road with pedestrians on either side, under defensive driving techniques, attract attention by honking to alert pedestrians that a vehicle is passing and to watch out; leave a margin of safety and anticipate their possible actions by \_\_\_.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Accelerating through \quad \textbf{B.} Driving normally \quad \textbf{C.} Slowing down \quad \textbf{D.} Honking the horn continuously}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：当驾驶车辆行经两侧有行人且有积水的路面时，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，要引人注意，鸣喇叭示意行人有车辆通过注意避让，要留有余地，预测行人可能做的行动，\_\_\_。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. Slowing down  On flooded roads, vehicle speed should not exceed 30 km/h.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2045.}\ 
When merging into traffic on a main road, under defensive driving techniques, scan your surroundings and attract attention by turning on the turn signal 3 seconds in advance, and \_\_\_.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Merge directly without observing \quad \textbf{B.} Force your way into traffic \quad \textbf{C.} Observe carefully and merge only after confirming it is safe \quad \textbf{D.} Accelerate to merge, changing lanes repeatedly}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶车辆汇入主干道车流时，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，要环回视野、引人注意，应提前3秒开启转向灯，\_\_\_。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. Observe carefully and merge only after confirming it is safe  Merging into traffic must be done only when it is safe.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2046.}\ 
When driving on the road, speed should stay within the safe, legal limit; defensive driving techniques require looking far ahead, meaning the driver's line-of-sight lead time should be extended to 15 seconds.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶车辆在道路上行驶时，车速应当按照规定的速度安全行驶，防御性驾驶技术要求放眼远方，即要驾驶人将视线提前量提高到15秒。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Drivers must watch the road ahead and plan for it in advance to ensure driving safety.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2047.}\ 
The main effect of rain on safe driving is a slippery road surface and obstructed visibility. Defensive driving techniques require the driver to keep scanning the surroundings and leave a margin of safety by keeping a sufficient distance from the vehicle ahead.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：雨天对安全行车的主要影响是路面湿滑，视线受阻，防御性驾驶技术要求，机动车驾驶人要环回视野，眼睛要不断观察周围情况，要留有余地，保持与前车足够的行车距离。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  In rainy weather, slow down and maintain a safe following distance.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2048.}\ 
When a vehicle on a multi-lane road encounters abnormal behavior from the vehicle ahead, under defensive driving techniques, leave a margin of safety, keep a safe distance from surrounding vehicles, promptly anticipate the possible actions of relevant vehicles and people, and preserve a safe escape route in case of emergency.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：车辆在多车道通行遇到前方车辆出现异常时，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，要留有余地，要保持与四周车辆的安全距离，及时预测相关车辆、人员有可能做的行动，保持出现紧急情况时自己有安全行驶的出路。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Keeping a safe following distance gives enough time to react in an emergency.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2049.}\ 
A key feature of pedestrians in traffic is that their movement is often unpredictable and their direction can change suddenly. Under defensive driving techniques, when passing through a complex road section, drivers should have heightened safety awareness, maintain 360-degree situational awareness, observe both relevant and seemingly unrelated objects, make eye contact with pedestrians, and adapt as needed.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：行人参与道路交通的主要特点是行走随意性大，方向多变，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，驾驶人途经复杂路段，应要有更强的安全意识，保持360°环视能力，观察相关与不相关的物件，多与行人进行眼神交流，随机应变。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Motor vehicles must always yield to pedestrians and non-motor vehicles.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2050.}\ 
When a vehicle is driving slowly in congested traffic and another vehicle forcibly cuts in, under defensive driving techniques, consider the overall situation and \_\_\_ to ensure driving safety.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Honk a warning and refuse to let it in \quad \textbf{B.} Accelerate and stay close behind the vehicle ahead to block it \quad \textbf{C.} Proactively yield and always keep an appropriate following distance \quad \textbf{D.} Squeeze against the cutting-in vehicle to force it away}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：车辆在拥挤路段低速行驶时，遇其他车辆强行“加塞”， 按照防御性驾驶技术要求，应顾全大局，\_\_\_，确保行车安全。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. Proactively yield and always keep an appropriate following distance  Safety comes first: avoid and yield whenever possible.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2051.}\ 
When encountering children playing by the roadside, under defensive driving techniques, leave a margin of safety, slow down in advance, and drive through cautiously.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：行车中遇儿童在路边玩耍，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，要留有余地，要提前减速，谨慎驾车通过。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Motor vehicles must always yield to pedestrians in any situation.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2052.}\ 
When a vehicle on a main road approaches a junction with a side road, to prevent a collision with a vehicle suddenly entering from the side road, under defensive driving techniques, look far ahead, leave a margin of safety, and \_\_\_.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Slow down and observe in advance, drive cautiously \quad \textbf{B.} Maintain normal speed \quad \textbf{C.} Honk and pass through quickly \quad \textbf{D.} Accelerate through in advance}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：车辆在主干道上行驶，驶近主支干道交汇处时，为防止与从支路突然驶入的车辆相撞，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，要放眼远方、留有余地，应\_\_\_ 。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Slow down and observe in advance, drive cautiously  Safety comes first: slow down when it is warranted.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2053.}\ 
When driving through a complex road section, under defensive driving techniques, look far ahead, maintain 360-degree situational awareness, keep your vehicle in a position with good visibility at all times, and maintain an appropriate following distance at all times.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：在复杂路段行驶，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，要放眼远方，要求保持360°环视能力，要保证您的车辆始终处于便于观察的位置，在任何时候都保持适当的跟车距离。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  On complex road sections, control your speed and keep a safe following distance.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2054.}\ 
The main effect of fog on safe driving is low visibility and poor sightlines. Under defensive driving techniques, leave a margin of safety by increasing the following distance and attract attention by promptly turning on the \_\_\_.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Rear position lights \quad \textbf{B.} Low beams \quad \textbf{C.} High beams \quad \textbf{D.} Hazard warning lights}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：雾天对安全行车的主要影响是能见度低，视线不清，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，要留有余地，适当拉开与前车的跟车距离，要引人注意，及时开启\_\_\_。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. Hazard warning lights  In foggy weather, drivers should turn on fog lights and hazard warning lights.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2055.}\ 
When driving normally, under defensive driving techniques, look far ahead and anticipate road conditions, so that when approaching an obstacle you can \_\_\_.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Brake hard enough to stop \quad \textbf{B.} Swerve sharply to go around it \quad \textbf{C.} Dodge quickly and avoid a collision \quad \textbf{D.} Come to a smooth stop}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶车辆正常行驶时，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，要放眼远方，对道路情况的处理要有预见性，在接近障碍时能\_\_\_。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. Come to a smooth stop  Driving requires anticipating road conditions in advance.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2056.}\ 
When a vehicle has the right of way at an intersection but another vehicle cuts in, under defensive driving techniques, consider the overall situation, leave a margin of safety, and \_\_\_.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Rush through first \quad \textbf{B.} Accelerate through in advance \quad \textbf{C.} Drive normally under the right-of-way rule without yielding \quad \textbf{D.} Slow down and yield, stopping if necessary}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：车辆在交叉路口有优先通行权的，遇有车辆抢行时，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，要顾全大局、留有余地，应\_\_\_。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. Slow down and yield, stopping if necessary  Safety comes first: avoid and yield whenever possible.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2057.}\ 
Before entering a curve on a mountain road, under defensive driving techniques, leave a margin of safety and attract attention, and even if no vehicle is coming from the opposite direction, still \_\_\_.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Slow down, sound the horn, and keep to the right \quad \textbf{B.} May drive on the outside of the curve \quad \textbf{C.} May briefly use the opposing lane \quad \textbf{D.} May accelerate through along the curve's tangent}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：车辆行经山区道路进入弯道前，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，要留有余地、引人注意，在对面没有来车的情况下，也\_\_\_。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Slow down, sound the horn, and keep to the right  On sharp curves, vehicle speed should not exceed 30 km/h.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2058.}\ 
Starting April 15, 2016, from 7:00 to 10:00 and 15:00 to 20:00 daily (excluding Saturdays, Sundays, and national holidays), the city's 12 elevated roads (urban expressways) and tunnel/bridge restricted sections include the Yangpu Bridge, Nanpu Bridge, and Lupu Bridge.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：2016年4月15日起，每日7时至10时、15时至20时(周六、周日、国定假日除外)，本市12条高架(城市快速路)及隧桥限行路段包括杨浦大桥、南浦大桥、卢浦大桥。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Knowing exactly which sections are restricted matters for everyday driving; these three bridges are not part of the restricted list.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2059.}\ 
Starting April 1, 2016, this city abolished the nighttime driving test for small passenger vehicles.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：自2016年4月1日起，本市取消小型客车夜间考试。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Note that this applies specifically to 'small passenger vehicles'.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2060.}\ 
If a temporary license plate has expired but the vehicle is on the road because registration procedures are still being processed, this does not count as a violation.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：临时号牌过期，但因办理机动车上牌手续上道路行驶的，不属于违法行为。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  A motor vehicle without a valid plate may not be driven on the road.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2061.}\ 
When a motor vehicle turns left, changes to the left lane, prepares to overtake, pulls away from a parked position, or makes a U-turn, under defensive driving techniques, look far ahead, keep scanning your surroundings, \_\_\_, and make sure to leave a margin of safety for relevant vehicles.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Turn on the turn signal at the same time as turning \quad \textbf{B.} Turn first and then turn on the signal \quad \textbf{C.} If no other vehicles are present, the signal is not needed \quad \textbf{D.} Turn on the left turn signal in advance}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车向左转弯、向左变更车道、超车前、驶离停车地点及掉头时，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，要放眼远方，不断扫视周围情况，\_\_\_，确保为相关车辆留有余地。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. Turn on the left turn signal in advance  The turn signal should be on for at least 3 seconds before turning the wheel.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2062.}\ 
When a motor vehicle passes through an intersection with no traffic lights, signs, markings, or police direction, under defensive driving techniques, the driver should scan the surroundings and keep sweeping the intersection with their eyes while \_\_\_.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Passing through quickly \quad \textbf{B.} Slowing down \quad \textbf{C.} Speeding up appropriately \quad \textbf{D.} Maintaining driving speed}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车通过没有交通信号灯、交通标志、交通标线或者交通警察指挥的交叉路口时，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，应当环回视野，用眼睛不断扫视路口周围情况\_\_\_。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Slowing down  Extra caution is required at intersections with no signal control.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2063.}\ 
If, while overtaking, the vehicle ahead does not slow down or give way, under defensive driving techniques, the driver should consider the overall situation, keep the vehicle in a position with good visibility, and \_\_\_.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Attract attention by honking continuously and accelerate past \quad \textbf{B.} Look far ahead and forcibly accelerate past \quad \textbf{C.} Leave a margin of safety, abandon the overtaking attempt, and preserve an escape route in case of emergency \quad \textbf{D.} Scan the surroundings, follow closely, and wait for another chance to overtake}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶人在超车时，前方车辆不减速、不让道，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，要顾全大局，使你的车辆保持在便于观察的位置上，要\_\_\_。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. Leave a margin of safety, abandon the overtaking attempt, and preserve an escape route in case of emergency  Overtaking should only be done when it is safe (when the conditions for overtaking are met).}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2064.}\ 
A motor vehicle that unlawfully uses a dedicated lane is fined 500 yuan under Articles 37 and 90 of the Road Traffic Safety Law.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车违反规定使用专用车道的，依据《道路交通安全法》第37条、第90条的规定，处500元罚款。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Motor vehicles must drive in the lanes designated by regulations; the actual fine amount differs from what is stated here.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2065.}\ 
When a driver passes through a flooded road while driving, under defensive driving techniques, they should observe carefully, leave a margin of safety, and \_\_\_.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Take special care to slow down \quad \textbf{B.} Quickly accelerate through \quad \textbf{C.} Pass at normal speed \quad \textbf{D.} Accelerate through in low gear}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶人在行车中经过积水路面时，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，应注意观察，留有余地，\_\_\_。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Take special care to slow down  On flooded roads, vehicle speed should not exceed 30 km/h.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2066.}\ 
Driving against traffic does not include running a one-way street or occupying the oncoming lane to force through.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车逆向行驶不包括闯单行道、占用对向车道逆行抢道行为。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Illegal overtaking, failure to yield, or driving against traffic each incur 3 demerit points.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2067.}\ 
If another vehicle forcibly overtakes and occupies your lane, under defensive driving techniques, consider the overall situation, leave a margin of safety, and the correct response is \_\_\_.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Accelerate \quad \textbf{B.} Slow down and avoid as much as possible, even to a full stop if needed \quad \textbf{C.} Maintain the original speed \quad \textbf{D.} Block its path}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：行车中突遇对方车辆强行超车，占据自己车道，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，要顾全大局、留有余地，正确的做法是\_\_\_。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Slow down and avoid as much as possible, even to a full stop if needed  Safety comes first: avoid and yield whenever possible.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2068.}\ 
Under defensive driving techniques, when a driver gets out of the vehicle, they should scan their surroundings and leave a margin of safety by \_\_\_.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Opening the door and getting out immediately after stopping \quad \textbf{B.} Checking traffic ahead, then opening the door \quad \textbf{C.} Opening the door first, then checking behind and to the side \quad \textbf{D.} Checking behind and to the side first, then slowly opening the door with the right hand}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：按照防御性驾驶技术要求，机动车驾驶人下车时，应环回视野、留有余地，\_\_\_。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. Checking behind and to the side first, then slowly opening the door with the right hand  Before getting out, safety must be confirmed and the right hand used to open the door slowly.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2069.}\ 
Illegal lane occupation by motor vehicles mainly includes unlawfully using bus-only lanes, unlawfully using the emergency lane, and cargo vehicles using passenger vehicle lanes.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车乱占道，主要包括违法占用公交专用道、违法占用应急车道、货运车用客车道等违法行为。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Civilized driving means never occupying lanes reserved for other uses.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2070.}\ 
Pedestrian jaywalking mainly includes running a red light, not using the sidewalk, and climbing over barriers, but does not include failing to use the crosswalk.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：行人乱穿马路行为，主要包括闯红灯、不走人行道、跨越隔离栏等违法行为，但不包括不走横道线。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Safety first: pedestrians must obey the Road Traffic Safety Law, and failing to use the crosswalk is also a violation.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2071.}\ 
When passing a vehicle parked on the right, to guard against it suddenly pulling out or a door opening, under defensive driving techniques, leave a margin of safety by \_\_\_, leaving enough space to prevent a collision.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Leaving a lateral safety distance and slowing down \quad \textbf{B.} Maintaining normal speed \quad \textbf{C.} Honking the horn continuously \quad \textbf{D.} Accelerating past}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：行车中超越右侧停放的车辆时，为预防其突然起步或开启车门，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，要留有余地，应\_\_\_，留出足够空间，防止碰撞。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Leaving a lateral safety distance and slowing down  Overtaking should only be done when it is safe (when the conditions for overtaking are met).}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2072.}\ 
If a motor vehicle acquired by purchase, transfer, or gift has not yet been registered, it may only be driven temporarily after applying for a temporary license plate from the vehicle administration office.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：经购买、调拨、赠予等方式获得机动车后未注册登陆的，向车辆管理所申请临时行驶号牌后，方可临时上路行驶。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  A motor vehicle without a plate may not be driven on the road.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2073.}\ 
Illegal passenger transport mainly includes cars, online-hailed cars, and the 'five vehicle types': electric tricycles, standard three-wheeled motorcycles, two-wheeled motorcycles, disability vehicles, and electric bicycles operating as illegal passenger transport.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：非法客运，主要包括汽车、网络专车以及电动三轮车、正三轮摩托车、二轮摩托车、残疾车、电动自行车这“五类车”非法客运等违法行为。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Safe driving means refusing illegal passenger transport.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2074.}\ 
When a motor vehicle travels on a road with no traffic signals and encounters a pedestrian crossing the road, under defensive driving techniques, the driver should leave a margin of safety, anticipate the pedestrian's possible actions, and in advance \_\_\_.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Honk to make the pedestrian hurry across \quad \textbf{B.} Accelerate \quad \textbf{C.} Slow down or stop to yield \quad \textbf{D.} Drive around them}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车行经没有交通信号的道路，遇行人横过道路时，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，应当考虑留有余地，预测行人可能做的行动，提前\_\_\_。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. Slow down or stop to yield  Motor vehicles must always yield to pedestrians.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2075.}\ 
When a vehicle behind signals a request to overtake, under defensive driving techniques, scan your surroundings, and while keeping a safe distance from surrounding vehicles, \_\_\_.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Slow down promptly and move to the right to let it pass \quad \textbf{B.} Slow down \quad \textbf{C.} Accelerate while staying to the right \quad \textbf{D.} Do not yield}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：行车中遇到后方车辆要求超车时，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，要环回视野，扫视周边情况，与周边车辆保持安全距离的情况下，应\_\_\_。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Slow down promptly and move to the right to let it pass  When a following vehicle signals to overtake, the vehicle ahead should proactively yield when it is safe to do so.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2076.}\ 
If a ball suddenly rolls into the road while driving, under defensive driving techniques, look far ahead and \_\_\_.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Continue at the same speed \quad \textbf{B.} Swerve quickly around it \quad \textbf{C.} Slow down immediately and be ready to stop, in case a child runs after it \quad \textbf{D.} Drive over the ball}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：行车中突然有皮球滚到路上，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，要放眼远方，应\_\_\_。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. Slow down immediately and be ready to stop, in case a child runs after it  A ball rolling into the road suggests children may be playing nearby.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2077.}\ 
License-plate-related violations for motor vehicles include driving without a plate, using an expired temporary plate, defacing or obscuring the plate, having a plate but not mounting it, and using a fake or cloned plate.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车涉牌违法，包括无牌上路、临时号牌过期、污损遮挡号牌、有牌不装、假套牌等违法行为。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  A motor vehicle without a plate may not be driven on the road.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2078.}\ 
If the vehicle administration office has doubts about an applicant's eligibility, submitted materials, or declared matters, it may not investigate and verify the substantive content.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：车辆管理所对申请人的申请条件及提交的材料、申告的事项有疑义的，不可以对实质内容进行调查核实。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Any doubts must be investigated and verified.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2079.}\ 
The main effect of the nighttime road environment on safe driving is \_\_\_. Under defensive driving techniques, the driver should look far ahead with a line-of-sight lead time of 15 seconds, scan the surroundings continuously to avoid tunnel vision or staring, and attract attention by using short horn taps and switching between high and low beams.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Low visibility, which hinders observation of traffic conditions \quad \textbf{B.} Complex, ever-changing road surfaces \quad \textbf{C.} Reduced driver stamina \quad \textbf{D.} Drivers are prone to impulsiveness or hallucination}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：夜间道路环境对安全行车的主要影响是\_\_\_，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，机动车驾驶人要放眼远方，视线提前量应达到15秒；要环回视野，眼睛不断观察扫视周围情况，避免出现视若无睹和凝视现象，要引人注意，多使用短促鸣笛，变换远近光灯。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Low visibility, which hinders observation of traffic conditions  At night, drivers should maintain a safe speed.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2080.}\ 
When a vehicle reaches an intersection and encounters a turning vehicle cutting in, under defensive driving techniques, consider the overall situation, leave a margin of safety, and \_\_\_.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Proactively stop and yield \quad \textbf{B.} Maintain normal speed \quad \textbf{C.} Speed up to go first \quad \textbf{D.} Honk and go first}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：车辆行至交叉路口，遇有转弯的车辆抢行，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，要顾全大局、留有余地，应\_\_\_。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Proactively stop and yield  Safety comes first: avoid and yield whenever possible.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2081.}\ 
When a vehicle approaches a pedestrian crosswalk, per defensive driving technique (scan your surroundings, leave a margin of safety), you should \_\_\_.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Accelerate through \quad \textbf{B.} Stop immediately \quad \textbf{C.} Honk the horn to signal pedestrians to yield \quad \textbf{D.} First carefully observe pedestrians and non-motor vehicles, then pass slowly}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：车辆驶近人行横道时，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，要环回视野、留有余地，应当\_\_\_。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. First carefully observe pedestrians and non-motor vehicles, then pass slowly  Motor vehicles must always yield to pedestrians and non-motor vehicles.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2082.}\ 
If you notice the road ahead is congested, per defensive driving technique, you should consider the overall situation, keep your vehicle where it is easy to observe, leave a margin of safety, and preserve an escape route for yourself and nearby vehicles in an emergency; you should \_\_\_.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Keep weaving through traffic \quad \textbf{B.} Look for gaps to overtake vehicle by vehicle \quad \textbf{C.} Honk the horn to signal vehicles ahead to speed up \quad \textbf{D.} Line up and wait in order}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：发现前方道路堵塞，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，正确的做法是顾全大局，使你的车保持在便于观察的位置，要留有余地，保持出现紧急状况时自己及周边车辆的出路，\_\_\_ 。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. Line up and wait in order  The road is already jammed, so do not add to the congestion.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2083.}\ 
While a plate is being reissued or replaced, the vehicle administration office should issue a temporary plate valid for no more than 15 days.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：补发、换发号牌期间，车辆管理所应当核发有效期不超过15日的临时行驶车号牌。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  The original plate number stays the same, and the temporary plate covers the up to 15 days needed to reissue or replace it.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2084.}\ 
When reversing on an ordinary road, per defensive driving technique (scan your surroundings, make yourself noticeable), if you see a passing vehicle you should \_\_\_.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Keep reversing \quad \textbf{B.} Honk the horn \quad \textbf{C.} Stop and yield proactively \quad \textbf{D.} Reverse faster}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：在一般道路倒车时，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，要环回视野、引人注意，发现有过往车辆通过，应\_\_\_。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. Stop and yield proactively  Reversing must not obstruct the normal passage of other vehicles.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2085.}\ 
Starting April 15, 2016, vehicles with temporary plates from other provinces or cities are banned within (and including) this city's outer ring road.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：2016年4月15日起，本市外环线以内（含外环）禁止外省市临牌车辆通行。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  The ban actually took effect on April 10, 2016, not April 15.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2086.}\ 
To drive a motor vehicle on the road, you must display the plates, display the inspection and insurance stickers, and carry the vehicle registration certificate with you.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车上道路行驶，应当悬挂机动车号牌，放置检验合格标志、保险标志，并随车携带机动车登记证书。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  You must carry the driving licence and vehicle licence, not the registration certificate, along with the two stickers and plates.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2087.}\ 
While driving, if you need to borrow the opposing lane to go around an obstacle ahead but an oncoming vehicle has already approached the obstacle, per defensive driving technique (consider the overall situation, leave a margin of safety), you should \_\_\_.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Slow down or stop and let the oncoming vehicle go first \quad \textbf{B.} Speed up to get past first \quad \textbf{C.} Honk the horn to signal the oncoming vehicle to yield \quad \textbf{D.} Quickly occupy the lane to force the oncoming vehicle to stop and yield}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：行车中需要借道绕过前方障碍物，但对向来车已接近障碍物时，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，要顾全大局、留有余地，应当\_\_\_。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Slow down or stop and let the oncoming vehicle go first  When meeting oncoming traffic at an obstructed section, the side without the obstruction gives way first, unless the obstructed side has already entered the section.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2088.}\ 
When you encounter children while driving, per defensive driving technique (scan your surroundings, leave a margin of safety), you should \_\_\_.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Honk the horn \quad \textbf{B.} Slow down, and stop to give way if necessary \quad \textbf{C.} Quickly pass to one side \quad \textbf{D.} Speed up and go around}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：行车中遇儿童时，按照防御性驾驶技术要求，要环回视野、留有余地，应当\_\_\_。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Slow down, and stop to give way if necessary  Motor vehicles must yield to pedestrians in all circumstances.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2089.}\ 
A driver may apply at a vehicle administration office other than the one that issued the licence for renewal upon expiry, renewal upon reaching a set age, renewal due to information changes, renewal due to damage, renewal for a lower licence class due to a change in physical condition, and reissuance.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶人可以向核发地以外的车辆管理所申请有效期满换证、到达规定年龄换证、信息变化换证、损毁换证、身体条件变化降低准驾车型换证和补证业务。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  A driver living outside the issuing area may apply for these renewals at the vehicle administration office of their place of residence.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2090.}\ 
A driver may still drive a motor vehicle even if their driving licence has been lost or damaged.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶人的机动车驾驶证丢失、损毁的，仍然可以驾驶机动车。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Driving without a valid licence in hand is not permitted.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2091.}\ 
Pedestrian jaywalking mainly includes running red lights, not using the sidewalk, and climbing over road dividers, but does not include failing to use the crosswalk.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：行人乱穿马路行为主要包括闯红灯、不走人行道、跨越道路隔离栏等违法行为，但不包括不走横道线。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Failing to use the crosswalk is also considered pedestrian jaywalking.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2092.}\ 
Illegal motor vehicle parking mainly includes leaving a vehicle unattended, stopping temporarily with the driver still inside, and stopping haphazardly to pick up or drop off passengers.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车乱停车，主要包括人不在车内的停放、人在车内的临时停车、乱停靠上下客等违法行为。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Follow traffic law and avoid illegal parking in all its forms.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2093.}\ 
After the night-driving test was removed for small passenger vehicles, a simulated lighting-use test should be assessed instead.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：小型客车取消夜间考试后，应当考核模拟灯光使用项目替代。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Under the licensing rules effective April 1, 2016, small passenger vehicles no longer take a night-driving test.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2094.}\ 
Illegal passenger transport does not include electric tricycles, three-wheeled motorcycles, two-wheeled motorcycles, disability vehicles, and electric bicycles.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：非法客运不包括电动三轮车、正三轮摩托车、二轮摩托车、残疾车和电动自行车。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  These five vehicle types are exactly the ones classified as illegal passenger transport when used to carry fare-paying passengers.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2095.}\ 
Running red lights, riding against traffic, not staying in the designated lane, riding non-motor vehicles recklessly, and illegally carrying passengers are all non-motor-vehicle riding violations.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：闯红灯、逆向行驶、不按规定车道行驶、非机动车乱骑行、违法载人，都属于非机动车骑行违法行为。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Road safety comes first, so all of these count as riding violations.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2096.}\ 
According to the Shanghai Public Security Bureau's notice on strengthening road traffic safety management, cars engaged in illegal passenger transport do not include ride-hailing (network car-hailing) vehicles.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：根据《上海市公安局关于加强本市道路交通安全管理的通告》，从事非法客运的汽车不包括网络专车。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Unlicensed ride-hailing vehicles are also classified as illegal passenger transport under this notice.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2097.}\ 
No unit or individual may forge or alter a motor vehicle's registration certificate, plates, driving licence, inspection sticker, or insurance sticker.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：任何单位或者个人不得伪造、变造机动车登记证书、号牌、行驶证、检验合格标志、保险标志。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Forging, altering, or using forged or altered vehicle documents leads to confiscation, vehicle detention, up to 15 days detention, and a fine of RMB 2,000-5,000.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2098.}\ 
Maliciously, continuously, or excessively honking the horn on the road does not count as horn abuse.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：道路上恶意、连续、长时间鸣号不属于机动车乱鸣号。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Drive safely and courteously; excessive honking is prohibited and does count as horn abuse.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2099.}\ 
Starting April 1, 2015, National I emission-standard gasoline vehicles were restricted 24 hours a day within this city's outer ring road, and starting January 1, 2016, National II gasoline vehicles registered before 2005 were also restricted within the outer ring road.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：从2015年4月1日起，本市外环内全天24小时限制国I汽油车通行，2016年1月1日起，对2005年前注册的国II汽油车实施外环限行。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  This matches the actual phased restriction schedule announced by the city for older emission-standard vehicles.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2100.}\ 
Starting April 15, 2016, the traffic restriction hours for this city's 12 elevated roads (urban expressways) and tunnel bridges are 7:00-10:00 and 15:00-20:00 daily (excluding Saturdays, Sundays, and public holidays).\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：2016年4月15日起，本市12条高架(城市快速路)及隧桥交通限行管理措施，时间是每日7时至10时、15时至20时(周六、周日、国定假日除外)。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  This matches the restriction hours announced by the city's public security bureau for those 12 elevated roads and tunnel bridges.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2101.}\ 
Per the notice on further strengthening environmental management of in-use vehicles, owners of yellow-label vehicles were required to complete scrapping procedures by December 31, 2015; if not done in time, the vehicle's plates and certificate are declared invalid and the traffic police cancel the registration of the overdue yellow-label vehicle.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：根据《关于进一步加强本市在用机动车环保治理的通告》要求黄标车车主于2015年12月31日前办理机动车报废手续，逾期不办理的公告机动车牌证作废，由本市公安交管部门依法将逾期未办理的黄标车进行注销。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  The notice required yellow-label vehicle owners to scrap their vehicles by that deadline, after which the registration documents are voided under the relevant national law.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2102.}\ 
A person residing outside their household registration location may apply for a driving licence in the categories of large passenger vehicle, tractor-trailer, city bus, medium passenger vehicle, or large truck at their place of residence.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：在户籍所在地以外居住的，可以在居住地申请大型客车、牵引车、城市公交车、中型客车、大型货车准备车型的机动车驾驶证。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  These licence categories may indeed be applied for at the applicant's actual place of residence.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2103.}\ 
Blocking an intersection, running a red light, crossing the stop line, and stopping and waiting on a crosswalk or yellow grid marking are not motor vehicle intersection violations.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：滞留路口、闯红灯、超越停车线、在人行道或网格线停车等候，这些不属于机动车路口违法行为。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  All of these are classified as motor vehicle intersection violations.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2104.}\ 
A physical fitness certificate is valid for one year from the date of issue.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：身体条件证明自出具之日起一年内有效。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  It is valid for six months, not one year.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2105.}\ 
Starting April 15, 2016, during 7:00-10:00 and 15:00-20:00 daily (excluding Saturdays, Sundays, and public holidays), the traffic management measure for this city's 12 elevated roads and tunnel bridges is: small passenger cars with temporary plates, empty taxis, small passenger cars with out-of-province plates, and small passenger cars driven by probationary drivers are prohibited from passing.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：2016年4月15日起，每日7时至10时、15时至20时(周六、周日、国定假日除外)本市12条高架(城市快速路)及隧桥交通管理措施是：使用临时号牌的小客车、未载客的出租小客车、悬挂外省市机动车号牌的小客车、实习期驾驶员驾驶的小客车禁止通行。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  This matches the restriction measure announced by the city's public security bureau for those road segments.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2106.}\ 
Drivers aged 70 and above should have a physical examination once a year, and within 30 days after the end of the points cycle may submit a physical condition certificate issued by a county-level or higher (or military regiment-level or higher) medical institution.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：年龄在70周岁以上的机动车驾驶人，应当每年进行一次身体检查，在记分周期结束三十日内，可以提交县级或者部队团级以上医疗机构出具的有关身体条件的证明。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Under the new rules, a physical condition certificate from a qualified county-level or higher medical institution may be submitted for licence renewal.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2107.}\ 
Under Article 16(3) and Article 96(1) of the Road Traffic Safety Law and the Regulations on Application for and Use of Motor Vehicle Driving Licences, using forged or altered plates results in confiscation, temporary vehicle detention, up to 15 days of detention, a fine of RMB 5,000, and 12 demerit points.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：使用伪造、变造的机动车号牌的，依据《道路交通安全法》第16条第3项、第96条第1款、《机动车驾驶证申领和使用规定》的规定，予以收缴，暂扣该机动车，处十五日以下拘留、5000元罚款、记12分。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  If the act constitutes a crime, it must be prosecuted under criminal law instead of receiving only these administrative penalties.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2108.}\ 
A person may not apply for a city bus driving licence class if they bear equal or greater responsibility for a fatal traffic accident, have driven under the influence of alcohol, or had their driving licence revoked or cancelled less than ten years ago.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：有发生交通事故造成人员死亡，承担同等以上责任的；醉酒后驾驶机动车的；被吊销或者撤销机动车驾驶证未满十年情况之一的，不得申请城市公交车准驾车型。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Bearing equal or greater responsibility for a fatal accident downgrades the licence, and such drivers are permanently barred from class B or higher licences.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2109.}\ 
Temporarily stopping with the driver remaining in the vehicle does not count as an illegal parking violation.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：人在车内的临时停车不属于乱停车违法行为。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Any vehicle not parked according to regulations counts as illegal parking, regardless of whether the driver stays inside.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2110.}\ 
When applying for a transfer-in licence renewal, the applicant should confirm the application information and submit their identity document, driving licence, and physical condition certificate.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：申请转入换证时，应当确认申请信息，提交机动车驾驶人的身份证明、机动车驾驶证和身体条件证明。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  A driver whose household registration moves out of the original vehicle administration office's jurisdiction must apply for renewal at the new jurisdiction's office.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2111.}\ 
Starting April 15, 2016, the restriction measure for this city's 12 elevated roads and tunnel bridges is: during 7:00-10:00 and 15:00-20:00 daily (excluding Saturdays, Sundays, and public holidays), small passenger cars with temporary plates, empty taxis, small passenger cars with out-of-province plates, and small passenger cars driven by probationary drivers are restricted.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：2016年4月15日起，本市12条高架(城市快速路)及隧桥限行管理措施是：每日7时至10时、15时至20时（周六、周日、国定节假日除外），使用临时行驶号牌的小客车、未载客出租小客车、悬挂外省市机动车号牌的小客车、实习期驾驶员驾驶的小客车限行。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  This matches the restriction measure announced by the city's public security bureau for those road segments.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2112.}\ 
Under Articles 63 and 89 of the Road Traffic Safety Law, a pedestrian who climbs over road dividing facilities is fined RMB 50.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：行人跨越道路隔离设施的，依据《道路交通安全法》第63条、第89条的规定，处50元罚款。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Personal safety comes first, so this penalty under the Road Traffic Safety Law is correct.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2113.}\ 
A driver may still drive a motor vehicle after accumulating 12 demerit points but before their licence is confiscated or suspended.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶人在机动车记分达到12分但未被扣留、暂扣期间，可以驾驶机动车。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Once 12 points have accumulated, the driver may no longer drive.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2114.}\ 
Per the Road Traffic Safety Law implementing regulations and the Road Traffic Safety Law, a non-motor vehicle rider who fails to obey the non-motor-vehicle signal is fined RMB 50; if they refuse to accept the fine, their non-motor vehicle may not be detained.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶非机动车闯红灯，依据《道路交通安全法实施条例》第38条、《道路交通安全法》第38条、第89条的规定，非机动车不按非机动车信号灯表示通行的处50元罚款；拒绝接受罚款处罚的，不得扣留其非机动车。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  A rider who disobeys the signal is fined RMB 50, but if they refuse the fine the vehicle can in fact be detained.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2115.}\ 
Illegal lane changing mainly includes cutting into a queue, changing lanes across a solid line, forcing a lane change, and making consecutive lane changes.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车乱变道，主要包括遇排队加塞、实线变道、强行变道、连续变道等违法行为。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Road safety comes first, so all of these count as illegal lane-changing violations.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2116.}\ 
Motor vehicle plates must be mounted as required and kept clear and intact; they must not be deliberately obscured or defaced.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车号牌应当按照规定悬挂并保持清晰、完整，不得故意遮挡、污损。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Deliberately obscuring a plate while driving results in 12 demerit points in a single instance.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2117.}\ 
Per the notice on further strengthening environmental management of in-use vehicles, gasoline vehicles registered in this city at National II standard or below, and diesel vehicles at National III standard or below, may not have their emissions and safety inspections conducted outside the province or city. Owners of "yellow-label vehicles" must complete scrapping procedures with the traffic police by December 31, 2015, or the vehicle's registration certificate, plates, and driving licence will be voided under relevant national law.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：根据《关于进一步加强本市在用机动车环保治理的通告》中说明，在本市注册的国Ⅱ标准及以下的汽油车、国Ⅲ标准及以下的柴油车不得委托外省市进行排气污染检测和安全技术检测。有关“黄标车”车主于2015年12月31日之前向公安交管部门办理机动车报废手续，逾期不办理的，本市公安交管部门将依据《中华人民共和国大气污染防治法》、《机动车登记规定》等法律法规要求，将“黄标车”的机动车登记证书、号牌和行驶证作废。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  This restates the notice's actual requirements accurately.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2118.}\ 
Running a red light, not using the sidewalk, not using the crosswalk, and climbing over dividers are all forms of pedestrian jaywalking.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：闯红灯、不走人行道、不走横道线、跨越隔离栏，这些违法行为都属于行人乱穿马路。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Safety comes first, and all of these are classified as pedestrian jaywalking violations under road traffic safety law.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2119.}\ 
A driver may complete the licence review and submit the physical condition certificate either at the place where the licence was issued or elsewhere.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶人可以在机动车驾驶证核发地或者核发地以外的地方参加审验、提交身体条件证明。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  The licence review does not have to take place at the issuing location.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2120.}\ 
If a motor vehicle is driven on the road without the driving licence or vehicle licence at hand, how should the traffic police handle it?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Detain the driver \quad \textbf{B.} Confiscate the vehicle's plates \quad \textbf{C.} Revoke the driving licence \quad \textbf{D.} Detain the vehicle}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车在道路行驶，未随车携带行驶证、驾驶证的，公安机关交通管理部门应当如何处理？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. Detain the vehicle  Driving on the road requires two certificates (driving licence, vehicle licence), two stickers (inspection, insurance), and one set of plates at all times.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2121.}\ 
After the traffic police confiscate the driving licence of a driver who has accumulated the specified number of demerit points, what happens next?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Administrative detention is imposed by law \quad \textbf{B.} The driver undergoes education on road traffic safety laws and regulations \quad \textbf{C.} The driving licence is revoked \quad \textbf{D.} The vehicle is detained}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：公安机关交通管理部门对累积记分达到规定分值的机动车驾驶人，扣留机动车驾驶证，然后如何处理？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. The driver undergoes education on road traffic safety laws and regulations  After reaching 12 points, the licence is confiscated, and the driver must study and pass an exam to get it back.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2122.}\ 
For forging, altering, or using a forged or altered vehicle registration certificate, plates, driving licence, or vehicle licence, the traffic police confiscate the documents and detain the vehicle; what additional penalty may be imposed?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} A fine of RMB 200-2,000 \quad \textbf{B.} Up to 15 days detention plus a fine of RMB 200-2,000 \quad \textbf{C.} A fine of RMB 2,000-5,000 \quad \textbf{D.} Up to 15 days detention plus a fine of RMB 2,000-5,000}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：伪造、变造或者使用伪造、变造机动车登记证书、号牌、行驶证、驾驶证的，由公安机关相关交通管理部门予以收缴，扣留该机动车，还可以如何处理？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. Up to 15 days detention plus a fine of RMB 2,000-5,000  No unit or individual may forge or alter a vehicle's registration certificate, plates, licence, or inspection and insurance stickers.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2123.}\ 
Starting April 10, 2016, vehicles with out-of-province temporary plates are banned within (and including) this city's outer ring road; what will police officers do to violators?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Lawfully detain the vehicle \quad \textbf{B.} Penalize the vehicle for violating the prohibitory sign and order it to leave the restricted area immediately \quad \textbf{C.} Lawfully revoke the driving licence \quad \textbf{D.} Only penalize the vehicle for violating the prohibitory sign}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：2016年4月10日起，本市外环线以内(外环线)区域禁止外省市临牌通行，违者公安民警将：}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Penalize the vehicle for violating the prohibitory sign and order it to leave the restricted area immediately  When a vehicle violates a prohibitory sign, police may penalize it and order it to leave the restricted area at once.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2124.}\ 
Starting April 15, 2016, during 7:00-10:00 and 15:00-20:00 daily (excluding Saturdays, Sundays, and public holidays), what is the traffic management measure for this city's 12 elevated roads and tunnel bridges?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Small cars with temporary plates and empty taxis \quad \textbf{B.} Small cars with temporary plates, empty taxis, small cars with out-of-province plates, and small cars driven by probationary drivers are prohibited from passing \quad \textbf{C.} Small cars with temporary plates, empty taxis, small cars with out-of-province plates, small cars driven by probationary drivers, and dedicated ride-hailing cars \quad \textbf{D.} Small cars with temporary plates, small cars driven by probationary drivers, and empty taxis}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：2016年4月15日起，每日7时至10时、15时至20时(周六、周日、国定假日除外)本市12条高架(城市快速路)及隧桥交通管理措施：}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Small cars with temporary plates, empty taxis, small cars with out-of-province plates, and small cars driven by probationary drivers are prohibited from passing  This matches the restriction measure announced by the city's public security bureau for those road segments.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2125.}\ 
Within what time frame should a traffic police officer submit the administrative compulsory measure certificate to their traffic management department?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Within 24 hours \quad \textbf{B.} The same day \quad \textbf{C.} Within 2 days \quad \textbf{D.} Within 5 days}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：交通警察应当在（ ）将行政强制措施凭证上交所属公安机关交通管理部门。}\par

When a traffic police officer corrects a violator's behavior (motor vehicle driver, non-motor vehicle driver, pedestrian, or passenger) with a warning or education, what is the standard phrase the officer should use?\par

Please show your driving licence and vehicle licence \quad \textbf{B.} Under Article 89 of the Road Traffic Safety Law, since you refuse to accept the fine, your non-motor vehicle may be detained \quad \textbf{C.} Your (specific violation) violates road traffic safety laws and regulations; please obey traffic rules, thank you for your cooperation \quad \textbf{D.} Your (specific violation) violates road traffic safety laws and regulations; under Article ** of the Road Traffic Safety Law and Article ** of its implementing regulations (or local regulation **), you are fined RMB ** on the spot}\par
