\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2189.}\ 
Within Sichuan Province, ( ), pedestrians, passengers, vehicle owners, vehicle managers, and units and individuals involved in road traffic activities must, in addition to following national law, also comply with the Sichuan Implementing Measures for the Road Traffic Safety Law.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Railway construction workers \quad \textbf{B.} Vehicle drivers \quad \textbf{C.} Vehicle rental agencies \quad \textbf{D.} Vehicle dealers}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：四川省行政区域内的（ ）、行人、乘车人、车辆所有人、车辆管理人以及与道路交通活动有关的单位与个人，在遵守国家法规的同时还应当遵守《四川省<中华人民共和国道路交通安全法>实施办法》。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Vehicle drivers  Drive in a civilized way and follow the law; vehicle drivers are the group named in the regulation.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2190.}\ 
Driving an assembled (jerry-built) vehicle, or a vehicle that has reached the scrapping standard, on the road is punished with a fine of RMB 1,000 on the responsible person.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶拼装或者已达报废标准的机动车上道路行驶的，处相关责任人员一千元罚款。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Under the Sichuan implementing measure, this specific violation carries a RMB 1,000 fine for the responsible person.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2191.}\ 
When a motor vehicle is permitted to use a non-motor vehicle lane, it must yield to ( ), and its top speed must not exceed ( ) per hour.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Non-motor vehicles, 15 km \quad \textbf{B.} Non-motor vehicles, 20 km \quad \textbf{C.} Motor vehicles, 15 km \quad \textbf{D.} Motor vehicles, 20 km}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车按照规定借用非机动车道通行时应当避让（ ），且最高时速不得超过每小时（ ）。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Non-motor vehicles, 15 km  Under the Sichuan implementing measure, a motor vehicle borrowing a non-motor vehicle lane must yield to non-motor vehicles and stay under 15 km/h.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2192.}\ 
Fleeing the scene after causing a traffic accident, when it does not rise to a crime, is classified as ( ).\par
{\small \textbf{A.} A minor infraction \quad \textbf{B.} A serious infraction \quad \textbf{C.} A minor traffic violation \quad \textbf{D.} A serious traffic violation}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：造成交通事故后逃逸，尚不构成犯罪的，是（ ）行为。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. A serious traffic violation  Where the act constitutes a crime, criminal liability applies instead; short of that, it is classed as a serious traffic violation.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2193.}\ 
If a party will not leave an accident scene, the traffic police officer completes an on-scene record per procedure, has the party sign it, and then orders the party to leave the scene to restore traffic flow.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：发生交通事故，当事人不撤离现场的，交通警察按程序做好现场记录后，由当事人签名后，责令当事人撤离现场，恢复交通。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  After an accident is processed, the scene should be cleared promptly to restore normal traffic flow.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2194.}\ 
Illegally stopping another vehicle, ignoring warnings, and causing serious traffic congestion is a serious traffic violation.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：非法拦截其他车辆，不听劝阻，造成交通严重阻塞，是严重交通违法行为。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Under Article 99(1)(8) of the Road Traffic Safety Law, illegally intercepting or detaining vehicles and causing serious congestion or major loss is fined RMB 200-2,000 as a serious violation.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2195.}\ 
Driving without a driving licence, or while the licence is revoked or suspended, is classified as a minor infraction.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：未取得机动车驾驶证或者驾驶证被吊销、暂扣期间驾驶机动车的，属于严重违章。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Under the Sichuan implementing measure, this is fined RMB 1,000 for the responsible person and is classed as a serious traffic violation, not a minor one.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2196.}\ 
Children under 12 years old may not ride in the front seat of a motor vehicle.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车前排不得乘坐未满十二周岁的未成年人。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Passengers must wear seatbelts, and children under 12 may not sit in the front seat, per the Sichuan implementing measure.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2197.}\ 
Road traffic should follow the principle of giving priority to vehicles.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：道路通行，应当坚持以车为主的原则。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  People always take priority over vehicles, not the other way around.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2198.}\ 
Vehicle drivers, pedestrians, passengers, vehicle owners, vehicle managers, and units and individuals involved in road traffic activities within Sichuan Province must, in addition to following national law, also comply with the Sichuan Implementing Measures for the Road Traffic Safety Law.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：四川省行政区域内的车辆驾驶人、行人、乘车人、车辆所有人、车辆管理人以及与道路交通活动有关的单位与个人，在遵守国家法规的同时还应当遵守《四川省<中华人民共和国道路交通安全法>实施办法》。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  This implementing measure is specifically targeted at these groups within Sichuan Province's jurisdiction.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2199.}\ 
A motor vehicle's ( ) must not have text, images, or objects that obstruct the driver's view affixed, hung, or placed on them.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Front and rear windshields \quad \textbf{B.} Left and right side windows \quad \textbf{C.} Front and rear seats \quad \textbf{D.} Rear trunk or cargo area}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车（ ）不得粘贴或者悬挂、放置遮挡驾驶人视线的文字、图案或者物品。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Front and rear windshields  Article 13 of the Road Traffic Safety Law prohibits attaching, hanging, or placing view-obstructing items on the front and rear windshields.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2200.}\ 
When a motor vehicle enters or exits a road, or drives on a section without traffic signals, it should yield to pedestrians and non-motor vehicles crossing the road.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车进出道路或者在没有交通信号的路段行驶，应当避让横过道路的行人和非机动车。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Motor vehicles must yield to pedestrians and non-motor vehicles in all circumstances.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2201.}\ 
A motor vehicle on the road must not modify or add external lighting or signal devices.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：上道路行驶的机动车不得改装、加装外部照明、信号装置。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Vehicle owners may not illegally modify their vehicles.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2202.}\ 
Illegally installing a ( ) or warning lights is punished with a fine of RMB 1,000 on the responsible person.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Roof rack \quad \textbf{B.} Siren \quad \textbf{C.} Billboard \quad \textbf{D.} Movable seat}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：非法安装（ ）、标志灯具的，处相关责任人员一千元罚款。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Siren  Motor vehicles must not illegally install sirens or warning lights.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2203.}\ 
Forcing a driver to violate road traffic safety laws, regulations, or safety requirements, thereby causing an accident, when it does not rise to a crime, is punished with a fine of RMB 1,000 on the responsible person.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：强迫机动车驾驶人违反道路交通安全法律、法规及安全要求驾驶机动车，造成交通事故，尚不构成犯罪的，处责任人一千元罚款。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Where the act constitutes a crime, criminal liability applies instead of only this administrative fine.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2204.}\ 
A motor vehicle making a temporary stop on the road should stop in the ( ) direction.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Lower side direction \quad \textbf{B.} Left side direction \quad \textbf{C.} Opposite direction of travel \quad \textbf{D.} Direction of travel}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车在道路上临时停车应当按（ ）停车。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. Direction of travel  A temporary stop must not obstruct the normal passage of other vehicles and pedestrians, so the vehicle must face the direction of travel.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2205.}\ 
When a sidewalk is obstructed and cannot be used normally, vehicles should yield to pedestrians who use the roadway instead.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：人行道有障碍无法正常通行时，车辆应当避让借用车行道通行的行人。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Motor vehicles must yield to pedestrians in all circumstances.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2206.}\ 
When vehicles on both the left and right are changing into the same lane, the vehicle on the right should let the vehicle on the left go first.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：左右两侧车辆向同一车道变更时，右侧车辆让左侧车辆先行变更。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  The rule is the opposite: the vehicle coming from the right has priority to go first.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2207.}\ 
When passing through a signal-controlled intersection on a green light, a driver should give priority only to public buses from other directions.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：通过有交通信号灯控制的交叉路口，遇放行信号时，应当只让其他方向的公交车辆优先通行。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  The rule requires yielding to any vehicles and pedestrians from other directions who were already released first, not just buses.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2208.}\ 
Ignoring warnings and violating traffic control regulations is a serious traffic violation.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：不听劝阻违反交通管制规定的，属于严重交通违法行为。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Ignoring warnings while violating traffic control measures is classified as a serious traffic violation.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2209.}\ 
A plate that is deformed, damaged, faded, or has blurred characters may continue to be used.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：号牌变形、残缺、褪色或者字迹模糊的，可以继续使用。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  A deformed, damaged, faded, or illegible plate may not continue to be used.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2210.}\ 
A driver who has driven continuously for 6 hours must stop and rest.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶人连续驾驶6小时的，必须停车休息。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  The actual rule requires a rest after 4 hours of continuous driving, for at least 20 minutes.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2211.}\ 
When a motor vehicle stops temporarily on the road, it should park facing the direction of traffic, with the vehicle body no more than 50 cm from the road edge.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车在道路上临时停车应当按顺行方向停车，车身距道路边缘不超过50厘米。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Article 50 of the Road Traffic Safety Law sets the limit at 30 cm from the road edge, not 50 cm.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2212.}\ 
When passing through a road with standing water, mud, gravel, or dust, a driver should slow down or yield if there are pedestrians or non-motor vehicles present.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：行经有积水、泥泞、碎石或者易产生扬尘的道路，遇有行人或者非机动车时，应当减速慢行或者避让。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Motor vehicles must always yield to pedestrians and non-motor vehicles.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2213.}\ 
The front and rear windshields of a motor vehicle must not have text, patterns, or objects affixed, hung, or placed on them that obstruct the driver's view.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车前后风窗玻璃不得粘贴或者悬挂、放置遮挡驾驶人视线的文字、图案或者物品。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Article 13 of the Road Traffic Safety Law prohibits attaching or hanging items on the windshields that block the driver's view.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2214.}\ 
Fleeing the scene after causing a traffic accident, when it does not constitute a crime, is punishable by a fine of 1,000 yuan.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：造成交通事故后逃逸，尚不构成犯罪的，处一千元罚款。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Article 71 of Sichuan's implementing measures for the Road Traffic Safety Law sets a 1,000 yuan fine for fleeing after an accident that is not a crime.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2215.}\ 
The "Sichuan Province Implementing Measures for the Road Traffic Safety Law of the People's Republic of China" is a type of ( ).\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Local regulation \quad \textbf{B.} Departmental rule \quad \textbf{C.} System \quad \textbf{D.} Standard}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：《四川省<中华人民共和国道路交通安全法>实施办法》属于（ ）。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Local regulation  It is a local regulation specifically covering drivers, pedestrians, and vehicles within Sichuan Province.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2216.}\ 
When a motor vehicle stops temporarily on the road, the vehicle body must be no more than ( ) cm from the road edge.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 50 \quad \textbf{B.} 40 \quad \textbf{C.} 30 \quad \textbf{D.} 20}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车在道路上临时停车，车身距道路边缘不超过（ ）厘米。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. 30  Article 50 of the Road Traffic Safety Law sets this limit at 30 cm from the right edge of the road.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2217.}\ 
A long-distance passenger bus driver who drives continuously for 4 hours in the daytime, or continuously for ( ) hours at night, must stop and rest for at least 20 minutes.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 2 \quad \textbf{B.} 4 \quad \textbf{C.} 6 \quad \textbf{D.} 8}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：长途客运汽车驾驶人日间连续驾驶4小时、夜间连续驾驶（ ）小时的，必须停车休息，休息时间不少于20分钟。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. 2  Drivers must rest at least 20 minutes after 4 continuous daytime hours or 2 continuous nighttime hours of driving.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2218.}\ 
A child safety seat is a seat fastened to a car seat for children to sit in, fitted with ( ) equipment that restrains the child in a crash to maximize the child's safety.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Comfort \quad \textbf{B.} Restraint \quad \textbf{C.} Entertainment \quad \textbf{D.} Viewing}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：儿童安全座椅是一种系于汽车座位上，供儿童乘坐且有（ ）设备并能在发生车祸时，束缚着儿童以最大限度保障儿童安全的座椅。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Restraint  The restraint function of a child seat reduces injury to the child in an emergency.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2219.}\ 
When a motor vehicle stops temporarily on the road at night, the driver must turn on the ( ), clearance lights, and rear position lights; the driver must not leave the vehicle and must drive away quickly if it obstructs traffic.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} High beams \quad \textbf{B.} Low beams \quad \textbf{C.} Fog lights \quad \textbf{D.} Hazard warning lights}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：夜间机动车在道路上临时停车应当须开启（ ）、示廓灯和后位灯；驾驶人不得离开车辆，妨碍交通时应当迅速驶离。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. Hazard warning lights  Hazard warning lights should be the first thing switched on when stopping temporarily.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2220.}\ 
Violating traffic control regulations by ( ) is punishable by a fine of 1,000 yuan against the responsible person.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Entering a controlled area \quad \textbf{B.} Taking the wrong route \quad \textbf{C.} But being willing to correct it \quad \textbf{D.} Forcing through and ignoring warnings}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：违反交通管制的规定（ ）的，处相关责任人员一千元罚款。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. Forcing through and ignoring warnings  Article 71 of Sichuan's implementing measures fines 1,000 yuan for forcing through a traffic control point while ignoring warnings.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2221.}\ 
While driving, when changing lanes, a driver must not change two or more lanes consecutively ( ), nor change lanes frequently.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} At once, two lanes \quad \textbf{B.} At once, three lanes \quad \textbf{C.} Twice, two lanes \quad \textbf{D.} Twice, three lanes}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：行车中，变更车道时，不得（ ）连续变更（ ）以上或者频繁变更机动车道。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. At once, two lanes  Lane changes must be made one lane at a time, not multiple lanes in one move.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2222.}\ 
After a traffic accident, once traffic police have completed the on-scene record per procedure, if a party refuses to leave the scene, they will be forcibly removed, and the cost is borne by ( ).\par
{\small \textbf{A.} The insurance company \quad \textbf{B.} The violator \quad \textbf{C.} The vehicle administrator \quad \textbf{D.} The party involved}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：发生交通事故，交通警察按程序做好现场记录后，对拒不撤离现场的，予以强制撤离，所需费用由（ ）承担。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. The party involved  Under the traffic accident handling procedures, the party involved bears the removal cost and may also be fined for causing congestion.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2223.}\ 
When a motor vehicle stops temporarily on the road, the driver ( ) leave the vehicle, and if it obstructs traffic, should ( ).\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Must not; put up a warning sign \quad \textbf{B.} Must not; drive away quickly \quad \textbf{C.} May; get in and drive away immediately \quad \textbf{D.} May; put up a warning sign}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车在道路上临时停车驾驶人（ ）离开车辆，妨碍交通时应当（ ）。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Must not; drive away quickly  Temporary parking must not obstruct the normal passage of other vehicles and pedestrians.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2224.}\ 
When carrying a preschool-age child in the rear seat of a motor vehicle, ( ) must be used as required.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Seat belt \quad \textbf{B.} Grab handle \quad \textbf{C.} Child lock \quad \textbf{D.} A dedicated child seat}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车后排搭载学龄前儿童的，按规定使用（ ）。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. A dedicated child seat  For safety, young children must be seated in a dedicated child seat; children under 12 may not ride in the front seat unaccompanied.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2225.}\ 
When a sidewalk is obstructed and pedestrians cannot pass normally, vehicles should ( ).\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Speed up and pass \quad \textbf{B.} Slow down \quad \textbf{C.} Stop and look around \quad \textbf{D.} Yield to pedestrians using the roadway}\par

Stopping a motor vehicle (other than a commercial passenger bus) on an expressway (or urban expressway) driving lane, under Article 82(1) of the Implementing Regulations of the Road Traffic Safety Law, Article 90 of the Road Traffic Safety Law, and the Measures for Point Deduction, is punishable by a 200 yuan fine and ( ) demerit points.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 3 \quad \textbf{B.} 9 \quad \textbf{C.} 12 \quad \textbf{D.} 6}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶营运客车以外的机动车在高速公路（城市快速路）行车道上停车，依据《道路交通安全法实施条例》第82条第1项、《道路交通安全法》第90条、《道路交通安全违法行为记分管理办法》的规定，处200元罚款，记（ ）分。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. 9  Illegally stopping on an expressway or urban expressway carries 9 demerit points.}\par\smallskip

Among Shanghai's major crackdown on road traffic violations, one of the 10 key targeted violations is ( ).\par

\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2279.}\ 
How many vehicles can currently be involved in a property-damage traffic accident handled through "Quick Claim" (快处易赔)?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Two vehicles \quad \textbf{B.} One vehicle \quad \textbf{C.} Four vehicles \quad \textbf{D.} Three vehicles}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：目前“快处易赔”可以适用几辆机动车的物损交通事故？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Two vehicles  "Quick Claim" currently applies only to two-vehicle accidents, not single-vehicle or multi-vehicle accidents, and not to out-of-town insured vehicles.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2280.}\ 
"Quick Claim" does not apply if any of the following occurs: personal injury or death; no license plate (including an expired temporary plate), no driving licence, or no local insurance policy; involvement of alcohol or drugs; or a vehicle that cannot be moved.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：存在人员伤亡、无牌（含临牌）或无证或无本市保单、涉酒涉毒、车辆无法移动情形之一的，不适用“快处易赔”。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  These four situations exclude "Quick Claim"; call the police directly in these cases.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2281.}\ 
When an accident is handled quickly on-site using the online method and insurance claims are filed, the insurance company provides expedited claims service, reducing steps and shortening the processing time.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：现场采用线上方式快速处理交通事故，并办理保险理赔的，保险公司提供快速理赔服务，减少理赔环节、缩短理赔期限。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Article 13 of the Shanghai measures for quick handling of property-damage accidents guarantees expedited service for online and eligible offline quick-processing cases.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2282.}\ 
"Quick Claim" requires the parties to manually enter the license plate number and insurance policy information.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：“快处易赔”需要当事人手工输入车牌号码、保单信息。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Only the driver's name needs to be entered manually; the plate number is captured automatically.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2283.}\ 
After handling a traffic accident on-site through offline quick-processing, the parties may also go separately to their nearest road traffic accident insurance claims service center to assess damages and file claims.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：交通事故现场采取线下快处后，当事人也可以分别至就近的道路交通事故保险理赔服务中心办理定损、理赔事宜。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  With online quick-processing the parties may go separately, but with offline quick-processing they must go together.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2284.}\ 
In a two-vehicle accident, while Driver A uses "Quick Claim" to photograph the scene and collect information, Driver B can follow the "Quick Claim" WeChat account and scan Driver A's "Quick Claim" QR code to track progress in real time and avoid disputes. At which step of Driver A's "Quick Claim" process is no QR code generated for Driver B to scan?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} During the liability negotiation stage in "Quick Claim" \quad \textbf{B.} While taking photos of the scene in "Quick Claim" \quad \textbf{C.} After completing scene photos and tapping "move the vehicle" in "Quick Claim" \quad \textbf{D.} While collecting the driver's name and licence photo in "Quick Claim"}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：两车事故中，甲方驾驶员在使用“快处易赔”拍照、采集信息时，为避免争议，乙方驾驶员可以登录微信关注“快处易赔”公众号并扫描甲方驾驶员正在使用“快处易赔”二维码，实时知晓“快处易赔”处理进度。那么，甲方驾驶员在操作“快处易赔”时哪个环节不会生成二维码供乙方驾驶员扫描？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. While taking photos of the scene in "Quick Claim"  No QR code is generated while photos of the scene are being taken in "Quick Claim."}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2285.}\ 
For a traffic accident where property damage to the other party exceeds the compulsory traffic insurance liability limit, if the party has commercial insurance, the insurer pays the excess according to the fault share recorded in the self-negotiated accident agreement or the (simplified-procedure) traffic accident determination, within the scope and ratio set by the policy terms; if the party has no commercial insurance, or the loss exceeds the commercial policy's limit, the parties may negotiate or file a civil lawsuit.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：造成对方财产损失超过交强险责任限额的交通事故，其超出部分，当事人投保商业保险的，保险公司依据道路交通事故自行协商协议书或《道路交通事故认定书（简易程序）》中载明的当事人过错责任，在保险责任范围内按保险条款规定的比例承担赔偿；当事人没有投保商业保险或财产损失超过商业保险责任限额的，可协商处理或向人民法院提起民事诉讼。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  This describes the standard rule: commercial insurance covers the excess per the agreed fault share, otherwise negotiation or litigation applies.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2286.}\ 
Traffic accidents causing death or injury do not fall under the Shanghai Measures for Quick Handling of Motor Vehicle Property-Damage Traffic Accidents; the parties should protect the scene and call the police immediately.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：造成人员死亡、受伤的交通事故不适用《上海市机动车物损交通事故快速处理实施办法》，当事人应保护现场并立即报警。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Four situations exclude "Quick Claim": injury or death; no plate, licence, or local policy; alcohol or drugs; or an immovable vehicle.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2287.}\ 
For accidents handled through offline quick-processing at the scene, the parties and vehicles must go together to the same road traffic accident insurance claims service center to register, assess property loss, and file insurance claims.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：交通事故现场通过线下快处的，当事人及车辆应共同至同一道路交通事故保险理赔服务中心，进行登记备案、核定财产损失、办理保险理赔。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  With online quick-processing the parties may go separately, but with offline quick-processing they must go together.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2288.}\ 
"Quick Claim" has automatic license plate recognition: after photographing the plate, it automatically enters the plate number, policy details, and other information.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：“快处易赔”具有车牌号码自动识别功能，拍摄车牌照片后，可以自动录入车牌号码、保单等信息。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  "Quick Claim" automatically recognizes and enters the plate number and policy information from the photographed plate.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2289.}\ 
When online quick-processing is used at the scene, since the driving licence, scene photos, and other information have already been uploaded via "Quick Claim" and the electronic agreement is generated automatically, only the vehicle registration certificate, bank card, and insurance policy are needed when filing the insurance claim.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：现场采取线上快处的，因驾驶证、现场照片等信息均已通过“快处易赔”做好上传，电子版协议书也自动生成，所以在办理保险理赔时，只需要提供行驶证、银行卡、保险凭证等理赔材料。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  With online quick-processing, photos are already uploaded, so only the registration certificate, bank card, and insurance policy are needed at claims time.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2290.}\ 
Which type of information is shown on the agreement?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Commercial insurance policy number \quad \textbf{B.} Gender \quad \textbf{C.} Loss amount \quad \textbf{D.} License plate number}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：以下哪类信息显示在协议中？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. License plate number  The license plate number is always shown on the agreement.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2291.}\ 
If a suspected intentional accident or a staged fake traffic accident to defraud insurance is discovered, there is nothing to do but accept the loss.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：发现有故意肇事或制造虚假交通事故骗取保险金嫌疑的，只好自认倒霉了。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Suspected insurance fraud should be promptly reported to the public security authorities for investigation.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2292.}\ 
A traffic accident involving a motor vehicle with no license plate, no inspection certificate, or no insurance mark can be handled by self-negotiation under the Shanghai Measures for Quick Handling of Motor Vehicle Property-Damage Traffic Accidents.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：涉及无机动车号牌、无检验合格标志、无保险标志的机动车发生的交通事故可以适用《上海市机动车物损交通事故快速处理实施办法》进行自行协商处理。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Four situations exclude "Quick Claim": injury or death; no plate, licence, or local policy; alcohol or drugs; or an immovable vehicle.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2293.}\ 
In which situation may the parties, after safely photographing the accident scene, move the vehicle to a place that does not obstruct traffic and wait for police to handle it?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Injury or death \quad \textbf{B.} No valid driving licence \quad \textbf{C.} No license plate, no insurance, or no inspection certificate \quad \textbf{D.} Drunk driving or drug-impaired driving}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：哪种情形下，事故当事人在确保安全的原则下拍摄交通事故现场照片后，可以将车辆移至不妨碍交通的地方等候民警处理？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. No license plate, no insurance, or no inspection certificate  With no plate, insurance, or inspection certificate, the parties may safely photograph the scene and move the vehicle aside while awaiting police, unlike the excluded cases.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2294.}\ 
Parties who handle an accident via online quick-processing at the scene may go separately to their nearest road traffic accident insurance claims service center or the insurer's designated location to assess damages and file claims.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：交通事故现场采取线上快处的当事人，可以分别至就近的道路交通事故保险理赔服务中心或保险公司及其指定地点办理定损、理赔事宜。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  With online quick-processing the parties may go separately, but with offline quick-processing they must go together.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2295.}\ 
A property-damage accident involving a motor vehicle using a temporary license plate can be handled through "Quick Claim."\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：涉及使用临时行驶车号牌的机动车物损事故可以适用“快处易赔”开展事故快处。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  An accident involving a vehicle on a temporary license plate is not eligible for "Quick Claim."}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2296.}\ 
After a party requests remote traffic-police liability guidance via "Quick Claim" and the response times out, which action is not permitted?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Requesting remote traffic-police liability guidance again \quad \textbf{B.} Continuing to negotiate on their own \quad \textbf{C.} Requesting the police come to the scene \quad \textbf{D.} Calling "110"}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：当事人使用“快处易赔”申请交警远程定责指导超时响应后，哪种行为不被允许？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Requesting remote traffic-police liability guidance again  After a timed-out remote liability guidance request, the parties are not allowed to request it again.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2297.}\ 
When on-site offline quick-processing is used and the parties go to the same road traffic accident insurance claims service center within 2 working days after the accident to file insurance claims, the insurance company provides expedited claims service, reducing steps and shortening the processing time.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：现场采用线下方式快速处理交通事故，并在事故发生后2个工作日内共同至同一道路交通事故保险理赔服务中心办理保险理赔的，保险公司提供快速理赔服务，减少理赔环节、缩短理赔期限。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  For offline quick-processing, if both parties file claims together within 2 working days, the insurer also provides expedited claims service.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2298.}\ 
If a party using "Quick Claim" to request remote traffic-police liability guidance times out or fails to get a determination, the only option left is to fill out a paper agreement and register for damage assessment at the "Motor Vehicle Property-Damage Traffic Accident Insurance Claims Service Center."\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：当事人使用“快处易赔”申请交警远程定责指导但超时相应或定责失败了，就只能采取填写纸质协议书至“机动车物损交通事故保险理赔服务中心”登记定损方式处理。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  After a timed-out or failed remote liability determination, the parties may still continue negotiating themselves or request the police come to the scene.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2299.}\ 
A property-damage accident involving a motor vehicle using a temporary license plate is not eligible for "Quick Claim."\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：涉及使用临时行驶车号牌的机动车物损事故不适用“快处易赔”开展事故快处。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Four situations exclude "Quick Claim": injury or death; no plate, licence, or local policy; alcohol or drugs; or an immovable vehicle.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2300.}\ 
What must be manually entered in "Quick Claim"?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Compulsory insurance policy number \quad \textbf{B.} Accident location \quad \textbf{C.} License plate number \quad \textbf{D.} Driver's name}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：“快处易赔”必须由人工输入的是？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. Driver's name  Driver information must be entered manually; the plate is auto-recognized, and the policy number and location need not be entered.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2301.}\ 
When one party bears full responsibility, the non-liable party may claim directly against the fully liable party's insurer, provided the liable party authorizes it.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：对一方承担全部责任的，在全责方授权的前提下，无责方可以直接向全责方保险公司提出索赔。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  When the other party is fully liable, a claim can be made directly against that party's insurer.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2302.}\ 
An accident handled through on-site offline quick-processing (including off-road accidents) must simultaneously meet these conditions: it occurred within the city; it caused only property damage; and all colliding vehicles (including motorcycles) are covered by compulsory traffic insurance.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：现场采取线下快处的交通事故（含道路外交通事故）需同时满足以下条件：一是在本市境内发生；二是仅造成财产损失；三是碰撞各方为均已投保交强险的机动车（含摩托车）。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  All three listed conditions must be met at the same time for offline quick-processing to apply.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2303.}\ 
If a party disagrees with the remote traffic-police liability determination received via "Quick Claim," they may request remote liability guidance again.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：事故当事人不认可“快处易赔”收到的交通警察远程定责意见的，可以再次申请交警远程定责指导。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Requesting it again is not useful; the party should call the police immediately or continue negotiating instead.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2304.}\ 
What needs to be manually entered in "Quick Claim"?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} The accident scenario \quad \textbf{B.} License plate number \quad \textbf{C.} Home address \quad \textbf{D.} Accident GPS location}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：“快处易赔”需要人工输入的有？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. The accident scenario  "Quick Claim" requires the accident scenario to be entered manually.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2305.}\ 
If an accident qualifies for quick-processing and quick-clearing but the parties have not left the scene and called "110," the local traffic command center or officer on duty may guide them by phone to use "Quick Claim" to photograph the scene, then move promptly to a location that does not affect traffic, either leaving on their own or waiting for police.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：符合快处、快撤条件，事故当事人未撤离现场并拨打“110”的，事发地交通指挥台或执勤民警可以通过电话引导当事人使用“快处易赔”拍摄事故现场照片后，提示尽快撤离至不影响交通的地点自行撤离或等候民警到场处理。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  For accidents meeting the quick-processing and quick-clearing conditions, this phone-guided "Quick Claim" approach is permitted.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2306.}\ 
When a police officer must issue an accident determination on-site, besides issuing it the officer will also penalize any traffic violations according to law.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：需要民警现场开具事故认定书的，民警除开具事故认定书外，还将对违法行为依法处罚。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Any traffic violations found must be penalized according to law.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2307.}\ 
Which of the following steps can currently be completed through "Quick Claim"?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Paying out the loss \quad \textbf{B.} Purchasing insurance \quad \textbf{C.} Photographing the scene and moving the vehicle \quad \textbf{D.} Online damage assessment}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：以下哪个步骤目前可以通过“快处易赔”完成？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. Photographing the scene and moving the vehicle  The "Quick Claim" process covers photographing the scene, moving the vehicle, negotiating liability, and filing an insurance report; remote police guidance is available on disagreement.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2308.}\ 
Which type of accident liability cannot be selected in "Quick Claim"?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Full liability \quad \textbf{B.} Equal liability \quad \textbf{C.} Primary liability \quad \textbf{D.} No liability}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：哪种事故责任类型不能通过“快处易赔”选择？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. Primary liability  "Quick Claim" only offers full liability, equal liability, and no liability as options.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2309.}\ 
Under the Ministry of Public Security's Regulations on Traffic Accident Handling Procedures, if a vehicle in a property-damage accident can be safely moved and meets the conditions for self-clearing, but the parties insist on staying at the scene, the officer on duty will order them to leave; if this causes a traffic jam, the parties will be fined. If the driver has other traffic violations, those will also be penalized according to law.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：根据公安部《道路交通事故处理程序规定》规定，机动车发生物损交通事故，车辆能够安全移动并符合自撤现场规定的，当事人坚持不撤离现场的，执勤民警将责令其撤离；造成交通堵塞的，对当事人处以罚款处罚。如驾驶人有其他道路交通违法行为的，依法一并处罚。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Failing to clear the scene when required to self-clear results in a penalty under the regulation.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2310.}\ 
If the non-liable party's insurer has already paid the insured, that insurer may seek reimbursement from the fully liable party's insurer through the subrogation mechanism.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：无责方保险公司已经向被保险人赔付的，无责方保险公司可以按照代位求偿机制向全责方保险公司追偿。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  An insurer that has already paid a claim may seek recovery from the liable party's insurer through subrogation.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2311.}\ 
For a traffic accident that meets the quick-processing and quick-clearing conditions, the parties may leave the scene without first securing evidence (i.e., without using "Quick Claim" or a phone camera to document the scene).\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：符合快处、快撤条件的交通事故，可以在未固定现场证据的情况下（即未在现场使用“快处易赔”或手机拍照等方式固定现场证据）撤离现场。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Evidence must be secured, such as with "Quick Claim" or phone photos, before leaving a scene that qualifies for quick-clearing.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2312.}\ 
Using "Quick Claim" only requires taking five photos (an overall scene photo, both vehicles' plate photos, and both vehicles' damage photos), then tapping "done" and following the prompt to leave the scene.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：使用“快处易赔”只要拍摄五张照片（包括全景照、双方车牌号牌照片、双方损坏部位照片）并点击完成后，按提示撤离现场。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  The five required photos are one overall shot, one plate photo per vehicle, and one damage photo per vehicle.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2313.}\ 
When using "Quick Claim," at which step will a message be received?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} When selecting "no dispute over liability" \quad \textbf{B.} When selecting the accident scenario \quad \textbf{C.} When photographing the scene \quad \textbf{D.} When entering the driver's name and phone number}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：使用“快处易赔”时，在哪个环节将收到信息？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. When selecting "no dispute over liability"  A message is received when selecting "no dispute over liability" or when accepting the remote traffic-police liability determination.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2314.}\ 
The Shanghai Measures for Quick Handling of Motor Vehicle Property-Damage Traffic Accidents require that parties using offline quick-processing must secure scene evidence by taking photos or similar means.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：《上海市机动车物损交通事故快速处理实施办法》规定当事人采取线下快处时必须要通过拍照等方式固定现场证据。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Both online and offline quick-processing require photographing the scene as evidence.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2315.}\ 
The WeChat version of "Quick Claim" currently lets the parties confirm liability and other information by jointly entering the verification codes each received on their phones into "Quick Claim."\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：目前“快处易赔”微信版可以通过将各方当事人手机收到的相关验证码共同输入“快处易赔”的方式，确认事故责任等信息。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  The WeChat version of "Quick Claim" confirms liability by having both parties enter their received verification codes.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2316.}\ 
For car insurance claims with clear facts, clear liability, and a claim amount under 5,000 yuan, insurers should consolidate the claim documents, combining the claim application, authorization, inspection record, loss confirmation, and claim notice into an "all-in-one" document.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：对事实清晰、责任明确，且索赔金额在5000元以下的车险理赔，保险公司应合并索赔单证，可以将索赔申请、委托授权、查勘记录、损失确认、索赔告知等内容整合，推行“多合一”单证。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  This is one of "Quick Claim's" conveniences: eligible cases get a consolidated "all-in-one" document.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2317.}\ 
The WeChat version of "Quick Claim" currently confirms accident liability information via a handwritten signature.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：目前“快处易赔”微信版可以通过在手写签名的方式确认事故责任信息。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Liability is confirmed by both parties entering the verification codes received on their phones, not by a handwritten signature.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2318.}\ 
Traffic accidents involving vehicles carrying explosives, flammable or explosive chemicals, or toxic, radioactive, corrosive, or pathogenic hazardous materials do not fall under the Shanghai Measures for Quick Handling of Motor Vehicle Property-Damage Traffic Accidents; after calling the police, the parties may safely photograph the scene to secure evidence and move the vehicle to a place that does not obstruct traffic while awaiting handling.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：涉及载运爆炸物品、易燃易爆化学物品以及毒害性、放射性、腐蚀性、传染病病原体等危险物品车辆的交通事故不适用《上海市机动车物损交通事故快速处理实施办法》，当事人可以在报警后，在确保安全的原则下采取现场拍照等方式固定事故相关证据，将车辆移至不妨碍交通的地点等候处理。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Accidents involving hazardous materials are excluded from "Quick Claim" and require calling the police and awaiting handling.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2319.}\ 
Online quick-processing at the scene refers to the mode of using "Quick Claim" to secure and upload photographic evidence, collect information about the people and vehicles involved, and complete the liability determination online.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：事故现场线上快处指：使用“快处易赔”固定、上传事故现场照片证据、采集人员、车辆等信息，并在线完成事故责任确定的模式。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  The Shanghai measures define online quick-processing exactly this way.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2320.}\ 
What does not need to be manually entered in "Quick Claim"?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Compulsory insurance policy number \quad \textbf{B.} Accident location \quad \textbf{C.} License plate number \quad \textbf{D.} Driver's name}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：“快处易赔”无需人工输入的是？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. License plate number  The license plate number is auto-recognized, while driver information must be entered manually and the policy number and location need not be entered.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2321.}\ 
For an accident where both parties are at fault and each party's loss is within the compulsory traffic insurance limit, the insurers handle it under the "mutual collision, self-settlement" method.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：互为有责的事故，事故各方损失均在交强险责任限额以内的，保险公司按“互碰自赔”的方式进行处理。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  "Mutual collision, self-settlement" applies when both parties share fault and losses stay within the 2,000 yuan compulsory insurance limit with no injuries or third-party property damage.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2322.}\ 
In the remote liability guidance process, neither the request-acceptance response nor the liability guidance step has a time limit, so the parties should wait patiently.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：远程定责指导中的申请受理响应和定责指导两个环节没有时间限制，当事人应当耐心等待。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  "No time limit" is clearly incorrect; both steps do have time limits.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2323.}\ 
For parties who complete accident handling via "Quick Claim," the at-fault party may report the accident to the insurer on-site to obtain a case number, and the insurer will guide them through the subsequent claims process.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：用“快处易赔”完成事故处理的当事人，有责方当事人现场可向保险公司报案取得报案号，并由保险公司引导办理后续保险理赔事宜。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  This matches the standard "Quick Claim" process of on-site reporting to the insurer for a case number.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2324.}\ 
If a dispute over liability arises while using "Quick Claim" to handle a traffic accident, the parties may request remote traffic-police liability guidance through "Quick Claim."\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：当事人使用“快处易赔”处理交通事故过程中发现事故责任有争议时，可以通过“快处易赔”申请交警远程定责指导。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  "Quick Claim" offers full, no, and equal liability options, and remote traffic-police assistance is available if there is a dispute.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2325.}\ 
If a party using self-negotiation provides false information, preventing the injured party from obtaining compensation, the injured party may report it to the traffic police where the accident occurred.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：采取自行协商的交通当事人提供虚假信息资料，造成受损方无法获得赔偿的，可至事故发生地公安机关交通管理部门报案。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  If a dispute over self-negotiated handling cannot be resolved, the party should file a report with the police.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2326.}\ 
Traffic accidents involving a driver who has been drinking or has taken state-controlled psychotropic drugs or narcotics do not fall under the Shanghai Measures for Quick Handling of Motor Vehicle Property-Damage Traffic Accidents; the parties should protect the scene and call the police immediately.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：涉及驾驶人饮酒、服用国家管制的精神药品或者麻醉药品的交通事故，不适用《上海市机动车物损交通事故快速处理实施办法》，当事人应当保护现场并立即报警。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Four situations exclude "Quick Claim": injury or death; no plate, licence, or local policy; alcohol or drugs; or an immovable vehicle.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2327.}\ 
For accidents handled through on-site offline quick-processing, when filing a claim at a road traffic accident insurance claims service center or with the insurer, the parties must provide valid scene evidence, the self-negotiated accident agreement, or the (simplified-procedure) traffic accident determination, among other claim materials.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：现场采取线下快处的，交通事故当事人在道路交通事故保险理赔服务中心或保险公司办理保险理赔的，应向保险公司提供事故现场有效证据、道路交通事故自行协商协议书或《道路交通事故认定书（简易程序）》等理赔材料。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  When filing a claim after offline quick-processing, valid scene evidence and the accident agreement or determination must be provided.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2328.}\ 
For a property-damage accident involving a vehicle insured with compulsory and commercial insurance from another province or city, if it meets the quick-processing and quick-clearing conditions, the parties may secure scene evidence with phone photos, immediately move to a place that does not affect traffic, and handle it using the traditional paper-agreement quick-processing method.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：涉及持外省市投保交强险和商业险的机动车物损交通事故，符合快处、快撤条件的，当事人可以在现场通过手机拍照等方式固定现场证据后，立即撤离至不影响交通的地点，并采取填写纸质协议书传统快处模式处理。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  This meets the quick-processing and quick-clearing conditions, so the described approach is correct.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2329.}\ 
In which situation must the parties protect the scene and wait for police to handle it?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Involving transport of hazardous materials \quad \textbf{B.} A single-vehicle accident \quad \textbf{C.} A dispute over facts, cause, or compensation \quad \textbf{D.} Drunk driving or drug-impaired driving}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：哪种情形下，事故当事人保护现场并等候民警到场处置？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. Drunk driving or drug-impaired driving  In cases of drunk or drug-impaired driving, the parties must protect the scene and wait for police, unlike "Quick Claim"-eligible cases.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2330.}\ 
The Shanghai Measures for Quick Handling of Motor Vehicle Property-Damage Traffic Accidents provide that once parties who meet the quick-processing and quick-clearing conditions secure scene evidence with photos and complete the agreement, they need not exchange it for an accident determination at the police desk of the insurance claims service center, even if the property damage exceeds the compulsory insurance limit.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：《上海市机动车物损交通事故快速处理实施办法》规定，符合快处、快撤条件的当事人通过拍照等方式固定现场证据并填写协议书后，物损超过交强险责任限额的，也无需在道路交通事故保险理赔服务中心警务室换取事故认定书。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  As long as evidence is secured via "Quick Claim" and the agreement is completed, no accident determination exchange is needed even if damage exceeds the compulsory insurance limit.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2331.}\ 
If the parties dispute the facts of the accident (for example, unable to determine who changed lanes or who ran the signal), they can only call the police and wait for the traffic police to handle it.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：当事人对事故事实有争议（即无法明确谁变道、谁违反信号灯等），则只能报警等候交警处置。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  When there is a dispute over the facts of an accident, only the police can resolve it on-site.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2332.}\ 
If the party has no commercial insurance and the loss exceeds the compulsory insurance limit, or if property damage exceeds the commercial insurance limit, the parties may negotiate or file a civil lawsuit in the people's court.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：没有投保商业保险且损失超过交强险责任限额，或者财产损失超过商业保险责任限额的，当事人可协商处理或向人民法院提起民事诉讼。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  When a dispute cannot be resolved, negotiation or filing a civil lawsuit is the available recourse.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2333.}\ 
Whether a vehicle meets the standard for a "yellow-label" (high-emission) or old vehicle is determined by the public security department.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：车辆是否达到黄标车或老旧车的标准是公安部门制定的。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  The standard for high-emission or old vehicles is set by the environmental protection department, not public security.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2334.}\ 
When using "Quick Claim," at which step will a message be received?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} When selecting the accident scenario \quad \textbf{B.} When agreeing to the remote traffic-police liability determination \quad \textbf{C.} When selecting "liability disputed" \quad \textbf{D.} When entering the driver's name and phone number}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：使用“快处易赔”时，在哪个环节将收到信息？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. When agreeing to the remote traffic-police liability determination  A message is received when accepting the remote traffic-police liability determination or selecting "no dispute over liability."}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2335.}\ 
Making or answering phone calls while driving easily causes accidents; which of the following reasons is incorrect?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} The driver fails to observe road conditions adequately, leading to operational errors \quad \textbf{B.} The driver's attention is divided and cannot judge danger in time \quad \textbf{C.} Holding the wheel with one hand reduces control of the vehicle \quad \textbf{D.} The phone's signal interferes with the operation of the car's electronic equipment}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车时接打电话容易引发事故，以下原因错误的是什么？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. The phone's signal interferes with the operation of the car's electronic equipment  Phone use causes accidents through poor observation, divided attention, and reduced steering control, not through electronic interference.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2336.}\ 
Which of the following photos must be taken in "Quick Claim"?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Interior photo \quad \textbf{B.} Photo of the people involved \quad \textbf{C.} Photo of the vehicle registration certificate \quad \textbf{D.} Photo of the damaged parts}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：以下照片是“快处易赔”必须拍摄的？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. Photo of the damaged parts  "Quick Claim" requires photographing the damaged parts of the vehicle as evidence.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2337.}\ 
Which type of information is not shown on the agreement?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Phone number \quad \textbf{B.} Accident liability \quad \textbf{C.} Home address \quad \textbf{D.} Driver's name}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：以下哪类信息不显示在协议书中？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. Home address  The home address is not shown on the motor vehicle accident quick-processing agreement.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2338.}\ 
If the parties dispute liability while using offline quick-processing, they can only call the police and wait for the traffic police to handle it.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：当事人通过线下快处，对事故责任有争议的，只能报警等候交警处置。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  A liability dispute during offline quick-processing can only be resolved by calling the police for on-site handling.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2339.}\ 
A traffic accident involving a driver without a valid driving licence can also be handled by self-negotiation under the Shanghai Measures for Quick Handling of Motor Vehicle Property-Damage Traffic Accidents.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：涉及驾驶人无有效机动车驾驶证的交通事故，也可以适用《上海市机动车物损交通事故快速处理实施办法》自行协商处理。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Four situations exclude "Quick Claim": injury or death; no plate, licence, or local policy; alcohol or drugs; or an immovable vehicle.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2340.}\ 
Two quick-processing modes can be used at an accident scene: one is offline quick-processing, and what is the other?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Calling the police \quad \textbf{B.} Filling out an agreement \quad \textbf{C.} Online quick-processing, i.e. "Quick Claim" \quad \textbf{D.} Issuing an accident determination}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：在事故现场可以采取两种快处模式，一个是线下快处，还有一个是什么？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. Online quick-processing, i.e. "Quick Claim"  "Quick Claim" is the online quick-processing method.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2341.}\ 
Which of the following situations means "Quick Settlement Easy Claim" does not apply?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} No casualties \quad \textbf{B.} Alcohol or drugs involved \quad \textbf{C.} Holding compulsory traffic insurance issued in this city \quad \textbf{D.} A two-vehicle accident}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：存在以下哪种情形的，不适用“快处易赔”？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Alcohol or drugs involved  Quick Settlement does not apply when there are casualties, no local insurance, alcohol or drugs are involved, or the vehicle cannot be moved.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2342.}\ 
Offline quick handling of an accident scene means: instead of using "Quick Settlement Easy Claim", the traditional method is used, taking photos and manually filling out a Road Traffic Accident Self-Negotiation Agreement to determine liability.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：事故现场线下快处指：现场未使用“快处易赔”，而是采取传统的拍照、手工填写《道路交通事故自行协商协议书》并确定责任的模式。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Shanghai's implementation rules define offline quick handling exactly this way: traditional photos plus a manually filled self-negotiation agreement.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2343.}\ 
If there is suspicion of intentionally causing an accident or fabricating a traffic accident to defraud insurance money, it should be promptly reported to the public security authorities.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：发现有故意肇事或制造虚假交通事故骗取保险金嫌疑的，应及时向公安机关报案。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Suspected insurance fraud through a staged or fabricated accident must be reported to police for investigation.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2344.}\ 
After "Quick Settlement Easy Claim" generates the electronic agreement, which piece of information cannot be fully displayed on it?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} License plate number \quad \textbf{B.} Compulsory insurance policy number \quad \textbf{C.} Driver's name \quad \textbf{D.} Mobile phone number}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：“快处易赔”生成电子协议书后，协议书无法完全显示哪种信息？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Compulsory insurance policy number  In the parties' information on the generated electronic agreement, the compulsory insurance policy number cannot be fully displayed.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2345.}\ 
Currently "Quick Settlement Easy Claim" cannot be used for property-damage traffic accidents involving vehicles insured with compulsory insurance from another province or city.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：目前“快处易赔”不能适用外省市投保交强险的机动车物损交通事故。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Four situations bar its use: casualties, no plate/license/local policy, alcohol or drugs, or a vehicle that cannot be moved; call the police instead.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2346.}\ 
If a party does not accept the remote liability determination opinion received via "Quick Settlement Easy Claim", they may immediately call the police and wait for traffic police to respond by phone or in person, or they may continue to negotiate on their own.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：事故当事人不认可“快处易赔”收到的交通警察远程定责意见的，可以立即报警，并等候交通警察电话或赴现场进行处置，也可以继续自行协商处理。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  If the determination is not accepted, the only options are calling the police or negotiating privately.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2347.}\ 
If the parties to a traffic accident cannot move the vehicles themselves, they should protect the scene and immediately call the police.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：交通事故当事人不能自行移动车辆的，当事人应保护现场并立即报警。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  When the vehicle truly cannot be moved, the parties must protect the scene and call the police right away.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2348.}\ 
How many photos must be taken at minimum when using "Quick Settlement Easy Claim"?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Four \quad \textbf{B.} Three \quad \textbf{C.} Six \quad \textbf{D.} Five}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：使用“快处易赔”拍摄照片至少几张？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. Five  At least five photos are required as evidence: an overview of both vehicles, damage to your own vehicle, damage to the other vehicle, and both vehicles' license plates.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2349.}\ 
The insurance company may inspect the damaged vehicle and assess the loss based on valid evidence from the scene, the self-negotiation agreement or the simplified-procedure accident determination form, and the insurance contract, then negotiate specifics with the parties within the liability limits of the contract.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：保险公司可依据事故现场有效证据、道路交通事故自行协商协议书或《道路交通事故认定书（简易程序）》记载的事实和保险合同，对受损车辆进行查勘和定损，根据保险合同在赔偿责任限额内与当事人具体协商。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  The insurance company negotiates specifics with the parties within the compensation limit set by the insurance contract.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2350.}\ 
Under the principle of ensuring safety, the main steps for parties using "Quick Settlement Easy Claim" are: first, one party photographs and uploads scene images meeting the requirements, then all parties quickly move the vehicles off the scene; second, at a location that does not obstruct traffic, the parties upload their names, contact details and other information via the app; third, the parties determine liability based on actual fault via the app, and after verification code confirmation the system automatically generates an electronic agreement.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：事故当事人在确保安全的原则下，使用“快处易赔”主要操作流程有：一是事故任一方当事人使用“快处易赔”拍摄、上传符合要求的事故现场影像后，各方当事人将车辆迅速撤离事故现场；二是事故各方当事人在不影响道路交通的地点或场所，通过“快处易赔”上传事故当事人姓名、联系方式等信息；三是事故当事人通过“快处易赔”根据实际过错确定事故责任，经验证码确认后，系统自动生成电子版协议书。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  The steps of "Quick Settlement Easy Claim" are: photograph and move vehicles, negotiate liability, and report to insurance.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2351.}\ 
"Quick Settlement Easy Claim" does not support uploading photos from the album afterward; photos taken must be uploaded immediately.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：“快处易赔”不支持相册照片事后上传功能，使用“快处易赔”拍摄的照片即拍即传。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  The app requires uploading photos as they are taken.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2352.}\ 
How does "Quick Settlement Easy Claim" collect driving license information?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} By photographing the driving license \quad \textbf{B.} By entering the driving license number \quad \textbf{C.} By entering the license issuing authority \quad \textbf{D.} By entering the license file number}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：“快处易赔”如何采集驾驶证信息？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. By photographing the driving license  "Quick Settlement Easy Claim" mainly relies on the parties photographing the accident scene to collect driving license information.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2353.}\ 
If a party used offline quick handling but did not fix scene evidence (such as photos or video) before leaving the scene, and later asks traffic police to handle it, they must report to the public security traffic management department at the location of the accident.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：若当事人采取线下快处时未通过拍照等方式固定现场证据（如照片、视频等）并已经撤离现场，事后又请求交警处理的，则要至事发地公安机关交通管理部门报案。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Without photographic evidence, the only option is to file a police report.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2354.}\ 
Which of the following ways is currently NOT a way to access "Quick Settlement Easy Claim"?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Registering a "Quick Settlement Easy Claim" account to enter \quad \textbf{B.} Logging into WeChat and following the "Quick Settlement Easy Claim" official account \quad \textbf{C.} Following via a "Quick Settlement Easy Claim" WeChat contact card shared by a friend \quad \textbf{D.} Scanning the "Quick Settlement Easy Claim" QR code}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：以下哪种方式，在目前是无法进入“快处易赔”的？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Registering a "Quick Settlement Easy Claim" account to enter  "Quick Settlement Easy Claim" is a WeChat account; simply following it is enough, no account registration is needed.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2355.}\ 
If a collision with a building, public facility, or other facility causes damage, the parties to the accident do not need to call the police.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：碰撞建筑物、公共设施或者其他设施，造成设施损坏的，交通事故当事人可以不用报警。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  After hitting a building or public facility, the driver should mark the scene, move the vehicle to a spot that does not obstruct traffic, call the police, and wait for traffic police to handle it.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2356.}\ 
Currently, "Quick Settlement Easy Claim" can be used for a three-vehicle accident.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：目前三车事故可以适用“快处易赔”。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  "Quick Settlement Easy Claim" only applies to two-vehicle accidents, not single-vehicle or multi-vehicle accidents, nor to out-of-town contracted vehicles.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2357.}\ 
Which of the following steps currently cannot be completed via "Quick Settlement Easy Claim"?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Negotiating liability \quad \textbf{B.} Reporting to insurance \quad \textbf{C.} Online loss assessment \quad \textbf{D.} Photographing and moving vehicles}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：以下哪个步骤目前无法通过“快处易赔”完成？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. Online loss assessment  The steps handled through the app are photographing and moving vehicles, negotiating liability, and reporting to insurance; online loss assessment cannot be done through it.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2358.}\ 
If the conditions for quick handling and quick clearance are met but the parties have not yet left the scene, they should finish filling out the agreement at the scene before leaving.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：符合快处、快撤条件且尚未撤离现场的，当事人应当在现场填写协议书完毕后再撤离现场。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  When "Quick Settlement Easy Claim" conditions are met, there is no need to finish filling out the agreement at the scene before leaving.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2359.}\ 
If one party intentionally refuses or delays handling the compensation matter, the other party may directly file a lawsuit with the court.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：一方当事人故意不处理或拖延处理赔偿事宜的，事故当事人可直接向法院提起诉讼。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  If one party refuses or delays handling the accident, the other party may pursue litigation through the courts.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2360.}\ 
When using "Quick Settlement Easy Claim", the scene may be left after taking just three photos (including overview and damaged-area photos).\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：使用“快处易赔”只要拍摄三张照片（包括全景照、损坏部位照片）即可撤离现场。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  The app requires at least five photos (overview, both plates, both vehicles' damaged areas) before completing and leaving the scene as instructed.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2361.}\ 
If the conditions for quick handling and quick clearance are met and the parties have not yet left the scene, they should, while ensuring safety, use "Quick Settlement Easy Claim" or their phone camera to photograph the accident scene, then move as quickly as possible to a location that does not obstruct traffic.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：符合快处、快撤条件且尚未撤离现场的，当事人应当在确保安全的前提下，使用“快处易赔”或手机照相功能等拍摄交通事故现场照片，并尽快撤离至不影响交通的地点。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Once conditions are met, the vehicle can be moved to a safe spot that does not obstruct traffic after photos are uploaded.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2362.}\ 
Currently "Quick Settlement Easy Claim" only applies to no-damage traffic accidents between two motor vehicles; single-vehicle or three-plus-vehicle accidents can only be handled offline or via a formal accident determination.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：目前“快处易赔”只能适用两辆机动车的无损交通事故，单车或三车及以上事故只能采取线下快处或开具事故认定等方式处置。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  "Quick Settlement Easy Claim" only applies to two-vehicle, damage-free accidents. Note: two vehicles, no damage.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2363.}\ 
If the conditions for "Quick Settlement Easy Claim" are met and the parties have not yet left the scene, they should use the app at the scene to complete name and phone collection, liability determination, and insurance reporting.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：符合“快处易赔”适用条件且尚未撤离现场的，事故当事人应当使用“快处易赔”完成姓名、电话采集、责任确定、保险报案等流程。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  When conditions are met, parties should take photos and then leave the scene to complete the process; staying at the scene is dangerous.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2364.}\ 
"Quick Settlement Easy Claim" supports uploading photos from the album afterward.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：“快处易赔”能够支持事后相册照片上传功能。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  "Quick Settlement Easy Claim" does not support uploading album photos after the fact.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2365.}\ 
"Quick Settlement Easy Claim" can currently be accessed by logging into WeChat and following its official account.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：“快处易赔”目前可以通过登录微信平台关注“快处易赔”公众号。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  "Quick Settlement Easy Claim" is a WeChat official account that can be followed directly.}\par\smallskip

\section{Additional Questions A \;/\; 补充题库 A}

\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2366.}\ 
If a driver moves the accident scene after an accident in order to rescue an injured person, the original position must be marked.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶人在发生交通事故后因抢救伤员变动现场时要标明位置。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Any change in position must be marked to help with the later determination of liability.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2367.}\ 
If a motor vehicle breaks down at night on the road and is hard to move, the hazard lights, outline marker lights, and rear position lights should be turned on.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车在夜间道路上发生故障难以移动时要开启危险报警闪光灯、示廓灯、后位灯。}\par
