{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  With poor night visibility, hazard lights, outline lights, and rear lights must be turned on, and a warning sign placed 50 to 100 meters behind the vehicle.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2368.}\ 
In a road traffic accident, if the motor vehicle has no license plate, no valid inspection sticker, or no insurance sticker, the parties should protect the scene and immediately call the police.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：道路交通事故中，机动车无号牌、检验合格标志、保险标志时，要保护现场并立即报警。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Call the police when: a public facility is hit, plates/stickers are missing, the vehicle cannot move, there are casualties, there is a dispute, or drunk driving is involved.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2369.}\ 
When driving and encountering road maintenance vehicles or engineering work vehicles that are working, drivers should give way and avoid them.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：行车中遇到正在进行作业的道路养护车辆、工程作业车时要注意避让。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Civilized driving means yielding and avoiding vehicles at work.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2370.}\ 
For a traffic accident on a road that causes casualties and has very serious consequences, the parties may leave the scene on their own.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：在道路上造成人身伤亡、事故后果非常严重的交通事故，可自行撤离现场。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  When there are casualties, the scene must be protected and the police called immediately.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2371.}\ 
For a motor vehicle property-damage accident that should be self-cleared but is not, traffic police may not order the parties to leave the scene.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车发生财产损失交通事故，对应当自行撤离现场而未撤离的，交通警察不可以责令当事人撤离现场。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  If the vehicle should be moved but is not, traffic police can order it moved and fine 200 yuan.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2372.}\ 
When reporting an accident, you should give the police the location, injury status, and vehicle plate number to help them reach the scene quickly.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：事故报警时，要向交警提供事故地点、人员伤情、车辆号牌等信息，协助交警快速定位到达现场。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  State the location, injury status, and plate number clearly; other details can be given in person once police arrive.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2373.}\ 
If a traffic accident causes injuries, the parties should protect the scene and immediately call the police.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：发生交通事故造成人员受伤时，要保护现场并立即报警。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Call the police when: a public facility is hit, plates/stickers are missing, the vehicle cannot move, there are casualties, there is a dispute, or drunk driving is involved.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2374.}\ 
If a road traffic accident causes casualties, the injured must be rescued immediately and the police notified promptly.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：在道路上发生交通事故造成人身伤亡时，要立即抢救受伤人员并迅速报警。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  If the position changes while rescuing the injured, it should be marked to help with the later determination of liability.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2375.}\ 
In a road traffic accident, under all circumstances the scene must first be marked before leaving.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车在道路上发生交通事故，任何情况下都应标明现场位置后，先行撤离现场。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  The phrase "under all circumstances" in the question is too absolute.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2376.}\ 
In a property-damage traffic accident, if the parties have no dispute over the facts and cause, they may leave the scene first.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车发生财产损失交通事故，当事人对事实及成因无争议的可先撤离现场。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  For property-damage accidents with no dispute, take photos and leave promptly to avoid congestion.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2377.}\ 
If a minor traffic accident on the road obstructs traffic, the vehicles do not need to be moved.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车在道路上发生轻微交通事故且妨碍交通时，不需移动。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Traffic must never be obstructed under any circumstances.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2378.}\ 
For a minor property-damage traffic accident that should be self-cleared but is not, traffic police have the right to order the parties to leave the scene.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车发生轻微财产损失的交通事故，对应当自行撤离现场而未撤离的，交通警察有权责令当事人撤离现场。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Vehicles that should be moved must be moved promptly so as not to obstruct traffic.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2379.}\ 
If a road traffic accident causes casualties, the driver must report it to the police.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车在道路上发生交通事故造成人身伤亡的，驾驶人必须报警。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Accidents with casualties must be reported to and handled by the police.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2380.}\ 
In a property-damage traffic accident, if the parties should have left the scene but did not, causing a traffic jam, the driver may be fined 200 yuan.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车发生财产损失交通事故，对应当自行撤离现场而未撤离造成交通堵塞的，可以对驾驶人处以200元罚款。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  If the vehicle should be moved but is not, traffic police can order it moved and fine 200 yuan.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2381.}\ 
After a minor scrape accident, if both drivers argue and insist on waiting at the scene for police, causing road congestion, this behavior will be fined.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：车辆发生轻微剐蹭事故，双方驾驶人争执不下，坚持在原地等待警察来处理，造成路面堵塞，该行为会受到罚款的处罚。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  If the vehicle should be moved but is not, traffic police can order it moved and fine 200 yuan.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2382.}\ 
After a road traffic accident, the vehicle must immediately be moved to the roadside.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车在道路上发生交通事故要立即将车移到路边。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  If a road accident causes no casualties and there is no dispute, the parties may leave the scene at once and negotiate privately.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2383.}\ 
In a road traffic accident, if the parties cannot move the vehicles themselves, they should protect the scene and immediately call the police.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车在道路上发生交通事故，当事人不能自行移动车辆的，应当保护现场并立即报警。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  If the problem cannot be resolved, seek help from the police.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2384.}\ 
In a road traffic accident, if a driver is suspected of drinking or being drunk, the parties should protect the scene and immediately call the police.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：道路交通事故中，驾驶人有饮酒、醉酒嫌疑时，要保护现场并立即报警。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Call the police when: a public facility is hit, plates/stickers are missing, the vehicle cannot move, there are casualties, there is a dispute, or drunk driving is involved.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2385.}\ 
In a traffic accident between motor vehicles, regardless of whether there are casualties, the parties may negotiate privately as long as both agree.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车之间发生交通事故，不管是否有人员伤亡，只要双方当事人同意，都可自行协商解决。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Only accidents with no casualties and no dispute can be settled by the parties leaving and negotiating privately.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2386.}\ 
When driving and encountering fire trucks, ambulances, or emergency engineering vehicles performing urgent duties, drivers should yield promptly.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：行车中遇到执行紧急任务的消防车、救护车、工程救险车时要及时让行。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Special-purpose vehicles performing urgent duties have right of way.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2387.}\ 
After a property-damage traffic accident, if the parties have no dispute over the facts and cause and move the vehicles, they need to photograph the scene or mark the vehicles' original positions.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车发生财产损失交通事故后，当事人对事实及成因无争议移动车辆时需要对现场拍照或者标划停车位置。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  For property-damage accidents with no dispute, take photos and leave promptly to avoid congestion.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2388.}\ 
After a minor scrape between two motor vehicles, to guarantee a claim can be made, the parties must wait for insurance company staff to arrive and assess before leaving the scene.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：两辆机动车发生轻微碰擦事故后，为保证理赔，必须等保险公司人员到场鉴定后才能撤离现场。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  For a minor accident with no dispute and no casualties, the parties should leave the scene promptly.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2389.}\ 
After colliding with a building or public facility, a driver may leave the scene immediately.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车碰撞建筑物、公共设施后可即行撤离现场。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Leaving the scene immediately in this case will be treated as hit-and-run.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2390.}\ 
How should a minor road traffic accident with no casualties and no dispute be handled?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Protect the scene, then negotiate \quad \textbf{B.} Do not move the vehicle \quad \textbf{C.} Direct other vehicles to detour around it \quad \textbf{D.} Leave the scene and negotiate privately}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：在道路上发生未造成人员伤亡且无争议的轻微交通事故如何处置？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. Leave the scene and negotiate privately  Try to avoid obstructing traffic and causing congestion.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{14\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2391.}\ 
[Image] How should this type of single-vehicle accident be handled?\par
\smallskip\begin{center}\includegraphics[width=6cm,height=4cm,keepaspectratio]{work/img/201904101025322s8roi63ziffb9zsppff7q.jpg}\end{center}\smallskip
{\small \textbf{A.} No need to call the police \quad \textbf{B.} Call the police \quad \textbf{C.} Contact the road administration department directly for compensation \quad \textbf{D.} Contact the greening department directly}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：遇到这种单方交通事故，应如何处理？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Call the police  When public property is damaged in an accident, the police should be called immediately to await a liability determination.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2392.}\ 
In which of the following traffic accidents involving a motor vehicle may the parties settle it by private negotiation?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} The other party has been drinking \quad \textbf{B.} There is a dispute over the facts and cause \quad \textbf{C.} No casualties occurred, and there is no dispute over the facts and cause \quad \textbf{D.} Casualties occurred}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车发生以下交通事故，哪种情况适用自行协商解决？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. No casualties occurred, and there is no dispute over the facts and cause  Accidents with casualties or disputes must be reported to police immediately.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{14\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2393.}\ 
[Image] In this situation, how should the vehicle ahead drive?\par
\smallskip\begin{center}\includegraphics[width=6cm,height=4cm,keepaspectratio]{work/img/20190410102532uk2puenqeqyb9aodo86yuv.jpg}\end{center}\smallskip
{\small \textbf{A.} Drive normally \quad \textbf{B.} Yield promptly \quad \textbf{C.} Drive with hazard lights on \quad \textbf{D.} Must not change lanes}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：在这种情形中前车怎样行驶？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Yield promptly  Vehicles must yield to police cars, fire trucks, ambulances, and emergency engineering vehicles performing duties.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2394.}\ 
If a traffic accident involving a motor vehicle causes only property damage, but there is a dispute over the facts and cause, what should be done?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Call the police promptly \quad \textbf{B.} Block the road and keep arguing \quad \textbf{C.} Find a mediator to help resolve it \quad \textbf{D.} Negotiate the compensation privately}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车发生交通事故，仅造成财产损失的，但是对交通事故事实及成因有争议的，应当怎么处理？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Call the police promptly  Whenever there is a dispute in a traffic accident, the police should be called immediately.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2395.}\ 
After an accident with no casualties and only minor property damage, which of the following is the correct approach?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Must call the police and wait for them to handle it \quad \textbf{B.} Drive away from the scene \quad \textbf{C.} While ensuring safety, photograph the scene, then move the vehicle to the roadside or another spot that does not obstruct traffic \quad \textbf{D.} Stay parked at the scene without moving}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：发生无人员伤亡的、财产轻微损失的交通事故后，以下做法正确的是什么？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. While ensuring safety, photograph the scene, then move the vehicle to the roadside or another spot that does not obstruct traffic  Traffic police have the authority to act if a vehicle that should be moved is not, causing congestion.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2396.}\ 
If a traffic accident involving a motor vehicle causes no casualties and liability is clear with no dispute between the two parties, how should it be handled?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Protect the scene, then negotiate \quad \textbf{B.} Do not move the vehicle \quad \textbf{C.} Direct other vehicles to detour around it \quad \textbf{D.} Leave the scene and negotiate privately}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车发生交通事故未造成人身伤亡的，责任明确双方无争议时，应当如何处置？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. Leave the scene and negotiate privately  If the scene is not left promptly, it should be reported quickly to the traffic police on duty or the traffic management department.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2397.}\ 
In a minor property-damage accident between motor vehicles with no dispute over facts and cause, after photographing or marking the vehicles' positions while ensuring safety, the parties may leave the scene to negotiate compensation privately. What is the main purpose of this?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Both sides suffered losses \quad \textbf{B.} Finding a witness is enough, no need to call police \quad \textbf{C.} To restore traffic quickly and avoid congestion \quad \textbf{D.} The consequences are minor, so no compensation is needed}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车之间发生交通事故造成轻微财产损失，当事人对事实及成因无争议时，在确保安全的原则下，对现场拍照或标划事故车辆现场位置后，可自行撤离现场处理损害赔偿事宜，主要目的是什么？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. To restore traffic quickly and avoid congestion  Traffic police have the authority to act if a vehicle that should be moved is not, causing congestion.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2398.}\ 
In which of the following situations should the parties protect the scene and immediately call the police after a traffic accident?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} No casualties occurred \quad \textbf{B.} No property-damage accident occurred \quad \textbf{C.} No public facilities or buildings were damaged \quad \textbf{D.} The driver is suspected of drunk driving}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：发生交通事故时，下列哪种情况下当事人应当保护现场并立即报警？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. The driver is suspected of drunk driving  If a driver is suspected of drunk driving, the scene must be protected and the police called immediately to assist.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{14\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2399.}\ 
[Image] In the traffic accident shown below, which statement about the liability determination is correct?\par
\smallskip\begin{center}\includegraphics[width=6cm,height=4cm,keepaspectratio]{work/img/201904101025402qyevnwhy69hunvmqb17qc.jpg}\end{center}\smallskip
{\small \textbf{A.} Vehicle B ran a signal, so B bears full responsibility \quad \textbf{B.} Vehicle B must not obstruct through-traffic that has right of way, so B bears full responsibility \quad \textbf{C.} Through-traffic must not obstruct left-turning vehicles, so A bears full responsibility \quad \textbf{D.} The vehicle on the right has right of way, so B bears full responsibility}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：在下图所示的交通事故中，有关事故责任认定，正确的说法是什么？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Vehicle B must not obstruct through-traffic that has right of way, so B bears full responsibility  Right turns yield to left turns, left turns yield to through traffic, and turning vehicles yield to through traffic.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{14\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2400.}\ 
[Image] In the traffic accident shown below, which statement about the liability determination is correct?\par
\smallskip\begin{center}\includegraphics[width=6cm,height=4cm,keepaspectratio]{work/img/20190410102545tfuizqe643km8rfdi8hkgx.jpg}\end{center}\smallskip
{\small \textbf{A.} Vehicle B ran a red light, so B bears full responsibility \quad \textbf{B.} Vehicle B may turn right, but must not obstruct through-traffic that has right of way, so B bears full responsibility \quad \textbf{C.} Through-traffic must not obstruct right-turning vehicles, so A bears full responsibility \quad \textbf{D.} The vehicle on the right has right of way, so A bears full responsibility}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：在下图所示的交通事故中，有关事故责任认定，正确的说法是什么？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Vehicle B may turn right, but must not obstruct through-traffic that has right of way, so B bears full responsibility  Right turns yield to left turns, left turns yield to through traffic, and turning vehicles yield to through traffic.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2401.}\ 
While driving, if you encounter a traffic accident ahead and help is needed, what should you do?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Try to detour and avoid it \quad \textbf{B.} Call the police immediately and just watch \quad \textbf{C.} Help protect the scene and immediately call the police \quad \textbf{D.} Speed past without paying attention}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：行车中遇有前方发生交通事故，需要帮助时，应怎样做？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. Help protect the scene and immediately call the police  Being ready to help others is a traditional Chinese virtue.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2402.}\ 
While driving, if you encounter an injured person at a traffic accident who needs rescue, what should you do?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Promptly send the injured to a hospital or call an emergency number \quad \textbf{B.} Try to avoid it and stay out of trouble \quad \textbf{C.} Drive around the scene \quad \textbf{D.} Make an excuse to avoid the scene}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：行车中遇交通事故受伤者需要抢救时，应怎样做？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Promptly send the injured to a hospital or call an emergency number  If there are injured people, an emergency number must be called immediately or they must be sent to a hospital.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2403.}\ 
In a property-damage traffic accident, how should traffic police handle it if the parties should have left the scene but did not?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Order the parties to leave the scene \quad \textbf{B.} Fine 200 yuan \quad \textbf{C.} Impound the motor vehicle \quad \textbf{D.} Detain}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车发生财产损失交通事故，对应当自行撤离现场而未撤离的，交警应如何处置？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Order the parties to leave the scene  If the vehicle should be moved but is not, traffic police can order it moved and fine 200 yuan.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2404.}\ 
In a traffic accident between motor vehicles causing property damage but no casualties, with a movable vehicle and no dispute between the two drivers, if one party is using a forged or altered license plate, the accident cannot be settled by private negotiation.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车之间发生的造成财产损失、尚未造成人员伤亡，且车辆可以移动的交通事故，双方驾驶人对交通事故无争议，但其中一方使用伪造、变造的号牌，不可以自行协商解决。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  A violation of the law should receive the corresponding penalty and cannot be settled privately.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2405.}\ 
If the parties did not report a traffic accident to the police at the scene and later ask the public security traffic management department to handle it, the department shall record it as required and decide whether to accept the case within how many days?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Three days \quad \textbf{B.} Five days \quad \textbf{C.} Two days \quad \textbf{D.} Ten days}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：当事人未在道路交通事故现场报警，事后请求公安机关交通管理部门处理的，公安机关交通管理部门应当按照相关规定予以记录，并在（）内作出是否受理的决定。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Three days  Whenever there is a dispute in a traffic accident, the police should be called immediately.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2406.}\ 
If a traffic accident causes only serious injury and the driver is willing to accept full responsibility, it can be settled by private negotiation.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：交通事故仅造成重伤且驾驶人愿意承担全部责任的，可自行协商处理。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  If a traffic accident causes casualties, the scene must be protected and the police must be called immediately.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2407.}\ 
After colliding with a building or public facility, as long as there are no casualties, the driver may leave the scene immediately.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车碰撞建筑物、公共设施后，只要没有人员伤亡，可即行撤离现场。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Leaving the scene immediately in this case will be treated as hit-and-run.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2408.}\ 
If a road accident causes no casualties or only minor property damage, and the basic facts are clear with no dispute over facts or cause, the parties may leave the scene immediately, restore traffic, and negotiate compensation privately.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车在道路上发生事故，未造成人身伤亡或仅造成轻微财产损失，基本事实清楚，当事人对事实及成因无争议的，可以即行撤离现场，恢复交通，自行协商处理损害赔偿事宜。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  If the scene is not left immediately, it should be reported quickly to the traffic police on duty or the traffic management department.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2409.}\ 
When driving and encountering a traffic accident ahead, you may detour via the emergency lane under the direction of traffic police.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：行驶中遇前方道路发生交通事故时，在交通警察的指挥下可从应急车道绕行。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  When traffic police are directing at the scene, their instructions take priority.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2410.}\ 
In a road traffic accident where the vehicle is difficult to move, what is the correct action?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Turn on hazard lights and place a warning sign behind the vehicle \quad \textbf{B.} Place a warning sign in front of the vehicle \quad \textbf{C.} Alternate high and low beams to alert other vehicles \quad \textbf{D.} Occupants should wait inside the vehicle for rescue}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车在道路上发生交通事故，难以移动时，正确的做法是？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Turn on hazard lights and place a warning sign behind the vehicle  For a breakdown: turn on hazard lights, move the vehicle aside, set up a warning sign, and have occupants leave the vehicle.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2411.}\ 
If a vehicle without a license plate on the road is involved in an accident, the police do not need to be called.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶未悬挂机动车号牌的车辆，在道路上行驶，发生事故可不报警。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  No stickers plus suspected drunk driving, if not obstructing traffic, can be handled otherwise; no plate or hitting a building requires protecting the scene and calling police promptly.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2412.}\ 
After a road traffic accident, while ensuring safety, occupants should be moved off the road to a safe place to avoid a secondary accident.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：当机动车在道路上发生交通事故后，在确保安全的情况下，应将车上人员疏散到路外安全的地方，避免造成二次事故。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  For an accident: turn on hazard lights, move the vehicle aside, set up a warning sign, and have occupants leave the vehicle.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2413.}\ 
If, during traffic accident mediation by the public security traffic management department, one party files a civil lawsuit with the People's Court, mediation shall be terminated.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：公安机关交通管理部门在交通事故调解期间，有一方当事人向人民法院提起民事诉讼的，应当终止调解。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  If one party files a civil lawsuit during mediation, mediation should be terminated.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2414.}\ 
If a road accident occurs and someone is on hand to direct traffic, a warning sign does not need to be set up.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：车辆在道路上发生事故，只要有人看守指引，可以不设置警告标志。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Warning signs must be placed 50 to 100 meters away on ordinary roads, and more than 150 meters away on expressways.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2415.}\ 
After a traffic accident with no casualties, if the parties have a dispute over the facts and cause, the police should be called immediately.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车发生未造成人身伤亡的交通事故后，当事人对事实及成因有争议的，应当立即报警。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  When the cause of an accident is unclear, the police should be notified promptly.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2416.}\ 
If a road traffic accident loss was intentionally caused by the victim, will the insurance company pay compensation?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} May pay compensation \quad \textbf{B.} Will not pay compensation \quad \textbf{C.} Must pay compensation \quad \textbf{D.} Must provide a subsidy}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：道路交通事故的损失是由受害人故意造成的，保险公司是否予以赔偿?}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Will not pay compensation  The insurance company will not compensate for a loss that was intentionally caused.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2417.}\ 
In a road traffic accident with no casualties and no dispute between the parties over the facts and cause, how should it be handled?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Leave the scene immediately and negotiate compensation privately \quad \textbf{B.} Keep the vehicle parked, protect the scene, and wait for traffic police \quad \textbf{C.} Protect the scene and ask the insurance company to assess the loss \quad \textbf{D.} The scene must not be left}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：在道路上发生交通事故，未造成人身伤亡，当事人对事实及成因无争议的，应当如何处理？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Leave the scene immediately and negotiate compensation privately  If the scene is not left immediately, it should be reported quickly to the traffic police on duty or the traffic management department.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2418.}\ 
If a motor vehicle traffic accident causes no casualties and both parties have no dispute, they must still wait at the scene for traffic police.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车发生交通事故未造成人身伤亡，双方当事人对事故无异议的，也要在现场等待交警处理。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  If the scene is not left immediately, it should be reported quickly to the traffic police on duty or the traffic management department.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2419.}\ 
If a party disputes compensation for a traffic accident and requests mediation from the public security traffic management department, within how many days from receiving the accident determination form must a written mediation request be submitted?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 3 days \quad \textbf{B.} 5 days \quad \textbf{C.} 10 days \quad \textbf{D.} 15 days}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：当事人对交通事故损害赔偿有争议，请求公安机关交通管理部门调解，在收到交通事故认定书之日起多少日内要提出书面调解申请？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. 10 days  If one party files a civil lawsuit during mediation, mediation should be terminated.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2420.}\ 
For a dispute over traffic accident compensation, the parties may request mediation from the public security traffic management department, or they may file a civil lawsuit with the People's Court.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：对交通事故损害赔偿的争议，当事人可以请求公安机关交通管理部门调解，也可以向人民法院提起民事诉讼。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  If a problem cannot be resolved directly, seek help from a government department.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2421.}\ 
When encountering a traffic accident ahead on the road, you may temporarily use the opposite lane under the direction of traffic police.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：遇前方道路发生交通事故时，在交通警察的指挥下可以临时占用对向车道。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  When traffic police are directing at the scene, their instructions take priority.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2422.}\ 
For a traffic accident between motor vehicles causing property damage or minor injury, where the vehicle can be moved, in which situation may it be settled by private negotiation?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} The vehicle has no license plate \quad \textbf{B.} The driver has no driving license \quad \textbf{C.} The driver has been drinking \quad \textbf{D.} The driver does not have their ID card with them}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车之间发生的造成车物损失或者人员轻微伤，且车辆能移动的交通事故，哪种情况适用自行协商解决？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. The driver does not have their ID card with them  Drivers must carry their driving license and the vehicle's registration document, but do not necessarily need to carry their ID card.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2423.}\ 
In heavy fog on an expressway, if an accident occurs and you cannot continue driving, what should you do?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Occupants should quickly exit through the left-side doors \quad \textbf{B.} Place a warning sign 100 meters in the direction of oncoming traffic \quad \textbf{C.} Turn on hazard lights and high beams \quad \textbf{D.} Occupants should stand outside the guardrail in a safe place}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：大雾天在高速公路遇事故不能继续行驶时怎样处置？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. Occupants should stand outside the guardrail in a safe place  For an accident: turn on hazard lights, move the vehicle aside, set up a warning sign, have occupants leave the vehicle, and call the police immediately.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2424.}\ 
A road traffic accident involving a motor vehicle that causes property damage but no casualties, with a movable vehicle, must wait for traffic police to handle it at the scene.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车在道路上发生的造成财产损失、尚未造成人员伤亡，且车辆可以移动的交通事故必须等待交通警察现场处理。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  By the Road Traffic Safety Law, if there is no dispute over facts and cause and no casualties, the parties may leave the scene immediately, restore traffic, and negotiate compensation privately.}\par\smallskip

\section{Additional Questions B \;/\; 补充题库 B}

\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2425.}\ 
For an accident vehicle whose evidence needs to be collected after a road traffic accident, the traffic police may lawfully impound it.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：对发生道路交通事故需要收集证据的事故车，交通警察可以依法扣留。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Traffic police may lawfully impound an accident vehicle in order to collect evidence.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2426.}\ 
Violating traffic safety laws while driving a motor vehicle on the road is a violation of the law.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车在道路上违反交通安全法规的行为属于违法行为。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  The official terminology no longer uses "minor infraction" or "irregularity", only "violation of the law".}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2427.}\ 
A driver who violates traffic transport management regulations and causes a major accident, resulting in significant loss of public or private property, may be sentenced to up to 3 years imprisonment or detention.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶人违反交通运输管理法规发生重大事故使公私财产遭受重大损失的可能处3年以下徒刑或拘役。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  It mainly depends on whether the driver fled and whether the flight caused death: no flight, up to 3 years; death followed by flight, 3 to 7 years; flight causing death, 7 years or more.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2428.}\ 
A person held criminally liable for a major traffic accident caused by drunk driving cannot apply for a motor vehicle driving license.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：酒后驾驶发生重大交通事故被依法追究刑事责任的人不能申请机动车驾驶证。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Do not drink and drive, do not drive after drinking.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2429.}\ 
If a driver is suspected of using another vehicle's insurance sticker, traffic police may lawfully impound the vehicle.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶人有使用其他车辆保险标志嫌疑的，交通警察可依法扣留车辆。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Using another vehicle's documents (registration certificate), plate, or stickers (inspection or insurance) allows police to impound the vehicle and fine 2,000 to 5,000 yuan.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2430.}\ 
A traffic accident caused by violating road traffic safety laws while driving is a traffic infraction.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车违反道路交通安全法律法规发生交通事故属于交通违章行为。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  The official terminology no longer uses the term "traffic infraction".}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2431.}\ 
For a vehicle using another vehicle's plate or registration document, traffic police may lawfully impound it.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：对使用其他车辆号牌、行驶证的车辆，交通警察可依法予以扣留。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Using another vehicle's documents (registration certificate), plate, or stickers (inspection or insurance) allows police to impound the vehicle and fine 2,000 to 5,000 yuan.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2432.}\ 
A major traffic accident caused by unlawful driving that constitutes a crime will not be prosecuted.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：对违法驾驶发生重大交通事故且构成犯罪的，不追究其刑事责任。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Any unlawful act constituting a crime is subject to criminal prosecution.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2433.}\ 
A driver who drives a motor vehicle drunk on the road shall be sentenced to 3 years or more of fixed-term imprisonment.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶人在道路上醉酒驾驶机动车的处3年以上有期徒刑。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Reckless racing with severe circumstances, or drunk driving, is punished with criminal detention plus a fine.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2434.}\ 
If a driver is suspected of using another vehicle's plate or registration document, traffic police may lawfully impound the vehicle.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶人有使用其他车辆号牌、行驶证嫌疑的，交通警察可依法扣留车辆。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Using another vehicle's documents (registration certificate), plate, or stickers (inspection or insurance) allows police to impound the vehicle and fine 2,000 to 5,000 yuan.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2435.}\ 
A driver who violates traffic transport management regulations and causes a major accident resulting in serious injury may be sentenced to up to 3 years imprisonment or detention.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶人违反交通运输管理法规发生重大事故致人重伤的可能判处3年以下徒刑或拘役。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  It mainly depends on whether the driver fled and whether the flight caused death: no flight, up to 3 years; flight or other severe circumstances (causing death), 3 to 7 years; flight causing death, 7 years or more.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2436.}\ 
If a driver lets someone whose license has been revoked drive their vehicle, traffic police will lawfully revoke the vehicle owner's driving license.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶人将机动车交给驾驶证被吊销的人驾驶的，交通警察依法吊销驾驶证。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Driving without a valid license, including a suspended or revoked one, is not allowed.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2437.}\ 
A driver who violates traffic transport management regulations, causes a major accident, and then flees or has other especially severe circumstances shall be sentenced to 7 years or more of fixed-term imprisonment.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶人违反交通运输管理法规发生重大事故后，逃逸或者有其他特别恶劣情节的，处7年以上有期徒刑。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  It mainly depends on whether the driver fled and whether the flight caused death: no flight, up to 3 years; flight or other severe circumstances (causing death), 3 to 7 years; flight causing death, 7 years or more.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2438.}\ 
If a driver accumulates 12 demerit points within one scoring cycle, traffic police will lawfully withhold the driving license.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶人在一个记分周期内累积记分达到12分的，交通警察依法扣留驾驶证。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Drinking and driving, or reaching 12 demerit points, results in the license being withheld.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2439.}\ 
Violating road right-of-way rules while driving a motor vehicle on the road should result in the corresponding penalty.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车在道路上违反道路通行规定应当接受相应的处罚。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Wrongdoing must be punished.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2440.}\ 
For a vehicle suspected of having a forged or altered plate or registration document, traffic police may lawfully impound it.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：对有伪造或变造号牌、行驶证嫌疑的车辆，交通警察可依法予以扣留。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Forging or altering a plate or registration document allows lawful impoundment, up to 15 days of detention, a fine of 2,000 to 5,000 yuan, and criminal prosecution if it constitutes a crime.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2441.}\ 
A driver who engages in reckless racing on the road with severe circumstances shall be sentenced to up to 3 years of fixed-term imprisonment.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶人在道路上驾驶机动车追逐竞驶，情节恶劣的处3年以下有期徒刑。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Both drunk driving and severe reckless racing are punished with criminal detention plus a fine.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2442.}\ 
Forging or altering a motor vehicle driving license, if it constitutes a crime, will lead to criminal prosecution.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：伪造、变造机动车驾驶证构成犯罪的将被依法追究刑事责任。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Any act that constitutes a crime will lead to criminal prosecution.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2443.}\ 
For a vehicle not insured under compulsory traffic insurance as required by state regulations, traffic police may lawfully impound it.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：对未按照国家规定投保交强险的车辆，交通警察可依法予以扣留。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Compulsory traffic insurance is legally mandated to ensure compensation is available after a traffic accident.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2444.}\ 
If a driver is suspected of using another vehicle's inspection sticker, traffic police may lawfully impound the vehicle.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶人有使用其他车辆检验合格标志嫌疑的，交通警察可依法扣留车辆。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Using another vehicle's documents (registration certificate), plate, or stickers (inspection or insurance) allows police to impound the vehicle and fine 2,000 to 5,000 yuan.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2445.}\ 
A driver who flees after causing a traffic accident and constitutes a crime will have their license revoked and can never obtain a driving license again.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：造成交通事故后逃逸且构成犯罪的驾驶人，将吊销驾驶证且终生不得重新取得驾驶证。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Memory aid: forged license revokes for 1 year, DUI-related revokes for 2, revocation-related for 3, drunk driving for 5, and hit-and-run bars a license for life.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2446.}\ 
A driver who violates traffic transport management regulations, causes a major accident, and flees causing death shall be sentenced to 3 to 7 years of fixed-term imprisonment.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶人违反交通运输管理法规发生重大事故后，因逃逸致人死亡的，处3年以上7年以下有期徒刑。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  First check whether the driver fled, then whether the flight caused death: no flight, up to 3 years; flight or especially severe circumstances, 3 to 7 years; flight causing death, 7 years or more.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2447.}\ 
If a driver lets someone whose license has been temporarily suspended drive their vehicle, traffic police will only give a verbal warning.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶人将机动车交给驾驶证被暂扣的人驾驶的，交通警察给予口头警告。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Driving without a valid license, including a suspended or revoked one, is not allowed.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2448.}\ 
A driver who violates traffic transport management regulations and causes a major accident resulting in death shall be sentenced to 3 years or more of fixed-term imprisonment.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶人违反交通运输管理法规发生重大事故致人死亡的处3年以上有期徒刑。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  It mainly depends on whether the driver fled and whether the flight caused death: no flight, up to 3 years; flight or especially severe circumstances, 3 to 7 years; flight causing death, 7 years or more.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2449.}\ 
For a vehicle suspected of using a forged or altered inspection sticker, traffic police will only issue a fine.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：对有使用伪造或变造检验合格标志嫌疑的车辆，交通警察只进行罚款处罚。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Any forged or altered item allows the vehicle to be lawfully impounded.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2450.}\ 
A blood alcohol content of 100 mg per 100 mL is considered drunk driving.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：当驾驶人的血液中酒精含量为100毫克/100毫升时，属于醉酒驾驶。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  A blood alcohol content of 20 to 80 mg per 100 mL counts as drinking and driving; 100 mg exceeds the drunk-driving threshold of 80 mg.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2451.}\ 
Driving a motor vehicle on the road in violation of the Road Traffic Safety Law is what kind of act?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} An infraction \quad \textbf{B.} A violation of the law \quad \textbf{C.} A negligent act \quad \textbf{D.} An irregularity}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车在道路上违反道路交通安全法的行为，属于什么行为？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. A violation of the law  When asked what kind of act it is, the correct choice is "violation of the law".}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2452.}\ 
For forcibly passing through a traffic control zone and ignoring warnings to stop, the public security traffic management department shall fine 200 to 2,000 yuan, and may additionally impose up to 15 days of detention.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：违反交通管制的规定强行通行，不听劝阻的，由公安机关交通管理部门处两百元以上两千元以下罚款，可以并处十五日以下拘留。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Common 200 to 2,000 yuan fine triggers: speeding by 50\% or more, fleeing after an accident without constituting a crime, unlicensed driving, driving an assembled or scrapped vehicle, letting an unlicensed person drive, etc.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2453.}\ 
For causing a traffic accident with one or more serious injuries where the driver bears full or primary responsibility, which of the following behaviors constitutes the crime of causing a traffic accident?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Not calling the police \quad \textbf{B.} Driving after drinking alcohol or using drugs \quad \textbf{C.} Not carrying the driving license \quad \textbf{D.} Not rescuing the injured}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：交通肇事致一人以上重伤，负事故全部责任或者主要责任，并具有下列哪种行为的，构成交通肇事罪？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Driving after drinking alcohol or using drugs  Any of these behaviors, combined with serious injury and full or primary responsibility, constitutes the crime: drunk/drugged driving, unlicensed driving, an unsafe vehicle, no plate or a scrapped vehicle, severe overload, or hit-and-run.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2454.}\ 
What penalty applies to reapplying for a driving license through concealment or deception?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Up to 15 days of detention \quad \textbf{B.} Confiscation of the vehicle registration document \quad \textbf{C.} A fine of 200 to 500 yuan \quad \textbf{D.} Criminal prosecution}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：以隐瞒、欺骗手段补领机动车驾驶证的，会受到下列哪种处罚？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. A fine of 200 to 500 yuan  Reapplying for a license by deception is punished with a fine of 200 to 500 yuan.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2455.}\ 
What penalty applies to reckless racing on the road with severe circumstances?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Criminal detention plus a fine \quad \textbf{B.} Public surveillance plus a fine \quad \textbf{C.} 1 year or more of imprisonment \quad \textbf{D.} 6 months of imprisonment}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车在道路上追逐竞驶，情节恶劣，会受到什么处罚？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Criminal detention plus a fine  Drunk driving or severe reckless racing on the road is punished with criminal detention plus a fine.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2456.}\ 
Which of the following situations will NOT result in the vehicle being impounded?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Not displaying the license plate as required \quad \textbf{B.} No insurance sticker displayed \quad \textbf{C.} Not carrying a fire extinguisher in the vehicle \quad \textbf{D.} Not carrying the vehicle registration document}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：下列哪种情形不会被扣留车辆？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. Not carrying a fire extinguisher in the vehicle  A vehicle must display its plate, inspection sticker, and insurance sticker, and carry its registration and driving license, or it will be impounded. Carrying a fire extinguisher is not one of these requirements.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2457.}\ 
A driver who violates traffic transport management regulations and causes a major accident, resulting in significant loss of public or private property, could face what penalty?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 5 years or more imprisonment \quad \textbf{B.} Up to 3 years imprisonment or detention \quad \textbf{C.} 3 years or more imprisonment \quad \textbf{D.} 3 to 7 years imprisonment}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶人违反交通运输管理法规发生重大事故使公私财产遭受重大损失，可能会受到什么刑罚？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Up to 3 years imprisonment or detention  It mainly depends on whether the driver fled and whether the flight caused death: no flight, up to 3 years; flight or especially severe circumstances (causing death), 3 to 7 years; flight causing death, 7 years or more.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2458.}\ 
Regarding penalties for drunk driving a motor vehicle, which of the following statements is incorrect?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} The public security traffic management department detains the driver until sober \quad \textbf{B.} The driving license is revoked \quad \textbf{C.} A new driving license cannot be obtained for 5 years \quad \textbf{D.} 6 demerit points are recorded}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：关于醉酒驾驶机动车的处罚，以下说法错误的是什么？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. 6 demerit points are recorded  Drunk driving results in 12 demerit points at once, license revocation, criminal prosecution, and a 5-year bar on reapplying, not 6 points.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2459.}\ 
Which of the following can constitute the crime of dangerous driving?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Running a red light \quad \textbf{B.} Unlicensed driving \quad \textbf{C.} Fatigued driving \quad \textbf{D.} Drunk driving}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：以下哪项行为可构成危险驾驶罪？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. Drunk driving  Drunk driving and severe reckless racing can constitute the crime of dangerous driving.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2460.}\ 
For causing a traffic accident with one or more serious injuries where the driver bears full or primary responsibility, which of the following behaviors constitutes the crime of causing a traffic accident?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Not reporting promptly \quad \textbf{B.} Severely overloaded driving \quad \textbf{C.} Not rescuing the injured \quad \textbf{D.} Not carrying the driving license}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：交通肇事致一人以上重伤，负事故全部责任或者主要责任，并具有下列哪种行为的，构成交通肇事罪？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Severely overloaded driving  Any of these behaviors, combined with serious injury and full or primary responsibility, constitutes the crime: drunk/drugged driving, unlicensed driving, an unsafe vehicle, no plate or a scrapped vehicle, severe overload, or hit-and-run.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}

For causing a traffic accident with one or more serious injuries where the driver bears full or primary responsibility, which of the following behaviors constitutes the crime of causing a traffic accident?\par

{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：交通肇事致一人以上重伤，负事故全部或者主要责任，并具有下列哪种行为的，构成交通肇事罪？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. Knowingly driving a vehicle with no plate/registration or one that has been scrapped  Any of these behaviors, combined with serious injury and full or primary responsibility, constitutes the crime: drunk/drugged driving, unlicensed driving, an unsafe vehicle, no plate or a scrapped vehicle, severe overload, or hit-and-run.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2462.}\ 
After driving continuously for 4 hours or more, a driver must rest for at least how long?\par

\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2463.}\ 
If a driver's unlawful driving causes a major traffic accident that constitutes a crime, what kind of liability will be pursued?\par

{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶人违法驾驶造成重大交通事故构成犯罪的，依法追究什么责任？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Criminal liability  Any unlawful act constituting a crime is subject to criminal liability.}\par\smallskip

If a driver does not carry which document while driving a motor vehicle on the road, may traffic police lawfully impound the vehicle?\par

\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2465.}\ 
A blood alcohol content of what level or higher is considered drunk driving?\par

{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. 80 mg per 100 mL  A blood alcohol content of 20 to 80 mg per 100 mL counts as drinking and driving; 80 mg or above counts as drunk driving.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2466.}\ 
Driving a motor vehicle across a double solid line is what kind of act?\par

{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车跨越双实线行驶属于什么行为？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. A violation of the law  Crossing a solid line violates the Road Traffic Safety Law and is therefore a violation of the law; the terms "infraction" and "irregularity" are no longer used officially.}\par\smallskip

\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2467.}\ 
Which of the following behaviors results in a fine of 200 to 2,000 yuan and revocation of the driving license?\par

\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2468.}\ 
Besides the prescribed fine, what other penalty applies to a driver who drives an assembled (illegally modified) motor vehicle on the road?\par

What is the penalty for reckless racing on the road with severe circumstances, or for drunk driving a motor vehicle on the road?\par

{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. Criminal detention plus a fine  Drunk driving or severe reckless racing is punished with criminal detention plus a fine.}\par\smallskip

If a driver violates traffic transport management regulations, causes a major accident resulting in death, and flees, what prison term applies?\par

{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. 3 to 7 years  It mainly depends on whether the driver fled and whether the flight caused death: no flight, up to 3 years; death followed by flight, 3 to 7 years; flight causing death, 7 years or more.}\par\smallskip

In which situation may traffic police lawfully confiscate a driver's license?\par

After a driver obtains a replacement driver's license and then drives using the original license, besides having the original license reclaimed by the traffic police, what other penalty applies?\par

If a driver violates traffic and transport regulations and causes a major accident resulting in serious injury or death, what criminal penalty may apply?\par

What penalty applies to a driver who drives an illegally assembled vehicle on the road?\par

In which situation may traffic police lawfully impound a vehicle being driven on the road?\par

What penalty applies to drunk driving of a motor vehicle on the road?\par

A driver on the road who fails to carry the driver's license and vehicle registration certificate: besides having the vehicle impounded, what other penalty applies?\par

Which of the following violations results in a 6-month suspension of the driver's license?\par

For an illegal parking violation already handled on the spot, one may apply to have the electronic camera penalty removed.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：因违法停车现场已被处理过的违法行为，可以申请消除电子眼处罚。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Demerit points can be removed for signal inconsistency, violations already handled on the spot, rescue or emergency avoidance, or theft or fraudulent use of the vehicle.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2530.}\ 
Driving 50\% over the speed limit is punished with a fine of 200 to 2,000 yuan, and may additionally result in revocation of the driver's license.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车行驶超过规定时速50\%时，处200元以上2000元以下罚款，可以并处吊销机动车驾驶证。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Common grounds for a 200 to 2,000 yuan fine include speeding by 50\%, non-criminal hit-and-run, unlicensed driving, driving an assembled or scrapped vehicle, and letting an unlicensed person drive.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2531.}\ 
A vehicle on the road not carrying the driver's ID card may lawfully have the vehicle impounded by traffic police.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：上路行驶的机动车未随车携带身份证的，交通警察可依法扣留机动车。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  The vehicle can be impounded for missing license, registration, stickers, or plates, not for a missing ID card.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2532.}\ 
If a highway passenger vehicle exceeds its approved passenger capacity and the traffic police department impounds the vehicle, the driver must transfer the excess passengers elsewhere. Who bears the cost?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} The traffic police department \quad \textbf{B.} The driver or owner of the overloaded vehicle \quad \textbf{C.} The passengers \quad \textbf{D.} The driver or owner of the passenger vehicle}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：公路客运车辆载客超过核定乘员，公安机关交通管理部门依法扣留机动车后，驾驶人应当将超载的乘车人转运，费用由谁承担？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. The driver or owner of the overloaded vehicle  Violating the Road Traffic Safety Law means the violator bears the consequences, including transfer costs.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2533.}\ 
Within how many days of receiving the administrative penalty decision for a fine must the party pay the fine at the designated bank?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 10 \quad \textbf{B.} 15 \quad \textbf{C.} 20 \quad \textbf{D.} 30}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：当事人应当自收到罚款的行政处罚决定书之日起几日内，到指定的银行缴纳罚款？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. 15  Upon receiving a penalty notice, the fine must be paid within 15 days.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{14\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2534.}\ 
[Image] The driver's manner of driving on the road shown in the picture is a minor violation.\par
\smallskip\begin{center}\includegraphics[width=6cm,height=4cm,keepaspectratio]{work/img/202112141652355q1cb8cebuhmvsydvygzf3.jpg}\end{center}\smallskip
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：图中驾驶人驾驶机动车上路行驶的做法，是一种轻微的违规行为。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Official terminology no longer classifies infractions as 'minor violations' in this way.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2535.}\ 
Driving while the driver's license is under suspension is punished with what fine by the traffic police department?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 20 to 200 yuan \quad \textbf{B.} 200 to 2,000 yuan \quad \textbf{C.} 1,000 to 2,000 yuan \quad \textbf{D.} 2,000 to 5,000 yuan}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶证被暂扣期间驾驶机动车的，由公安机关交通管理部门处多少元罚款？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. 200 to 2,000 yuan  Driving is prohibited whenever a license is lost, suspended, or revoked, and violations incur a 200 to 2,000 yuan fine.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2536.}\ 
Drunk driving of a non-commercial vehicle: the traffic police department revokes the driver's license, criminal liability is pursued according to law, and the driver is barred from reapplying for life.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：醉酒驾驶非营运机动车的，由公安机关交通管理部门吊销机动车驾驶证，依法追究刑事责任，并且终生不得重新取得机动车驾驶证。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Drunk driving of a non-commercial vehicle carries a 5-year reapplication ban, not a lifetime one.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2537.}\ 
Driving an illegally assembled vehicle on the road is punished with a fine of 200 to 2,000 yuan, and the driver's license is revoked.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶拼装的机动车上道路行驶，会处200以上2000元以下罚款，并吊销驾驶证。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Assembled and scrapped vehicles are barred from the road, and violations draw a fine plus license revocation.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2538.}\ 
A driver suspected of drinking, being drunk, or having taken state-controlled psychotropic or narcotic drugs must submit to testing and examination.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶人有饮酒、醉酒、服用国家管制的精神药品或者麻醉药品嫌疑的，应当接受测试、检验。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Driving is prohibited after drinking, taking controlled drugs, or with an illness impairing safe driving, so testing is required.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2539.}\ 
A driver who has had a small amount of beer may drive a short distance as long as it does not affect driving operation.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶人饮用少量啤酒，在不影响驾驶操作的情况下，可以短距离驾驶机动车。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  Drink and don't drive, drive and don't drink; any alcohol before driving is prohibited.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2540.}\ 
Letting a person whose license has been revoked drive the vehicle allows traffic police to lawfully impound the vehicle's registration certificate.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：将机动车交给驾驶证被吊销的人驾驶的，交通警察可以依法扣留其行驶证。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. Wrong  The penalty targets the driver's license, not the vehicle registration certificate; read the question carefully.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2541.}\ 
If, while a driver's license is lawfully seized, detained, or suspended, the driver obtains a replacement license by concealment or deception, what penalty applies?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Revoke the license \quad \textbf{B.} A fine of 20 to 200 yuan \quad \textbf{C.} A fine of 200 to 500 yuan \quad \textbf{D.} Revoke the vehicle registration certificate}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶证被依法扣押、扣留或者暂扣期间，采用隐瞒、欺骗手段补领机动车驾驶证的，会受到下列哪种处罚？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{C}. A fine of 200 to 500 yuan  Fraudulently obtaining a replacement license carries a fine of 200 to 500 yuan.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{判断题 / True or False}\ \textbf{2542.}\ 
A driver convicted of the crime of reckless racing, whose license was lawfully revoked, may not apply for a new license until 5 years have passed.\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Correct \quad \textbf{B.} Wrong}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶机动车追逐竞驶，构成犯罪的，依法被吊销机动车驾驶证未满五年的，不得申请机动车驾驶证。}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. Correct  Regulations bar reapplication for 5 years after a license revocation stemming from a crime such as reckless racing.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2543.}\ 
If a driver's physical condition changes to become unfit for driving but they continue to drive, what fine applies?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 20 to 200 yuan \quad \textbf{B.} 200 to 500 yuan \quad \textbf{C.} 1,000 to 2,000 yuan \quad \textbf{D.} 200 to 1,000 yuan}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：机动车驾驶人身体条件发生变化不适合驾驶机动车，仍驾驶机动车的，处多少元罚款？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{B}. 200 to 500 yuan  Regulations set a 200 to 500 yuan fine for driving despite a disqualifying change in condition, fraudulent replacement, or an overdue license review.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2544.}\ 
Which of the following results in a fine of 200 to 2,000 yuan plus revocation of the driver's license?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} Violating road right-of-way rules \quad \textbf{B.} Fleeing after causing a traffic accident \quad \textbf{C.} Driving without carrying a license \quad \textbf{D.} Letting an unlicensed person drive the vehicle}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：下列哪种行为会受到200元以上2000元以下罚款，并处吊销机动车驾驶证？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{D}. Letting an unlicensed person drive the vehicle  Letting an unlicensed, revoked, or suspended person drive is punished with a 200 to 2,000 yuan fine and license revocation.}\par\smallskip
\needspace{4\baselineskip}
\qtag{单选题 / Single choice}\ \textbf{2545.}\ 
A driver in the probationary period who tows a trailer is punished with what fine by the traffic police department?\par
{\small \textbf{A.} 20 to 200 yuan \quad \textbf{B.} 200 to 500 yuan \quad \textbf{C.} 500 to 1,000 yuan \quad \textbf{D.} 1,000 to 2,000 yuan}\par
{\footnotesize\color{zhgray} 中文：驾驶人在实习期内驾驶机动车牵引挂车的，由公安机关交通管理部门处多少元罚款？}\par
{\small\color{ansg}\hei 答案 Answer: \textbf{A}. 20 to 200 yuan  Regulations set a 20 to 200 yuan fine for using an old license after replacement or violating probationary-period restrictions such as towing a trailer.}\par\smallskip
